jobs.title: Applied AI AM Associate
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Job Specification — AI/ML Associate, ICB Risk Modelling

The ICB (International Consumer Banking) business within JPMorgan Chase has grown significantly since its launch in 2021, and we expect the business to expand further over the next few years. Join the expansion of the Chase digital bank across the UK and Europe, and help us continue to build our award-winning bank.

The ICB Risk Modelling team develops statistical and machine learning models to reduce fraud and credit risk within ICB. The team also engages with external vendors and supports the onboarding of vendor models, working through Model Governance to obtain the appropriate approvals for different uses. The team conducts model surveillance and provides insights to support regulatory requirements.

As an AI/ML Associate in the ICB Risk Modelling team, you will analyse business problems, develop and manage in-house machine learning models, and support the onboarding and management of vendor models to mitigate fraud and credit risk within ICB. You will work closely with product owners, risk officers, data engineers and software engineers, and collaborate with external vendors where needed, to ensure models are developed and managed in line with the firm's standards and perform effectively.

We are looking for someone with a strong foundation in statistics, machine learning and data analysis, who can understand and support the strategic objectives of large, complex organisations and work effectively within their data landscapes.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Develop in-house fraud and credit risk models end-to-end, applying statistical and machine learning techniques (e.g., regression, XGBoost/LightGBM and neural networks) across feature engineering, model training, testing and benchmarking, and deployment readiness.
* Support vendor model assessment and onboarding, where needed, as part of broader fraud and credit risk modelling activities. Evaluate and adopt state-of-the-art modelling approaches for fraud and credit risk, assessing model methodology, assumptions, inputs, limitations and performance. Contribute to vendor capability assessments where appropriate.
* Design and execute ongoing performance monitoring for in-house models and support ongoing monitoring of vendor models where needed. Analyse performance across relevant dimensions, including time, geography, portfolio and segment, channel, and customer and transaction or loan attributes, to track stability, drift and outcomes. Conduct root-cause analysis of emerging trends and performance shifts, quantify business impact, and communicate clear findings and recommendations to senior management and partners.
* Prepare and maintain model documentation and supporting materials for governance, audit and regulatory requirements, covering model development, oversight and surveillance. Support audit and other business functions on model management matters.
* Collaborate on projects with modelling teams across locations to maintain high standards in model development, reviews and re-reviews, monitoring, and model usage support. Ensure models are developed and used appropriately, in line with the firm's Estimation policies and procedures.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills**

* 3+ years' statistical Machine learning model development/validation experience in a deeply quantitative role in the financial services industry or Fintech's dealing with advanced analytical or machine learning methods.
* Experience developing or validating statistical and machine learning models in a highly quantitative role within financial services or fintech, using advanced analytical or machine learning methods.
* A master's degree or PhD in a technical or quantitative field, such as statistics, economics, finance, mathematics, computer science or engineering, from a top-tier university.
* A solid understanding of fraud and/or credit risk modelling in financial organisations, including the specific challenges and regulatory considerations involved.
* Proficiency in Python, with hands-on experience in data analysis and writing production-quality code.
* Extensive experience with machine learning and data analysis toolkits (e.g., NumPy, scikit-learn and pandas).
* Ability to effectively leverage generative AI tools to enhance productivity, analysis and problem-solving in day-to-day work.
* Strong written and spoken communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts and results to both technical and business audiences and collaborate effectively across teams.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills**

* Experience with model governance processes and model risk management frameworks.

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  
  
Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

jobs.title: Product Manager| Product| Bill Avenue
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Product Manager – Digital Payments & Financial Services**

**Company: AvenuesAI Limited**

**Location:** Mumbai, Maharashtra

**Department:** Product Management

**Experience:** 8–12 years

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Reporting To:** Head of Product / Business Head / Senior Management

**Role Overview**

**AvenuesAI Limited** is looking for an experienced and result-oriented Product Manager to manage and drive the development, enhancement and performance of its digital payment products and financial technology solutions.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in payment processing, digital payment ecosystems, prepaid payment instruments (PPI), banking and financial integrations, regulatory compliance and product operations.

The candidate will be responsible for managing the product lifecycle, identifying business opportunities, coordinating with technology and business teams, implementing product enhancements and ensuring seamless product delivery in line with business objectives, regulatory requirements and customer expectations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management**

* + Define and execute product strategies aligned with the company's business goals.
  + Manage the complete product lifecycle, from conceptualisation and requirement gathering to development, launch and post-launch performance monitoring.
  + Identify opportunities for new product development, enhancements and business expansion.
  + Prepare product roadmaps, business requirement documents (BRDs), product requirement documents (PRDs) and functional specifications.
  + Monitor product performance and recommend improvements based on business and customer feedback.

**2. Digital Payments & Financial Integrations**

* + Manage and drive payment products and integrations across BBPS, PPI and other applicable payment channels.
  + Coordinate with banks, NPCI, payment aggregators, technology partners and other financial institutions for product integrations.
  + Oversee payment workflows, transaction processing, settlement, reconciliation and exception management.
  + Ensure smooth implementation, testing and deployment of new payment features and integrations.
  + Identify and resolve product-related operational challenges affecting transaction success rates and customer experience.

**3. Product Development & Technology Coordination**

* + Work closely with technology, engineering, QA and operations teams to translate business requirements into product specifications.
  + Define product priorities, development milestones and implementation timelines.
  + Coordinate UAT, functional testing, integration testing and product acceptance.
  + Track product development progress and ensure timely delivery.
  + Identify system gaps, process bottlenecks and opportunities for automation.

**4. Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management**

* + Ensure product processes and functionalities are aligned with applicable RBI guidelines, NPCI regulations and other relevant regulatory requirements.
  + Work closely with compliance, risk and legal teams to implement regulatory changes.
  + Monitor transaction risks, fraud indicators, operational exceptions and control mechanisms.
  + Support internal, external and regulatory audits by maintaining appropriate product documentation and operational records.
  + Ensure appropriate controls are incorporated into product design and delivery.

**5. Business & Operational Performance**

* + Define and monitor product KPIs, including transaction success rates, transaction volumes, revenue, active users, turnaround time and customer complaints.
  + Analyse product performance and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and profitability.
  + Drive initiatives to improve customer and merchant experience.
  + Work with sales and business development teams to support product adoption, partner onboarding and revenue growth.
  + Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) for product-related processes.

**6. Stakeholder & Team Management**

* + Act as the primary coordination point between business, technology, operations, compliance and external partners.
  + Manage relationships with banks, payment networks, vendors and technology service providers.
  + Lead product review meetings and provide regular updates to senior management.
  + Guide and mentor team members involved in product operations and implementation.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* + Graduate degree in Business Administration, Finance, Commerce, Technology or a related discipline.
  + 8–12 years of experience in fintech, digital payments, banking, financial services or payment operations.
  + Strong understanding of digital payment systems, payment processing and settlement mechanisms.
  + Practical experience in UPI, IMPS, PPI and other payment integrations.
  + Experience in product onboarding, implementation, product enhancement and operational management.
  + Good understanding of RBI guidelines, NPCI processes, compliance requirements and risk management.
  + Proven experience working with technology, operations, business and compliance teams.

**Required Skills**

* + Product lifecycle and roadmap management
  + Digital payment ecosystem knowledge
  + Payment processing and reconciliation
  + UPI, IMPS, PPI and banking integrations
  + BRD, PRD and functional requirement documentation
  + UAT and product implementation
  + RBI and NPCI regulatory understanding
  + Risk management and fraud monitoring
  + Data analysis and KPI monitoring
  + Stakeholder and vendor management
  + Team leadership and problem-solving
  + Strong communication and decision-making skills

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated on the basis of:

* + Successful and timely delivery of product launches and enhancements.
  + Improvement in transaction success rates and payment processing efficiency.
  + Reduction in transaction failures, reconciliation issues and operational exceptions.
  + Timely completion of banking, NPCI and third-party integrations.
  + Compliance with applicable regulatory and internal control requirements.
  + Improvement in product adoption, customer experience and business performance.
  + Effective coordination with internal teams and external stakeholders.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

The preferred candidate should be a hands-on fintech professional with a strong understanding of the Indian digital payments ecosystem. The candidate should be capable of bridging the gap between business requirements and technology execution, while ensuring operational efficiency, regulatory compliance and sustainable product growth.

Experience in PPI services, UPI/IMPS integrations, payment settlements, banking partnerships and payment product implementation will be an added advantage.

jobs.title: Sitecore Engineer (Banking & Wealth, AI Enabled)
jobs.description:
**Location:** Chennai, India (offshore delivery for a UAE based client)

**Experience:** 4+ years of hands-on Sitecore development

**Domain:** Banking, Wealth Management, Fintech

**About the Role**

We are hiring a Sitecore Engineer to join the digital delivery team of a leading UAE bank, working from Chennai. You will build, customize and scale the bank's customer-facing web platforms, focusing on banking and wealth journeys. You will also help the team adopt Sitecore's AI features (Sitecore AI, formerly XM Cloud, and Sitecore Stream) to deliver content faster and personalize it better.

This role suits someone who is highly motivated, eager to learn, quick to adapt to changing requirements, and comfortable working in a cross-functional Scrum team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and maintain Sitecore websites and components using ASP.NET, C#, MVC and SQL
* Define and build Sitecore templates, page layouts, renderings and components following Helix architecture principles
* Implement custom rules, personalization and content targeting for retail banking and wealth customer journeys
* Customize and extend Sitecore content APIs, including GraphQL / Experience Edge, used by other applications such as mobile apps and partner platforms
* Build and support headless implementations using Sitecore JSS / Next.js where applicable
* Configure and integrate Sitecore AI features: AI assisted content generation and optimization, Brand Kits, and AI driven personalization through Sitecore Personalize and CDP
* Use AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot responsibly to improve delivery speed, code quality and test coverage
* Deploy and support Sitecore in scaled, multi environment setups (Azure, containers, CI/CD pipelines)
* Follow banking grade standards for secure coding, unit testing, code review and documentation
* Take an active part in Scrum ceremonies with the UAE team: sprint planning, daily stand ups, reviews and retrospectives
* Research and benchmark new technologies, and share knowledge to raise the productivity of the wider team
* Present technical ideas and solution options clearly to senior and executive stakeholders

**Must Have**

* Bachelor's or postgraduate degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent industry experience
* 4+ years of development and design experience on Sitecore
* Sitecore Certified Developer
* Strong skills in ASP.NET, C#, MVC and SQL
* Solid knowledge of Helix architecture and Sitecore development best practices
* Proven experience creating templates, pages and custom personalization rules
* Experience customizing Sitecore content APIs used by other applications
* Experience deploying and supporting Sitecore in a scaled enterprise environment
* Working experience in an Agile / Scrum team

**Good to Have**

* Exposure to Sitecore AI (XM Cloud), Sitecore Stream, Agentic Studio or Sitecore AI Search
* Hands-on experience with Sitecore Personalize, CDP or A/B testing for customer journeys
* Experience integrating LLM services such as Azure Open AI into web platforms, with awareness of data privacy and responsible AI controls in a regulated environment
* Headless experience with Sitecore JSS, Next.js and GraphQL
* Banking, financial services or fintech project experience in an enterprise setting
* Wealth management product knowledge: investments, mutual funds, bonds, structured products, priority and private banking propositions
* Familiarity with UAE banking regulatory expectations around security, accessibility and data handling

**Soft Skills**

* Self motivated and self starting; owns tasks end to end with minimal supervision
* Eager to learn and quick to adapt when requirements change
* Strong team player with an agile mindset and a drive for continuous improvement
* Able to influence teams on technical decisions by sharing deep knowledge
* Clear communicator who can explain technical ideas to senior and executive management

**Why Join**

* Work on high-visibility digital platforms for one of the region's leading banks
* Get hands-on with Sitecore's latest AI and composable capabilities
* Grow within a collaborative, Scrum-based engineering culture working with a UAE client team

**Senior Platform Engineer (AI Gateway, Identity & Observability)**

**Agentic AI Platform | Financial Services | Full-time**

*Experience: 8+ years overall, including 5+ years hands-on API platform, identity or observability engineering*

**ABOUT THE ROLE**
==================

We are building an enterprise agentic AI platform for a financial services client: the runtime, gateway, developer tooling and data interfaces that internal engineering teams will use to build and run AI agents in production.

You will build the control plane every agent passes through, regardless of where that agent runs. That means three connected things: the AI gateway that fronts all model traffic, the identity and registration path that governs which agents are allowed to call it, and the observability plane that makes the whole fleet visible and attributable.

These are deliberately held together in one position rather than split. The gateway is where identity is enforced and where much of the telemetry originates, so an engineer who understands only one of the three will build seams into what should be a single plane. You will be expected to work across all three, with depth in at least one and real working competence in the others.

This work is also the most time-critical on the platform: an external engineering team needs the gateway carrying production traffic early in the engagement, and the interface published to them cannot change afterwards.

This is a hands-on engineering position on a small, senior delivery team. It is not an oversight or coordination role.

**INDICATIVE RESPONSIBILITIES**
===============================

*The platform is being designed as the engagement progresses, so responsibilities will evolve. Indicative, and not limited to:*

**? Deliver the AI gateway** that routes model traffic across cloud-hosted models, other providers and on-premises inference, presenting one consistent, provider-agnostic interface to every consuming agent.

**? Implement gateway policy:** routing and backend pools, token-based rate limiting and quotas, retries, failover and circuit breaking, caching, and request and response transformation.

**? Harden an existing service for production** and run a controlled migration to the long-term gateway, moving consumers across without changing the contract they already integrated against.

**? Build the agent identity and registration path:** workload or service identity for agents, registration on deployment, and the promotion gate that governs what reaches production. Full automation is not assumed; part of the work is automating what can be automated and designing a clean, documented path for the steps that require human approval.

**? Design and implement the telemetry schema** and the OpenTelemetry pipelines that carry it, spanning agents in every runtime, so traces are consistent and attributable to an owning team.

**? Build the fleet view** showing each agent, its owner, version, environment, health and consumption, including the identifiers that make usage chargeable back to consuming teams.

**? Own the reliability view of the platform:** defining what good telemetry looks like, verifying that traces are complete and correctly attributed across every runtime, setting service level indicators and objectives for the gateway and the agent fleet, and building the alerting that surfaces failures, latency regressions and cost anomalies before consuming teams report them.

**? Apply guardrails at the gateway,** including content safety policy and a callout path to custom filtering services.

**? Establish the network and integration paths** the control plane depends on, including private connectivity or controlled egress to observability backends and third-party services, DNS and certificate handling, and the security review each path requires.

**? Load test and prove the gateway** under realistic production volume, and produce the runbooks and operational documentation the client will run it from.

**MUST HAVE**
=============

**? 5+ years hands-on engineering across API platforms, identity or observability,** with production depth in at least one and working competence in the others. All three areas are in scope for this position.

**? 4+ years building and operating API gateways in production:** routing, policy authoring, rate limiting and quotas, authentication, transformation and versioning. Azure API Management is strongly preferred; comparable depth in Apigee, Kong or an equivalent enterprise gateway is acceptable.

**? 3+ years enterprise identity and access engineering:** OAuth2, OpenID Connect and JWT validation, service principals and workload or managed identity, and secrets management using an enterprise vault.

**? 3+ years hands-on OpenTelemetry** or equivalent distributed tracing: instrumentation, collectors, resource attributes, span design, and trace, metric and log pipelines.

**? 3+ years in a site reliability, production engineering or platform operations role,** or equivalent hands-on responsibility for a service other teams depend on: service level objectives and error budgets, alerting design, on-call and incident response, and post-incident analysis. This position owns whether the telemetry is trustworthy, not only whether it is being collected.

**? 2+ years working with LLM or AI workloads in production,** including model routing across providers, token-based limits and quotas, streaming responses, content filtering, and how inference cost accrues and is attributed.

**? Experience with LLM observability tooling,** such as Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize or an equivalent platform, including how agent traces differ from conventional application traces.

**? 3+ years production API operations:** failover, circuit breaking, caching, load testing to prove capacity, and incident response for a service other teams depend on.

**? 2+ years integrating third-party or self-hosted services into an enterprise network,** including private connectivity or controlled egress, DNS resolution, TLS and certificate management, and working the firewall and security review needed to get each path approved.

**? Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure** on at least one major hyperscaler: networking, identity, container platforms and infrastructure-as-code.

**? Programming competence** in Python, C# or an equivalent language, sufficient to build and maintain policy extensions, callout services and instrumentation libraries.

**PREFERRED**
=============

Familiarity with Azure AI Foundry observability and Azure Monitor or Application Insights,** including agent tracing, continuous evaluation and how a managed observability plane compares with a self-hosted one such as Langfuse. This platform may run one, the other, or both, and the choice is still open.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Credit Analyst – Mortgages**

**About Yubi MENA**

Yubi is the world’s only technology company powering the end-to-end debt lifecycle. In the UAE, Yubi Mortgage operates as a premier digital mortgage marketplace connecting residents, UAE nationals, and non-resident homebuyers with 25+ leading retail, Islamic, commercial, and digital banks. By combining AI-driven underwriting tools, Business Rules Engines (BRE), and dedicated relationship management, we make home financing faster, simpler, and fully transparent.

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a detail-oriented Credit Analyst to join our Mortgage team in Dubai. Acting as the critical analytical and operational bridge between Yubi’s Relationship Managers (RMs), homebuyers, and our 25+ partner banks, you will evaluate borrower creditworthiness, verify mortgage application dockets, ensure strict compliance with UAE Central Bank (CBUAE) and partner lender policies, and drive smooth loan processing from pre-approval through to disbursement and registration.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Credit Assessment & Underwriting Support**

* Evaluate incoming retail and commercial mortgage applications (salaried, self-employed, resident, and non-resident profiles) against partner bank credit policies and Yubi’s Business Rules Engine (BRE) criteria.
* Calculate Debt Burden Ratios (DBR), Loan-to-Value (LTV) limits, net disposable income, and affordability metrics in alignment with CBUAE mortgage regulations.
* Analyze bank statements, AECB (Al Etihad Credit Bureau) credit reports, income proofs, and financial statements to identify credit risks, liabilities, or red flags early in the lifecycle.
* Draft accurate, structured Credit Appraisal Memoranda (CAMs) and recommend optimal partner lenders to RMs to maximize approval conversion rates.

**2. Document Scrutiny & Non-Discrepancy Verification**

* Conduct thorough pre-sanction and post-sanction scrutiny of loan files, including KYC documents, Emirates ID/passports, salary certificates, trade licenses, property valuation reports, Memoranda of Understanding (MOUs), and Title Deeds/Oqood.
* Maintain a high first-time-right (non-discrepancy) submission rate by screening files for completeness and accuracy before submission to partner banks.
* Follow up proactively with RMs and borrowers to resolve pending documents, lender queries, and sanction conditions within defined Turnaround Times (TAT) and SLAs.

**3. Disbursement, Islamic & Conventional Fulfilment Coordination**

* Support post-approval execution across both conventional mortgages and Islamic home finance structures (such as Ijarah and Murabaha), ensuring all security documents (PDCs, manager's cheques, settlement letters, and NOCs) are verified.
* Coordinate seamlessly with partner bank credit/operations teams, legal teams, developers, and trustees to track cases from Offer Letter issuance to final disbursement and DLD/municipality mortgage registration.
* Track Post-Disbursal Documents (PDD) and ensure timely closure of compliance requirements.

**4. MIS Reporting, Compliance & Platform Excellence**

* Maintain accurate application trackers, CRM updates, and daily Management Information Systems (MIS) reports covering pipeline status, approval ratios, discrepancy trends, and TAT performance.
* Ensure 100% adherence to UAE AML/KYC guidelines, internal Delegation of Authority (DOA) matrices, and partner bank regulatory standards.
* Provide feedback to Yubi’s Product and Tech teams to improve automated document classification, OCR accuracy, and BRE matching workflows.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Commerce, Accounting, Banking, Economics, or a related discipline (MBA/CA Inter/CFA Level 1 is a plus).
* Experience: 2 to 5 years of hands-on experience in mortgage credit underwriting, home finance operations, or retail loan processing within a UAE bank, mortgage brokerage, or fintech lender.

Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of UAE mortgage products (resident/non-resident home loans, buyouts/equity release, commercial mortgages), CBUAE DBR/LTV guidelines, and both conventional and Islamic (Ijarah) financing workflows.

* Technical Skills: High proficiency in Microsoft Excel (financial calculations, VLOOKUP, pivot tables), CRM/Loan Origination Systems (LOS), and AI-assisted document review tools.
* Core Competencies: Sharp analytical eye for detail, ability to manage high transaction volumes with zero errors, strong stakeholder communication skills, and comfort working in a fast-paced fintech environment.
* Languages: Fluency in English is mandatory; proficiency in Arabic or Hindi/Urdu is an advantage.

**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Overview:

Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. The core client segments of VCA include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintechs, payment enablers and governments.

Role Summary:

The Analyst for Digital, Strategy and AI supports the delivery of digital transformation, strategy and artificial intelligence (AI) engagements across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) region.

  

The Digital, Strategy and AI Consulting practice is a team of experts specializing in strategy and digital transformation topics, including but not limited to:

Strategy:

* Defining business, segment, channel and functional strategies, such as digital banking, affluent banking, loyalty, open finance, stablecoins and artificial intelligence.

Ideation:

* Supporting the innovation agenda of clients through foresight, strategic trends research and co-creation activities.

Value proposition design:

* Developing holistic offerings, including products, services and customer experience, for strategic consumer, business and corporate customer segments.

Customer experience and engagement:

* Developing best-in-class digital customer journeys and engagement strategies, including digital onboarding, end-to-end digital journey transformation, digital channel benchmarking and user interface and user experience enhancement.

Performance analytics:

* Improving client performance and process efficiency by deploying data, digital and AI tools.

Digital delivery:

* Supporting clients with the implementation of digital strategies, including the design and development of digital channels, generative AI (GenAI) use cases and proofs of concept.

Key Responsibilities:

* As an Analyst, you will work within project teams under the guidance of senior consultants and managers, contributing to research, analysis and the development of client deliverables.
* Support the delivery of digital, strategy and AI projects across the GCC, from scoping through to final recommendations.
* Conduct market, competitor and customer research, including benchmarking and trends analysis, to inform client recommendations.
* Gather, clean and analyze data from Visa and industry sources to generate insights that support client recommendations.
* Contribute to the problem-solving process, including structuring analytical frameworks and developing insight-driven recommendations.
* Build business cases and financial models that measure business performance and quantify return on investment (ROI).
* Prepare clear and compelling client presentations and reports that communicate findings and recommendations.
* Support the preparation and running of client workshops and stakeholder sessions, and document findings, decisions and next steps.
* Track project workplans and deliverables, and keep the project leadership informed of progress, risks and issues.
* Collaborate with Visa Account Executives and the Product, Value-Added Services (VAS), Marketing and other internal teams to deliver integrated solutions as One Visa.
* Contribute to proposals and responses to requests for proposal (RFPs), as well as practice thought leadership, points of view and case studies.
* Help build reusable toolkits, templates and best practice documents that can be applied across the VCA practice.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* At least 2 years of work experience in management consulting, preferably on financial services, payments, digital or AI projects.
* Degree from a leading university, preferably in business, economics, engineering, computer science or a related field.
* Professional proficiency in English.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, including building clear and compelling presentations, financial models and data analyses.
* Strong curiosity about AI, including GenAI and agentic AI, with hands-on experience using AI tools for research, analysis or content creation and an understanding of how to use them responsibly.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience working on projects in the GCC region.
* Exposure to digital transformation, strategy or digital banking projects.
* Knowledge of banking products, services, operations; payment schemes, services, card issuing and marketing initiatives.
* Strong interest in fintech and payments.
* Proficiency in Arabic is a plus.

What You Will Need to Be Successful:

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex problems and work with large data sets.
* Strong storytelling skills, with the ability to turn analysis into clear and compelling presentations.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Commercial awareness and an understanding of the financial indicators used to measure business performance.
* A collaborative, diplomatic and flexible working style, with the ability to work effectively in a matrixed organization.
* High attention to detail and a commitment to deliverables quality.
* Self-motivated and results-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines at the same time.
* Curiosity and a willingness to learn, take on feedback and develop new skills quickly.
* Ability to build strong working relationships with clients and colleagues.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Manager Internal Audit
jobs.description:
**Key Accountabilities**

* Audit planning and governance
  + Establish and maintain the Internal Audit Charter, audit methodology and risk-based annual audit plan for Board/Audit Committee approval.

  + Coordinate with du Group Audit on methodologies, specialist support and assurance coverage while maintaining accountability to du Pay’s Board.
  + Identify resource and specialist requirements, including technology, cybersecurity and financial crime expertise.
* Operational and regulatory assurance
  + Audit wallet operations, payments, cards, digital remittances, finance, treasury, settlement and customer service.
  + Assess customer fund safeguarding, float management, reconciliations, liquidity, applicable capital and guarantee requirements, and regulatory reporting.
  + Independently assess AML/CFT, sanctions screening, customer due diligence, transaction monitoring and suspicious reporting controls.
  + Review consumer protection, customer disclosures, complaints handling, fraud controls and compliance with licence conditions.
  + Assess technology governance, cybersecurity, access management, data protection, outsourcing, business continuity and disaster recovery.
* Partner products and distribution
  + Audit governance and controls supporting lending, investment and insurance partnerships.
  + Review partner due diligence, contractual responsibilities, regulatory permissions, service standards, audit rights and ongoing oversight.
  + Assess customer journeys, disclosures, consent, fees, commissions, complaints ownership and escalation arrangements.

jobs.title: Product Stream Lead - Payment Exceptions & Investigations
jobs.description:
**Organization:**
At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in other people’s financial wellbeing. Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward to progress. To make the right financial decisions and achieve their dreams, targets, and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organisation, your initiative, talent, ideas, and energy all contribute to the impact that we can make with our work. Together we can achieve great things.
  
  
**Job Title:**
Product Stream Lead - Payment Exceptions & Investigations
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Business & Team:**
Payments work brilliantly when everything goes right. The real test is what happens when they do not. A payment may be rejected, delayed, returned or held; a customer may send funds to the wrong account; an international payment may need to be traced or recalled; or an operations team may need to investigate an ambiguous payment state across multiple systems and external institutions. Today these journeys can span payment rails, customer and banker channels, payment platforms, operational work queues, case-management tools, risk teams and external financial institutions. We want to fundamentally change that experience.
  
  
Within the Payments Servicing Solutions Crew, we are shaping a channel-agnostic Payment Exception and Investigation capability that brings these journeys together. The ambition is one reusable product capability across Australian domestic and international payment exceptions - connecting customers, bankers, operations teams, payment platforms and external institutions while preserving clear system ownership and controls. This is an opportunity to build an enduring payments product, not simply deliver another workflow or operations screen. You will help shape a capability that can progressively move exception handling from manual investigation to intelligent assistance, straight-through processing and, ultimately, proactive exception prevention.
  
  
**Impact and Contribution:**
As Product Stream Lead - Payment Exceptions & Investigations, you will lead the product vision, strategy and evolution of this capability within the Payments Servicing Solutions Crew. You will connect customer insight, operational pain points, payments expertise, enterprise priorities, technology possibilities and risk considerations into a clear product strategy and executable roadmap.
  
  
You will lead across related squads and partner closely with Product Leads, Product Managers, Engineering, Architecture, Payments Operations, Digital Channels, frontline teams, Financial Crime, Risk, Legal and Compliance. You will create alignment around shared outcomes, make evidence-based investment and sequencing trade-offs, and ensure the product is run safely and sustainably.
  
  
The product vision extends beyond a new workbench. It is about creating an intelligent payment exception orchestration capability that can ingest and correlate events from multiple rails and channels, create a consistent case and investigation journey, orchestrate controlled resolution actions, provide transparent status back to customers and colleagues, and use data and intelligence to improve both resolution and prevention.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Define and communicate the product vision, strategy and multi-year roadmap for payment exceptions and investigations across domestic and international payments.
* Lead cross-squad prioritisation, sequencing and investment trade-offs, balancing customer value, operational efficiency, risk reduction, technology simplification and commercial outcomes.
* Build reusable product capabilities rather than point solutions for individual rails, channels, systems or operational teams.
* Deeply understand how exceptions arise across payment initiation, execution, settlement, investigations, trace and recall, returns, repairs, failed payments and servicing journeys.
* Shape simple experiences for retail and business customers, bankers/frontline colleagues, investigators and payment operations teams, with consistent status and required-action visibility across channels.
* Lead product outcomes for case and investigation management, event intake and correlation, workflow orchestration, operational work management, evidence and audit, communications and controlled resolution actions.
* Identify journeys that can move from manual handling to assisted resolution and straight-through processing, with clear policy, eligibility, approval and control boundaries.
* Partner with Engineering and Architecture to shape scalable APIs, event-driven integration, reusable channel experiences and clean ownership boundaries between servicing channels, exception orchestration and payment execution platforms.
* Explore practical applications of AI and agentic workflows for context reconstruction, classification, summarisation, investigation planning, next-best-action, response drafting and cross-case root-cause intelligence.
* Ensure AI-enabled outcomes are explainable, evidence-backed, auditable and appropriately bounded by human accountability and risk controls.
* Use customer, operational and product data to identify exception patterns and upstream causes, creating a prevention backlog that reduces avoidable exceptions over time.
* Define and own measurable outcomes including resolution time, STP rate, repeat contact, touches per case, queue ageing, SLA performance, customer-update timeliness, control effectiveness, colleague adoption and exception reduction.
* Coach and develop Product Leads and Product Managers, building strong product discipline and a culture of ownership, curiosity and continuous improvement.

**Essential Skills:**

* 14+ years of industry experience
* Bring significant product leadership experience, leading complex products or value streams from strategy through execution and value realisation.
* Have strong payments expertise, including domestic and/or international payments, processing, settlement and servicing.
* Understand payment ecosystems such as NPP, BECS/Direct Entry, BPAY, RTGS/HVCS, SWIFT and correspondent banking.
* Have experience across payment investigations and exceptions, including trace and recall, returns, repairs and failed or mistaken payments.
* Have built or transformed workflow, servicing, case-management or platform products within regulated financial services.
* Can turn fragmented processes and legacy journeys into scalable product capabilities, balancing long-term vision with pragmatic delivery.
* Have driven automation and straight-through processing across complex operational journeys.
* Bring strong commercial judgement and can make clear investment, prioritisation and scope trade-offs.
* Can influence across Product, Technology, Operations and Risk, embedding controls and operational resilience into product design.
* Are curious about AI and emerging technology, while distinguishing genuine customer and operational value from hype.
* Build high-performing teams and coach and develop product talent.

**Payments, Automation & Emerging Technology**
This is not an AI-first role. It is an opportunity to shape how automation and emerging technology can safely transform a complex, high-volume payments environment.
  
  

* Move journeys from manual handling toward intelligent assistance, bounded automation and straight-through processing.
* Determine where deterministic workflows are best and where AI can improve investigations, context-building and next-best actions.
* Explore agentic and orchestration approaches while retaining appropriate human oversight.
* Establish clear guardrails around approval, explainability, traceability, auditability, privacy and access.
* Use exception and outcome data to move from exception resolution toward exception prevention.

**The Mindset We’re Looking For**

* Think product, not project: Build enduring capabilities and measure outcomes, not just delivery.
* Start with the customer:

Senior experience leading or advising BFS transformation, industry solutions, domain consulting, product, operations or technology programs.

A proven record of engaging senior stakeholders in India and internationally, with the credibility to advise business, product, operations and technology leaders as a peer.

Deep BFS domain and operating-model knowledge across the front, middle and back office, with working knowledge of core platforms, data, cloud, digital channels, payments, risk, compliance and RegTech.

A strong record of shaping large change and transformation programs with measurable impact on outcomes such as cost-to-income, cycle time, straight-through processing, control effectiveness, customer experience and revenue growth.

Practical depth in financial-services AI and GenAI, including where it creates value, where it does not, and how to prove and scale outcomes through PoCs and PoVs.

Ability to shape and sell propositions internally and externally, build business cases, secure sponsorship, navigate complex stakeholder groups and lead solution narratives.

Strong commercial understanding of large programs, including proactive propositions, RFPs and RFIs, solution defense, pricing trade-offs, TCV and revenue impact.

Experience working effectively across geographies and time zones, mobilizing matrixed teams and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to create executive-ready content and lead senior client conversations.

Willingness to travel within India and internationally as business needs require.

**Preferred experience**

Leadership experience within, or significant advisory experience serving, a Global Capability Center in India.

Experience advising Product Management and Digital Product Management organizations on product strategy, operating-model design, value realization and digital product innovation.

Experience building domain-led solutions or consulting capabilities that have been deployed across multiple geographies.

Financial-services M&A, post-merger integration, captive setup, capability transition or GCC transformation experience.

Embedded finance, Banking-as-a-Service, fintech partnership or ecosystem experience.

Experience engaging industry analysts, advisors and external forums.

**Leadership approach**

Engages clients as a peer, brings a clear point of view and changes it when the evidence changes.

A high-impact India leadership role within the global BFS Industry Solutions Group, with direct exposure to senior organizational and client leadership.

The opportunity to shape how the organization engages the rapidly evolving GCC ecosystem in India and connects GCC capabilities to global business priorities.

A mandate to build India as a global hub for BFS domain expertise, propositions, thought leadership and reusable solution assets.

The breadth that comes from working across financial institutions, GCCs, geographies and business models rather than within a single organization.

The opportunity to apply AI and GenAI to real banking problems at scale and turn successful approaches into repeatable solutions.

A visible platform across client, GCC, analyst, advisor and industry forums.

An open and transparent culture

jobs.title: Business Head - BFSI
jobs.description:
Business Head – BFSI | OTPless

Bengaluru or Mumbai · On-site · 8–12 years

**ABOUT OTPLESS**

OTPless builds the authentication, identity and trust infrastructure for digital businesses. We power login and user journeys for Zepto, Meesho, Ixigo and ShareChat, we run 300Mn+ silent verifications a month, and we're backed by General Catalyst, FJ Labs, SIDBI, Amrish Rau and Kunal Shah. We were founded by the founding team at BharatPe.

Authentication is where we started — Smart Auth is live across some of India's largest consumer and financial businesses. Our next growth engine is OTPless Watch, a device and risk intelligence platform that combines device fingerprinting, app protection, telecom and IP signals, and identity data to help businesses spot suspicious activity and make better risk decisions. Watch sits right next to Smart Auth, so businesses get authentication and fraud intelligence from one place.

**THE ROLE**

We're hiring a Business Head to own the entire OTPless BFSI business — the full vertical, end to end, across Smart Auth, Watch and everything we take to market in financial services.

You'll own the BFSI P&L outright: the strategy, the revenue, the customers and the roadmap. That means growing and deepening our existing Smart Auth footprint in BFSI, and opening the next frontier with Watch — starting with fintechs and NBFCs, then banks and insurance. You'll find the market, prove the products, carry the number, and build the business.

You won't be starting from zero. Smart Auth is already live in production with Navi, Paytm and Bajaj, which gives you relationships, reference customers and a running start to expand across the vertical and pull Watch into live accounts.

This is a hands-on ownership role — you'll lead the biggest deals yourself and work directly with the CBO and the founders, with real influence over product, pricing and strategy.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* The business. The full BFSI P&L — strategy, revenue growth and ownership across the vertical. You decide which fintechs, NBFCs, banks and insurers to go after, grow the accounts we already have, build the relationships that matter across Product, Risk, Fraud and Business teams, and set the pricing and commercial models that make the motion repeatable.

* The market fit. Run discovery with real buyers, find the use cases where OTPless wins, and work directly with the Product and Engineering teams to turn what you hear into roadmap. Use our live Smart Auth relationships to expand accounts and pull Watch into them.

* The deals. Lead consultative engagements end to end — discovery, solution design, technical evaluation, POC, commercial close and expansion — across the full OTPless stack. Prove measurable outcomes, not demos.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

Above all, someone who can own and grow a BFSI business — a builder who carries revenue, closes senior deals and can be trusted with the full vertical. Beyond that, we're looking for:

Domain & experience

* 8–12 years across product, growth, strategy or business roles, with real ownership of revenue or outcomes
* Deep experience in fintech, payments, UPI, digital lending, NBFCs, banking or insurance, and a real grasp of the Indian BFSI ecosystem
* A track record on products or deals involving fraud, risk, trust and safety, identity, authentication or digital onboarding
* Live relationships inside fintechs and NBFCs; connections into banks and insurers are a plus

Product & technical depth

* You don't have to code, but you're technically credible — you can sit with an engineer, understand how it works, and shape what gets built
* Comfort with APIs, SDKs, device intelligence, fingerprinting, SIM binding, risk scoring and digital onboarding flows
* You can translate what a customer needs into product requirements, and work with Product and Engineering to get it built

Business & growth instinct

* You turn market opportunities into revenue — hunting new logos and growing the accounts you already have
* Strong consultative selling, senior stakeholder management and commercial negotiation
* An entrepreneurial streak — you can operate alone, build from nothing, and own the outcome end to end

**STRONG SIGNALS**

This is likely to fit people coming from:

* Payments & fintech: Juspay, Razorpay, PhonePe, Paytm, Cashfree, CRED
* Lending & NBFCs: Navi, KreditBee, Fibe, Lendingkart and other tech-led lenders
* Fraud, risk & identity: Bureau, SHIELD, Signzy, HyperVerge, IDfy, GoKwik
* Banks & financial institutions: product, digital banking, payments and fraud-risk leaders

We're especially keen on product, growth and strategy people who've worked close to business, tech and risk teams and now want to own a business, not a backlog.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (FIRST 6 MONTHS)**

* A clear BFSI strategy and target-account universe across the full OTPless portfolio
* Existing Smart Auth accounts grown and deepened, with measurable revenue
* 5–10 lighthouse fintech/NBFC wins across Smart Auth and Watch, with banks and insurers seeded in the pipeline
* A repeatable business development and account-growth motion
* Validated high-value use cases that have moved the product roadmap
* Real cross-sell between Smart Auth and Watch

**WHY OTPLESS**

You'll own an entire vertical with real P&L responsibility, at the intersection of payments, identity and fraud — three of the spaces moving fastest in Indian financial services. You build on top of an authentication platform and customer base that already exist, not a blank page.

You'll work directly with the CBO and the founders — the founding team behind BharatPe — backed by General Catalyst, FJ Labs, SIDBI, Amrish Rau and Kunal Shah. It's early enough that you shape the business, the product and the commercial model, with the autonomy and ownership of a founder and the backing of a company that's already at scale.

If you're ready to move past managing a product and own a business, let's talk.

jobs.title: Head of Product, PhonePe Wealth
jobs.description:
**About PhonePe**
At PhonePe our vision is to provide financial inclusion to a billion Indians. Today we have made significant progress on this vision by making digital payments far simpler and ubiquitous than it has ever been. However we wish to make it so easy, safe, and universally accepted that people never feel the need to carry cash or cards again. And not just in Urban India. At PhonePe, our aim is to transform the entire Indian landscape so that every Indian, in every corner of the country, makes significant economic progress. Onwards and upwards! That is our goal.
  
  
**About PhonePe Invest**
PhonePe Invest is rebuilding trading and investing for India. It's a full-stack broking platform — stocks, F&O, ETFs, mutual funds, IPOs, and Wealth Baskets — with a research and intelligence layer (factor analysis on every stock, expert-curated baskets) sitting on top. It's a separate app from the main PhonePe one, and it's backed by PhonePe's reach, trust, and distribution.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Opportunity:**
As a Director of Product at PhonePe Invest, you will own and drive the roadmap for our PhonePe Invest products catering to for first time investors to seasoned traders. This is a hard but interesting product and design problem. You're working with regulated financial products, real money, and a spectrum of users that runs from a first-time investor buying their first stock to an active trader running F&O strategies. The job is to make something genuinely powerful feel calm and trustworthy — not to bolt more features onto a busy screen.
  
  
You will work with other pod members and a diverse set of stakeholders towards a collective set of objectives. We work on complex technology, scale while iterating quickly and have a bias for impact in everything we do. Leading our PhonePe Invest product portfolio, you will be working with leaders in PhonePe ecosystem to determine the portfolio product strategy. You will be responsible for evangelizing and aligning all the cross-functional stakeholders on the strategy and plans and work on the execution and delivery to realize the identified opportunity and impact.
  
  
You'll own all aspects of Product and Design for PhonePe Invest end to end. Today that means you, the craft, and a close partnership with Business, Engineering and regulated ecosystem.This is a hands-on leadership role, not a manage-from-a-distance one. As the product grows, you'll build and lead the team around it.
  
  
You'll set the Product and Design direction, ship the work yourself when it matters, and be the person accountable for the quality of the experience for all the users. You'll report to the Head of Engineering and work alongside the broader PhonePe org.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**As a Director of Product, you will:**

* Define a portfolio product strategy from first principles that becomes the org’s reference point; drives multi-pod execution and measurable portfolio outcomes
* Identify and deliver multiple Annual Operating Plan-shaping bets; consistently make correct profitability vs growth calls across portfolio, shift business trajectory with durable levers (pricing, distribution, unit economics, cost-to-serve)
* Design pod-level org structure and capability plan that materially increases throughput and quality; shape cross-functional Hiring AOP with high accuracy; prevent bottlenecks before they form.
* Build a strong leadership bench; direct reports consistently progress levels. Establish pod-wide talent mechanisms with counterparts that raise performance across functions.
* Design and evolve the pod operating system (planning, decision forums, execution reviews, launch readiness, learning loops) with measurable improvements in reliability and speed.
* Demonstrate thought leadership and be the go to person for product decisions for internal and external stakeholders.
* Engage with external customers and stakeholders, communicate objectives and progress.
* Own the experience. Set the bar for what best looks like on PhonePe Invest, and hold it. Strategy, flows, visual craft, microcopy — you're accountable for all of it.
* Ship, don't just direct. Get into the file. Design the experience for our users e2e to give them maximum efficiency and wow during their financial, investment and trading journeys. Prototype to find the answer rather than arguing about it in a doc.
* Make complex things simple. Turn dense financial data and regulated flows into something a first-time investor trusts and a serious trader respects. This is the core craft of the job.
* Partner closely. Work shoulder to shoulder with Business and engineering as an equal. Bring the user's point of view to roadmap and tradeoff conversations early, not at the end.

**What we look for:**

* Excellent communication skills.
* At least 15+ years of experience in Product / Platform building and development.
* Strong business acumen and ability to partner with cross-functional teams.
* Contributes to business decisions regularly and proactively.
* Can build credibility via knowledge and judgment to persuade others.
* Conducts interviews for PM/SPM roles and for specific competencies.

**Additional Information**
**Culture:**
At PhonePe, we take extra care to make sure you give your best at work, Everyday! And creating the right environment for you is just one of the things we do. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. Being enthusiastic about tech is a big part of being at PhonePe. If you like building technology that impacts millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. **Title And Summary**

* Wallet UI and Wearables
* Merchant Presented QR (MPQR)

* Token Service Providers (TSP)

* Manage modifications to vendor contracts or agreements, engaging legal when required.

* Manage the Global Test Bench Identifier (GTBI) tool and ensure timely delivery to labs.

* Maintain product approval databases and tracking files, proposing and implementing continuous improvement ideas.
* Implement AI/Agent in our daily support activities and operations (when possible).

Education
  
  

* University degree in Engineering or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree preferred.

Professional Background
  
  

* 9+ years’ experience in quality assurance, project management, or business process engineering.
* Industry exposure in one or more of the following: software development, financial services, telecom/mobile, e commerce.

Technical & Domain Expertise
  
  

* Strong understanding of digital payment systems.
* In depth knowledge of chip card technology and EMV specifications.
* Familiarity with testing and approval methodologies is essential.

Core Skills
  
  

* Excellent analytical and business writing skills.

* Business acumen and ability to provide solutions while managing customer expectations.
* Strong presentation and communication skills, with clarity in explaining concepts and processes.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering | Technology Delivery Leadership — Azure Cloud, Web Applications, Salesforce, and Payments
jobs.description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a seasoned technology leader to serve as Senior Manager, Software Engineering. This role is accountable for end-to-end delivery across Azure Cloud, modern web applications, Salesforce, and payment platforms. The successful candidate will combine strong technical expertise with disciplined execution, build high-performing engineering teams, and coordinate complex initiatives across multiple functions and geographies. This leader will translate business priorities into scalable technology outcomes while strengthening engineering practices, operational resilience, security, and accountability.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end execution: Own planning, architecture alignment, engineering delivery, testing, release readiness, production launch, and post-production stabilization for a portfolio of strategic initiatives.
* Drive multi-platform delivery: Provide leadership across Azure Cloud services, web application ecosystems, Salesforce capabilities and integrations, and payment processing platforms.
* Translate strategy into outcomes: Partner with product, business, architecture, security, risk, operations, and infrastructure leaders to convert priorities into roadmaps, executable plans, and measurable results.
* Strengthen engineering excellence: Champion scalable architecture, secure coding, automation, CI/CD, observability, performance engineering, reliability, and disciplined software development lifecycle practices.
* Build high-performing teams: Recruit, develop, coach, and retain engineers; establish clear expectations, empower decision-making, and create succession and capability-development plans.
* Coordinate globally: Align teams, vendors, dependencies, and stakeholders across multiple geographies and time zones, ensuring clear ownership, effective handoffs, and timely escalation of risks and decisions.
* Manage delivery health: Establish transparent governance for scope, schedule, quality, budget, capacity, dependencies, risks, and technical debt; use metrics to guide decisions and continuous improvement.
* Own operational outcomes: Ensure platforms meet availability, resilience, security, compliance, recovery, and support expectations; lead effective incident response and root-cause remediation.
* Influence technology direction: Evaluate emerging technologies, guide build-versus-buy decisions, and shape modernization plans that balance innovation, maintainability, cost, and risk.
* Communicate with impact: Provide concise, data-driven updates to senior leaders and stakeholders, surfacing trade-offs and enabling timely decisions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Proven technology delivery experience, including significant experience leading engineering teams across multiple projects/initiatives in parallel.
* Demonstrated success delivering complex, enterprise-scale programs from concept through production and ongoing operations.
* Strong working knowledge of Azure Cloud architecture and services, cloud-native design, integration patterns, APIs, and DevSecOps practices.
* Experience overseeing modern web application delivery, including front-end, back-end, security, performance, accessibility, and production support considerations.
* Experience with Salesforce platforms, custom development, integrations, release management, and governance.
* Experience with payment ecosystems, including transaction flows, integrations, reconciliation, resiliency, security, and regulatory or control requirements.
* Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, resolve cross-team dependencies, and lead distributed teams across geographies.
* Strong financial, vendor, resource, risk, and change-management capabilities.
* Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and decision-making skills.

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

We are seeking a visionary and execution-focused
**Manager / Senior Manager – Product Design**
to elevate the end-to-end design experience across our digital ecosystem.

Position Overview

The incumbent will be responsible for shaping Anand Rathi's digital product experience, visual identity, and customer journeys across mobile applications, web platforms, and other digital touchpoints.

The role will encompass multiple design disciplines, including:

* Product and UX Design
* UI and Visual Design
* Customer Journey and Interaction Design
* Design Systems and Accessibility
* Conversion-Led and Behaviour-Driven Experiences

The position will work closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Analytics, and Business teams to deliver world-class digital experiences that enhance customer engagement, trust, and conversion.

Key Responsibilities

1. Design Strategy

* Define and execute the overall design vision and strategy, aligned with business growth and digital transformation objectives.
* Establish design standards, governance frameworks, and best practices across digital platforms.
* Champion a customer-first, design-led culture across the organization.

2. User Experience & Product Design

* Develop and optimize UX strategies for mobile applications, trading platforms, onboarding journeys, and investor tools.
* Simplify complex financial workflows into intuitive and seamless customer journeys.
* Drive usability, accessibility, and frictionless navigation across digital products.
* Ensure a consistent omnichannel experience across websites, mobile applications, WhatsApp, email, and other customer touchpoints.

3. Customer Journey & Conversion Optimization

* Map and optimize customer journeys across acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention.
* Identify and reduce customer drop-offs across onboarding, KYC, account funding, trading, and investment journeys.
* Apply behavioural design principles to improve customer activation, trading frequency, and cross-selling opportunities.
* Collaborate with analytics teams to conduct A/B testing and continuously improve conversion rates.

4. Design Systems & Visual Identity

* Develop and maintain scalable design systems to ensure consistency across all digital platforms.
* Enhance brand perception through clean, modern, intuitive, and trustworthy financial interfaces.
* Ensure visual consistency while adhering to brand guidelines and regulatory compliance requirements.

5. Research, Insights & Data-Driven Design

* Lead user research, usability testing, and customer feedback analysis to identify user pain points.
* Collaborate with product analytics teams to translate customer behaviour and insights into actionable design improvements.
* Continuously improve digital experiences based on user insights, performance metrics, and market trends.

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Work closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Business teams to deliver seamless digital experiences.
* Collaborate with digital marketing and growth teams to optimize landing pages, conversion funnels, and campaign journeys.
* Ensure design feasibility, smooth execution, and effective implementation in coordination with engineering teams.

7. Innovation & Future-Ready Experiences

* Stay updated on global fintech design trends, emerging technologies, and innovative interaction paradigms.
* Introduce innovative digital experiences, including:
* Intelligent dashboards and personalized user experiences.
* Contextual nudges, recommendations, and financial insights.
* Simplified investing and trading journeys.
* Drive business differentiation through experience-led innovation and continuous design improvements.

Experience & Qualifications

* 5–8 years of experience in UX/Product Design, including design leadership responsibilities.
* Proven experience in leading design initiatives for consumer-facing BFSI digital platforms.
* Experience in fintech, stock trading platforms, wealth management, or banking is preferred.
* Strong design portfolio demonstrating UX excellence and measurable business impact.
* Experience in building, mentoring, and scaling design teams and design systems.
* Familiarity with financial products, investment platforms, and investor behaviour will be an added advantage.

Skills & Competencies

* UX Strategy and Interaction Design.
* Conversion and Behaviour-Driven Design.
* Mobile-First and Responsive Design.
* Design Systems and Accessibility.
* Strategic Thinking with Strong Execution Focus.
* Customer-Centric Mindset.
* Data-Driven Decision Making.
* Stakeholder Management and Influencing Skills.

***Ready to shape India’s Premier lending strategy across cards mortgages and loans?***

  

**Why HSBC**

  

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

  

**The Role**

  

Head of Lending, India IWPB, shapes HSBC’s International Wealth and Premier Banking lending business across credit cards, mortgages and unsecured loans. Based in Mumbai and reporting to the Head of IWPB, India the role sets strategy that meets the borrowing needs of affluent and emerging affluent customers while delivering sustainable growth and attractive risk-adjusted returns. You’ll own commercial and operational performance end-to-end - from product pricing and distribution through servicing and collections. Working closely with business and control functions you’ll strengthen digital journeys and ensure fair customer outcomes within HSBC’s risk appetite and regulatory requirements. Success looks like a well-balanced portfolio with strong customer engagement healthy portfolio quality and clear evidence-based governance and controls.

  

What you'll be doing

  

* Define the India IWPB lending strategy across credit cards mortgages and unsecured loans
* Translate strategy into annual plans budgets and measurable KPIs across growth income profitability engagement and portfolio quality
* Set customer acquisition ambition with targets by product and channel and deliver within agreed risk appetite
* Own the business plan and financial outlook including income costs impairment and returns on capital
* Shape product propositions for Premier and affluent customers ensuring they are differentiated customer-relevant and commercially viable
* Strengthen transparency and simplification across pricing fees terms and conditions and key customer journeys
* Partner with Marketing Distribution and Digital to build go-to-market plans and improve digital and assisted-channel access
* Oversee portfolio quality through monitoring concentrations arrears losses provisioning and recoveries using early-warning indicators
* Embed effective affordability indebtedness and suitability assessment and coordinate early support for customers in financial difficulty
* Govern approvals and material change across policy pricing campaigns credit models outsourcing and operational and technology change
  

**What we're looking for**

  

* Bring senior leadership experience in retail banking consumer finance or wealth-related lending with accountability for a material portfolio in a regulated environment
* Demonstrate delivery of sustainable growth and improved customer outcomes while managing budgets pricing and risk-adjusted returns
* Apply portfolio analytics to evaluate performance identify emerging risks and take timely action
* Partner effectively with Risk Compliance Finance Operations and Technology within a complex regulatory environment
* Influence senior stakeholders across business and control functions and contribute in management and governance forums
* Oversee product and operational performance across the credit lifecycle from acquisition and underwriting through servicing and collections
* Embed regulatory conduct data privacy and resilience requirements into lending operations and decision-making
* Establish clear accountabilities decision rights and development focus across a lending team including succession planning
  

**Building India’s lending portfolio**

  

This role gives you the scope to set direction for HSBC’s IWPB lending business in India and turn strategy into measurable commercial and customer outcomes. You’ll shape propositions and journeys customers rely on for important life decisions while maintaining strong governance and portfolio quality. If you want to own performance end-to-end and partner across functions to improve digital journeys and operational scalability we’d like to hear from you.
