jobs.title: Lead Associate,Institutional Client Strategy & Insights.
jobs.description:
**Lead Associate,Institutional Client Strategy & Insights.**
============================================================

Req ID: 128715

Department: Insto Relationship International Client Insights

Division: Institutional

Location: Bengaluru

**About Us**
------------

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our customers. Our Institutional bank helps our largest customers move trade and capital around the region, providing our people with great opportunities to build their technical expertise and their careers.

**About the Role**
------------------

The Client Insights & Solutions (CIS) team develops actionable insights and solutions that help priority Institutional clients achieve their strategic objectives and manage challenges. The team supports ANZ Institutional to originate higher-returning transactions, improve cross-sell and deepen senior client engagement, and to differentiate ANZ as a leading relationship bank.

  

The Lead Associate is a senior member of the Bengaluru CIS team with team leadership responsibilities. The role leads complex client analyses and initiatives, acts as a subject matter expert in capital structure, liquidity, M&A, credit and risk management, and manages, mentors and develops Senior Associates (Group 4.4) and Associates (Group 5.1) in the team.

  

The Lead Associate works closely with the Head of CIS Bengaluru, the onshore CIS teams and senior stakeholders, relationship bankers and product partners to deliver the broader goals of the CIS team.

  

The role contributes to ANZ 2030 priorities: customer-first propositions, simplicity and productivity, resilience and strong risk management, and higher-returning growth. It does this through high-quality, insight-led work for Institutional clients, efficient delivery through the global operating model, building team capability, and strong quality and risk discipline

  

Role Type: Permanent  
Role Location: Bengaluru

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

As a Lead Customer Insights Associate, you will have the opportunity to:

  

* Lead financial, credit and industry analysis for priority Institutional clients, including capital structure optimisation, M&A assessment, credit analysis, financial modelling, working capital reviews and sector research.
* Translate complex data into clear, client-ready insights that support origination, cross-sell opportunities and senior client engagement.
* Review financial models and client materials to ensure accuracy, quality and relevance.
* Develop client presentations and industry campaigns that support relationship banking and product teams.Partner with Relationship
* Bankers, Product Specialists and onshore CIS teams to understand client needs, define deliverables and drive outcomes.
* Maintain effective stakeholder communication and proactively manage timelines and priorities.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives across Relationship, Product and Business Execution teams.
* Incorporate stakeholder feedback to continuously improve deliverables and client value.
* Mentor and coach Analysts and Senior Analysts, supporting project delivery and professional development.
* Review team outputs to ensure high-quality, client-ready standards.
* Promote collaboration, continuous improvement and knowledge sharing across Bengaluru and onshore teams.
* Drive process improvements, automation opportunities and analytical tool enhancements.
* Support a strong risk and compliance culture by adhering to ANZ policies and identifying and mitigating risks

**What will you bring?**
------------------------

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:

  

* 8+ years in a similar or related role, preferably in Institutional Banking or Financial Services
* Experience managing, mentoring or supervising analysts or associates, through direct line management or project-based team leadership
* Capital structuring, risk assessment and credit-rating or shadow rating experience (S&P Global, Moody's, Fitch methodologies)
* Exposure to Debt Capital Markets and risk management products, including advising on FX, interest rate and commodity price risk
* Preparation of pitch books, client presentations, credit papers or research reports; supporting relationship bankers and onshore or cross-border teams
* Data analysis, visualization or process automation, and experience with financial databases and research platforms
* Industry qualifications (e.g. CFA) are highly regarded
* Leadership capability, including coaching, quality review and managing work to successful outcomes
* Structured, evidence-based approach, with attention to detail and ownership of output quality

**So why join us?**
-------------------

ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.

  

We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services.

  

We want to continue building a diverse workplace and welcome applications from everyone. Please talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you are a candidate with a disability or access requirements, let us know how we can provide you with additional support.

jobs.description:
**Product Manager, Input Zone**

  

**About our Team:-**

DSM Product is the product management team within Data Source Management (DSM, led by Adrian Scotney), part of Data Operations (led by Kanwar Singh). It is led by the Head of Product Management and owns product management for how publisher content enters the Input Zone, Elsevier’s governed gateway for academic publisher content. This includes technical onboarding, ingestion development, publisher rights data (Salesforce) and the Platform Intelligence reporting that supports content providers.

The team is organised around three areas: Platform Intelligence (PLINT), Salesforce/SCM, and the Content Acquisition Liaisons functions that cover ingestion development and technical onboarding.

  

**About the Role:-**

The Product Manager, Input Zone will own the technical onboarding and ingestion-development activities for the Content Acquisition Liaisons group and lead execution of related workstreams. They will own the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow, represent this area within the PM team, and have a solid understanding of content providers and publishers. They will represent their technical needs to the delivery team, prioritise and communicate production issues affecting ingestion or onboarding, and support and participate in demos to key stakeholders at programme milestones.

  

**Responsibilities:-**

  

**Customer Focus**

* Interacts with content providers, publishers, and internal engineering teams during technical onboarding and represents their requirements.

* Anticipates onboarding and ingestion needs (for example, journal processing moving to the DPOP-601 workflow and the Scopus transition off the legacy OpsBank workflow) and prioritises them for the group.

* Acts as a named Onboarding Technical Liaison, fielding technical questions from content providers and publishers during negotiation so engineering capacity stays focused on implementation.

* Focuses on meeting onboarding timelines without compromising the completeness or quality of ingested content.

**Data-Driven Decision-Making & Analysis**

* Autonomously analyses onboarding, delivery, and completeness-checking data from multiple sources (content providers, engineering, Governance reporting).

* Compares and evaluates ingestion and onboarding options, and makes recommendations that consider business implications.

* Uses AI tools responsibly to accelerate analysis, and validates the results before acting on them.

**Onboarding & Content Acquisition Lifecycle**

* Communicates technical requirements and timelines clearly to negotiation and engineering stakeholders.

* Coordinates with the LeapSpace negotiation team, system test team, and OpsBank test team on technical onboarding execution once a negotiation concludes.

* Answers internal and provider-facing questions on ingestion capability, manifest handling, and onboarding scope.

* Prioritises and communicates production issues and defects affecting ingestion or onboarding, based on relevant data.

**Product Delivery & Development Lifecycle**

* Leads execution of the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow.

* Defines and prioritises requirement changes for engineering and performs analysis to meet acceptance criteria.

* Authors clear, testable specifications (requirements, acceptance criteria, manifest and validation rules) as the shared source of truth for engineering and AI-assisted development, in line with spec-driven development (SDD).

* Reviews AI-assisted outputs (generated specs, test cases, prototypes) against requirements and is accountable for their quality before they reach engineering.

* Participates in product discovery and process improvement, and contributes to prototypes (for example, content provider manifest ingestion and PDF identification).

* Is familiar with SDLCs identified by management, for example agile processes.

**Strategy & Commercial Acumen**

* Contributes to the strategy and development plans for ingestion and technical onboarding, shared across the roles carrying the Onboarding Technical Liaison responsibility.

* Understands the operating cost and effort involved in onboarding a new content provider or source.

* Makes links between personal goals and the team and business strategy.

**Technical Skills**

* Understands the Input Zone's data and technical architecture — publisher drop zones, ingestion validation, and the downstream handoff — well enough to liaise credibly with engineering.

* Uses technologies to assist day-to-day tasks (Excel, SQL, Jira, Confluence; familiarity with Salesforce/Snowflake rights data flows and sFTP/S3 publisher landing zones).

* Has working experience with generative AI tools and AI-assisted development workflows (for example prompt design, specification-to-code generation, AI-supported testing) and understands their limitations, including accuracy, data confidentiality, and publisher-content handling.

* Ability to engage developers to understand technology constraints.

**Competencies**

**Personal Capability**

**Practices Self-Development**

* Is curious and keen to learn and develop new ideas, skills, and knowledge.

* Acts on feedback to improve him/herself.

* Looks for developmental opportunities in day-to-day work.

* Invests time and energy in self-development (professional qualifications, relevant reading, networking, keeping up with AI-assisted product and development practices).

**Solves Problems and Analyses Issues**

* Is able to ask effective questions and collect facts from multiple sources in order to solve problems.

* Is able to effectively identify and analyse problems and propose solutions.

* Effectively manages day-to-day issues and problems without intervention.

**Innovates**

* Brainstorms with others to look for different approaches to current processes and tasks.

* Looks for opportunities to develop new ideas or thinking within own role.

* Experiments with new ideas, including applying AI and SDD to onboarding and ingestion workflows, and shares what works with the team.

**Interpersonal Skills**

**Communicates Powerfully and Prolifically**

* Demonstrates effective conversational skills, including active listening and questioning.

* Shares information relevant to own role.

* Participates in team presentations.

**Collaboration and Teamwork**

* Develops co-operative working relationships within the team.

* Considers how own style affects others and tailors interactions accordingly.

* Looks for ways to develop mutually beneficial relationships across teams.

**Builds Relationships**

* Is approachable and friendly.

* Asks for opinions of others.

* Participates in formal and informal gatherings to meet new people and develop new relationships.

**Inspires and Motivates Others to High Performance**

* Brings enthusiasm to the team.

* Gets to know others in the team and what is important to them.

* Observes behaviours and models self after others.

* Leads by example by performing at high levels.

**Focus on Results**

**Drives for Results**

* Works hard to achieve objectives.

* Stays focused on key commitments.

* Looks to overcome obstacles or barriers to performing.

* Works with others to achieve joint goals.
  

**Requirements:** -

**Suggested minimum years of PM experience:** 4-6 years

**Critical Experiences**

* Recognised as full owner of a technical onboarding, ingestion, or comparable technical-liaison feature area.

* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks, projects, and priorities, and to work with engineers, content providers, publishers, or negotiation teams to modify or maintain a product and identify technology challenges.

* Hands-on experience applying AI tools in product management work, such as specification writing, analysis, or prototyping.

* Experience writing or working from specifications in a spec-driven or specification-first delivery mod

jobs.description:
Designation: Chief Manager

Location: India Tamil Nadu Adyar - Chennai

Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title**
=============

**Zonal Sales Manager (South) - IndusInd Bank Affluent & NRI Channel**

**Location**
------------

South India (Chennai) handles all four states of South.

**Reporting To**
----------------

National Sales Head - IndusInd Bank Relationship

**Role Purpose**
================

Lead the South India region for ABSLI's strategic partnership with IndusInd Bank's Affluent, HNI, and NRI Banking segments. The incumbent will be responsible for driving life insurance penetration across the bank's affluent customer base by building strong engagement with banking leadership, enhancing frontline capability, driving sales productivity, and ensuring sustainable business growth.

The role requires deep expertise in bancassurance, wealth management, relationship selling, and team leadership to establish ABSLI as the preferred insurance partner within IndusInd's affluent banking ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

### **Business Development & Revenue Growth**

* Drive insurance sales across Affluent, Imperia, HNI, and NRI customer segments.
* Deliver annualized premium targets (APE/FYP) for South India.
* Increase wallet share within the affluent customer base.
* Build a robust opportunity pipeline from wealth, investment, and protection-led discussions.
* Drive high-ticket and protection-focused product penetration.

### **Relationship Management**

* Manage relationships with Zonal Heads, Regional Heads, Cluster Heads, and Wealth Leaders of IndusInd Bank.
* Position ABSLI as a strategic partner within the bank's affluent business model.
* Conduct regular business reviews with banking stakeholders.
* Ensure alignment of branch priorities with insurance business objectives.

### **Team Leadership**

* Lead a team of Regional Managers and Relationship Managers across South India.
* Drive productivity and capability building.
* Coach teams on HNI sales conversations and financial planning discussions.
* Build a high-performance sales culture.

### **Capability Development**

* Upskill bank relationship managers on:
  + Financial protection planning
  + Estate planning solutions
  + Retirement planning
  + Wealth transfer concepts
  + NRI insurance solutions
  Tax-efficient insurance products

### **Sales Governance**

* Ensure compliance with IRDAI regulations.
* Monitor suitability and quality parameters.
* Drive persistency and customer retention.
* Maintain healthy business mix and reduce concentration risks.

### **Customer Engagement**

* Conduct HNI customer meets, wealth seminars, and investment forums.
* Participate in client acquisition and portfolio review events.
* Engage with key customers for large-ticket closures.

**Key Result Areas (KRAs)**
===========================

**KRA**

  
  

New Business Premium (APE/FYP) Achievement

  
  

Affluent & HNI Customer Acquisition

  
  

Product Mix & Protection Penetration

  
  

Active Branch Productivity

  
  

Banker Activation & Engagement

  
  

Team Productivity & Retention

  
  

Persistency & Quality Metrics

  
  

Stakeholder Relationship

  
  

**Critical Challenges of the Role**
===================================

### **1. New Partnership Establishment**

* Building mindshare and trust for ABSLI within an existing banking ecosystem.
Competing with legacy bancassurance relationships and established insurers.  

### **2. Affluent Customer Expectations**

* HNI and NRI customers demand advisory-led conversations rather than transactional selling.
Higher scrutiny on product suitability and value proposition.  

### **3. Banker Engagement**

* Securing mindshare from affluent bankers already focused on liabilities, investments, and AUM acquisition.
Maintaining insurance visibility amidst competing priorities.  

### **4. Geographic Complexity**

* Managing multiple states, languages, and diverse customer demographics across South India.

### **5. High Ticket Closure Cycles**

Longer sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, family members, and financial advisors.  



### **6. Wealth vs Protection Balance**

* Driving sustainable protection business while meeting premium targets.
Avoiding overdependence on single-premium or investment-oriented sales.  

### **7. NRI Business Development**

Navigating regulatory processes, documentation requirements, and customer accessibility challenges.  



### **8. Talent & Capability Building**

* Developing teams capable of engaging affluent customers on sophisticated financial planning topics.

**Desired Candidate Profile**
=============================

### **Experience**

* 10-15+ years in Wealth Bancassurance.
* Minimum 5 years in a leadership role.
* Strong experience with HNI, Emerging Affluent, Wealth, or NRI segments.
Proven track record of managing large geographies and partnerships.  

### **Preferred Background**

* Bancassurance leadership.
* Insurance distribution leadership.

### **Key Skills**

* Strategic Sales Leadership
* Wealth & Protection Planning
* Stakeholder Management
* Relationship Management
* Team Development
* Negotiation & Influence
* Business Planning
* Data-Driven Sales Management

**Success Profile (First 12 Months)**
=====================================

The ZSM should be able to:

* Establish ABSLI as a preferred insurance partner within IndusInd's Affluent Banking ecosystem.
* Activate 80-90% of targeted affluent banking locations in South India.
* Build a strong pipeline of HNI/NRI business.
* Deliver target APE/FYP with healthy protection mix.
* Develop a high-performing regional sales team.
* Create sustainable banker engagement and referral generation mechanisms.

jobs.title: Vice President - Business Management, Design Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Our Business Management team acts as a trusted advisor to senior leaders and optimizes business performance by helping to drive key initiatives. We act as a counterweight to business and group heads and are responsible for identifying, escalating, and mitigating business risks. The role is dynamic and can vary from business to business, in line with the priorities of different lines of business. This is a time-pressured and high-profile position, instrumental in assisting and advising senior management. You will help coordinate the deployment of corporate resources to address strategic and tactical objectives.

Job summary

As a **Business Management** professional within the **Business Management team**, you will help drive strategic and tactical objectives by coordinating corporate resources and advising senior management. You will implement new business strategy, strategic initiatives, or platforms by aligning partners across Finance, Technology, Operations, Legal, and Compliance. You will optimize bottom-line performance by driving key initiatives related to fees, cost base, risk-weighted assets, and capital utilization. You will identify, escalate, and mitigate business risks that could impair the ability to do business, including legal, tax, regulatory, capacity issues, and extraordinary transaction costs. You will partner across functions to define future workflows and implement related technology and infrastructure projects to support an evolving market structure.

Job responsibilities

* **Implement** new business strategy, strategic initiatives, or platforms, including aligning department and support groups (Finance, Technology, Operations, Legal, Compliance)
* **Optimize** bottom-line business performance by driving key initiatives (fees, cost base, risk-weighted assets, and capital utilization)
* **Identify** business risks that could impair the ability to do business and **escalate and mitigate** those risks (e.g., legal, tax, regulatory, capacity issues, extraordinary transaction costs)
* **Analyze** financial performance, including expenses; **identify** productivity initiatives and **drive** implementation
* **Partner** with the business, Operations, and Technology to define future workflows and **implement** related technology and infrastructure projects to prepare for evolving market structure requirements
* **Partner** with relevant external service and infrastructure providers
* **Represent** the business in internal and external working groups

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or other related area
* Previous product knowledge and/or prior Business Management or Chief Operating Officer experience
* Energetic and dynamic style
* Highly motivated self-starter with excellent time management and prioritization skills
* Ability to present well to senior and global business heads
* Ability to forge strong internal relationships across a broad range of functions
* Self-motivated, tenacious, and able to work with a high degree of independence
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Ability to define and deliver a strategic agenda across multiple groups
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including ability to analyze large data sets and present conclusions concisely
* Excellent project management and organizational skills, with strong attention to detail and a logical thought process

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**  
  
  

Our Consumer & Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.

  

Global Finance & Business Management works to strategically manage capital, drive growth and efficiencies, maintain financial reporting and proactively manage risk. By providing information, analysis and recommendations to improve results and drive decisions, teams ensure the company can navigate all types of market conditions while protecting our fortress balance sheet.

jobs.title: Director - Credit Product Lead, CEMEA
jobs.description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Director, Credit Product Lead for CEMEA will define and lead Visa’s regional credit product agenda across Central Europe, Middle East and Africa. The role will work closely with Regional and market leadership, Product, Advisory, Analytics, Risk and other cross-functional partners to accelerate sustainable credit growth across a highly diverse set of markets.
  
  
Credit growth is a key pillar of Visa’s 2030 strategy, and CEMEA represents one of the high potential regions for credit growth. This role will help determine where and how Visa captures that opportunity by identifying the priority markets, customer segments and product propositions for the next three to five years. With global credit card issuance continuing to expand, Visa is positioned to capture a disproportionate share of that growth if the right strategic, commercial and capability foundations are established now.
  
  
The role holder will translate this ambition into a practical regional strategy and market-level execution plans, combining Visa’s network, data, products, advisory capabilities and partnerships to expand responsible access to credit and strengthen client economics.
  
  
Directors in Product Development/Management at Visa are responsible for leading the development, commercialization, and optimization of technology products within the payments ecosystem. This role requires deep expertise in product strategy, design, and execution, with a focus on delivering innovative solutions that address customer needs and drive business growth. Directors operate in complex, matrixed environments, collaborating across functions to define product goals, manage lifecycles, and ensure successful launches and ongoing enhancements.
  
  
The position demands strong analytical and problem-solving skills, the ability to navigate ambiguity, and a proven track record of recruiting, growing, and retaining technical talent. Directors are expected to drive consensus in cross-functional teams, forecast business trends, and translate insights into agile technology solutions. Exceptional communication and leadership skills are essential for influencing stakeholders and building credibility across regional and functional lines.
  
  
All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and drive the CEMEA credit product strategy, including market prioritization, segment choices, product roadmap and commercial model with a three-to-five-year growth agenda.
* Drive multiple levers of credit growth across diverse CEMEA markets, spanning countries with established/ mature credit businesses as well as emerging but high potential markets.
* Accelerate credit adoption across emerging markets by enabling new-to-credit consumers and issuers through innovative and non-traditional credit products and propositions. This may include instalment-led, secured, ecosystem-based and alternative underwriting models that broaden access to responsible credit.
* Support clients with the capabilities required to build, launch and scale sustainable credit businesses, including proposition design, acquisition, underwriting and portfolio strategy driving usage and risk-adjusted profitability.
* Develop structured client upskilling programs that combine Visa expertise, data, advisory support, playbooks and market best practices, tailored to the maturity and regulatory context of individual CEMEA markets.
* Build market-level opportunity assessments and business cases using consumer research, Visa data, competitive intelligence, portfolio economics and regulatory insights; convert these into clear investment and execution priorities.
* Partner with Country Management, Sales, Product, Visa Consulting and Analytics, Risk, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Government Engagement and regional product teams to secure alignment and deliver coordinated execution.
* Engage senior client stakeholders at financial institutions/fintechs, regulators and ecosystem partners to identify barriers to credit expansion and develop scalable solutions.
* Establish performance metrics and governance for the regional credit agenda, track pipeline and portfolio outcomes, and provide regular updates and recommendations to CEMEA leadership.
* Act as a trusted advisor and subject-matter expert on card and payments-linked credit, sharing global and regional best practice and representing CEMEA in global credit product forums.

**Qualifications**

* 12 or more years of experience including 5+ years building and managing cards and payments-linked credit businesses, with accountability for strategy, product development, portfolio performance and commercial outcomes.
* Deep understanding of the credit value chain, including customer segmentation, proposition design, acquisition, underwriting, portfolio and line management, pricing, activation, engagement, collections, risk and profitability.
* Strong knowledge of payments economics and lending business P&L; experience across multiple CEMEA markets or comparable emerging and developed markets is highly desirable.
* Proven ability to translate strategy into market-level execution. This would include prioritization, business-case development, product launch, client commercialization and performance management.
* Strong client leadership and executive communication skills, with the ability to influence senior internal and external stakeholders across different cultures and market contexts.
* Strategic thinking, strong analytical capability and financial acumen, with confidence using data to frame opportunities, make trade-offs and measure outcomes.
* Track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in a matrixed organization and delivering against demanding timelines.
* Self-directed, collaborative and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment with a broad regional remit.
* Bachelor’s degree required; an MBA or other relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

In this strategic leadership role, you will define the product vision, shape the roadmap, and drive initiatives that improve customer experience and business performance.

jobs.title: Group Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Group Product Manager / AVP – Product**

**Engagement – Trading & Loyalty | Remote**

**About the Organisation**

We are a well-established, fast-growing global financial technology organisation focused on making financial markets more accessible to retail investors and traders.

Our mission is to empower a new generation of investors with the knowledge, tools, technology, and market access they need to make informed trading and investment decisions with confidence.

With over two decades of experience in online trading and a substantial international customer base, the organisation provides access to multiple asset classes, including equities, commodities, foreign exchange, and other financial instruments.

Operating across several international markets, the business combines an entrepreneurial culture with a diverse, globally distributed workforce. We offer an environment that encourages ownership, innovation, professional development, and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

**Role and Responsibilities**

The Group Product Manager / AVP will lead the Engagement Product Tribe, covering Trading and Loyalty, with 2–3 Product Managers reporting directly into the role.

Reporting to the VP of Product, this individual will own the tribe's overall strategy, key results, product portfolio, and the professional development of its Product Managers.

The organisation is scaling its proprietary trading platform and looking to strengthen its engagement and retention capabilities.

The role requires a leader who can bring strategic direction, accountability, and execution discipline across trading and loyalty experiences, ensuring that both areas work together to deliver a seamless customer experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Launch and Market Adoption**

* Lead the launch and market adoption of the organisation's proprietary trading platform.
* Define launch priorities, target customer segments, product readiness criteria, and migration strategies for existing customers.
* Ensure a seamless transition for existing traders while maintaining customer trust and familiarity.

**2. Engagement Strategy and Performance Ownership**

* Take direct ownership of the tribe's key results and engagement metrics.
* Identify performance gaps early and drive corrective actions to improve outcomes.
* Focus on measurable business impact rather than roadmap delivery alone.

**3. Loyalty and Retention**

* Develop loyalty as a strategic retention and engagement capability rather than simply a rewards programme.
* Own loyalty initiatives covering tiers, points, missions, challenges, and referral programmes.
* Identify and implement behavioural mechanisms that improve customer retention, trading frequency, and long-term engagement.
* Evaluate programme effectiveness and discontinue initiatives that fail to deliver measurable value.
* Ensure customers clearly understand loyalty benefits and reward structures.

**4. Product Team Leadership and Development**

* Lead, mentor, and develop 2–3 Product Managers.
* Improve the team's capabilities in product discovery, problem definition, data-driven decision-making, customer engagement, and independent execution.
* Build a strong product management culture with clear accountability and ownership.

**5. Product Strategy and Vision**

* Define a three-year product vision focused on transforming funded customers into confident, habitual platform users.
* Translate the long-term vision into actionable quarterly priorities and strategic initiatives.
* Establish clear product pillars that align trading and loyalty experiences.

**6. Portfolio and Roadmap Management**

* Own product portfolio prioritisation across trading and loyalty.
* Balance competing priorities, manage dependencies, and make strategic trade-offs.
* Ensure resources are focused on initiatives with the greatest customer and business impact.

**7. Experimentation and Product Delivery**

* Establish a culture of continuous experimentation, rapid iteration, and frequent releases.
* Balance short-term experimentation with long-term strategic product investments.
* Identify opportunities for testing while managing execution and operational risks.

**8. Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with Risk, Compliance, Dealing, Commercial, and Marketing teams.
* Build strong stakeholder relationships and ensure cross-functional alignment.
* Involve key stakeholders early in product decisions to ensure commercial, regulatory, and operational feasibility.

**Key Skills and Experience**

**Essential Requirements**

* Proven experience taking a product from concept to launch and driving meaningful market adoption, preferably within an established business with an existing customer base and revenue streams.
* Demonstrated ownership of engagement, retention, or monetisation outcomes within a CFD brokerage or multi-asset trading platform.
* Strong understanding of the trading product lifecycle and user experience, including order execution, risk controls, charting, trading signals, and platform behaviour.
* Experience building and managing customer retention and engagement programmes.
* Strong understanding of trading and investment products. Candidates without direct brokerage experience may be considered if they actively trade or invest and have significant engagement, retention, or monetisation experience in a consumer-facing digital platform.
* Proven experience mentoring and developing junior Product Managers.
* Experience improving product release frequency and experimentation capabilities.
* Strong product discovery capabilities, including direct customer engagement across different customer segments, from beginners to high-value traders.
* Commercial understanding of engagement-driven business metrics, including ARPU, customer retention, trading activity, and incentive economics.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders across Compliance, Risk, and Commercial functions without direct reporting authority.
* Ability to independently develop and articulate a product strategy from the ground up.

**Desirable Requirements**

* Experience designing and scaling loyalty and rewards programmes.
* Experience developing gamification, progression, and behavioural engagement systems.
* Experience establishing experimentation frameworks and infrastructure from scratch.

**Relevant Industry Backgrounds**

Candidates may come from the following environments:

* **Trading and Investment Platforms:**
  Online brokers, neobrokers, retail investment platforms, or financial services organisations, particularly those with experience in trading product ownership, activation, first-trade conversion, or trader retention.
* **Consumer Fintech:**
  Established digital financial services and fintech businesses.
* **Consumer Technology / Big Tech:**
  Product roles focused on customer engagement, retention, active usage, lifecycle management, or subscription and marketplace engagement.
* **New Product / 0-to-1 Teams:**
  Organisations building proprietary products or replacing previously outsourced third-party platforms.
* **Crypto and Betting:**
  Digital platforms where customer engagement, repeat usage, monetisation, and retention are key business drivers.

jobs.title: Chief Product Officer
jobs.description:
**About Us**

UMO is a stealth-mode FinTech venture aiming to evolve the way people experience money by building a unified, AI-powered, yet deeply human money platform across fiat, crypto, and investments – subject to regulatory approvals. The platform is being designed to break down traditional barriers to money across access, assets, and experience, enabling simpler, more adaptive ways for people to interact with financial services.

We are currently developing our MVP and navigating licensing requirements, with a multidisciplinary team of 100+ people representing 20+ nationalities. With our headquarters in the UAE, we are united behind a shared ambition and a relentless focus on serving our customers.

**About This Role**

You'll help us build a platform that works for One — the individual, whether that's a business owner, an artist, or a freelancer, not a segment or a balance. We focus on individuals, not numbers. You'll take ownership of our global product ecosystem from zero to one: first the minimal licensable product, then the agentic financial platform we build on top of it. You'll partner directly with the founders on strategic direction, operate with full autonomy, and build shared understanding across the organization.

**You'll Take Ownership Of**

* **Zero-to-One Product Delivery:**
  Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for regulated financial products, from initial concept to launch, prioritizing value delivery over premature optimization.
* **Product & People Leadership:**
  Build and lead the product organization — hire, mentor, and grow product talent, and establish a culture of high performance, data literacy, and low ego. This is core to the role, not an adjunct to it.
* **Agentic Banking Architecture:**
  Architect a financial ecosystem built for autonomous agents from the ground up, treating AI as an operating model for the organization rather than a bolt-on feature.
* **Scope Discipline:**
  Maintain control over delivery timelines under pressure. Cut scope deliberately rather than sacrifice quality, keeping focus on the minimal licensable product.
* **Regulatory & Compliance Architecture:**
  Treat regulatory, compliance, and audit obligations as first-class product inputs, turning friction into intuitive product features.
* **Cross-Functional Feasibility:**
  Partner with the CTO to co-own technical feasibility and organizational commitments, separating what the product does from how it's engineered.
* **Context & Alignment:**
  Act as the primary bridge for shared understanding across the company — communicating product vision, customer needs, and strategic rationale through multiple channels.

**About You**

* **Regulated Startup Background:**
  You've built and shipped regulated financial products from zero to one within a fintech, crypto exchange, custodian, or digital banking environment, with proven exposure to compliance frameworks such as VARA, MiCA, EMI, or PI, and to strict licensing processes.
* **Comfort with Shifting Landscapes:**
  You thrive in continuous-delivery setups with agile teams, staying resilient and decisive under regulatory, investor, and shifting deadline pressures.
* **Agentic Framework Literacy:**
  You have practical understanding of agentic capabilities, architectural pitfalls, and the agentic-deterministic bridge, so deterministic safety holds on the money path.
* **Cross-Domain Fluency:**
  You're comfortable across crypto systems, traditional banking, and modern neobank infrastructure, rather than specialized in a single domain.
* **Outcome Ownership:**
  You own outcomes end-to-end rather than running a feature factory. You commit to measurable results and core OKRs, and you value autonomy while building a collaborative, non-siloed organization.
* **Clarity & Conviction:**
  You reduce ambiguity across teams and argue from data with conviction, but disagree and commit when it's time to align the organization.
* **Language Skills:**
  You speak and write English at a professional level, to support clean communication across global offices.

**This Is Not For You If**

* You're looking for a mature product to optimize. We're building from zero — there's no existing user base to A/B-test against.
* You're a product manager from a large bank who needs six committees to change a button. We move fast, fail fast on wrong calls, and decide from data.
* You know crypto well but see banking regulation as an outdated formality. For us, regulation is part of the product architecture, not an obstacle.
* You want to run a feature factory and just execute roadmaps. We need someone who will fight for the right scope, even if that means shipping less.
* You need the founders to make every product call. You'll have real autonomy here — and the responsibility that comes with it, including owning your own mistakes.

**Can Get You a Few Bonus Points**

* **Founder Roots:**
  Prior experience as a founder or early product leader of a regulated fintech startup, building the organization from the ground up.
* **Agentic Shipping History:**
  Direct experience bringing a live, agentic-first product to market.
* **Augmented Operations:**
  Active daily use of AI agents, personal documentation systems, or a "second brain" to streamline your own operational delivery.

**The UMO Standard**

* **Mandate & Ownership:**
  Full ownership of the product organization and roadmap, reporting directly to the founders.
* **Equity:**
  A meaningful equity stake in a venture built from zero to one.
* **Location & Flexibility:**
  Base yourself in Lisbon, Dubai, Kyiv, or Lviv, with openness to remote for the right fit.
* **Impact & Ownership:**
  Your work directly shapes the product and company direction — not just executes it.

**Head of Product, Exchange-Traded Products**

Make your next career step and apply NOW!

**Role Overview**

The Branch CEO / Senior Executive Officer is the accountable executive for MultiPass's DIFC branch and the leader of its next stage of UAE growth. The role combines regulated executive leadership, delivery of a mainland licensing programme, and direct commercial ownership. The successful candidate will protect the branch's regulatory standing, build trusted relationships with regulators and local banking partners, originate revenue personally, and create a high-performing Sales and Business Development organisation.

**The Three Core Mandates**

1.
**Lead the DIFC branch.**
Act as Branch CEO and, subject to regulatory approval, Senior Executive

Officer; own governance, regulatory engagement, compliance, local banking relationships,

operational performance, and the branch's reputation.

2.
**Deliver mainland authorisation.**
Lead the end-to-end programme to identify and obtain the

appropriate UAE mainland electronic-money and/or payment-services licence or authorisation,

working with the relevant federal and mainland authorities and external advisers.

3.
**Grow the revenue base.**
Win strategic clients through personal origination, develop partnerships and distribution channels, and recruit, coach, and scale a UAE Sales and Business Development team with disciplined targets, processes, and economics.

**Key Accountabilities**

**1. Branch Leadership, Regulation and Banking Relationships**

* Serve as the senior accountable executive for the DIFC branch and provide coordination for
* strategy, governance, culture, risk, compliance, operations, and financial performance.
* Maintain a proactive, transparent, and credible relationship with the Dubai Financial Services
* Authority (DFSA), including timely regulatory engagement, notifications, returns, remediation, and responses to supervisory requests.
* Ensure the branch operates within its permissions, policies, risk appetite, and applicable DIFC/DFSA requirements, with particular attention to AML/CFT, sanctions, conduct, safeguarding, prudential oversight, outsourcing, and financial-crime controls.
* Chair or participate in branch governance forums; ensure decisions, delegated authorities, management information, incident escalation, and board or group reporting are clear and effective.
* Own senior relationships with local banks, safeguarding or settlement partners, payment providers, professional advisers, and other critical counterparties; negotiate resilient and commercially sound arrangements.

**2. UAE Mainland Licensing Programme**

* Define the target regulated business model and licensing strategy for mainland UAE, aligned with MultiPass's products, client segments, risk appetite, capital plan, and growth ambitions.
* Lead the feasibility study and business case for the mainland licence.
* Coordinate internal Legal, Compliance, Risk, Finance, Product, Technology, Operations, Treasury, and People teams, together with external legal and regulatory advisers.
* Oversee preparation of the business plan, governance and ownership materials, financial projections, capital and liquidity plans, policies, control frameworks, technology and outsourcing documentation, and evidence of operational readiness.
* Build constructive relationships with the relevant UAE authorities, including the Central Bank of the UAE where applicable, and ensure all submissions are accurate, consistent, and delivered to the agreed standard and timetable.
* Translate licensing conditions into an executable mobilisation plan and ensure the mainland entity or operation is ready to launch without weakening the DIFC branch's controls or service quality.

**3. Revenue Growth and Commercial Team Build**

* Own the UAE branch revenue plan, client-acquisition strategy, commercial pipeline, and contribution to profitability, with clear monthly and quarterly targets.
* Personally originate, negotiate, and close high-value clients and strategic partnerships, particularly among internationally active businesses requiring multi-currency accounts, cross-border payments, and FX services.
* Develop a strong network across the UAE business, banking, professional-services, investment, and fintech communities and represent MultiPass at relevant market and industry forums.
* Recruit and lead the Sales and Business Development team; define coverage, roles, incentives, targets, account ownership, onboarding standards, and performance-management routines.
* Implement a disciplined commercial operating system covering CRM hygiene, lead qualification, pipeline reviews, conversion, pricing governance, revenue attribution, forecasting, client retention, and cross-sell.
* Work closely with Compliance, Product, Operations, Treasury, and Group leadership to ensure commercial growth remains within risk appetite and that client feedback informs product and service development.

**4. People, Operations and Profitability**

* Build a high-accountability, client-focused branch culture in line with DYNINNO Corporate Values.
* Own the branch operating plan and budget; manage cost, headcount, vendor performance, revenue quality, and progress toward sustainable profitability.
* Ensure the branch has appropriate business-continuity, operational-resilience, information-security, complaints, and incident-management arrangements.
* Provide concise, decision-useful reporting to Group leadership and the Board.

**Requirements**

* Senior leadership experience as a CEO, Managing Director, Country Head or equivalent within regulated payments, electronic money, B2B fintech or transaction banking.
* Strong UAE market knowledge, including practical experience engaging with regulators and understanding DIFC/DFSA requirements and the UAE mainland regulatory environment.
* Experience leading licensing or authorisation programmes, including regulatory submissions, coordination with external advisers and preparation for operational launch. UAE payments or electronic-money licensing experience is strongly preferred.
* Proven personal track record in B2B client acquisition, negotiating and closing high-value corporate clients and strategic partnerships, ideally in cross-border payments, multi-currency accounts or FX.

jobs.description:
Inception42, a G42 company, is the region’s leading innovator of AI-powered domain-specific as well as industry-agnostic products, built on a rich heritage of research and development. Within the G42 ecosystem, Inception functions as the core intelligence layer – transforming data and compute infrastructure into real-world, applied AI solutions. Beyond its commercial endeavors, Inception is committed to creating positive societal impact. For more information, please visit www.inception42.ai
  
  
**Overview**
We are looking for a hands-on Product Director with deep FinTech expertise to lead Alpha, Inception42's investment and credit AI product. You will own strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for institutional investors, lenders, and financial analysts.
  
  
Translate emerging AI capabilities into investment research, due diligence, underwriting support, and portfolio monitoring workflows. Turn fragmented information into reviewable analysis, with clear evidence and user control. Success means accurate work, sustained adoption, and measurable customer value.
  
  
You will lead cross-functional teams spanning Design, Engineering, Science, domain experts, and Growth. You will make difficult trade-offs, stay close to customers and product details, and mentor product managers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Product strategy and discovery**

* Define Alpha’s vision, target markets, differentiation and roadmap, aligning customer needs with emerging AI capabilities.
* Engage investment analysts, portfolio managers, credit teams and senior decision-makers to understand workflows, buying criteria and adoption barriers.
* Assess competitors and alternatives; validate demand through research, AI-assisted prototypes and pilots. Prioritise by customer value, commercial potential, feasibility and risk, coordinating shared capabilities with Catalyst.

**Investment and credit workflows**

* Own requirements for opportunity screening, company and sector research, due diligence, valuation support and investment committee materials.
* Develop workflows for financial statement analysis, cash-flow and debt-service assessment, downside scenarios, credit memos, covenant review and portfolio monitoring.
* Define AI behaviour and acceptance criteria, enabling analyst review, collaboration, versioning and approval, with Excel, Word and PowerPoint outputs.
* Prioritise integrations with filings, transcripts, market and credit data, internal research and deal rooms; guide licensing, access rights and build-versus-partner decisions.

**AI development, quality and governance**

* Partner with Science and Engineering on models, retrieval-augmented generation, prompts, context, memory, tools and agent orchestration.

* Convert pilots into sustained adoption through repeatable onboarding, workflow templates and training.
* Track task success, time to validated analysis, errors, corrections and abandonment alongside adoption, conversion, retention, expansion and unit economics.

**Leadership**

* Align technical, financial and commercial stakeholders on priorities and trade-offs; communicate effectively with customers and leadership.
* Mentor product managers, support hiring and strengthen discovery, evaluation and product reviews while remaining hands-on with experiments, feedback and production performance.

**Qualifications**
What We’re Looking For
  
  

* 10+ years in product management or closely related roles, with substantial ownership of complex products at senior or principal level and a record of launching and scaling financial technology.
* Knowledge of institutional investment or credit workflows, with working fluency across both.
* Experience building products for analysts, investment teams, lenders, or risk professionals.
* Strong understanding of financial statements, valuation, leverage, and credit risk.
* Ability to interrogate financial models and challenge analytical assumptions.
* Experience delivering enterprise software with measurable adoption and commercial impact, including direct customer discovery and engagement with senior financial stakeholders.
* Experience taking AI-powered products, such as agents, copilots, or intelligent workflows, from concept to production and measurable adoption.
* Practical fluency in large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, context, memory, tool use, and evaluations. Ability to reason with technical teams about quality, latency, reliability, and cost.
* Hands-on use of AI tools to prototype workflows, test model behaviour, and accelerate research, analysis, or delivery.

* Clear written and verbal communication, leadership across functions, and sound judgement in ambiguous environments where accuracy and customer trust are critical.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Prior investment banking, asset management, private equity, private credit, corporate lending, or credit research experience alongside product leadership.

* Experience with financial institutions, sovereign deployment, and regulated enterprise procurement. Arabic language ability and bilingual product experience are advantages.

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Client Manager is the pivotal relationship in the Client Delivery team responsible for delivering exceptional client account management. The Client Manager is responsible for proactively managing the client account on all day-to-day maintenance activities to ensure the highest level of client service and relationship health.

The Client Manager supports the **Global Account Managers (GAMs)** , **Regional Account Managers (RAMs)** and **Financial Institution Account Managers (FAMs)** across an aligned client portfolio to ensure strong client delivery execution.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Business**
------------

Provide direct support to the **Relationship Manager (RM)** by proactively:

* Helping to prepare Account Plans, client briefing notes for senior management discussions and providing input into **Regional Client Account Forums (RCAF)** and **Global Client Account Forums (GCAF)** .
* Joining client visits where appropriate and ensuring client discussions are documented through call reports in the Bank's client management system.
* Reviewing client profitability and identifying opportunities to increase client utilisation of banking services.
* Liaising with **Implementation Management Office (IMO)** and **Credit Analyst (CA)** teams to ensure seamless client onboarding and ongoing credit monitoring.
* Actively engaging and collaborating with Clients, Relationship Managers (RMs) and Product Partners to understand and respond to issues relating to ongoing account maintenance, including highlighting unusual account utilisation patterns to coverage teams.
* Partnering effectively with the Implementation Management Office (IMO), Credit Analysts (CA), Legal, Compliance, Operations and Service teams to ensure client expectations are met or exceeded.
* Ensuring client account maintenance issues are resolved promptly and escalating matters to the Client Manager Team Lead or Head of Client Management where appropriate.
* Coordinating and liaising with Financial Institution Account Managers (FAMs) to support network business opportunities.

**Client Relationship Management**
----------------------------------

* Demonstrate strong knowledge of client needs across the assigned portfolio and engage clients effectively while providing insights on market conditions and trends within the Bank's international network.
* Build trust and provide strong account management support to clients, including loan drawdowns and overseeing the resolution of client complaints, issues and escalations.
* Provide guidance to clients on documentation requirements, including credit documentation and account monitoring activities.
* Maintain strong client relationships through consistent and responsive support.

**Documentation: Credit (Existing Facilities – Renewals and Amendments) & Other Documentation**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* Manage the end-to-end documentation negotiation process, including the use of documentation across the Bank's international network, subject to required approvals from Legal, Product and Business teams.
* Engage and coordinate with Legal & Compliance, Credit, Implementation Management Office (IMO) and clients on standard documentation requirements, including:
  + Standard Terms and Conditions (T&Cs)
  + Country-specific documentation supplements
  + Banking Facility Letters
  + Master Credit Terms
  + Supplementary Letters and related documentation
* Obtain approvals for any deviations from standard Terms & Conditions (T&Cs) from the relevant authorised approvers.
* Ensure document deficiencies are minimised, including items reflected in Documentation Deferrals and Waivers, and that outstanding issues are rectified in a timely manner.
* Follow through to ensure documentation is fully completed and liaise with the Implementation Management Office's **Client Risk Centre (CRC)** to validate that credit limits are accurately loaded and reflected in transaction processing systems.

**Account Management & Portfolio Quality**
------------------------------------------

Manage maintenance activities across the assigned client portfolio, including:

* Reviewing overdue balances and excess account positions daily and ensuring they are regularised on time.
* Ensuring cash and cheque releases are completed within required timelines.
* Escalating exceptions to the Relationship Manager (RM) and Credit Analyst (CA).
* Acting as an escalation point for unsettled **Foreign Exchange (FX)** past due trades and failed trades, working closely with Operations teams.
* Supporting loan drawdowns, Cash Management services, **Local Treasury Product (LTP)** trades within **Financial Institutions (FI)** banking, and the release of Trade Finance offerings.
* Attending **ASTAR** review meetings where appropriate and participating in relevant business meetings, forums and committees.
* Leading or supporting key projects aimed at improving processes, tools and the client experience.

**Processes**
-------------

* Ensure adherence to all internal and regulatory policies and regulations, including:
  + **Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA)** requirements
  + Credit policies
  + Banking Control Account (BCA) overdue procedures
  + Other applicable regulatory and internal requirements
* Identify and escalate operational risks relating to the client portfolio to the Client Manager Team Lead or Head of Client Management.
* Recommend process improvements to resolve or mitigate identified risks.
* Work with Operations, Service Hub and Client Services teams to resolve operational issues and post-transaction queries.

**Risk Management**
-------------------

* Support the Relationship Manager (RM) in reviewing client account activity to ensure transactional activity aligns with expected business activity levels for the client.
* Develop a strong understanding of credit risk, including default risk and fraud risk.
* Ensure the quality of all **Anti-Money Laundering (AML)** and credit documentation complies with **Corporate, Commercial and Institutional Banking (CCIB)** standards.
* Escalate operational risk concerns to the Head of Client Management, Client Manager Lead or **Business Operational Risk Manager (BORM)** .
* Proactively ensure compliance with Bank policies and procedures and support the preparation of client files for audits and regulatory reviews.

**Governance**

**Senior Associate - Product Solutions (Credit & Compliance)**

**Location:** Dubai

**About the Role**

We are looking for a strong Product Specialist to join our Product team at YubiMENA. The ideal candidate understands banking credit, risk, and compliance, and knows how products are designed around them. This person sits between clients, sales, and product engineering. They translate each bank's or lender's regulatory, credit, and risk requirements, along with its existing systems, into a configured solution that can be scoped, priced, and delivered.

They will be the main technical and regulatory voice for clients during pre-sales and implementation, and will turn complex requirements into solutions that product and delivery teams can build.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Client discovery and requirements**

  

* Lead discovery workshops with credit, risk, compliance, and technology stakeholders to understand regulatory obligations, risk appetite, and current controls.
* Map regulatory and compliance requirements to product capabilities, covering understanding the obligations, translating them into functional requirements, and tracing each one to the product feature that satisfies it.
* Identify gaps between client needs and the current product, and document them clearly for the product roadmap.

**Solution design**

  

* Design end-to-end solution architectures covering credit origination, underwriting and decisioning, risk monitoring, AML/CFT screening, KYC onboarding, and regulatory reporting, including integration with core banking, onboarding, and payments systems.
* Define configuration approaches for risk-based rules, scoring models, thresholds, and workflows, and explain the trade-offs between them.
* Produce solution documentation: design documents, data flow diagrams, integration specifications, and configuration guides.

**Pre-sales and proposals**

  

* Support sales with technical deep-dives, demos, and proof-of-concept scoping.
* Lead the technical sections of RFPs, RFIs, and security or regulatory questionnaires.
* Estimate implementation effort, timelines, and resource needs, and flag risks early.

**Implementation handover**

  

* Hand off solution designs to delivery and engineering with clear acceptance criteria.
* Support UAT planning and resolve design questions that come up during implementation.
* Contribute reusable patterns and accelerators back to the product team.

**Product input**

  

* Work with Product Management to prioritize features based on client demand, credit policy needs, and regulatory change.
* Track regulatory and credit policy updates and advise on their product impact, including new reporting templates, thresholds, and typology changes.

**Must-Have Qualifications**

  

* 6 to 10 years of experience in banking, with a focus on credit, risk or compliance, including at least 3 years in a solution, pre-sales, implementation, or product-facing role.
* Hands-on experience in credit and compliance processes (underwriting, credit assessment, credit risk, or credit monitoring) and/or financial crime compliance (AML/CFT, sanctions, KYC/CDD) within banks.
* Working knowledge of UAE and GCC regulatory frameworks, including CBUAE requirements.
* Experience designing, configuring, or implementing banking systems such as credit decisioning, risk scoring, transaction monitoring, screening, or case management platforms.
* Ability to write clear solution documents and explain technical concepts to both business stakeholders and engineers.
* Experience running workshops and presenting to senior stakeholders, including CCOs, CROs, and credit heads.
* Strong analytical skills, with comfort working with transaction or portfolio data and tuning metrics such as approval rates, default rates, and false positive rates.

**Preferred Background**

  

* 10 years of banking experience in Dubai or the UAE, in credit, risk or compliance roles.
* Experience in a product department at a bank, or in product design, product management, or solutioning.
* Current or recent experience at an AI-first, tech-forward fintech or financial institution in Dubai, with a prior background in traditional banking.

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**  
NEXT Ventures is where ambition takes shape and momentum becomes movement. As a global platform, revolutionising access to performance-based capital, we empower the world’s most driven individuals to rise. Through our flagship brand, FundedNext, we empower dreamers to become doers and potential to turn into performance. FNmarkets is our international brokerage arm, serving clients across global markets*.*

With 500+ driven minds across five countries, we power a global rhythm—220,000+ daily users, from 170+ nations, each chasing greatness in their own way.

**Your Role in Our Mission**  
As a Manager, Payments & Treasury (FNmarkets Brokerage), you own the end-to-end movement, safeguarding, and optimization of client and corporate funds across FNmarkets’ international brokerage operations. You will run the PSP and banking portfolio that powers client deposits and withdrawals, manage multi-currency liquidity and FX exposure, and keep settlement, reconciliation, and treasury controls tight as the brokerage scales across markets. Sitting at the intersection of payment operations, treasury, and bank/PSP relationship management, you partner closely with Compliance, Finance, Risk, and trading-platform teams to keep funds flowing reliably, cost-efficiently, and within regulatory requirements.

This role reports to the group Head of Payments & Treasury.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* **Payment Operations & PSP Portfolio:**

* **Portfolio Ownership:** Own the PSP and payment-method portfolio (cards, local bank rails, e-wallets, crypto) across the brokerage’s active markets, from onboarding and integration through performance monitoring and offboarding.
* **Payment Routing Optimization:** Optimize payment routing in the orchestrator to lift approval rates, reduce decline and failure rates, and lower blended cost per transaction.
* **SLA & Performance Tracking:** Track and improve deposit/withdrawal success rates, processing times, and chargeback/dispute ratios against agreed SLAs.

**2. Client Funds & Payout Operations:**

* **End-to-End Flow Oversight:** Oversee client deposit and withdrawal flows end to end, ensuring funds are processed accurately, on time, and in line with client-money safeguarding rules.
* **Payout Management:** Manage brokerage client withdrawals and wallet transfers, including volume forecasting, queue management, and exception handling.
* **Fund Segregation & Reporting:** Maintain segregation of client funds from corporate funds and support audit and regulatory reporting on balances.

**3. Treasury, FX & Cash Management:**

* **Multi-Currency Liquidity:** Manage multi-currency liquidity across entities and accounts, ensuring sufficient funding for client withdrawals, settlements, and operating needs.
* **FX & Hedging Execution:** Run FX operations and conversions, monitor currency exposure, and execute hedging or rebalancing as directed by policy.
* **Cash Forecasting & Yield:** Forecast cash positions, optimize working capital, and manage the placement of eligible corporate cash within approved investment and counterparty limits—with client funds held separately and safeguarded at all times.

**4. Banking & Relationship Management:**

* **Partner Management:** Own relationships with banks, PSPs, and acquiring partners—covering commercials, fee and settlement-term negotiation, issue escalation, and periodic performance reviews.
* **Cost Reduction:** Drive down processing, settlement, and FX costs through negotiation and transfer-pricing/routing optimization.
* **Infrastructure Redundancy:** Build banking and PSP redundancy to protect the continuity of client deposits and withdrawals.

**5. Reconciliation, Compliance & Risk:**

* **Multi-Ledger Reconciliation:** Own daily and periodic reconciliation across PSPs, banks, crypto wallets, and the ledger, resolving breaks and ensuring settlement accuracy.
* **Regulatory & Compliance Alignment:** Partner with Compliance on KYC/AML, licensing, and regulatory requirements affecting payment flows and client funds.
* **Risk Mitigation:** Identify and mitigate operational, settlement, counterparty, and fraud risk across the payment and treasury stack.

**6. Projects & Optimization:**

* **Expansion & Automation Initiatives:** Lead payments and treasury projects, including new-market and new-method launches, orchestrator and system integrations, and process automation.
* **Executive Reporting:** Build reporting and dashboards on approval rates, cost, settlement cycles, liquidity, and payout performance for leadership.
* **Cross-Functional Scaling:** Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Finance, and Risk to scale payment and treasury capability as the brokerage grows.

**7. Build & Scale, Team Leadership & Innovation:**

* **Build & Scale:** Define and build out the FNmarkets payments and treasury operating model - people, processes, and systems - to support the brokerage’s growth across new markets and product lines.
* **Team Leadership:** Lead, develop, and grow a high-performing payments & treasury wing for FNmarkets business line, setting clear priorities, fostering accountability, and building capability at every level.
* **Innovation & Knowledge Sharing:** Champion continuous improvement by staying current on industry developments, introducing best practices, and ensuring knowledge flows across the team and key stakeholders.

**What You Bring**

* **Industry Experience:** Minimum 5 years in payments, funds management, and treasury functions at an international brokerage (CFD/FX/securities); strong candidates from payments firms serving brokerage clients also considered.
* **High-Volume Payment Operations:** Hands-on experience managing client deposit and withdrawal flows, PSP relationships, and payment routing in a high-volume, multi-currency environment.
* **Treasury & FX Mastery:** Treasury experience across multi-currency liquidity and cash management, FX operations, and working-capital or settlement optimization.
* **Payment Ecosystem Knowledge:** Strong grasp of digital payment methods and ecosystems—card networks, local/alternative payment rails, e-wallets, and crypto/stablecoin settlement.
* **Commercial Negotiation:** Demonstrated bank and PSP negotiation experience, with a track record of reducing fees and improving settlement terms and approval performance.
* **Reconciliation & Breaks Resolution:** Solid command of reconciliation and settlement across multiple payment partners and ledgers, including breaks investigation.
* **Compliance & Safeguarding:** Working knowledge of KYC/AML, client-money safeguarding, and the compliance/licensing considerations affecting cross-border payment flows.
* **Data & Analytics:** Strong analytical skills; comfortable working with transaction data, dashboards, and spreadsheets to drive decisions.
* **Education & Communication:** A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field; paired with fluent written and spoken English for coordinating across international partners and internal stakeholders.

**Preferred (Nice-to-Haves)**

* **Payment Orchestration:** Experience with payment orchestration platforms and routing logic (e.g., cascading, smart routing, retry optimization).
* **Multi-Jurisdiction Setup:** Familiarity with regulated-entity treasury across multiple jurisdictions, including banking setups and licensing considerations.
* **Market Launches:** Prior experience launching payment methods or banking relationships in new markets.

* **Crypto Settlement:** Exposure to crypto settlement and reconciliation (USDT, TRC-20/ERC-20) and crypto–fiat on/off-ramp flows.

**About SC Ventures**

**SC Ventures is Standard Chartered ’s innovation, fintech investment and ventures arm. We were established to reinvent banking, as the significant technological disruptions to the industry was impacting its ability to serve clients and customers, in the ways they needed to be served. We are a unique ecosystem of innovators, banking experts, business builders and partners who are focused on rewiring the DNA in banking and bringing breakthrough ideas to scale, together. We are building ecosystems around four high conviction themes: Online Economy & Lifestyle, SMEs & World Trade, Digital Assets, and Sustainability & Inclusion. We are a global team of "Members" (excluding individual ventures), including dedicated colleagues from the Group's support functions, based in Singapore, Hong Kong, London, and the United Arab Emirates**

**About HAL**

**HAL is a B2B domestic and cross border marketplace being built for SMEs in the UAE. Incubated by SC Ventures, the ventures arm of Standard Chartered Bank, the platform will enable digital commerce and access to financial & value-added services. HAL’s vision is to act as a super glue connecting multiple partners & ecosystems by bringing together buyers, sellers, financial institutions, logistics partners under one roof. We are building this as an agentic AI native stack along with several strategic partners in the UAE who bring different capabilities into the platform.**

**SMEs are the backbone of the UAE economy and vital for economic growth and diversification. We want to help SMEs grow profitably, safely and with ease. Hal is being built for scale with the latest technologies and with a vision to truly become the one stop shop for SMEs. We are looking to launch later in the year.**

**The Senior Marketing Manager will lead HAL's marketing function, working closely with the CEO and the commercial, product and partnerships teams. This is a commercially driven role: success is measured by the qualified B2B leads you generate (sellers, buyers and SMEs looking for finance), the revenue they bring in, and HAL's growing share of the UAE SME market. You will be hands-on and highly experimental, testing new channels and ideas quickly, doubling down on what works, and doing whatever it takes to help HAL win in the market.**
