jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager 3
jobs.description:
#### **About Behavox**

Behavox is shaping the future for how businesses harness their most important raw material - data. Our mission is bold: Organize enterprise data into actionable information that protects and promotes the business growth of multinational companies around the world.

From managing enterprise risk and compliance to maximizing revenue and value, our data operating platform presents a widespread opportunity to build multilingual, AI/ML-based solutions that activate data for every function within a global enterprise.

Our approach is unique, and it's validated by our customers who tell us to keep forging ahead because no one else is aggregating, analyzing, and acting on data to uncover opportunities or solve problems quite the way we are.

We are looking for fearless innovators who have an insatiable appetite for building what no one has built before.

**About the Role**

Behavox's Strategic Account Managers own the full commercial relationship with some of the world's most complex and highly regulated financial institutions. This includes delivery outcomes, commercial performance, executive relationships, and long-term strategic growth across a portfolio of global banks, hedge funds, asset managers, and energy firms operating under the world's most demanding regulatory frameworks.

Clients in this portfolio are building or strengthening unified controls frameworks that bring together communications surveillance, trade surveillance, compliant archiving, and policy management into a single, defensible control system. The Strategic Account Manager's role is to understand where each client sits on that journey, ensure Behavox is delivering against their current needs, and position the platform to serve the full scope of their controls framework over time. This requires full end-to-end ownership of the relationship, delivery, health, satisfaction, retention, and growth for every account in the portfolio, operating with a high degree of autonomy on account strategy, renewals, escalations, and executive relationships.

The role requires the ability to think strategically and execute operationally, often in the same day. The Strategic Account Manager will own all renewals across the portfolio, build retention strategy, lead negotiations, and close; accurately forecast ARR churn risk and develop mitigation plans; drive inbound expansion deals independently in collaboration with Account Executives; and lead executive business reviews that are genuinely strategic: conversations about compliance posture, regulatory risk, control maturity, and platform value.

This is a hybrid position based out of our London office.

**What You'll Bring**

* **Enterprise compliance technology and unified controls frameworks.** Deep working knowledge of how communications surveillance, trade surveillance, compliant archiving, and policy management converge into a single control system at regulated financial institutions; understands how clients evaluate and mature their compliance posture over time.
* **Financial services regulatory environment.** Understands the regulatory obligations driving client demand, from communications monitoring requirements to trade reconstruction and archiving mandates, across global banking, hedge fund, asset management, and energy sectors.
* **Multi-stakeholder account management across regulated financial institutions.** Navigates complex organizational structures involving Heads of Surveillance, compliance analysts, technology teams, and operations teams; manages both executive-level strategic relationships and working-level practitioner relationships simultaneously.
* **Commercial lifecycle management for enterprise SaaS.** Owns the full renewal and expansion cycle: retention strategy, churn forecasting, negotiation, close, and pipeline development in partnership with Account Executives; understands how delivery health directly impacts commercial outcomes.
* **Escalation management and operational accountability**. Owns ticket triage, escalation, and resolution end to end for the full portfolio; manages complex, multi-workstream escalations with minimal manager involvement; builds relationships with Product, Engineering, and Support counterparts to accelerate resolution.

**What You'll Do**

* **Account health monitoring and risk identification.** Independently assesses account health and risk across commercial, operational, and relationship dimensions; surfaces risk early by reading ticket patterns, stakeholder signals, and adoption data as intelligence; builds intervention plans without manager direction.
* **Executive business review design and delivery.** Designs and executes QBRs and EBRs for all accounts including executive-level engagement; leads conversations about compliance posture, regulatory risk, control maturity, and platform value rather than product update calls.
* **Renewal ownership and churn forecasting.** Owns all renewals across the portfolio: builds retention strategy, leads negotiations, closes; accurately forecasts ARR churn risk and develops mitigation plans using account health data, stakeholder intelligence, and delivery performance indicators.
* **Expansion identification and commercial execution.** Drives inbound expansion deals independently; collaborates with Account Executives per Unit of One model for strategic accounts; leads with value, not discount-first positioning; builds commercial plays grounded in customer intelligence.
* **Delivery follow-through and client communication ownership.** Owns the client-facing narrative when delivery issues arise, ensuring commitments made to the client are tracked and fulfilled; translates technical or operational updates into language the client can act on; holds internal teams accountable through to confirmed resolution so the client has everything they need without chasing.

**What We Offer**

* A truly global mission with a passionate community in locations all over the world
* Huge impact and learning potential as our aspirations require bold innovation
* Highly competitive compensation
* Benefits include fully covered health coverage for employee and family
* Generous time-off policy and flexible work schedule

**About Our Process**

  

We take Talent very seriously and we are building a community of extraordinary individuals working together in very high performing teams. We also know that the best Talent always has options so we believe that the process has to be a two way assessment - the company AND the candidate assessing the business needs alignment, the career next step alignment, and the cultural alignment.  
  
During the process we will begin by exploring the core factors regarding salary and location along with core experience and skills and values alignment. We will then deep dive explore the critical technical competencies we have identified for the role, and then we will deep dive in behavioral competencies.  
  
The most aligned candidate will then be asked to do a practical work task simulation activity so we can make sure that you will enjoy the kind of work the role requires, and this task will typically be presented and discussed with a group of colleagues and managers. Finally we will ask you to meet with a number of our senior leaders to make sure that you are making the most informed call possible.

**Please note that:**

* We want to get to know you and have a genuine conversation, so the use of AI tools or assistance during live interviews is strictly prohibited and will result in immediate disqualification from the process
* Interviews may be recorded for internal review purposes to ensure fairness and enable collaborative hiring discussions within the team.

The Key Account Manager – Payments will drive the adoption and growth of OxyX among UAE small and medium-sized businesses (SMEs). The role combines two complementary routes to market: building productive referral relationships with accounting firms and acquiring, onboarding and managing SMEs directly.

The successful candidate will help business owners understand how OxyX can improve collections, payment journeys, customer engagement and day-to-day business decisions. The role is focused on consultative selling, trusted relationships, activation and sustained usage—not simply signing up accounts.

***Key responsibilities***

*1. Accounting firm partnership development*

*2. Direct SME acquisition and sales*

* Identify and approach SMEs across relevant sectors, including retail, trading, professional services, hospitality and other suitable business categories. **Understand each prospect's business model, current ERP/accounting setup, payment and collection processes, operational pain points and growth priorities.** Conduct needs-based discussions and demonstrate relevant OxyX capabilities rather than delivering generic product presentations. **Explain how OxyX works as an intelligence and action layer alongside the SME's existing systems, subject to connector availability, permissions and supported data.** Develop proposals, manage objections, follow up opportunities and progress prospects through evaluation, decision and onboarding. **Build relationships with business owners, finance managers, operations managers and other decision-makers.**

*3. SME onboarding, activation and account management*

* Coordinate onboarding with the SME, accounting firm and internal implementation/support teams. **Ensure the SME understands agreed use cases, onboarding requirements, connector prerequisites and each party's responsibilities.** Support initial setup, user orientation and first-use milestones; escalate technical or integration issues promptly. **Monitor engagement, identify underused capabilities and recommend relevant steps to improve adoption and business value.** Maintain regular account reviews, resolve relationship issues and identify opportunities for expansion, renewal and referral. **Capture customer feedback and share product, integration and service improvement suggestions internally.**

*4. Product and market understanding*

* Develop working knowledge of OxyX's SME cockpit, business controls, AI-assisted insights, collections and payment-related workflows, rewards, expense-related capabilities and e-invoicing integrations where available. **Understand the distinction between OxyX technology/workflows and services delivered by banks, payment service providers, acquirers and accredited e-invoicing service providers.** Keep up to date with SME operating challenges, accounting practice needs, market developments and competitor propositions. **Translate customer feedback and market observations into clear inputs for product, marketing, operations and management.**

*Performance expectations*

Performance will be assessed on the quality and consistency of partner development, SME acquisition, successful onboarding, active usage, customer retention and value created for SMEs and accounting partners.

jobs.description:
**Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution**

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

**Why Skan AI**

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

**Role Overview**

As Director of Product, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Skan's process intelligence platform. This is the platform that helps the world's largest enterprises see how work actually happens inside their organizations, and act on that understanding. It is technically complex, data-intensive, and genuinely impactful at scale.

We are looking for someone who has spent meaningful time in process mining, process intelligence, or intelligent automation. Not just an awareness of the space, but real product experience in it. You know the gap between a compelling demo and something that actually works in a large enterprise environment. You have shipped products in this domain and have the scars to show for it.

With 12 to 15 years of product experience, including time at AI-native startups, you are comfortable making product calls with incomplete information, working without a lot of support structure around you, and keeping a team focused when everything feels urgent. You are also someone who uses AI tools every day in how you work, not just in what you build. That matters to us.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Vision and Strategy**

* Own the product roadmap for the process intelligence platform, from how we capture and model operational data through to the analytics and prescriptive insights we surface to customers.
* Make clear, defensible decisions on what we build next. You will get input from customers, from sales, from data, and from the competitive landscape. Your job is to synthesize all of that and land on a prioritized point of view.
* Keep the company aligned on product direction. That means being a consistent voice in leadership discussions, not just a person who maintains a roadmap document.
* Know the competitive landscape well. Understand what Celonis, SAP Signavio, UiPath, and the broader BPM and automation ecosystem are doing. Use that knowledge to sharpen Skan's positioning and find the white space.

**Product Execution and Delivery**

* Work closely with engineering, design, and data science to turn complex customer problems into product requirements teams can actually build from. Good PRDs, clear acceptance criteria, and regular communication matter here.
* Manage delivery across several workstreams at once, covering process discovery, analytics, conformance, and integrations. Help teams make smart trade-off decisions when timelines get tight.
* Stay engaged with architecture and data model decisions that affect the product. You do not need to write the code, but you need to understand what is being built and why certain technical choices matter at enterprise scale.
* Hold a high bar for user experience. Process intelligence data is inherently complex. Making it feel accessible and actionable to both business users and technical users is one of the harder product challenges in this space.

**Using AI in How You Work**

We are an AI company. We expect product leaders to work with AI tools every day, not just build products that use them. This is what that looks like in practice.

* Use LLMs and AI research tools to move faster in discovery. Summarize customer interviews, identify patterns across large volumes of feedback, and sharpen your hypotheses without spending days manually reviewing notes.
* Use generative AI to write better first drafts of PRDs and specifications. Spend your energy making judgment calls and refining thinking, not starting from a blank page every single time.
* Set up workflows to track what is happening in the market. Use AI tools to monitor competitor releases, analyst commentary, and community signals across the process mining and automation space so you are never behind.
* Bring your team along. Help your product managers develop real fluency with these tools, including knowing when to trust AI output and when to push back on it.
* Stay grounded in what AI can and cannot do reliably inside enterprise products. That practitioner perspective will directly shape how we build and talk about AI features in the platform.
* Share what you learn. Recommend tools, document what works, and help build an internal culture of AI-augmented work across the product organization.

**Team Leadership**

* Build and grow the product management team. That means hiring thoughtfully, giving people real ownership of meaningful problems, and being the kind of manager whose reports get better over time.
* Set up the operating model. Good product teams do not run themselves. Help establish the rituals, frameworks, and ways of working that let people move fast without losing sight of what matters.
* Create an environment where people are honest about trade-offs, comfortable sitting with uncertainty, and focused on outcomes over activity.

**Customer and Commercial Engagement**

* Spend real time with customers. Get into the detail of how they use the product, where it falls short, and what they actually need. Use those conversations to challenge your assumptions, not just confirm them.
* Show up in executive-level customer conversations and sales cycles as a credible product voice. You should be able to walk a customer through where the product is heading and why it matters to their specific business.
* Work with Customer Success to track how customers are getting value from the platform and use those signals to sharpen what we build next.

**Cross-Functional Alignment**

* Help Sales and Marketing tell a sharper product story. That means going beyond feature lists and helping them articulate what actually makes Skan different in a crowded market.
* Collaborate with Finance and leadership when business cases need product input, whether that involves pricing, packaging, or expansion opportunities.
* Stay close to what Professional Services and Customer Success teams see on the ground. Some of the most useful product insights come from the people who spend the most time with customers post-sale.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* 12 to 15 years of professional experience, with at least 8 years in product management in enterprise software or SaaS.
* You have worked at an AI-native startup. You know what it is like to build under pressure, make product calls without full information, and keep moving without a lot of infrastructure around you.
* Background in process mining, process intelligence, BPM, task mining, or RPA is strongly preferred. Candidates with this domain experience will stand out. If you have worked at companies like Celonis, UiPath, SAP Signavio, ABBYY, Minit, or similar, we want to hear from you.

jobs.description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
**QAD**
is a leading provider of ERP solutions purpose-built for manufacturing industries — automotive, life sciences, food & beverage, high tech, and industrial. Serving thousands of global manufacturers, QAD's Adaptive Manufacturing Cloud helps companies operate with greater precision, agility, and intelligence.
  
  
Enterprise software is entering a third era. The first gave manufacturers a System of Record — ERP that answered 'what do we have and what did we commit to?' The second gave them Data Infrastructure — the ability to move, analyse, and query that data at scale. The third era is domain-specific intelligence: AI agents that can act autonomously on manufacturing data, but only if that data has been given the context, relationships, and governed rules that allow an agent to reason correctly.
  
  
**ERA — QAD's Enterprise Resource Allocation platform —**
is the domain intelligence layer that sits between any ERP and any AI agent. It encodes what manufacturing data means, governs what agents are permitted to do, and makes every autonomous decision traceable and accountable.
  
  
**Job Description**
This role owns a key pillar of ERA — the Manufacturing Data Fabric & Intelligence layer. This is the foundational intelligence core: the semantic layer that encodes what manufacturing data means, the metric registry that governs how business outcomes are measured, and the AI Insights and conversational analytics capabilities that surface intelligence to users and agents alike. Without this layer, the rest of ERA cannot function. It is the prerequisite for every downstream agent action, every governed decision, and every autonomous workflow ERA enables.
  
  
As Director of Product for Data, AI, Reporting & Analytics, you will report directly to the Head of Platform Product and lead a team of Product Managers and Technical Product Owners. Your scope is the intelligence core — not the integration layer, not the governance engine, not the developer API. You will partner closely with the Directors leading those pillars, but your mandate is singular: make manufacturing data meaningful, queryable, and AI-ready at enterprise scale.
  
  
This is a high-visibility, high-leverage role. The semantic layer is ERA's primary moat — the hardest layer to build and the one no horizontal AI platform will invest in replicating. Your roadmap decisions will compound over years and directly determine QAD's competitive positioning in the era of autonomous manufacturing.
  
  
**The Opportunity**

jobs.description:
**About ModMed**

At ModMed®, we are transforming healthcare through technology. Our mission is to empower healthcare providers with innovative, specialty-specific software solutions that simplify clinical and administrative workflows, improve operational efficiency, and enable better patient care.

Our solutions combine deep healthcare expertise with modern technology to address the complex challenges faced by medical practices. We are a global team of innovators, engineers, product leaders, and healthcare professionals passionate about making a meaningful difference in healthcare.

Join us and help shape the future of healthcare technology!

**About Our Practice Management Product**

ModMed's Practice Management solutions help healthcare practices streamline their administrative, operational, and financial workflows. From scheduling and patient registration to billing, claims management, and revenue cycle operations, our technology helps practices operate more efficiently and manage the business of healthcare.

We continuously evolve our products by leveraging modern technologies, intelligent automation, and AI-driven capabilities to simplify complex workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve financial and operational outcomes for healthcare providers.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a hands-on, people-first
**Manager – Product Management**
to lead and develop a team of Product Owners responsible for our Practice Management product portfolio.

This role combines people leadership, product execution, customer engagement, and AI-driven product innovation. You will be responsible for building a high-performing Product Owner team, establishing strong product discovery and requirements practices, and ensuring initiatives deliver measurable value to customers and the business.

A key focus will be defining and validating requirements for AI-powered features and intelligent automation, translating complex healthcare and financial workflows into clear product specifications, and partnering closely with Engineering, Product, and business stakeholders to bring these capabilities to market.

You will own outcomes across the product lifecycle, from problem discovery and prioritisation through development, customer validation, release, and adoption.

**What You'll Do**

**Product & People Leadership**

* Build, lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Product Owners.
* Establish clear ownership, accountability, performance expectations, and development plans across the team.
* Coach Product Owners on product discovery, requirements definition, prioritisation, stakeholder management, and execution.
* Allocate initiatives based on business priorities, team capacity, and individual strengths.
* Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

**Product Strategy & Initiative Ownership**

* Drive execution of the Practice Management product roadmap in alignment with business objectives and customer needs.
* Ensure every initiative has a clearly defined problem statement, expected business outcome, scope, success criteria, and ownership.
* Balance competing priorities and make informed decisions on resource allocation and initiative sequencing.
* Maintain visibility into product progress, dependencies, risks, and outcomes.
* Ensure initiatives move efficiently from discovery through development, release, and customer adoption.

**AI-Driven Product Requirements & Automation**

* Establish standards for defining, analysing, documenting, and validating requirements for AI-driven features and intelligent automation.
* Translate complex business logic, operational workflows, and automation triggers into clear functional specifications.
* Ensure requirements include detailed workflows, business rules, edge cases, acceptance criteria, and expected system behaviour.
* Partner with Engineering and AI teams to validate technical feasibility, model accuracy, scalability, and reliability.
* Drive appropriate validation of AI-generated outputs, including accuracy, consistency, and compliance considerations.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation to simplify workflows, reduce manual intervention, and improve operational efficiency.

**Data-Driven Decision Making & Product Prioritisation**

* Leverage product analytics, operational data, and customer insights to identify workflow inefficiencies and improvement opportunities.
* Use data to prioritise automation initiatives that reduce manual effort, improve productivity, and deliver measurable financial outcomes for customers.
* Define and track product success metrics, including feature adoption, workflow efficiency, time saved, automation rates, and financial impact.
* Use SQL for data validation, root-cause analysis, and investigation of product and operational issues.
* Establish a metrics-driven approach to product prioritisation and continuous improvement.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with Engineering, Product Management, Architecture, AI, and business stakeholders to drive successful product outcomes.
* Work with technical teams to address complex workflows, business rules, edge cases, scalability, and system dependencies.
* Ensure alignment between product requirements, technical implementation, and intended business outcomes.
* Communicate product decisions, priorities, and trade-offs effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Bring together cross-functional teams to resolve challenges and maintain momentum across initiatives.

**Customer Engagement & Release Management**

* Lead customer discovery sessions, product demonstrations, and feedback discussions to understand real-world challenges.
* Oversee alpha and beta programs to validate new capabilities and incorporate customer feedback into product decisions.
* Ensure product functionality meets customer expectations and delivers the intended operational and financial value.
* Drive release readiness, ensuring product documentation, training materials, and communication plans are in place before general availability.
* Monitor feature adoption and customer feedback post-release to identify opportunities for further improvement.

**What You'll Bring**

**Experience & Domain Expertise**

* 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, or related product leadership roles.
* At least 2 years of experience leading and developing Product Owners or Product Managers.
* Strong experience working in SaaS or cloud-based product environments.
* Deep understanding of healthcare technology, Practice Management, medical billing, and revenue cycle management workflows.
* Proven experience owning product initiatives from discovery and requirements definition through development, release, and adoption.
* Demonstrated ability to build and develop product talent while managing multiple initiatives.

**Product & AI Capabilities**

* Strong ability to identify the problem worth solving, define the desired outcomes, and translate business needs into actionable product requirements.
* Expertise in developing high-quality functional specifications, workflow diagrams, business rules, and acceptance criteria.
* Practical understanding of AI-driven products, intelligent automation, and AI-assisted workflows.
* Ability to evaluate AI capabilities and limitations and establish appropriate validation approaches for accuracy, reliability, and compliance.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools to improve product discovery, requirements gathering, analysis, and documentation.
* Strong analytical capabilities with proficiency in SQL for data validation and problem investigation.
* Experience defining product KPIs and measuring adoption, operational efficiency, and business impact.

**Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Proven ability to lead, mentor, and empower Product Owners to take ownership of product outcomes.
* Strong prioritisation and decision-making skill

jobs.title: Principal Manager, Product Management (Comply Tech)
jobs.company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
jobs.description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $115 billion in investment capital as of September 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are seeking an enthusiastic, analytical, and resourceful product manager to join our Investment Services Technology team, partnering closely with the Compliance team, based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram. This position offers the opportunity for broad exposure to the firm’s trading, operations, and software development groups, as well as the chance to manage real-time issues related to the firm’s expanding suite of global investment products in a dynamic, constantly evolving regulatory environment. The role offers an inclusive and dynamic environment, with a focus on improving technology for efficiency, control, and scalability. The ideal candidate will bring exceptional product management fundamentals, experience in process optimization and workflow automation, and the judgment to operate effectively in a highly regulated and confidential environment with diverse stakeholders.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
You will drive technological solutions that support critical compliance functions across the firm, collaborating with cross-functional teams — engineering, design, business, and other front- and back-office partners — to develop and launch new products and features. You will develop and maintain a strategic product roadmap that aligns with the firm's overall goals and evolves continuously based on user feedback, prioritization, and other factors while working with senior leadership in Compliance. You will also partner closely with the business to understand their needs, define product requirements, scope open-ended projects, and conceptualize effective solutions across a broad range of functional areas, including pre-trade compliance and trade-restriction management, position-limit monitoring, trade surveillance, and regulatory and transaction reporting. Additionally, you will conduct technical design and architecture reviews to ensure alignment with the roadmap and end-user needs and partner with engineering to address technical challenges and deliver on time and to specification. You will evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, replace legacy and vendor systems with scalable in-house platforms, and develop AI- and data-enabled tools for monitoring, detection, and reporting — balancing near-term regulatory and operational needs against long-term strategic and architectural objectives, often building scalable infrastructure in areas with limited existing technology while serving as a senior point of coordination for compliance technology transformation. Furthermore, you will monitor product usage and feedback to identify areas for improvement and address technical debt in a timely manner, maintain product documentation (requirements documents, user guides, and more), conduct training and enablement as a subject-matter expert for the product suite, and manage product launches and backlogs — prioritizing features and enhancements based on end-user feedback and business needs.
  
  
**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, a related field, or an MBA, with 8+ years of product management experience, preferably within the financial services or investment management industry
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical and operational concepts clearly, influence decision-making through both meetings and written artifacts, and engage effectively with diverse stakeholder groups
* Excellent analytical and data-driven decision-making capabilities, with proficiency in data analysis tools and techniques to generate product insights, prioritize initiatives, measure outcomes, and guide product strategy
* Proven adaptability in managing changing priorities, with robust project and delivery management skills in dynamic environments
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, operations, and business teams, translating nontechnical needs into clear requirements while balancing competing stakeholder priorities, building consensus, and delivering customer-focused outcomes
* A high degree of attention to detail and structured problem-solving abilities, with a consistent focus on quality, risk awareness, and operational excellence
* Hands-on experience owning and delivering technology products end-to-end in Agile environments, from product vision and discovery through backlog management, iterative delivery, launch, scaling, and ongoing maturation
* Demonstrated expertise in workflow automation and process optimization, applying structured approaches and tools to improve efficiency, transparency, and control
* A solid understanding of operational workflows within hedge funds and investment management firms, including how controls, data integrity, and regulatory considerations shape technology and product design

Preferred qualifications:
  
  

* Exposure to the investment management or hedge fund domain, with familiarity with pre-trade compliance, trade restrictions, position limits, trade surveillance, or regulatory and transaction reporting
* Experience partnering closely with Compliance, Legal, Risk, or other control functions to define requirements and deliver workflow-driven, compliant technology solutions

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/PMComplyTechOct26
  
  
We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.
  
  
The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers

jobs.description:
Job description:

Job Description – Business Development Manager (Field Sales)

**Position:** Business Development Manager (BDM) – Field Sales  
**Experience:** 2–8 Years  
**Job Location:** Mumbai (Open to candidates across Mumbai and nearby locations)  
**Salary:** ₹40,000 – ₹50,000 per month (based on experience and interview)  
**Joining:** Immediate Joiners Only  
**Employment Type:** Full-time | Field-Based Role

About the Role

We are looking for dynamic and target-driven Business Development Managers to drive business growth by connecting with founders, business owners, entrepreneurs and decision-makers. The role involves field sales, client acquisition, relationship building and converting qualified prospects into customers.

**Note:** This is a field-based role, not an office-based job. Candidates are not required to visit the office every day. You will manage your daily field activities, client meetings and follow-ups independently.

Key Responsibilities

* Meet business owners, founders, directors and decision-makers through daily field visits.
* Generate leads through market visits, networking, references and follow-ups.
* Identify businesses that require funding-readiness support.
* Explain the services, programme fees, deliverables and terms transparently.
* Convert qualified prospects into paying clients.
* Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline.
* Maintain daily records of leads, client visits, follow-ups and conversions in the CRM.
* Submit daily sales and activity reports.
* Coordinate with the internal team after successful client onboarding.

Target Audience

You will primarily connect with:

* Manufacturers, distributors and wholesalers.
* Traders and exporters.
* Retail and restaurant businesses.
* Clinics, laboratories and healthcare businesses.
* Education businesses.
* D2C and e-commerce brands.
* Technology startups and entrepreneurs.
* Logistics, textile and other business sectors.

Candidate Requirements

* 2–8 years of experience in target-based sales.
* Experience in Banking, NBFC, Loans, Credit Cards, Insurance, Financial Products or B2B Field Sales preferred.
* Proven track record of achieving monthly sales targets.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and client-handling skills.
* Comfortable with daily field visits and meeting business owners.
* Self-driven, proactive and capable of independently managing sales activities.
* Honest and transparent approach towards client acquisition.
* Immediate joiners only.

Monthly Targets

* **During Probation (First 3 Months):** 5 verified paid clients per month.
* **After Confirmation:** 10 verified paid clients per month.

A client is counted only after the agreement is signed, payment is received and settled, and onboarding is completed.

Salary & Incentives

**Monthly Salary Package: ₹40,000 – ₹50,000**

Incentive structure:

* 0–4 verified paid clients: No incentive.
* 5–9 verified paid clients: ₹20,000 incentive.
* 10 or more verified paid clients: ₹40,000 incentive.

Salary consists of base wages and a target-linked component, as specified in the written offer.

**Travel Allowance:**

* During probation: ₹3/km for bike and ₹2/km for scooty, based on field kilometres recorded in the CRM.
* After probation: ₹3,000 per month.

* 7-day online training programme before employment.
* Training starts: 1 December 2026.
* Certification is mandatory.
* Shortlisted candidates will complete joining formalities on 7 December 2026.
* Certified candidates who complete training and join will receive a training completion bonus equivalent to 7 days of their monthly salary package, along with

Pay: ₹45,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience you have in field sales ?
* How many years of experience you have in NBFC?
* Can you work from Pune?
* Please mention your current CTC
* Please mention your expected CTC
* Please mention your notice period?

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Associate - Legal Counsel - Cross Border - Asset & Wealth Management
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

JPMorgan Chase & Co. is a leading global financial services firm with assets of $2.6 trillion and operations worldwide, and its Legal Department provides specialized legal support aligned to the firm's lines of business and corporate staff areas. Asset & Wealth Management is one of the largest asset and wealth managers in the world, serving institutional and retail clients through Asset Management and high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients through the Private Bank. The business offers global investment management across equities, fixed income, real estate, hedge funds, private equity, and liquidity, and provides trust and estate, banking, brokerage, and retirement services. The Legal Department is seeking an experienced lawyer to support cross-border efforts, focusing on reviewing and analyzing legal opinions related to the cross-border provision of asset and wealth management products and services, and helping document and communicate related legal and regulatory requirements.

This role is based in Mumbai, India, at the J.P. Morgan Mumbai Corporate Centre, and functionally reports to:

* A Managing Director and Associate General Counsel for Asset & Wealth Management in the United States
* An Executive Director and Assistant General Counsel for Asset & Wealth Management in the United Kingdom
* A local Asset & Wealth Management Legal supervisor in Mumbai

Job summary:

As an Associate Legal Counsel within Asset & Wealth Management Legal, you will support cross-border efforts with a primary focus on reviewing and analyzing legal opinions related to the cross-border provision of products and services. You will help drive documentation of cross-border laws and regulations and communicate related requirements to business stakeholders. You will partner with lawyers, compliance partners, business stakeholders, and external counsel to maintain clear, current, and usable guidance for the business.

Job responsibilities:

* Conduct the first review of new or updated legal opinions from external counsel and new or revised draft rules for the business to provide products and services on a cross-border basis, and facilitate periodic and ad hoc updates of existing materials based on legal or regulatory changes or business developments
* Draft summaries of updates to facilitate the review-and-approval process via an internal workflow tool
* Engage with external counsel, Asset & Wealth Management lawyers, Compliance, and business stakeholders to obtain and resolve feedback on updates
* Field stakeholders' basic queries concerning the materials and fact-specific queries
* Advise as the Legal Department's first point of contact on potential issues relating to cross-border materials
* Provide regular feedback to business stakeholders and cross-border forums on pending reviews
* Conduct additional research and assist on special projects as needed
* Create and enhance audit-ready processes in a highly regulated environment, including through the use of technology

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

* Demonstrate excellent English writing and communication skills
* Hold a law degree
* Be in compliance, prior to commencement of employment, with all relevant licensing requirements, including the requirements of the jurisdiction where the role will be located
* Be sufficiently well qualified to interpret and summarize external legal advice and articulate clear “rules of the road” for the business
* Operate as a self-starter who works collaboratively in a high-performing team, takes ownership of responsibilities and projects, and is results-oriented and flexible
* Manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, complex business environment and maintain communication with attorneys regarding project status and estimated completion timelines
* Demonstrate competence with Microsoft Office products, including Microsoft Excel, and the use of large language models and artificial intelligence
* Successfully complete a conflicts of interest clearance review prior to commencement of employment (applicable to all Legal Department roles)

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

* Master of Laws (LLM) preferred
* 2–4 years of experience in financial services law
* Experience instructing and interacting with external counsel directly

Financial Controller – Entrance Control Middle East is responsible for leading the finance function, ensuring financial integrity, regulatory compliance, effective financial planning, and sustainable business performance. + ITIL / ITSM frameworks

.
  
  
By joining Citi, you will become an integral part of a global organization whose mission is to serve as a trusted partner to institutional clients by responsibly providing financial and custody services that enable growth, operational resilience, and market connectivity

The
**Investment Planning and Portfolio Oversight**
role sits within the Custody Business Execution team, and as part of the broader Investor Services business in Citi.
  
  
This role is responsible for managing the technology budgeting process for the Custody business and overseeing the execution of the change book of work.
  
  
It covers the full scope of the Custody Product set – Transaction Management, Asset Servicing, FX, Cash, Digital Assets, Tax and Business Services
  
  
Custody sits within
**Investor Services**
, part of
**Services**
—one of the primary core business lines at Citi. Serving institutional clients across more than 95 markets and operating the industry’s largest proprietary custody network in over 60 markets, Services provides integrated payments and collections, liquidity management, trade services, securities custody, fund administration, and issuer solutions to sovereign wealth funds, asset managers, banks, broker-dealers, and multinational corporations worldwide.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
As the Custody Investment Planning and Portfolio Oversight Lead, you will drive the end-to-end global technology investment portfolio for Custody. You will serve as the primary liaison between Custody Product, Operations, Technology, Finance and Investor Services to ensure that multi-million-dollar technology investments deliver strategic differentiation, regulatory compliance, risk mitigation, an improved client experience and strong commercial ROI.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead Annual Technology Investment Planning: Drive the annual and multi-year technology book of work (BoW) planning cycle for Custody, establishing and managing a transparent and rigorous investment prioritization framework.
* ROI Tracking & Portfolio Governance: Implement structured governance forums, scorecard metrics, and financial oversight to track project delivery against budget, monitor capitalization vs. expense burn, and measure post-implementation commercial/productivity ROI.
* Business Case Formulation & Appraisal: Partner with Custody Product Managers and Operations Leads to build robust, quantitative business cases and benefits-realization plans for platform modernization, process automation, digital assets capabilities, and market infrastructure mandates
* Strategic Prioritization & Risk Reduction: Balance discretionary investments against mandatory/regulatory programs, prioritizing initiatives that optimize asset safety, mitigate operational and counterparty risks, and improve straight-through processing (STP) rates.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Act as the trusted advisor and central point of coordination for senior business heads across Custody Product, Technology leads, Finance, Operations and the Investor Services team.
* Own the Custody Strategic Investment Story: Help craft the Custody investment thesis, and ensure it propagates through to the execution book of work – top down strategy alignment with bottoms up tech spend.

**What We’ll Need From You**
**Qualifications & Experience:**

* 10+ years of relevant experience in Financial Services, Securities Services/Custody, or Management Consulting with a focus on Technology Strategy, Investment Portfolio Governance, or Transformation Execution.
* Custody Knowledge: Strong understanding of the Investor Services business – including Global Custody, Direct Custody and post-trade settlement cycles.
* Portfolio & Financial Governance: Demonstrated track record in managing large-scale technology investment budgets, business case evaluations, cost-benefit analyses, and Capex allocation models.
* Transformation & Architecture Methodologies: Experience with business capability modeling, target state architecture design, and process mapping frameworks. Agile experience preferable.
* Executive Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication, storytelling, and consensus-building skills with proven ability to influence senior C-suite and managing director-level stakeholders across Product, Technology, and Operations in a matrixed environment.
* Agility & Analytical Rigour: Strong problem-solving abilities with experience managing competing priorities under tight delivery and regulatory deadlines.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Business Administration, or equivalent practical experience.
* Digital and AI native: Embrace new and improved ways of working, putting AI-capabilities at the centre of a process improvement agenda

**What We Can Offer You**

* High visibility and leadership exposure across Citi's flagship Custody franchise.
* Direct involvement in shaping the multi-year technology roadmap for a market-leading securities services provider.
* Broad exposure to cross-functional initiatives across Investor Services, Markets, and enterprise CTO domains.
* Professional development and continuous learning opportunities within a tier-1 global institution.

**Workplace & Benefits (India)**
We work hard to have a positive financial and social impact on the communities we serve. In turn, we prioritize our employees with comprehensive benefits designed to help them live well, save well, and thrive.
  
  
By joining Citi India, you will be part of a collaborative workplace supporting a
**hybrid working model**

jobs.title: IT Business Lead Analyst - Vice President
jobs.description:
Citi, the world leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and a presence in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions worldwide. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. Citi enables clients to achieve their strategic financial objectives by providing them with cutting-edge ideas, best-in-class products and solutions, and unparalleled access to capital and liquidity.
  
  
The Derivatives Credit Risk Technology Team is responsible for delivering Counterparty Credit Risk Management software solutions to Citi’s Risk organization which manages Citi’s exposure to financial institutions, governments and corporates that trade with Citi. The team builds and maintains software used to compute metrics that help mitigate Citi’s exposure to counterparty default. These include computation of optimal Margin Allocation for Portfolios and Trades, Haircut for Security and Cash Collateral, Trade and Collateral Liquidity, Collateral Concentration Levels and Wrong Way Risk, amongst others.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Liaise with stakeholders across the Risk and Front Office Technology, Counterparty Risk Management, Finance and Front Office business organizations, and external Market Regulators to assemble business requirements for Counterparty Risk Technology projects.
* Manage expectations of various stakeholder groups and help negotiate solutions to complex problems.
* Project manage complex Counterparty Credit Risk projects end to end. Accurately record, maintain, and report Program/Project management tracking data such as milestones via Citi’s internal project tracking systems.
* Help assemble/manage detailed documentation covering Counterparty Risk calculations and other processing, to be used to discuss technology implementation details with the Business users and Market Regulators in various countries/regions. Create flow diagrams, structure charts, and other types of system or process representations when appropriate.
* Facilitate and drive project meetings with both business and technology teams.
* Develop and review test scripts with business users as well as technology teams for System, User and Impact testing.
* Understand, analyse, and explain counterparty mark-to-future exposures on Derivatives books to users. Investigate Potential Future Exposure/EPE/EAD/RWA and related calculations for internal risk management and BASEL regulatory capital reporting based on the exposure profiles generated by the systems.
* Ability to trace changes in day to day exposures to changes in markets, books and or legal agreements.
* Where feasible develop excel prototypes to demonstrate and analyse risk calculations.

**Knowledge/Experience:**

* 10-15 years related experience in Business Analysis and Project Management in Capital Markets domain.
* SDLC awareness including knowledge of quality issues in software development.
* Excellent understanding of the mechanics and life cycle of derivatives products, including Options, Futures, Forwards and Swaps. Knowledge of Securities Financing Transactions (SFT) products an advantage.
* Excellent understanding of Counterparty Credit Risk
* Potential Future Exposure, Margin (ISDA MNA and CSA), Collateral Haircut, Liquidity and Period of Risk, Settlement Risk.
* Understanding of Basel III/IV and any other relevant Risk Regulations and measures including PSE, RWA, EAD.
* Knowledge of Market Risk an advantage including Credit Value Adjustment (CVA).
* Extensive project management experience, including co-ordination across remote global teams.
* Where required supervise day-to-day staff management issues, work allocation but especially mentoring/coaching.
* Data Analysis capabilities (Database or Spreadsheet), with extensive experience using Excel required.

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience. Master's degree an advantage.
* Graduate in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) or Finance disciplines.
* FRM/CFA or other Financial mathematics degree or certification is an advantage.

*Exceptional candidates who do not meet these criteria may be considered for the role provided they have the necessary skills and experience.*
**Competencies:**

* Excellent verbal and written English.
* Ability to collaborate effectively in a large global team.
* Ability to take ownership and proactively follow up on issues.
* Ability to work well under pressure, to agreed and often challenging deadlines.
* Strong organization skills.

Transition execution‑heavy work from high‑cost vendors into the iCoE through structured knowledge transfer, scaling internal capability, and reducing dependence on vendors
* Aligning contractor‑to‑FTE transitions and phasing resource migration strategically. Drive FTE vs Contractor ratio strategy, establishing a sustainable talent supply model for PMO, and other iCoEs as required

jobs.title: Global AML Center, Vice President
jobs.description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
We are looking for an experienced leader with a strong track record in AML/KYC operations and transformation to provide senior leadership within the Global AML Center (GAC) in Hyderabad.
  
  
As part of the GAC leadership team, you will own delivery & transformation across AML/KYC portfolios - onboarding, event-driven reviews, periodic reviews, screening and quality assurance. You will also help shape and drive GAC’s strategic agenda. That means leading technology-enabled change, automation and AI adoption to build a scalable, standardized and data-led operating model. You will also take on Chief Administrative Officer (CAO) responsibilities for GAC: overseeing business management, budget and headcount planning, governance, and the site and people agenda in Hyderabad. You will balance strong day-to-day delivery with a clear view of where the function needs to be in the future.
  
  
**Why this role is important to us**
The Global AML Center carries out AML/KYC activities as part of State Street’s global AML operating model. This includes Customer Identification Program (CIP), Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), customer verification and customer risk rating across all business areas. Hyderabad is a key part of GAC’s global footprint.
  
  
Volumes, regulatory expectations and methodology changes keep growing, and adding capacity alone is not a sustainable answer. This role is central to changing how GAC operates: cutting manual effort, strengthening controls through technology and data, and positioning GAC as a strategic partner to the business rather than a purely operational function. As GAC grows, it also needs strong business management discipline: clear financial and headcount oversight, consistent governance, and a well-run site and people agenda.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
As Vice President you will:
  
  
***Operational Leadership***

* Provide senior leadership for GAC operations in Hyderabad and act as a key point of contact for local India management and global stakeholders
* Own end-to-end delivery across assigned AML/KYC portfolios against agreed service, quality, risk and productivity standards
* Keep active oversight of volumes, pipeline, ageing and capacity, and raise emerging pressure before it affects delivery or compliance
* Set clear priorities across BAU, new business, remediation and regulatory commitments, and move resources as demand changes

***Strategy & Technology Change***

* Help shape GAC’s strategic direction and multi-year transformation roadmap, in line with business growth, regulatory change and the target operating model
* Lead strategic change initiatives from idea through to delivery and adoption, with clear business cases, measurable outcomes and benefits tracking
* Act as the business lead for technology change, working with Technology, product and change teams on enhancements to KYC platforms, workflow tools and data capability
* Identify and drive opportunities for automation, AI, digitization and workflow integration that reduce manual effort, improve turnaround times and strengthen controls
* Champion data-led decision making through better MI, dashboards and real-time visibility of pipeline, risk and performance
* Make sure process, policy and methodology changes are turned into sustainable system and operational changes, reducing reliance on manual workarounds
* Prioritize the change portfolio and balance investment, capacity and risk to deliver the greatest business value
* Build a culture of innovation and continuous improvement, and grow change and digital capability within the team

***Business Management & CAO***

* Act as CAO for GAC, partnering with the GAC Head on business management, planning and execution of the leadership agenda
* Lead annual budget, headcount and workforce planning, including capacity models, run-rate tracking, attrition and backfill planning
* Track expenses, productivity and cost efficiency, and support business cases for investment and location strategy
* Run the GAC management operating rhythm, including leadership meetings, governance forums, management reporting and executive or board materials
* Coordinate senior stakeholder and regulatory reporting, ensuring information is accurate, consistent and on time
* Track key initiatives, decisions and actions across the leadership team, making sure commitments are followed through
* Oversee administrative controls, including policies and procedures, entitlements and access, business continuity and resilience planning
* Partner with HR, Finance, Procurement, Real Estate and Technology on hiring, onboarding, workforce management, space and infrastructure
* Lead the Hyderabad site and culture agenda, including employee engagement, communications, town halls, recognition and talent programs

***Risk, Control & Governance***

* Maintain a strong control environment in line with AML/KYC policies, procedures and regulatory requirements
* Identify and address emerging operational and regulatory risks before they affect the business, and escalate where needed
* Ensure new technology, automation and AI solutions are put in place with appropriate controls, governance and risk oversight
* Support audit, regulatory and governance requirements

***Stakeholder Leadership***

* Work with Business Units, Compliance, Technology and Risk teams to resolve dependencies, close control gaps and drive accountability
* Represent GAC in senior forums with clear, fact-based views on delivery, strategy, risk, capacity and the decisions required
* Influence senior stakeholders to secure support and investment for strategic and technology initiatives

***People Leadership***

* Attract, develop and retain strong talent, and build leadership depth and succession across the Hyderabad organization
* Hold managers and teams accountable for outcomes while empowering them to make decisions, and create opportunities for them to realize their full potential
* Lead teams through change, building adoption and new ways of working

**What We Value**
These skills will help you succeed in this role
  
  

* Strong understanding of KYC/CDD/EDD, client onboarding, periodic reviews, screening and financial crime controls
* Strategic thinking: the ability to set direction and turn a long-term vision into executable plans
* A proven track record of leading technology-enabled transformation, automation or digital change in a regulated environment
* An understanding of how workflow platforms, data, automation and AI can redesign operating models
* Proven ability to lead large, complex teams, including managing other managers
* A forward-looking approach to risk, with the ability to anticipate issues rather than react to them
* Strong analytical skills, with experience using MI, KPIs and capacity data to drive decisions
* Excellent interpersonal, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge constructively
* Strong business management and financial acumen, including budgeting, headcount and workforce planning
* Ability to run a disciplined management rhythm and produce clear executive and board-level materials
* A collaborative leadership style that balances empowerment with accountability

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* 15+ years of relevant experience in AML/KYC, financial crime or operations within a large global financial institution
* Demonstrated experience leading strategic transformation and technology change programs, from business case to adoption
* Significant senior people leadership experience, including leading leaders
* Experience in business management role, including budget, headcount and governance ownership, is strongly preferred
* Bachelor’s degree required
* Strong knowledge of global AML/KYC regulatory requirements
* Experience with KYC workflow platforms (e.g., Fenergo/FenX), automation tools or AI solutions is an advantage
* Change or pro

jobs.description:
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Senior Manager, IT Delivery leads globally distributed technology teams responsible for delivering and operating business-critical platforms, products, and digital experiences supporting Financial Advisor Services. The role partners with Product, Business, Architecture, Operations, and Technology leaders to shape demand, establish priorities, and translate strategy into reliable, scalable business outcomes.
  
  
This leader is accountable for end-to-end software delivery, engineering excellence, operational resilience, security, talent development, and vendor performance. The role will support the continued evolution of advisor and model-portfolio capabilities while preparing teams to adopt modern cloud, automation, data, and AI-enabled engineering practices.
  
  
As the organization evolves, the role is expected to expand its leadership scope across advisor-facing digital experiences, including modern front-end technologies and Adobe Experience Manager (AEM). Experience in this area is preferred and strongly recommended.
  
  
**Leadership opportunity:**
Build high-performing teams, modernize advisor-facing technology, and help shape the next generation of scalable digital and AI-enabled capabilities within FAST.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead, develop, and inspire high-performing engineering and technology teams responsible for delivering business-critical platforms, products, and services supporting advisor and investment solutions.
* Drive execution of strategic technology initiatives, ensuring alignment with business priorities, modernization objectives, client outcomes, and long-term platform roadmaps.
* Oversee end-to-end delivery across the software development lifecycle, ensuring solutions are delivered with quality, reliability, scalability, accessibility, and strong operational readiness.
* Partner with Product, Business, Architecture, User Experience, Operations, Risk, and Technology leaders to shape demand, establish priorities, manage dependencies, and deliver measurable business value.
* Establish and monitor delivery, service-health, reliability, security, and engineering-effectiveness measures while driving continuous improvement across teams.
* Build and manage globally distributed teams by hiring, coaching, mentoring, and developing technology professionals while fostering accountability, inclusion, innovation, and continuous learning.
* Lead platform and digital-experience modernization focused on cloud adoption, APIs, automation, observability, resiliency, simplified architecture, and reusable engineering patterns.
* Guide the evolution of modern front-end and content-management capabilities, including future expansion into Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), in partnership with architecture, product, design, and engineering leaders.
* Drive operational excellence by improving controls, reducing technology risk, strengthening release readiness, managing vulnerabilities, and ensuring compliance with security, privacy, risk, and governance expectations.
* Provide oversight for incident response, production health, root-cause analysis, and sustainable corrective actions for business-critical services.
* Manage vendor and third-party relationships, ensuring clear accountability, effective capacity planning, quality execution, knowledge transfer, and delivery against contractual commitments.
* Identify opportunities to apply Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, intelligent automation, and data-driven capabilities to improve engineering productivity, operations, and business outcomes.
* Communicate strategy, delivery progress, risks, trade-offs, and outcomes clearly to senior technology and business leaders.

**Must Have Qualifications**

* Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of training and experience.
* Progressive technology leadership experience, including responsibility for engineering teams, software delivery, production operations, and complex cross-functional initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience leading globally distributed teams and developing technical talent across multiple roles and experience levels.
* Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices, cloud platforms, APIs, distributed systems, DevSecOps, observability, resiliency, and secure development practices.
* Experience partnering with product and business leaders to shape technology strategy, manage priorities, and deliver measurable outcomes in a complex enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated ability to manage delivery risk, cross-team dependencies, organizational change, and vendor or third-party relationships.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders at multiple levels.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading modern front-end and digital-experience technology teams, with exposure to Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with modern web frameworks, content-management platforms, design systems, accessibility standards, and scalable digital-experience architectures. This capability is strongly recommended because the role is expected to expand into the AEM and front-end technology space within FAST.

* Experience with AWS or comparable cloud platforms, serverless architecture, API-led integration, data platforms, and modern CI/CD practices.
* Experience applying AI, Generative AI, or intelligent automation within software engineering, operations, or digital product delivery.
* Experience leading platform modernization, operating-model evolution, or transformation across multiple products and teams.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**
**Benefits**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.

Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Product Control GBS team is accountable for delivery of the end-to-end product & valuation control functions in GBS and lead different strategic initiatives for Macro Product Control.
  
We are seeking a dynamic and technically skilled professional to join our team as Vice President – Macro Product Control, reporting into the Product Control Management which rolls up to Global Head, Product Control. This role will play a pivotal part in expanding the Bank’s Macro capabilities, developing compliant and commercially effective strategies, and supporting transition initiatives. The successful candidate will act as lead running the Macro Product Control team, working closely with Technical Accounting, COO’s, Product Control, and other key stakeholders to deliver best-in-class Macro Product Control across the Group.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategy**

* Responsible for producing and managing the Daily P&L workflow for the Macro desk
* Spearhead the end-to-end design and implementation of Macro changes —from opportunity assessment to final accounting approval. This could include TP changes, accounting changes etc.
* Identification and remediation of control gaps
* Lead Proof-of-Concept (PoC) initiatives for new strategies, business models, sig trade reviews and new product approvals for the bank
  

**Business**

* Partner with Technical Accounting, Group Reporting, and Product Control to drive compliance with applicable accounting standards (e.g., IAS 39, IFRS 9).
* Coordinate with Valuation Control and other key stakeholders to ensure book closure is accurate.

**Processes**

* **Responsible for running various PC Handbook related controls like Daily P&L reporting, Actual vs Estimates, P&L commentaries, VaR backtesting submissions.**
* **Collaborate closely with regional and cross-functional teams (e.g., Macro, local CFOs, TA, COO, VC) to deliver enterprise-wide initiatives.**
* **Champion thought leadership, mentor peers, and support knowledge-sharing across regions.**

**People & Talent**

* **To lead, inspire and motivate the team ensuring that everyone achieves their potential and that the team delivers its collective agenda.**
* **Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from the team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners across the organization.**

**Risk Management**

* **Prepare and present complex technical Macro Product papers under IAS 39/IFRS 9 for internal stakeholders and external auditor endorsement**

**Governance**

* **Lead and manage financial projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.**

**Key Stakeholders**

* **Head and Directors, Macro, Global**
* **Technical Accountant team, Singapore**
* **Valuation Control team, Singapore, India**
* **Macro COO team, Singapore, India**
* **Macro CFO team, Singapore, India**
* **Product Control, India**
* **Sabre Tech team, Singapore**

**Qualifications**
------------------

* **Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field; a Master’s degree or professional certification (e.g., CA, CPA, CFA) is strongly preferred.**
* **12+ years of experience in finance or accounting functions, with a strong preference for candidates with Macro Product expertise.**
* **Deep technical knowledge of Macro Products and their accounting (e.g., IAS 39) and practical experience in financial instrument valuation.**
* **Demonstrated success in designing and executing Macro Product strategies across multiple risk types.**
* **Strong analytical mindset and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to apply judgment in data-driven decisions.**
* **Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively influence and collaborate across business, finance, and technical teams.**
* **Familiarity with Macro Product tools and financial systems (e.g., Sabre Cortex, Murex) is an advantage.**
