jobs.title: Vice President, DataDesk – Vendor Onboarding & Automation
jobs.description:
Your Team Responsibilities:

MSCI's DataDesk team owns the onboarding of new vendor datasets into MSCI's data ecosystem — ensuring new sources are integrated quickly, validated rigorously, and governed well from day one. We're looking for a Vice President to lead and scale this function by embedding AI and automation into the onboarding lifecycle, while bringing genuine technical fluency with data to work credibly alongside Research content, Products, engineering and AI teams.

Your Key Responsibilities:

**Vendor Onboarding & Due Diligence**

* Own end-to-end onboarding of new vendor datasets — from initial due diligence and scope assessment through integration and go-live
* Define and enforce onboarding standards: identifier mapping at ingestion, full scope pre-onboarding assessment, QA assessment and fit for purpose qualification, formal SLAs definition with clear escalation ownership
* Conduct vendor due diligence and maintain trusted relationships with data providers
* Assess onboarded datasets to identify coverage gaps and quality issues, and partner with the vendor to remediate them
* Lead root-cause analysis on onboarding delays or quality gaps, and drive process fixes (as opposed to one-off fire-fighting)

**AI & Automation-Led Scaling**

* Identify and implement AI/automation opportunities across the onboarding pipeline — e.g., automated identifier/field mapping, validation rule generation, matching and reconciliation logic
* Partner with engineering/AI teams to build or adopt tooling that automates QA diagnostic and certification, reduce manual onboarding effort and turnaround time, acting as the functional expert who validates outputs against real onboarding scenarios
* Continuously evaluate emerging AI techniques and apply them to reduce onboarding cycle time and error rates
* Track and report onboarding efficiency metrics (cycle time, automation coverage, error/rework rates) to leadership
* Incorporate AI-based data usage/rights validation into the data collection process, ensuring new vendor sources are governance-compliant before integration
* Enrich and expose AI powered catalogue of data, QA / Diagnostic and other DataDesk Services

**Data Quality & Governance**

* Define validation rules and quality benchmarks for newly onboarded vendor data
* Ensure onboarded datasets meet MSCI's data standards for accuracy, consistency, and compliance before integration
* Collaborate with product and downstream teams to assess data fit and flag risks early in the onboarding process
* Conduct a quarterly assessment of MSCI's vendor data risk across product lines and single points of failure, identify possible remediations or alternatives, and present findings to senior leadership to inform operational planning and investment decisions

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Lead and mentor a team of analysts/associates involved in onboarding and vendor evaluation
* Engage with internal and external stakeholders to align on onboarding priorities, resolve escalations, and ensure timely, transparent communication throughout the onboarding lifecycle
* Partner with global stakeholders across product, research, technology, and operations to align onboarding priorities and standards
* Present onboarding pipeline status, risks, and automation roadmap to senior leadership

Your skills and experience that will help you excel:

**Experience:** 10+ years in data operations, vendor management, or data onboarding, ideally in financial data/index/analytics

**Technical Skills:**

* Strong understanding of data structures, formats, and identifiers (LEI, DUNS, CUSIP/ISIN) sufficient to assess vendor data fit and define validation logic
* Working proficiency in SQL and Python — able to review/write validation and matching logic, not just specify requirements
* Experience applying AI/ML or automation tools to data matching, validation, or process acceleration
* Comfort working directly with engineering/AI teams as a technical counterpart, not just a requirements source

**Domain Knowledge:**

* Familiarity with vendor data landscape (e.g., FactSet, LSEG/EJV, ICE, EDI) and cross-vendor field mapping challenges
* Understanding of financial reference data concepts (entities, securities, classifications) as they relate to onboarding validation

**Soft Skills:** Strong stakeholder and vendor relationship management, project management, and the ability to translate operational pain points into automation opportunities

  
About MSCI:

**What we offer you**

* Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
* Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
* A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.
* A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients.
* Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center , LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development.
* Multi-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles.
* We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.

At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our vision – to power better decisions. You’ll be part of an industry-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry.

MSCI strengthens global markets by connecting participants across the financial ecosystem with a common language. Our research-based data, analytics and indexes, supported by advanced technology, set standards for global investors and help our clients understand risks and opportunities so they can make better decisions and unlock innovation. jobs.title: Business Senior Analyst - Assistant Vice President
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

Citi, the world leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and a presence in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions worldwide. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. Citi enables clients to achieve their strategic financial objectives by providing them with cutting-edge ideas, best-in-class products and solutions, and unparalleled access to capital and liquidity.

  
  

The Derivatives Credit Risk Technology Team is responsible for delivering Counterparty Credit Risk Management software solutions to Citi’s Risk organization which manages Citi’s exposure to financial institutions, governments and corporates that trade with Citi. The team builds and maintains software used to compute metrics that help mitigate Citi’s exposure to counterparty default. These include computation of optimal Margin Allocation for Portfolios and Trades, Haircut for Security and Cash Collateral, Trade and Collateral Liquidity, Collateral Concentration Levels and Wrong Way Risk, amongst others.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  
  

* Liaise with stakeholders across the Risk and Front Office Technology, Counterparty Risk Management, Finance and Front Office business organizations, and external Market Regulators to assemble business requirements for Counterparty Risk Technology projects.

* Manage expectations of various stakeholder groups and help negotiate solutions to complex problems.

* Project manage complex Counterparty Credit Risk projects end to end. Accurately record, maintain, and report Program/Project management tracking data such as milestones via Citi’s internal project tracking systems.

* Help assemble/manage detailed documentation covering Counterparty Risk calculations and other processing, to be used to discuss technology implementation details with the Business users and Market Regulators in various countries/regions. Create flow diagrams, structure charts, and other types of system or process representations when appropriate.

* Facilitate and drive project meetings with both business and technology teams.

* Develop and review test scripts with business users as well as technology teams for System, User and Impact testing.

* Understand, analyse, and explain counterparty mark-to-future exposures on Derivatives books to users. Investigate Potential Future Exposure/EPE/EAD/RWA and related calculations for internal risk management and BASEL regulatory capital reporting based on the exposure profiles generated by the systems.

* Ability to trace changes in day to day exposures to changes in markets, books and or legal agreements.

* Where feasible develop excel prototypes to demonstrate and analyse risk calculations.
  

  

**Knowledge/Experience:**

  
  

* 8-12 years related experience in Business Analysis and Project Management in Capital Markets domain.

* SDLC awareness including knowledge of quality issues in software development.

* Excellent understanding of the mechanics and life cycle of derivatives products, including Options, Futures, Forwards and Swaps. Knowledge of Securities Financing Transactions (SFT) products an advantage.

* Excellent understanding of Counterparty Credit Risk

* Potential Future Exposure, Margin (ISDA MNA and CSA), Collateral Haircut, Liquidity and Period of Risk, Settlement Risk.

* Understanding of Basel III/IV and any other relevant Risk Regulations and measures including PSE, RWA, EAD.

* Knowledge of Market Risk an advantage including Credit Value Adjustment (CVA).

* Extensive project management experience, including co-ordination across remote global teams.

* Where required supervise day-to-day staff management issues, work allocation but especially mentoring/coaching.

* Data Analysis capabilities (Database or Spreadsheet), with extensive experience using Excel required.
  

  

**Education:**

  
  

* Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience. Master's degree an advantage.

* Graduate in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) or Finance disciplines.

* FRM/CFA or other Financial mathematics degree or certification is an advantage.

*Exceptional candidates who do not meet these criteria may be considered for the role provided they have the necessary skills and experience.*

  
  

**Competencies:**

  
  

* Excellent verbal and written English.

* Ability to collaborate effectively in a large global team.

* Ability to take ownership and proactively follow up on issues.

* Ability to work well under pressure, to agreed and often challenging deadlines.

* Strong organization skills.

Our mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress. We strive to earn and maintain our clients and the publics trust by constantly adhering to the highest ethical standards and making a positive impact on the communities we serve. Our Leadership Standards is a common set of skills and expected behaviors that illustrate how our employees should work every day to be successful and strengthens our ability to execute against our strategic priorities.

  
  

**The Quality Assurance and Testing Validation (QATV) team** delivers independent oversight and rigorous validation across the organization's regulatory reporting ecosystem and is dedicated to ensuring the highest standards of accuracy, reliability and control through testing Citi’s regulatory and management reporting while providing an objective assessment of issue remediation.

QATV Reporting & Analytics team provides analytical support on:

Reporting & Intelligence — Building and maintaining data marts, synthesizing test results into quantitative metrics, and authoring detailed qualitative narratives and formal publication reports for senior stakeholders and report owners.

Operational Intelligence & Capacity Planning — Monitor testing sprints to ensure timeline adherence, leading proactive capacity planning across all execution phases, and leveraging skill assessments to assign qualified personnel to appropriate testing stages.

Testing & Exception Management Automation — Automation of design, creation, and execution of test scripts

  
  

**Job Summary:**

**Assistant Vice President (IC) - Data\Information Management** will be part of QATV team within Citi AIM vertical, a global community driving data-driven transformation across Citi. AIM's objective is to generate actionable intelligence for business leaders. In this role, the Analyst will support the QATV function by maintaining dedicated testing data marts, consolidating validation outcomes, identifying data inconsistencies, and assisting in the drafting of detailed narrative reports and metrics for final publication to key stakeholders.

Working in close collaboration with team leads, the Analyst will also support testing delivery governance and resource management. This includes monitoring sprint cycles to track milestone adherence, maintaining capacity planning models to ensure balanced workload distribution, and assisting with skills-matrix assessments to align team capabilities with testing demand across all phases of regulatory validation.

  
  

**In this role, you are expected to:**

* Assist in organizing and maintaining dedicated testing data marts and data pipelines.
* Expertise in data management principles, SQL, SAS programming for data extraction, manipulation and validations. Guide and mentor junior members in team in this area.
* Use of data warehousing concepts, ETL processes, and experience working with Business Intelligence platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI). To act as SME in this area and go-to person for the team.
* Research and identify data inconsistencies, trends, or reporting gaps to support root-cause analysis.
* Automate current process to remove manual effort
* Develop workflows and automation logic using SAS, SQL, Workflow tools
* Conduct in-depth analyses of current operational processes to identify inefficiencies and areas for improvement.
* Continuously improve processes and strategies by exploring and evaluating new data sources, tools, and capabilities
* Work closely with internal and external business partners in building, implementing, tracking and improving decision strategies
* Support your team and help them accomplish their goals with empathy. You act as a facilitator and remove blockers and create a positive atmosphere for them to be innovative and productive at work
  

  

**Qualifications:**

* Work experience: 8+ years with Masters as Educational background

* Technical Skills: Expertise in data management principles, SQL, SAS , Python programming for data extraction and manipulation, and database management systems. Including Tableau, and other BI tools.

* Strong coding expertise in SAS & SQL, Autosys package.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and quantify opportunities for improvement.

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

* Banking Knowledge: Good understanding of the banking domain, banking products and Operations in banking is preferred.
* Soft Skills: Ability to multi-task effectively and efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

**Overview**:

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. Our core activities are safeguarding assets, lending money, making payments and accessing the capital markets on behalf of our clients.

Our mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress. We strive to earn and maintain our clients and the publics trust by constantly adhering to the highest ethical standards and making a positive impact on the communities we serve. Our Leadership Standards is a common set of skills and expected behaviors that illustrate how our employees should work every day to be successful and strengthens our ability to execute against our strategic priorities.

  
  

**The Quality Assurance and Testing Validation (QATV) team** delivers independent oversight and rigorous validation across the organization's regulatory reporting ecosystem and is dedicated to ensuring the highest standards of accuracy, reliability and control through testing Citi’s regulatory and management reporting while providing an objective assessment of issue remediation.

QATV Reporting & Analytics team provides analytical support on:

Reporting & Intelligence — Building and maintaining data marts, synthesizing test results into quantitative metrics, and authoring detailed qualitative narratives and formal publication reports for senior stakeholders and report owners.

Operational Intelligence & Capacity Planning — Monitor testing sprints to ensure timeline adherence, leading proactive capacity planning across all execution phases, and leveraging skill assessments to assign qualified personnel to appropriate testing stages.

Testing & Exception Management Automation — Automation of design, creation, and execution of test scripts

  
  

**Job Summary:**

The **Assistant Vice President (IC) - Specialized Analytics** is a developing professional role within the QATV team. This role applies specialized expertise in machine learning, statistical modeling, data science, and advanced AI technologies (including Generative AI and Agentic AI) to revolutionize how regulatory testing is executed, analyzed, and governed.

The Data Science Analyst will partner with QATV testing and reporting teams to identify high-impact opportunities for automation, predictive analytics, and intelligent reporting. Key responsibilities include applying AI/ML techniques to detect complex data anomalies, automating test narrative generation, predicting testing cycle risks, and optimizing testing sprint capacity and resource allocation.

**In this role, you are expected to:**

* **Predictive Defect & Risk Modeling:** Build predictive analytics and forecasting models to project test execution cycle times, identify recurring defect patterns, and anticipate regulatory reporting risks before filing deadlines.
* **Testing Intelligence & Metrics:** Analyze historical test execution data to uncover systemic data quality trends, derive actionable quality scores, and provide data-driven recommendations to strengthen internal control frameworks.

* **Automated Narrative Generation:** Design, build, and deploy Generative AI solutions (using LLMs, prompt engineering, and RAG architectures) to automate the drafting of complex, audit-ready narrative test summaries and executive readouts.
* **Agentic AI & Workflow Automation:** Experiment with and develop Agentic AI workflows (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph) to automate multi-step validation checks, intelligent test result consolidation, and autonomous exception routing.
* **AI Evaluation & Guardrails:** Establish robust benchmarking tools, validation frameworks, and guardrails to evaluate the accuracy, hallucination risks, consistency, and performance of deployed AI/GenAI models.

* **Resource & Capacity Modeling:** Develop quantitative models and optimization algorithms to enhance sprint capacity planning, workload balancing, and skill-to-task allocation across multi-phase testing cycles.
* **Sprint Analytics & Tracking:** Build automated intelligence pipelines and interactive dashboards (Power BI / Tableau) to track sprint velocity, defect burn-down rates, and milestone adherence in real time.
* **Automated Test Script Generation:** Leverage Generative AI and LLM-powered pipelines to automate the creation, synthesis, and maintenance of standardized regulatory test scripts, validation rules.

* **Control, Risk & Governance:** Ensure all data science and AI applications comply with Citi Model Risk Management (MRM), Responsible AI guidelines, and data governance policies. Appropriately assess risk when developing solutions, ensuring transparent escalation and adherence to all supervisory standards.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in QATV by managing expectations and ensuring alignment on project goals and deliverables. Communicate project status, risks, and issues to stakeholders timely manner
* **Team Player & Mentor:** Provide technical leadership and guidance to junior team members. Mentor and coach team members on best practices in data analysis, reporting, and data infrastructure management

**Qualifications:**

* Work experience: 8+ years with Masters as Educational background

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and quantify opportunities for improvement.

* Programming & ML Frameworks: Strong programming skills in Python with proficiency in data science and ML libraries (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Transformers).

* Generative AI & LLMs: Hands-on experience developing GenAI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Chroma, Milvus), and API integration.

* Agentic Frameworks & MLOps: Practical exposure to agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or AutoGen, along with foundational knowledge of MLOps and model deployment pipelines.

* Data Engineering & SQL: Advanced SQL skills with experience querying, manipulating, and transforming large datasets from relational databases and testing data marts (e.g., Oracle, Snowflake, PostgreSQL).

* Data Visualization & BI: Experience building interactive analytics dashboards using Tableau or Power BI.

ICM’s objective is to provide integrated end-to-end credit underwriting, identification, measurement, management, and monitoring for wholesale credit across the enterprise.

Within ICM, the Credit Underwriting function (“ICM UW” or “UW”) provides credit analysis, underwriting, and first line of defense credit approval for periodic / material transaction reviews, and any necessary subsequent credit monitoring across all institutional business including Corporate Banking, Services, and Markets relationships.

ICM Underwriters manage a portfolio of relationships, being responsible for the continuous monitoring of that portfolio. We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the India Demat Team within India International Wealth and Premier Banking as Assistant Vice President – Demat Operations.

  

**Role Purpose**

  

The role holder will manage end-to-end depository participant operations within a regulated bank environment, encompassing demat account opening and servicing, settlement monitoring, reconciliations, income and DP charge controls, and regulatory reporting. The role will ensure accurate and timely execution in accordance with applicable SEBI requirements, NSDL/CDSL rules and bye-laws, PMLA, and HSBC policies and operating procedures.

  + Ensure accurate and timely processing of dematerialisation and rematerialisation requests (DRF/RRF), Delivery Instruction Slips (DIS), pledge, un-pledge and invocation requests, and off-market and inter-depository transfers.
  + Monitor settlement cycles and ensure timely reconciliation with depositories and clearing corporations.
  + Oversee daily, weekly and monthly reconciliations of client holdings, DP balances, suspense accounts and control accounts; investigate and resolve reconciliation breaks.
  + Manage provisioning of income entries and reconciliation of DP charges in coordination with Finance/Accounts.
  + Prepare and submit regulatory and depository reports within prescribed timelines and maintain accurate MIS for management review and compliance oversight.

  + Promote disciplined execution, clear accountability and strong collaboration across first- and second-line stakeholders.

* **Leadership and Teamwork**
  

* + Demonstrate ownership and accountability for assigned DP operations and coordinate with stakeholders to meet operational, regulatory and audit deadlines.

* **Operational Effectiveness & Control**
  

* Conduct periodic process and control reviews to identify operational and regulatory risks.
* Own audit and inspection observations, agree remediation plans and ensure timely, evidenced closure.
* Monitor implementation of regulatory and product changes and confirm that required controls operate effectively.
* Proactively identify and escalate material operational, regulatory, conduct or control risks.
* Regulatory and business deliverables completed within prescribed timelines.
* Timely and sustainable closure of audit, inspection, compliance and control actions.
* Accuracy and completeness of regulatory trackers, governance records, evidence and management information.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**Custody Product Manager**
**The opportunity & role purpose**
Emirates NBD Capital Custody is building a larger, more connected custody franchise combining high-touch local service, regional and international market access, the wider Emirates NBD ecosystem and institutional-grade control. We are seeking a commercially minded Product Manager to turn this ambition into a prioritized, scalable and profitable product roadmap.
  
  
**Role purpose**
Own the end-to-end Custody product agenda across strategy, proposition, commercial performance, governance and delivery. The role will optimize existing services, expand the product set and support new business across priority client segments.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
Product strategy and proposition
  
  

* Define and maintain a three-year product roadmap based on client demand, commercial value, strategic fit, delivery complexity, risk and scalability.
* Monitor market, competitor, regulatory and technology developments across local and global custody, sub-custody, funds, collateral and digital assets.
* Lead new-product development from concept through business case, approval, operating model, pricing, launch and adoption.
* Evaluate build, buy, partner and network options, ensuring solutions are commercially viable and operationally deliverable.

Commercial and business development
  
  

* Partner with Business Development, Relationship Management and the wider Emirates NBD franchise to convert client needs into viable solutions.
* Support pitches, RFPs, due diligence, pricing and solution design for new and existing clients.
* Create segment-led propositions, identify appropriate target clients and build profitability models for new products.
* Own product performance across Assets under Custody, revenue, pricing, yield, linked cash, FX, ancillary income and fee leakage.

Delivery, technology and client experience
  
  

* Act as product owner for priority change, defining scope, requirements, milestones, acceptance criteria, risks and benefits.
* Work with Technology and Operations to increase automation and straight-through processing across onboarding, settlement, corporate actions, reporting, reconciliations, billing and service quality.
* Advance client connectivity through portal, SWIFT, API, SFTP and configurable reporting; maintain a transparent backlog and escalate blockers early.

Governance and market engagement
  
  

* Ensure propositions meet product approval, legal, regulatory, tax, financial-crime, data, cyber-security and operational-risk requirements.
* Maintain a robust product-control framework with Legal, Compliance, Risk, Finance, Operations and Internal Audit.
* Manage relationships with exchanges, CSDs, ICSDs, global custodians and vendors; represent Emirates NBD Capital in relevant client and industry discussions.

**First 12 months**

* Diagnose - Validate the current product perimeter, client needs, operating constraints, economics, control gaps and in-flight change.
* Prioritize - Agree a funded three-year roadmap and decide what to accelerate, partner for, defer or stop.
* Deliver - Progress the highest-value capabilities, focusing on market connectivity, institutional and sub-custody readiness, digital servicing, reporting and automation.
* Commercialize - Package propositions by segment, equip client-facing teams and embed product-level pricing and profitability disciplines.
* Measure - Establish a monthly scorecard covering assets, revenue, profitability, linked cash, activity, adoption, delivery, service health and realised benefits.

Measures of success:
  
  

* Roadmap delivery against agreed milestones, budget and benefits.
* Incremental Assets under Custody and revenue enabled by new or enhanced products.
* Improved product yield, linked cash, ancillary wallet capture and pipeline conversion.
* Greater adoption of portal, SWIFT, API, SFTP and automated reporting.
* Reduced manual touchpoints, exceptions, service issues and operational risk.
* Timely product approvals, control remediation and effective change governance.

**Essential**
**Experience and capabilities**

* Minimum five years' relevant experience in custody, securities services, post-trade, transaction banking, market infrastructure or a related institutional financial-services business.
* Proven product-management experience across strategy, business cases, governance, requirements, delivery, launch and performance.
* Working knowledge of safekeeping, settlement, corporate actions, cash, FX, tax, reporting, reconciliations and custody operating models.
* Strong commercial judgement, linking client needs and product choices to pricing, profitability, assets, revenue and wider relationship value.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and work across Operations, Technology, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Finance, Sales and Relationship Management.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

Highly desirable
  
  

* UAE or GCC custody experience and familiarity with SCA, UAE exchanges, CSDs and regional institutional clients.
* Knowledge of global-custody networks, ICSDs, sub-custody, fund settlement, collateral, securities financing or custody-linked lending.
* Exposure to TCS BaNCS, SWIFT, APIs, SFTP, client portals, institutional reporting, Agile delivery or digital-asset propositions.

The person we are looking for
  
  
You combine product depth with commercial energy. You can navigate operational details and bank governance while maintaining pace and ambition. You are credible with clients, precise with control functions, pragmatic with technology and comfortable presenting investment cases to senior management.
  
  
If you do not meet every requirement but believe you can materially contribute to our ambition, please apply with a covering letter explaining the value you would bring.
  
  
There’s never been a better time to join Emirates NBD.
  
  
We’re one of the region’s most recognizable brands. We’re banking innovation leaders. We’re growing across both the UAE and our global offices. We offer a huge range of professional development opportunities to accelerate your career. It also goes without saying that we provide extremely competitive rewards, benefits and perks too, like our flexible work policy so you can work from home whenever it suits.
  
  
At ENBD, we encourage interested candidates to review the key responsibilities and qualifications for each role and apply for positions that match their skills and capabilities.

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB) is an emerging markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.

Credit & Capital Management Services (CCMS) under CIB are in the process of implementing a new, modern, and consistent E2E operating model. A key component of this operating model is the introduction of a first line credit management office, the Business Credit Office (BCO). The BCO function will complete tasks currently owned by multiple actors in the management of the first line credit risk responsibilities including structuring, credit analysis and rating recommendation, client credit monitoring tasks, credit terms and document negotiation and clients acting as a single handoff from a RM to the BCO for all Credit & Lending (C&L) tasks, creating a single control point. The function will be client facing and customer service orientated.

We are currently seeking an ambitious professional to join the team as an Assistant Vice President who will provide credit advisory and support services to Relationship Managers (RMs) / Coverage. This includes facilitating client review and renewal activities, and is responsible for carrying out customer outreach, research, financial and credit analysis on behalf of the RMs, ensuring exemplary risk management acumen and control standards are embedded within the end-to-end C&L process

**Description**

At the **International Finance Corporation (IFC)**, a member of the **World Bank Group (WBG)**, you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. In fiscal year 2026, IFC committed a record $105.6 billion to private companies and financial institutions in developing countries. For more information, visit www.ifc.org.

The CFO and Capital Mobilization Vice Presidency, led by IFC’s Vice President and CFO, mobilizes private capital at scale to support clients that create jobs and drive growth in emerging markets. It brings together debt and equity mobilization, investor engagement, blended finance, and partnerships functions to expand the pool of capital available for development, while also overseeing the Corporation’s financial strategy and reporting, balance sheet management, and treasury functions. This prudent financial stewardship safeguards IFC’s AAA credit rating and ensures discipline, transparency, and alignment with institutional priorities.

Looking ahead, the VPU’s vision is to channel private capital into the sectors with the greatest potential to create jobs by embedding Originate-to-Distribute (OtD) approaches into IFC’s operating model, deepening and diversifying engagement with investors, donors, and development partners, and delivering innovative financial solutions that attract institutional capital to emerging markets. It will leverage data, technology, and market expertise to scale impact and improve efficiency.

As IFC continues to scale its impact and mobilize private capital at scale, in support of the WBG goal of creating jobs that lift people out of poverty, its ability to attract long term institutional investors to invest in IFC-originated emerging market assets has become increasingly central to its operating and financial model. In the context of heightened global uncertainty, constrained public resources, and rising development needs, effective engagement with institutional investors is critical to creating jobs, and sustaining and expanding development impact across emerging markets.

IFC’s originate-to-distribute and capital mobilization initiatives—including securitization, the Managed Co Lending Portfolio Program (MCPP), B Loan syndications, parallel loans, private equity funds and anchor bond investing, thematic bond issuances, blended finance facilities, and other structured mobilization vehicles—have expanded substantially in recent years, reflecting IFC’s strong focus on originating assets that both meet World Bank Group’s development mandate and are consistent with the investment preferences of institutional investors.

To support this strategically critical agenda, IFC is seeking Principal Investor Relations Officers in IFC’s Global Investor Relations function to work in collaboration with IFC’s originate-to-distribute (OtD) initiative and to help embed OtD into the operating model of IFC, by leading and strengthening IFC’s global investor engagement approach. The role will be to lead IFC’s critical institutional investor relationships, positioning IFC as a partner of choice for institutional investors while embedding scalable, best-in-class investor relationship management practices across the organization.

The Principal Investor Relations Officer will be responsible for deepening long-term investor relationships, expanding and diversifying IFC’s investor base, aligning investor mandates with IFC’s mobilization priorities, strengthening IFC’s visibility and credibility in global capital markets, integrating investor intelligence into institutional decision-making, and institutionalizing robust systems, governance, and standards for investor relationship management.

This vacancy announcement is for nine (9) positions posted across multiple duty stations. The selected candidates’ duty stations will be determined based on organizational requirements and business needs.

**Duties and Accountabilities:**

The selected candidate is responsible for performing activities in the following areas:

Own day-to-day IFC relationships with assigned Tier 1 and Tier 2 investors, under the Director’s executive sponsorship for the most significant relationships and expand participation in IFC-originated assets by connecting investor demand with IFC opportunities and the Originate-to-Distribute agenda.

**Relationship ownership & growth responsibilities:**

* Serve as accountable owner and primary point of contact for assigned investors. Where designated as geography Team Lead, lead and coordinate the other officers in the regional hub.
* Map investor interests and identify opportunities across IFC products, platforms and programs.
* Build trusted senior relationships and coordinate integrated engagement with product, regional, industry, transaction and country teams.
* Sponsor priority platforms, roadshows, investor education and external engagements for assigned relationships

**Planning, reviews & execution responsibilities:**

* Develop customized engagement plans, including strategic dialogues, co-investment discussions, site visits, reporting, events and investor education.
* Lead MOUs, frameworks, and commercial terms, subject to Legal clearance and authorized approval/signature.
* Lead onboarding and coordinate KYC and due diligence logistics.
* Conduct quarterly business and annual strategic reviews and maintain accurate Salesforce records and relationship updates.
* Support syndication and structuring teams while engaging with investors.

**Demand, risk & coordination responsibilities:**

* Capture risk appetite, pricing, tenor, sector interests and other actionable demand signals.
* Consolidate and propose relationship risk limits for funds, subsidiaries and insurers and assess financial sustainability.
* Communicate structured investor feedback to Syndications, with the OTD Analytical Team supporting consolidation and analysis.
* Advise underwriting and structuring on investor demand; designated authorities retain decisions. Participate occasionally in OtD or strategy meetings when relevant.
* Ensure that investor engagement activities are conducted in accordance with IFC policies, World Bank Group ethical standards, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Legal and Compliance teams on investor agreements, side letters, and co-investment arrangements.

**Selection Criteria**

* Master’s degree or MBA, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* A minimum of 12 years of relevant professional experience of increasing complexity and responsibility in institutional investor relations, capital markets, private markets, asset management, investment banking, or related areas.
* Extensive experience developing and managing senior-level relationships with institutiona

jobs.title: Senior Vice President Marketing
jobs.description:
**The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance:**

At CoinDCX, our mission is clear - to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.

As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.

We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build what’s next.

If you’re driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you’ll feel right at home here.

**About the Role:**

At CoinDCX, brand and growth are one system. Brand earns trust, and trust brings in users who stay, trade and recommend us. As
**SVP – Growth & Marketing**
, you will own both sides and make them work as one.

Your mandate is not to promote crypto, but to normalise it and make it trusted. You will shape how millions of Indians understand, assess and use this new asset class. You will own the full path from first awareness to a loyal customer: brand trust, recall, acquisition, activation, retention, win-back, product-led growth and consumer understanding.

You will work at the meeting point of cultural narrative, regulatory nuance, reputation and capital discipline. We need a leader who plans in multi-year horizons, stays steady under public scrutiny and builds systems that hold up through market cycles.

You will lead the full marketing organisation (Brand, Creative, Content, Social and Community, PR), the Growth teams (Retention, Resurrection, PLG, Product Marketing, SEO and Digital Marketing) and Consumer Insights. You will partner closely with the Business unit, which owns CLM, and with Product, Policy, Analytics and Leadership, so that what we build, say and stand for stays aligned.

If building one of India’s most consequential financial brands, and the growth engine behind it, excites you, this role will both challenge and reward you.

**What You'll Do:**

* You are the
  **DRI (Directly Responsible Individual)**
  for the full Growth & Marketing budget across ATL, BTL, digital media, performance, social, content and PR. You are accountable not just for outcomes, but for the reasoning behind every spend decision.
* **Metric & Budget Ownership:**
  Own the brand KPIs (brand health, social media metrics, organic acquisition) and the growth KPIs (new users, activation, retention, blended CAC, LTV). You are accountable for full funnel marketing and building brand trust.
* **Brand Strategy:**
  Own the multi-year brand roadmap. Turn complex VDA (Virtual Digital Asset) topics into simple, education-led stories that enhance trust while keeping technical accuracy.
* **Growth Strategy:**
  Own the plan from first install to long-term customer, with one shared view of the funnel across marketing and growth.
* **Retention & Resurrection:**
  Keep active users coming back, and bring lapsed users back, through product-led and marketing-led programmes.
* **PLG & Product Marketing:**
  Build referrals, in-product loops and organic acquisition with Product. Own positioning, launches and go-to-market for each product line.
* **SEO & Digital Marketing:**
  Own organic search and paid digital channels. Manage CAC, ROAS and cost per activated user, and direct media buying and budget allocation.
* **Consumer Insights:**
  Lead the insights team. Use research, user behaviour data and brand tracking to guide decisions across marketing, growth, product and business.
* **Org Design:**
  Lead and grow the full team, from creatives to analysts to performance specialists. Build a strong layer of second-level leaders so day-to-day execution does not depend on you.
* **Reputation Systems:**
  Design and own proactive PR and “Issue Readiness” playbooks to protect institutional credibility during market volatility.
* **Product & Policy Partnership:**
  Work with Product and Policy so the brand promise of “Responsible Education” shows up in the app experience and in all advertising, and stays compliant.
* **Experimentation & Measurement:**
  Run a steady pipeline of growth and brand experiments with Product and Analytics, and set one trusted set of numbers for the whole function.

**You’ll Excel in This Role If You Have:**

* **Think in First Principles:**
  You look for the real reason users do not trust us or do not stay, rather than applying standard marketing frameworks.
* **Act as an Owner:**
  You treat company capital and reputation as your own, and make hard trade-offs to protect long-term brand value over short-term “hacks.”
* **Are Equally at Ease with Story and Numbers:**
  You can judge a brand film and read a funnel or cohort chart with the same confidence.
* **Translate Strategy:**
  You turn disruptive technology into simple, trusted, mass-market stories without losing technical accuracy.
* **Build Systems:**
  You build scalable content, PR and growth engines instead of managing individual tasks.
* **Lead Leaders:**
  You have led large, mixed teams of creatives, analysts and performance specialists, and earned the respect of each.
* **Decide Under Scrutiny:**
  You are comfortable being the final decision maker in moments of reputational, regulatory or public pressure.

**You’ll Know You’re Winning When:**

* **Trust & Recall:**
  “Institutional Trust” scores and “Responsible Education” recall rise in a measurable way.
* **Growth:**
  More new users complete KYC, make a first deposit and place a first trade, and retention and win-back rates improve.
* **Efficiency:**
  Blended CAC falls as organic acquisition and brand-led conversion improve.
* **Market Share:**
  CoinDCX’s share of the total Indian crypto user base grows.
* **Evidence-Led Decisions:**
  Consumer Insights visibly shapes major campaign, product and business decisions.
* **One Plan with Business:**
  Growth, Marketing and CLM run to shared targets without friction.
* **Independence:**
  Your leadership bench runs high-impact campaigns and growth programmes with little intervention from you.

**Why This Role Matters & What’s In It For You:**

You will bring brand and growth together under one leader at a $2.45B unicorn, and shape how a nation learns to trust a new financial system. You will work side by side with the founders to drive the company’s mission, and you will see first-hand how a brand and a user base scale from 10 → 100 in one of the world’s fastest-evolving industries. Very few roles offer this. This is one of them.

**Hiring Process:**

Here’s what your journey with us looks like:

* **Application Review**
  – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent
* **Recruiter Connect**
  – A short conversation to understand you better
* **Functional Round(s)**
  – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem-solving
* **Assignment / Simulation Round**
  –A take-home task or live problem-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios
* **Culture & Values Discussion**
  – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best
* **Founder Conversation (Optional)**
  – For certain roles and senior levels, you may meet our founders to explore strategic alignment and long-term fit

**Where We Work:**

We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space.

With this belief, we operate as a work-from-office organisation. This role is based out of our
**Bangalore**
office, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.

**Perks That Empower You:**

We believe great people deserve great experiences.

* **Design Your Own Benefits:**
  Flexible perks to match your lifestyle
* **Unlimited Wellness Leaves:**
  Rest and recharge as you need
* **Mental Wellness Support:**
  Access to therapy and wellness resources
* **Learning Sessions:**
  Bi-weekly learning and growth opportunities

As an Engineering Director at Backbase, you will lead a multi-project engineering organization delivering complex digital banking solutions for leading financial institutions in the Middle East region. You are accountable for building a high-performing engineering organization that consistently delivers predictable, high-quality software while developing future engineering leaders.
  
  
This is not only a delivery leadership role. You are expected to continuously improve how engineering operates by introducing modern engineering practices, scaling engineering excellence across teams and driving AI-assisted software development.
  
  
You will lead Engineering Managers and Technical Leaders across multiple customer engagements, engineering quality and organizational growth.
  
  

* Lead and grow an engineering organization of 100+ engineers across multiple customer programs.
* Coach, develop and raise the bar for Engineering Managers through regular mentoring, feedback and performance management.
* Drive engineering excellence by improving delivery predictability, quality, developer experience, operational readiness and engineering metrics.
* Establish consistent engineering governance, release readiness, architecture and quality practices across multiple teams.
* Partner with customers, Delivery Managers, Technical Leaders, Architects and Product leadership to build trusted engineering relationships and resolve complex delivery challenges.
* Build a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous improvement and technical excellence.
* Lead engineering transformation through adoption of AI-native development practices, Agentic SDLC, automation and modern platform capabilities.
* Develop engineering capability for the region through hiring, succession planning, technical communities and career development.

What success looks like
  
  

* You build an organization where:
* Engineering Managers grow into exceptional leaders.
* Teams deliver predictably with a balance of quality.
* Engineering decisions are driven by data.
* Customers trust engineering commitments.
* AI measurably improves engineering productivity and quality.
* Engineering standards scale consistently across projects and teams.
* Difficult organizational changes are implemented when required to improve long-term outcomes.
* Proven experience leading multiple engineering teams (50+ engineers) through Engineering Managers.
* Experience operating large-scale software delivery organizations across multiple concurrent projects.
* Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices including architecture governance, CI/CD, testing strategies, observability, operational excellence and engineering metrics.
* Demonstrated success building and coaching engineering leaders

Experience leading organizational transformation and driving measurable engineering improvements.
  
  

* Strong customer-facing leadership with the ability to build trust while navigating difficult delivery situations.
* Hands-on understanding of AI-assisted software engineering, developer tooling and Agentic SDLC with the ability to pragmatically introduce these practices across engineering organizations.
* Excellent communication skills with both executive stakeholders and engineering teams.
* Bias for ownership, continuous improvement and data-driven decision making.

Leadership principles
  
  

* Engineering Directors at Backbase:
* Build leaders.
* Measure outcomes, not activity.
* Solve systemic problems rather than local optimizations.
* Raise engineering quality without slowing delivery.
* Challenge the status quo and continuously improve how engineering works.
* Embrace AI as an engineering multiplier while maintaining strong engineering fundamentals.

jobs.title: Manager - Technology & Engineering
jobs.description:
We are looking for experienced professionals who have spent years proving themselves but haven't always received the recognition they deserve. We don't necessarily want people with impressive designations, big corporate titles, or fancy resumes. We want people with real skills, strong execution capabilities, fresh ideas, and an ownership mindset.

**Your skills deserve more than just a designation**

* Have you ever been the person who solves the toughest technical problems, builds systems from scratch, keeps things running, and makes technology work, yet rarely gets the recognition you deserve?
* We believe great technology professionals aren't defined by their job titles. They are defined by what they build, what they solve, and the impact they create.
* We are looking for an experienced, ambitious, and technically strong professional who wants to take ownership of technology and engineering initiatives and help build something meaningful.

**What will you be responsible for?**

* Develop and drive the organization's technology and engineering roadmap.
* Oversee software development, technical infrastructure, and technology implementation.
* Lead and coordinate engineering teams and technology initiatives.
* Build scalable, secure, and efficient systems and processes.
* Identify opportunities for automation, AI integration, and digital transformation.
* Establish engineering standards, development processes, and quality benchmarks.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and implement relevant solutions.
* Collaborate with business teams to translate business requirements into technology solutions.
* Manage technology projects, timelines, resources, and implementation.
* Take ownership of technology performance, innovation, and continuous improvement.

**What are we looking for?**

* 7-10 years of experience in technology, software engineering, technical operations, or technical program management.
* Strong understanding of software development and modern technology infrastructure.
* Experience managing technology initiatives and engineering teams.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms, APIs, databases, cybersecurity, and system architecture.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to independently make decisions and execute ideas.
* An ownership mindset and a passion for building rather than merely maintaining.

**What does success look like?**

* Reliable, scalable, and efficient technology infrastructure.
* Successful execution of engineering initiatives.
* Improved engineering productivity.
* Effective automation and technology integration.
* Reduced operational inefficiencies.
* Technology that contributes directly to business growth.

**This is not a conventional salary-based opportunity. We believe those who help build value should have the opportunity to participate in that value.**

Our compensation structure is designed around:

* Revenue Sharing: Participation through mutually agreed revenue-sharing arrangements, subject to defined terms and performance parameters.
* ESOPs: Employee Stock Option opportunities, subject to eligibility, company policy, vesting, and applicable terms.
* Ownership: The opportunity to influence technology decisions, build systems, and take meaningful functional responsibility.

**Who should apply?**

Someone who has spent years building technology for others and is now ready to help build something they can genuinely take ownership of. If you have the experience, the capability, and the hunger to prove what you can do, we want to hear from you.

jobs.description:

Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

**Job Description**

### **About Navi**

At Navi, our mission is to simplify finance for a billion people, through technology-first products built at scale.

Founded in 2018 by Sachin Bansal and Ankit Agarwal, Navi has grown rapidly across Loans, UPI, Insurance, Mutual Funds and Digital Gold – building products designed around speed, simplicity and customer experience.

Today, millions of customers use Navi for experiences like instant personal loans, fully digital home loan sanctions within minutes, low-cost mutual funds, instant credit lines in minutes and one of India’s fastest-growing UPI platforms.

What makes Navi different is the way we build. We move fast, solve real customer problems and give people the ownership to create meaningful impact early in their journey.

### **Why Explore a Career at Navi?**

Where Ownership Creates Real Impact
  
At Navi, ownership starts early. People here are trusted to solve problems, make decisions and drive outcomes that directly shape the products and experiences used by millions of customers every day.

Where Careers Accelerate
  
Growth at Navi is driven by impact, not tenure. We strongly believe in promoting from within and creating opportunities for people to take on larger responsibilities as they grow. If you consistently raise the bar, you’ll find the space to grow quickly here.

Where Great Talent Builds Together
  
We take pride in building high talent-density teams where ambitious people learn from one another every day. Working on high-scale business and technology problems creates steep learning curves, fast execution cycles and opportunities to make visible impact throughout your journey.

About the Team

Navi’s GenAI team is transforming how AI powers financial services in India. We are embedding advanced AI that directly impacts millions of users across Lending, Payments, Insurance, and Investments. As a cross-functional team of engineers, researchers, and product leaders, we work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and real business problems-shipping fast, learning constantly, and scaling what works.

**What You’ll Own**

* Lead design and delivery of GenAI solutions for high-impact use cases: clarify requirements, propose architectures (retrieval, tooling, guardrails, human-in-the-loop where needed), and drive execution with engineering and product.
* Partner deeply with cross-functional teams to solutionize, prioritize, and deploy AI capabilities; ensure robust integration, observability, and operational readiness.
* Advance prompt and system design beyond basics: structured outputs, multi-step workflows, failure modes, red-teaming, and iteration under production feedback.
* Own evaluation and quality: define metrics and evaluation harnesses (accuracy, relevance, safety, bias, latency, cost); run systematic experiments; document learnings and standards others can reuse.
* Stay current on GenAI, ML, and adjacent tech; evaluate and adopt techniques that fit Navi’s constraints; contribute to internal best practices, playbooks, or reusable components where
* appropriate.
* Mentor and align: support AI Scientist I peers and partners through design reviews, pairing, and crisp written specs; represent GenAI credibly in technical discussions.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Engineering, Computer Science, or a closely related field from a recognized institution (or equivalent depth via strong industry experience).
* Excellent communication: written and verbal—specs, metrics, trade-offs, and stakeholder alignment.
* Meaningful experience shipping or operating data/ML/AI systems in production or near-production settings.
* Advanced critical thinking: diagnosing model/application failures, designing ablations and evals, and iterating under uncertainty.
* Strong analytics: pattern detection, bias and quality risks, and defensible conclusions from metrics and samples.
* Solid understanding of LLMs: prompting, limitations, and practical customization paths (e.g., RAG, fine-tuning or adapters where applicable, evaluation, latency/cost controls).

### **The Navi OS**

The Navi OS is our Operating System for how we work every day. Success at Navi is defined by living these core values.

* Start with the Customer
* Master the Details
* Act with Urgency
* Own the Outcome
* Build for a Decade - Not a Day
* Win as One

We hire talented individuals who already show these strengths, because those who share these values thrive at Navi and grow with the organisation.

To read more about the Navi OS, visit navi.com/our-values

Life at Navi

Life at Navi is fast-paced, ambitious and deeply collaborative. Beyond work, teams come together through sports, celebrations, offsites, music jams, team outings and many more shared experiences that make the journey exciting and memorable.

We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, through flexible leave policies, strong health and wellness benefits, free financial, legal and medical consultations, ESOPs and a workplace designed for both productivity and well-being.

Whether it’s the sports turf, gym, focus zone or nap rooms, the campus is built to make everyday work more enjoyable.

If you’d like to know more about life at Navi, our culture and employee benefits, head to our careers page: navi.com/careers/life-at-navi

If solving meaningful problems, building at scale and growing alongside ambitious teams excites you,

Navi could be the place for you.

About Company

Navi is one of the fastest-growing financial services companies in India providing Personal & Home Loans, UPI, Insurance, Mutual Funds, and Gold. Navi's mission is to deliver digital-first financial products that are simple, accessible, and affordable. Drawing on our in-house AI/ML capabilities, technology, and product expertise, Navi is dedicated to building delightful customer experiences.

We are on a mission to make finance simple, accessible and affordable for a billion Indians. Guided by a strong customer-first approach, we are building tech-first solutions that work at scale. Founded by **Sachin Bansal & Ankit Agarwal** in 2018, we are one of India’s fastest-growing financial services organisations. But we’re just getting started!

**Our Culture**

At Navi, we’re a place where ambition meets opportunity and ideas turn into impact quickly. We empower people with high ownership from the start, encouraging them to solve meaningful problems and build with excellence. Teams here work in an environment that values speed, collaboration and craftsmanship, while celebrating learning, growth and shared wins along the way. Whether you’re shaping the future of fintech products or driving innovation behind the scenes, life at Navi means being part of a high-energy, talent-driven workplace where your contributions truly make a difference.

**We’re guided by our own operating system - The Navi OS - a set of principles that shape how we work and win together. You can explore them at** **navi.com/our-values** **to see what drives us every day.**

jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer
jobs.description:
The Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) is responsible for establishing, implementing, operating, monitoring, and continuously enhancing OneFin’s Information Security Management System (ISMS) across all product lines and enterprise infrastructure.

This leader will own end-to-end information security strategy, cloud security governance (AWS), regulatory compliance (RBI guidelines for digital lending and IT governance), ISO/IEC 27001:2022 standards, and client-facing security assessments for institutional banking partners. Implement zero trust security architecture.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Information Security Governance & Strategy**

* Define, maintain, and enforce OneFin's Level-1 ISMS policies, standards, and guidelines in alignment with business goals.
* Report security posture, risk profiles, and incident metrics directly to the CEO, C-suite, and Board of Directors.
* Lead the annual risk assessment framework across all business units, maintaining the enterprise Risk Register and tracking remediation strategies.
* Establish annual security objectives, measurable parameters, and operational security targets.

**2. Regulatory, Compliance & Client Audit Management**

* Direct compliance for ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certifications, surveillance audits, and internal security audits.
* Ensure strict adherence to Reserve Bank of India (RBI) guidelines regarding digital lending, data localization, outsourcing, and cloud management.
* Act as the executive point of contact for financial institution (FI) client audits, managing Information Security Group (ISG) checklists, VAPT review points, and security questionnaires.
* Oversee Data Protection and Privacy compliance, protecting Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and Sensitive Personal Data or Information (SPDI).
* Oversee source code audits, and conduct internal security audits of codebase.

**3. Cloud Infrastructure & Product Security**

* Oversee security configuration across AWS environments, ensuring AES-256 encryption at rest (S3, RDS, ECR) and enforced TLS/HTTPS in transit.
* Enforce secure architecture models for single-tenant / dedicated client deployments on Financial Institution AWS infrastructure.
* Direct Web Application Firewall (WAF) policies, IP/URL whitelisting, geo-blocking, and network perimeter controls.
* Maintain DevSecOps rigor within CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), ensuring automated peer reviews, static analysis, code coverage thresholds, and container image vulnerability management.

**4. Threat Management & Security Operations (SecOps)**

* Lead the Incident Response Team; ensure end-to-end management, SLA tracking, and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for all P1/Critical incidents.
* Oversee centralized logging, Database Activity Monitoring (DAM), and integration capabilities with Bank SIEM systems.
* Mandate periodic Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing (VAPT) across applications, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
* Enforce robust Access Control & Identity Management (IAM), including mandatory multi-factor authentication (MFA) across email, code repositories, and cloud portals.

**5. Third-Party Risk & Business Continuity**

* Enforce Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) guidelines, ensuring mandatory MSAs and NDAs across all vendors.
* Manage annual Business Continuity Planning (BCP) and Disaster Recovery (DR) drills, validating Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).
* Conduct annual enterprise-wide security awareness training programs and specialized DevSecOps workshops.

**Candidate Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or related engineering fields.
* **Experience:** 12+ years in Information Security and Technology Risk, with at least 4+ years in a leadership role (CISO, Head of Security, or Director of InfoSec).
* **Domain Background:** Prior experience in Fintech, B2B SaaS, Banking, or Financial Services ecosystems is strictly required.

**Technical & Professional Competencies**

**Cloud Security**- Deep expertise in AWS Security Hub, WAF, KMS, CloudTrail, IAM, RDS/S3 encryption, and containerized deployments (ECS/ECR).

**Frameworks**- Hands-on mastery of ISO/IEC 27001:2022, NIST CSF, OWASP Top 10, and SOC 2 Type II compliance.

**Regulatory Knowledge**- In depth knowledge of RBI Cybersecurity Framework, RBI Digital Lending Directions, and Indian Data Protection laws.

**Application Security**- Expertise in DevSecOps, API security, automated code scanners, tesseract/OCR pipeline security, and LLM/AI model deployment governance.

**Leadership**- Exceptional stakeholder management, board-level reporting, and experience negotiating security requirements with Tier-1 Bank CISOs.

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
* Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)
* Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)
* ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor / Lead Implementer

Pay: ₹3,000,000.00 - ₹3,500,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

Experience:

* Information security: 10 years (Required)
* Leadership: 4 years (Required)

**About the Company**

Jupiter is a consumer financial services platform run by Amica Financial Technologies Private Limited and its group companies. The group runs regulated businesses in lending (NBFC and NBFC-P2P), prepaid payment instruments, insurance broking and mutual fund distribution, and is a UPI third-party application provider. With its partner banks, it offers co-branded savings accounts and credit cards on theJupiter app.

**About the Role**

The Director - Legal & Compliance heads legal and compliance for the Jupiter group, covering nine entities regulated or governed by RBI, SEBI, IRDAI, NPCI, IFSCA and UIDAI frameworks.The role owns legal risk, regulatory compliance, and regulator engagement for the group. It works closely with the founders, product, business, finance, technology, and partner banks, and leads the in-house legal and compliance team.

  

**Key responsibilities**

* Draft, review and negotiate agreements across the group, including lending partnerships (LSP,DLA and co-lending), bank partnerships, insurer and distribution agreements, and technology,vendor and data agreements.
* Lead legal work on fundraising, both equity rounds (term sheets, investment and shareholders; agreements, due diligence and related FEMA and corporate filings) and debt(term loans, NCDs and other borrowings), from term sheet to closing.
* Advise product and business teams on new products and features, and own customer-facing documents such as terms and conditions, MITC, KFS, privacy policies, consent flows and campaign terms.
* Lead data protection compliance under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 across the group.
* Manage litigation, legal notices and consumer disputes, and engage and supervise external counsel.
* Protect the group's intellectual property and manage contractual risk.

**Regulatory compliance**

* Own compliance for the groups NBFC, NBFC-P2P, PPI, insurance broking and mutual fund distribution businesses, and its UPI third party application provider obligations.
* Ensure digital lending compliance across lender, LSP and DLA arrangements.
* Track regulatory changes from RBI, SEBI, IRDAI, NPCI, IFSCA and UIDAI, assess their impact and drive implementation with the business.
* Lead regulator inspections, audits and information requests, and draft regulatory responses, filings and licence applications.
* Support partner bank audits and due diligence for the group's bank partnerships.
* Oversee KYC and AML frameworks, and customer complaints escalated to regulators,including the RBI Ombudsman.
* Act as Compliance Officer for group entities where designated.

**Leadership**

* Lead, build and develop the legal and compliance team.
* Report on legal and compliance risk to senior management and the boards of group entities.
* Build and maintain compliance trackers, calendars and policies for the group.

**Qualifications**

* LL.B. from a recognised university.
* LL.M. or Company Secretary qualification.

**Required Skills**

**What we are looking for:**

* LL.B. from a recognised university.
* 15+ years of post-qualification experience, with substantial in-house time at a fintech, NBFC,bank or payments company.
* Deep, hands-on knowledge of RBI regulation for NBFCs, digital lending and PPIs, and working knowledge of SEBI, IRDAI and NPCI frameworks.
* A record of leading regulator inspections and engagement.
* Strong drafting and negotiation skills across commercial, financing and partnership agreements.
* Experience building and leading legal or compliance teams.
* Comfort working across several regulated entities in a fast-moving, product-led business.

**Preferred Skills:** Good to have

* Experience with IFSC (GIFT City) regulation or DPDP Act implementation.
