**Job Summary**
---------------

The Global Process Owner Support (GPOS) role exists to strengthen first-line-of-defence risk management and governance across Credit Origination, Credit Monitoring and Credit Allied Risk processes within Client Coverage. It supports Global Process Owners in embedding applicable policies, standards and controls into day-to-day business activities, helping the business manage operational and process risks consistently across markets. The role delivers oversight of control effectiveness, coordinated remediation of control gaps and exceptions, and clear reporting and escalation of material risks to support informed governance decisions. Working with business, country teams and second-line stakeholders, it also supports process simplification and the implementation of change with appropriate risk assessments and controls. Its primary focus is to maintain effective, consistent and efficient credit processes that support business delivery while operating within established risk tolerances.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

The role holder is an individual contributor with no formal people-management accountability. The role leads and coordinates assigned risk, control and process-improvement activities through stakeholder collaboration, supporting the Global Process Owner / delegate and GPOS Lead across Credit Origination, Credit Monitoring and Credit Allied Risk processes. The role holder is accountable for the quality and timely delivery of assigned assessments, assurance oversight, reporting and remediation coordination; designated action owners remain responsible for completing their actions.
  
**Risk assessment and control implementation**  
• Implement applicable control requirements and procedures, and support each stage of the RCSA, from process and risk identification to monitoring implemented controls, at least annually and when trigger events occur, to maintain a current view of process and residual risks.
  
**Timely risk treatment**  
• Coordinate and track agreed elevated residual-risk actions and treatment plans with designated action owners, maintain records in the Group operational risk management system, and escalate delays to support timely completion.
  
**Learning from risk events**  
• Initiate Root Cause Reviews for in-scope material risk events and, where required, aggregate smaller events with similar root causes to identify recurring weaknesses and support corrective action.
  
**Controlled change delivery**  
• Identify delivery risks and dependencies, assess impacts on critical processes and residual risk, and review and support Operational and Change Risk Assessments and process-impact assessments before go-live, including minor changes where required.

**Broad Accountabilities**  
**Strategy**  
• Targeted Improvements: Work with internal stakeholders to identify gaps and improvement opportunities in credit processes, and lead assigned change and remediation activities to make processes more effective and streamlined.
  
• Support the GPO’s credit transformation agenda by translating agreed priorities into implementation activities and delivering assigned work within agreed timelines.
  
• Automation and Streamlining: Review operational efficiency, effectiveness and quality against changing business and customer needs, and identify actions to improve process performance.
  
• Drive continuous improvement and automation, and remove or simplify unnecessary process steps to improve efficiency and consistency across systems and processes.
  
• Support CPA Team Heads, including the CPA Hub, in improving process efficiency, simplifying processes and increasing capacity.
  
**Business**  
• Assess the process and operational-risk implications of business strategies, projects and programmes, and provide remediation guidance to support informed decisions.
  
• Support global adoption of Credit COE initiatives and work with management to implement agreed process improvements and strategic credit transformation initiatives.
  
• Maintain effective relationships with Business, Finance, Risk, Technology and Operations to resolve process issues and coordinate delivery across markets.
  
• Coordinate stakeholder inputs and supporting information for regulatory and audit requests to enable timely responses.

**Processes**  
• Support the Process Owner in delivering BAU operational-risk requirements on time and in designing and maintaining the Control Assessment Standards framework for front-office processes globally.
  
• Monitor CST/KCI exception trends and agree practical improvement actions with countries to strengthen processes and controls.
  
• Guide QC teams in GBS and countries in understanding and consistently applying checks, particularly those involving qualitative or subjective assessments.
  
• Support process governance by streamlining existing processes, rolling out new processes and resolving Credit and Credit Monitoring queries with the relevant GPOS Lead.
  
• Work with CPAs, Client Management, CPOs, R&C, Business Heads and other regional and country stakeholders to share developments, lessons and best practices, and deliver agreed requirements on time.
  
• Assess change impacts through CCIA, evaluate change readiness and perform GRAM assessments. Provide subject-matter expertise to help mitigate identified process risks.
  
• Support the resolution of Group-specific process issues and related actions identified by GIA.
  
• Support the Process Owner in promptly escalating significant risks and issues to Process Universe Owners, relevant RFOs or Policy Owners. Maintain effective relationships with 2LOD across applicable risk types to support management of the Bank’s risk profile.
  
**Risk Management**  
• Identify process risks and support implementation of the Operational Risk Framework and appropriate controls. Help operations manage risk within established tolerance thresholds and minimise risks and losses in Credit Origination.

* Identify non-standard processes and agree appropriate controls with the GPOS Lead. Review proposed process and system changes for material impacts, and keep DOIs and process documentation up to date.

• Support implementation of applicable Credit, Fraud, Climate, Reputational and Sustainability Risk policies and standards within CC COE, embedding their requirements in managed processes.
  
• Prepare updates on risk initiatives for CC Governance Committee packs, and provide subject-matter expertise for Root Cause Reviews and boundary events to support oversight and corrective action.
  
• Support the design and delivery of relevant Credit Transformation initiatives and partner with TB, FM and Lending to improve the operating model and execution through existing CC credit processes.
  
• Provide ongoing learning and guidance on policies, process risks, controls and governance. Work with 2LOD and Product partners to develop and implement a roadmap for improving the control framework.
  
• Support implementation and closure of Group-level audit Management Action Plans, and delivery of actions arising from PRA Dear CEO Letters and specific reviews relating to owned processes.
  
**Governance**  
• Ensure risks are clearly identified, quantified and reported to the appropriate governance forums, with timely visibility and escalation of material issues.
  
• Assess how effectively the control framework addresses key risks and initiate treatment plans where required. Coordinate remediation of capability, process, data and documentation gaps.
  
• Provide central oversight of CST/KCI assurance checks performed by GBS, including ongoing training and guidance, to maintain standardised and consistent assessments.

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**About Us :-**

*In a short span of 2.5 years since inception, Birla Pivot has evolved into a comprehensive B2B e-commerce platform offering integrated procurement and financial solutions that help businesses become efficient and grow. We offer products across 35 categories, 40,000+SKUs from 300+ brands across* ***Building Material, Chemicals & Metals****. We launched private labels in 3 categories : Tiles, Ply and Bath ware. With a robust network of suppliers and transporters, we have delivered to 4,000+ pin codes across 375 cities. Our customer base now spans top-tier EPC companies, civil contractors, real estate developers, OEMs, fabricators, manufacturing companies, dealers, and retailers. We connect Sellers, Buyers, Logistics service providers, Lending partners, Payment solution providers on a unified digital backbone thereby creating end to end visibility and providing a B2C like fulfilment experience for the B2B ecosystem.*

*The evolution of B2B ecommerce is expected to mirror the B2C ecommerce journey, where technology transformed discovery, pricing, fulfilment, and customer experience at scale. Digital penetration today in B2B ecommerce is still under* ***2%****, indicating massive headroom for scalable digital-first platforms. As the Aditya Birla Group, we are uniquely positioned to transform and shape the way commerce is done across these verticals by leveraging our deep industry expertise and scale. We have built a unique Quote based, Credit linked commerce journey that solves for the needs of B2B commerce with a diverse team that is a mix of deep industry expertise and experience of building complex technology platforms from the ground up. Our goal is to drive this digital adoption and create a distribution platform that can become* ***the most trusted B2B ecommerce platform in the country.***
  
  
***Why is this role exciting?***
  
  
***As our Security Engineer, you are the single hands-on owner of security operations and governance for Birla Pivot's cloud native B2B commerce platform —keeping every security KRI Green and closing audits with no major findings. In this role you get to:***
  
***?Own both sides of security —vulnerability, cloud posture, detection and access controls, and the policies, evidence and cadence that audits and the DPDP Act require.***
  
***?Shape how a high-growth business adopts AI securely, from the AI usage policy to reviews of every AI use case.***
  
***?Work closely with the Head of Cybersecurity, InfoSec & Cloud, the ABG central security team, legal and our vendors.***
  
  
***What will you do?***
  
  
***Security Operations & Incident Response***
  
  
***?Triage SIEM and EDR alerts daily; act as first responder for security incidents.***
  
***?Run incident response playbooks; prepare CERT-In reports within 6 hours of a reportable incident.***
  
***?Run tabletop exercises and post-incident reviews.***
  
  
***Vulnerability & Exposure Management***
  
***?Run vulnerability scanning across cloud, containers, code and endpoints; track remediation against SLA (Critical 7 days, High 30 days).***
  
***?Coordinate VAPT and red team engagements and drive findings to closure.***
  
***?Maintain WAF rules and virtual patching for internet-facing apps.***
  
  
***Endpoint, Patching & Resilience***
  
  
***?Keep EDR healthy on all endpoints and servers; validate patch compliance monthly.***
  
***?Verify backup restore tests and support DR drills.***
  
  
***Cloud Security (AWS)***
  
  
***?Monitor posture with Prisma Cloud, Security Hub and Prowler; fix critical misconfigurations within 72 hours.***
  
***?Review IAM, security groups, network ACLs and firewall rules weekly.***
  
***?Enforce encryption, logging, key rotation, MFA and least privilege.***
  
  
***Identity & Privileged Access***
  
  
***?Integrate IAM with the HR system for joiner-mover-leaver; disable leaver accounts within 24 hours.***
  
***?Run the monthly manager certification of off-role and contractor IDs, and quarterly access reviews.***
  
***?Onboard servers, databases and admin accounts to PAM; deploy LAPS and domain-only login.***
  
  
***ISO 27001, Policies & Audits***

***?Maintain the ISMS document set: policies, procedures, risk register, Statement of Applicability.***
  
***?Draft policy amendments for approval; keep the policy register current.***
  
***?Collect audit evidence for internal, external and ISO audits; track findings to closure.***
  
  
***Data Privacy & Vendor Risk***

***?Maintain the personal-data inventory and DPDP records with legal; implement technical controls (encryption, logging, erasure).***
  
***?Run vendor risk assessments and keep all vendor contracts in the central repository***
  
  
***Cadence, Reporting & Awareness***

***?Run the Friday SPOC and vendor ticket review; issue and close monthly, quarterly and half-yearly checklists.***
  
***?Prepare the monthly KRI pack and feed the central security dashboard (SIEM, VAPT, patching, DPDP, change, PAM).***
  
***?Publish the weekly infosec mailer; run trainings and phishing simulations.***
  
  
***AI Security & Governance***

***?Maintain the AI usage policy and the approved AI tools list —enterprise or ABG central accounts only, and no new AI initiative live without review.***
  
***?Run a security and privacy review for every AI use case: data shared, model and vendor, prompt injection, output handling, access rights.***
  
***?Detect and block unapproved AI tools through Zscaler logs; apply DLP so confidential and personal data stays out of public AI tools.***
  
***?Secure AI integrations against the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications: least-privilege API keys, guardrails, logging, human approval for high-impact actions.***
  
***?Keep an AI use-case register for audit.***
  
  
***What success looks like in your first 6 months***

***?EDR coverage 98%; leaver accounts disabled within 24 hours, 100% of the time.***
  
***?No Critical vulnerability past its 7-day SLA. ?Critical log sources in SIEM with 180-day retention ( 95%).***
  
***? 95% of privileged accounts in PAM. ?Internal audit for ISO 27001 closed with no major technical findings.***
  
***?All monthly and quarterly checklists closed on time; weekly mailer running every week.***
  
***?AI usage policy published; every AI use case in the register with a completed risk review; no unapproved AI tools in use.***

***A Day In Life of a Security Engineer at Birla Pivot***

***Your day moves fast —from triaging the morning's SIEM and EDR alerts and chasing a Critical finding to closure, to fixing a cloud misconfiguration, reviewing a new AI use case with the product team, and pulling audit evidence together. At Birla Pivot, you operate at the pace of a high-growth business where every control counts.***

**What makes you a great fit?**

?3–5 years in security operations, vulnerability management or cloud security (at least 2 in cloud, AWS preferred).
  
?Hands-on AWS security: IAM, VPC, security groups, CloudTrail, GuardDuty or Security Hub, KMS.
  
?Working knowledge of SIEM, EDR, WAF and vulnerability scanners (e.g. Qualys, Prisma Cloud, Snyk).
  
?Understanding of ISO 27001 controls and audit evidence.
  
?Scripting in Python or Bash for automation.
  
?Experience preparing audit evidence, writing policies and running review cadences.
  
?Clear written communication for incident reports and audit responses

**Good to have**

?Certifications: AWS Certified Security –Specialty, CompTIA Security+, CEH, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor.
  
?Exposure to PAM (BeyondTrust, Arcon), Zscaler, Kubernetes security, DevSecOps pipelines (SAST, SCA, DAST).
  
?Knowledge of the DPDP Act 2023 and CERT-In directions.
  
?AI security: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, securing LLM APIs and AI agents.

**Company:** Loan2grow Fincap Private Limited  
**Department:** Customer Service & Operations  
**Designation:** Customer Service Executive  
**Location:** Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, Office-based  
**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday  
**Reporting To:** Customer Service Manager / Head of Operations  
**Salary:** As per experience and suitability (Fixed + Performance Incentive)

1. About Loan2grow Fincap

Loan2grow Fincap Private Limited is a growing lending and financial services company focused on providing responsible, accessible and technology-enabled credit solutions to underserved customer segments.

The company offers financing solutions across multiple customer categories and is expanding its digital lending and financial services operations.

At Loan2grow, we believe that a good customer experience is central to responsible lending. We aim to make financial services accessible, transparent and convenient through technology-enabled platforms and responsive customer support.

2. About the Role

We are looking for customer-oriented and proactive professionals to join our Customer Service & Operations team as Customer Service Executives.

The selected candidates will be responsible for handling customer queries, providing assistance throughout the loan application and servicing journey, resolving customer complaints and coordinating with internal teams to ensure timely resolution of customer issues.

The role will involve handling inbound and outbound customer calls, responding to service requests, guiding customers through digital processes and maintaining accurate records of customer interactions.

The Customer Service Executive will serve as an important point of contact between the company and its customers, ensuring that customer concerns are addressed professionally, efficiently and within defined timelines.

This is a full-time, office-based role involving regular telephone-based customer interaction and coordination with internal departments.

3. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Customer Support & Query Management

* Handle inbound and outbound customer calls relating to loan products and financial services.
* Respond to customer queries regarding loan features, eligibility, application procedures and documentation requirements.
* Provide information on loan application status, approval, disbursement and repayment schedules.
* Assist customers in understanding their loan accounts, outstanding balances, EMI obligations and payment timelines.
* Provide accurate information regarding applicable interest rates, processing fees, charges and other loan-related terms.
* Ensure that customer queries are addressed in a professional, courteous and timely manner.
* Escalate complex queries to the appropriate internal teams.

B. Loan Application & Customer Onboarding Support

* Assist prospective customers with the digital loan application process.
* Guide customers through KYC verification, documentation and other onboarding requirements.
* Help customers resolve issues related to application submission, document uploads and verification.
* Follow up on incomplete applications and pending documentation.
* Coordinate with Credit and Operations teams to track application progress.
* Keep customers informed about application status and pending requirements.
* Assist customers in navigating the company's digital platforms and applications.

C. Loan Servicing & Repayment Support

* Handle customer queries relating to loan disbursement, repayment schedules and EMI deductions.
* Assist customers with repayment-related issues, including failed transactions, incorrect deductions and payment confirmation.
* Guide customers on approved repayment channels and payment procedures.
* Coordinate with Finance and Collections teams to resolve payment reconciliation issues.
* Support customers in obtaining loan statements, repayment schedules and other account-related information.
* Track and follow up on unresolved loan servicing requests.
* Ensure that customer concerns relating to loan servicing are addressed within defined timelines.

D. Customer Complaint & Grievance Resolution

* Receive, register and track customer complaints and service requests.
* Understand the nature of customer grievances and identify the appropriate resolution mechanism.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to resolve complaints.
* Follow up on pending complaints until closure.
* Maintain accurate records of complaints, actions taken and resolution timelines.
* Escalate unresolved or sensitive customer grievances to the reporting manager.
* Ensure that customer complaints are handled in accordance with company policies and applicable regulatory requirements.

E. Customer Relationship & Communication

* Maintain professional and positive relationships with customers.
* Communicate loan-related information in simple, clear and understandable language.
* Proactively contact customers regarding pending documentation, application updates and service requests.
* Provide appropriate guidance to customers throughout their loan journey.
* Handle dissatisfied customers and difficult conversations with patience and professionalism.
* Ensure transparency in all customer communications.
* Never make unauthorised commitments regarding loan approvals, interest waivers, settlements or changes in repayment terms.

F. Coordination with Internal Teams

* Coordinate with Sales and Business Development teams for customer acquisition and onboarding-related queries.
* Work with Credit teams to obtain updates on loan applications and pending verifications.
* Coordinate with Operations for documentation, disbursement and loan servicing issues.
* Work with Collections teams on repayment-related customer queries and payment confirmation.
* Coordinate with Finance for payment reconciliation and account-related discrepancies.
* Ensure timely communication and closure of customer requests across departments.

G. Customer Service MIS & Reporting

* Maintain accurate records of customer calls, queries, complaints and service requests.
* Update customer interactions and service request status in the CRM or designated systems.
* Maintain daily customer service reports covering:
* Total inbound and outbound calls.
* Customer queries received.
* Customer requests registered.
* Complaints received and resolved.
* Pending service requests.
* Average query resolution time.
* Escalated complaints.
* Customer follow-up status.
* Share daily and weekly performance updates with the reporting manager.
* Identify recurring customer issues and highlight opportunities to improve service delivery.

4. Qualifications & Experience

**Essential Qualifications:**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* 1–3 years of experience in customer service, customer support, telecalling, contact centres or customer relationship management.
* Good verbal communication skills in Hindi and basic English.
* Comfortable handling inbound and outbound customer calls.
* Basic proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets and customer management systems.
* Ability to handle multiple customer queries and service requests simultaneously.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Prior experience in banking, NBFCs, fintech, digital lending, microfinance or other financial services organisations.
* Experience handling loan-related customer queries and servicing requests.
* Familiarity with loan application processes, KYC documentation and digital onboarding.
* Experience resolving EMI, repayment and payment-related queries.
* Experience working with CRM, LOS or LMS platforms.
* Exposure to complaint management and customer grievance resolution.

5. Key Skills & Competencies

* Excellent verbal communication and listening skills.
* Customer relationship management.
* Problem-solving and query resolution.
* Professional telephone etiquette.
* Patience and empathy in customer interactions.
* Ability to handle difficult customer conversations.
* Follow-up and service

* Backed by $68M in venture debt facilities and growing at 20% month-over-month, Comfi is rapidly expanding across the region. We are not improving traditional financing — we are redefining how businesses access capital.

We're looking for a Head of Referral Partnerships to own Comfi's referral program as a business. This is a P&L-owning role, not a relationship-management role. You will be the single business owner of the channel: its strategy, its growth, its partners, its incentives and its team.

Your scope is Comfi's standard referral offering for every affiliate partner — financial brokers, accountants, auditors, business setup firms, existing customers and any other player that sits close to SMEs — whether they send cases through the partner dashboard or through the API. 

You'll report to the CRO and work daily with Product, Risk, Customer Success, Finance and Marketing. Success is simple to measure: the referral program hits its KYB, origination and revenue goals every month, and leadership can rely on you to run it.

**What You'll Do**

🔹
**Growth & P&L**

* Own the P&L of the referral division and its monthly goals: KYB submissions, origination and revenue
* Grow the number of active partners and the output of each partner
* Set the strategy for the program and focus the team on the few things that move the numbers most

🔹
**Partner Ecosystem**

* Build a large ecosystem of referral partners on Comfi's standard offering, via dashboard or API
* Open new partner types beyond financial brokers: accounting firms, audit firms, business setup firms, existing customers and other SME ecosystem players
* Design the acquisition, onboarding and activation motion for each partner type, from first contact to first funded case

🔹
**Partner Relationships**

* Be the main face of Comfi for all referral partners
* Build real rapport with partner owners and their teams, and keep the top partners close
* Handle escalations, hard conversations and commercial negotiations yourself

🔹
**Incentives & Partner Tiers**

* Design and run the motivational structure of the program, including the introduction of partner tiers
* Measure what each incentive returns and change what does not pay back

🔹
**Business Requirements for Product**

* Act as the business owner for the referral dashboard and partner journey
* Write clear, systematic specifications for the product team: the problem, the rules, the edge cases, the acceptance criteria and the metric it should move
* Decide what gets built first and say no to what does not matter

🔹
**Data & Infrastructure**

* Run the program on numbers and facts: partner funnel, conversion at every step, unit economics per partner type
* Dig deep into the data and check whether it can be trusted before acting on it
* Design the infrastructure of the channel — stages, tracking, reporting and processes — so it scales without adding headcount at the same rate

🔹
**Team & Stakeholders**

* Lead, coach and grow the referral team
* Manage dependencies with Product, Risk, Customer Success, Finance and Marketing so partner cases move fast and nothing waits on you

**What You Bring**

✅ 5+ years in B2B partnerships, channel or affiliate programs, or business development, ideally in fintech or a high-growth startup

✅ Proven ownership of a P&L or a revenue number for a partner channel, not just execution against a target

✅ Track record of building a large network of small and mid-size partners and making it produce, with numbers to show for it

✅ Structured thinker who speaks in numbers and facts, and designs systems rather than one-off fixes

✅ Extremely strong with data: you pull it yourself, question it, and can tell when a number cannot be trusted

✅ Experience writing business requirements that a product and engineering team can build from

✅ Experience designing incentive or commission structures, such as tiers, bonuses or rev-share

✅ A natural relationship builder who earns the trust of partner owners and negotiates with confidence

✅ Sharp prioritisation: you focus on the most important thing and drop the rest

✅ Team leadership experience, with a record of hiring, coaching and holding people to targets

✅ Strong cross-functional operator, comfortable working through dependencies you do not control

*Nice to have:*

⭐ An existing network among UAE financial brokers, accounting, audit or business setup firms

⭐ Background in fintech, SME lending, BNPL or payments

⭐ Hands-on experience with SQL, BI tools or a CRM such as HubSpot

⭐ Experience with partner dashboards, referral platforms or API-based partner integrations

⭐ Prior experience in the UAE or GCC market

**Why Us?**

🚀
**Run a business, not a function:**

full ownership of the referral P&L, strategy and team

💡
**Build the ecosystem:**

open new partner types and shape how SMEs across the UAE reach Comfi

📈
**Fast-growing fintech:**

join a company scaling at 20% month-over-month

🤝
**Direct line to leadership:**

work side by side with the CRO and founders, with decisions made in days

🌍
**Regional scale:**

grow with Comfi as it expands across the Middle East

jobs.title: Product Manager I
jobs.description:
Take a step forward and let Edenred surprise you.

Every day, we deliver innovative solutions to improve the life of millions of people, connecting employees, companies, and merchants all around the world.

We know there are hundred ways for you to grow. With us, you will expand your skills in a multicultural, challenging, and dynamic environment.

**Dare to join Edenred and get ready to thrive in a global company that will offer you endless opportunities.**

Edenred is all about meritocracy. You come as you are, and you contribute. Indeed, the Edenred Group recognizes, recruits and develops all talents and singularities.

We are committed to preventing all forms of discrimination and to providing all our candidates with equal opportunities regardless of their gender and gender expression, disability, origin, religious belief and sexual orientation or any other criteria.

**About Edenred**

Edenred is the leading digital platform for corporate services in the areas of benefits, professional mobility, and B2B payments.

Operating in 44 countries, it connects more than 60 million users to over 2 million partner merchants through more than 1 million client companies.

Edenred offers solutions dedicated to employee engagement (meal vouchers, commuting, gift vouchers, wellness, rewards, and preferential offers to boost purchasing power), mobility (multi-energy solutions, including EV charging, fleet management services, maintenance, toll, and parking), and corporate payments (virtual cards). In addition to its own solutions, Edenred also distributes offers from more than 120 partners on its platform.

True to the Group's purpose, “Enrich connections. For good.”, these solutions enhance users' well-being and purchasing power and simplify the lives of professional drivers while promoting access to healthier food, more environmentally friendly products, and more sustainable mobility. They improve the attractiveness and efficiency of businesses and vitalize the employment market and the local economy.

Edenred's 12,000 employees are committed to making the world of work a connected ecosystem that is safer, more efficient and more responsible every day.

In 2024, thanks to its global technology assets, the Group generated a business volume of nearly €45 billion, mainly through mobile applications, online platforms and cards.

Edenred is listed on the Euronext Paris stock exchange and included in the following indices: CAC Next 20, CAC Large 60, Euronext 100, Euronext Tech Leaders, FTSE4Good, DJSI Europe Index, DJSI World Index, and MSCI Europe.

  

**The UAE CONTEXT**

Edenred UAE is a fast-growing payroll service provider serving more than 20,000 businesses and more than 2.2 million unbanked employees. We service over 10 banks and 35 financial institutions.

We offer a unique value proposition for companies to manage their payroll, and for employees to receive their salaries and use them in the simplest way — through multiple value-added services in our mobile app (money transfer, mobile recharge, card services and more).

  

**THE ROLE**

Most of our users receive their salary on a card we issue, send money home through our app, and pay for their week with a product our team built. For a large share of them, we are their first and only financial relationship. That raises the stakes on every decision — and makes this one of the more interesting product jobs in the region.

You will own product strategy and delivery for a product area inside an organisation that has the autonomy of a startup and the reach of a multinational. You set direction for your area, shape its strategy, and make day-to-day calls that are demonstrably aligned to a clear product vision — with the coaching and air cover to get it right.

Depending on where the business needs you most, you might begin in financial crime and compliance — making onboarding fast without weakening controls, catching fraud earlier, turning regulatory requirements into changes engineering can actually build. Or you might begin on the consumer side — remittance, cards, wallet, lending — working acquisition, activation, retention and monetisation problems for 2.2 million people.

The PMs who do best here are the ones who can hold a regulatory constraint and a growth funnel in their head at the same time.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own a product area. Identify the levers and problems that matter, build a now / next / later roadmap you can defend against real resource constraints, and treat company resources as your own.

* Set and evangelise a vision. Make sure your decisions and your squad's decisions stay aligned to it, and that everyone can explain the “why” without you in the room.

* Lead discovery. Decide independently what to ask and who to ask, know when research is and isn't needed, and turn what you learn into decisions rather than decks.

* De-risk deliberately. Define the riskiest assumptions behind an initiative, prioritise them, and pick the right test for each — balancing speed against certainty instead of defaulting to trial and error.

* Use data properly. Judge which metrics matter, read experiment results honestly, and make confident scale-or-pivot calls. You self-serve across Excel, CleverTap and SQL.

* Ship with engineering. Write crisp PRDs, mitigate feasibility risk early, hold the bar on specifications, and clear blockers before they bite.

* Drive outcomes, not output. Take initiatives, objectives and key results to completion on time, and be honest about what moved and what didn't.

* Work the room. Frame ambiguous problems, facilitate strong problem-solving discussions, manage stakeholder expectations, and pull in senior leaders when that's what unblocks the outcome.

* Communicate top-down. Present a cohesive narrative to data, design, engineering and senior business audiences, and make the trade-offs legible.

Stay close to a unique customer. Our users are underbanked, often first-time app users, sending money to families across several corridors. Every decision comes back to what they're trying to achieve.  

  

**YOUR PROFILE**

* 3+ years in product management - with a track record of independently owning a product or product area and shipping.

* Evidence you moved the numbers - KPIs and OKRs that mattered, not just features that launched.

* Range - Comfort operating in a regulated environment and appetite for consumer growth problems. Experience in payments, fintech, fraud, compliance or high-scale consumer products is a plus, not a requirement.

* Strong analytical instincts - You can set sensible thresholds, spot risk in data, size an opportunity, and check whether something is actually working.

* Technical fluency - Enough to discuss APIs, automation and trade-offs with engineers and be taken seriously.

* Excellent organisation, judgment and attention to detail - you can operate without direction.

* Communication and influence - You drive consensus, articulate recommendations and trade-offs to senior executives, and write specs engineers can build from without guessing.

Beyond the craft, we care a lot about how you work:

* Ownership — you take responsibility for outcomes, speak up when something looks wrong, and follow through on what you commit to.

* Collaboration — you listen actively, build trust across teams, and bring people along rather than pushing work over the wall.

* Problem solving — creative and structured, using both data and judgment to land on an answer.

* Drive — proactive and entrepreneurial; you clear your own obstacles and ask for help early when you're stuck.

* Curiosity — genuinely interested in users, and in how the product works under the hood.

Senior candidates will also be expected to coach and mentor junior product managers, review their work, and contribute to hiring.

  

**REPORTING STRUCTURE**

Reporting to: Product Lead / Senior Product Manager, depending on the area you join.

Working with: Engineering, Design, Data, Compliance,

jobs.title: Executive Manager - Technology Modernisation
jobs.description:
**Organization:**
At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in other people’s financial wellbeing. Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward to progress. To make the right financial decisions and achieve their dreams, targets, and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organisation, your initiative, talent, ideas, and energy all contribute to the impact that we can make with our work. Together we can achieve great things.
  
  
**Job Title:**
Executive Manager – Technology Modernisation
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Business & Team:**
ASB is one of New Zealand’s leading banks and a wholly owned subsidiary of the Commonwealth Bank of Australia. This role sits within CBA India and is dedicated to ASB — you will build and lead ASB’s India-based engineering capability, working shoulder to shoulder with ASB Technology leaders in NZ. ASB is mid-flight in a generational modernisation of its technology, data and digital estate. The agenda is set and owned by ASB’s leadership in New Zealand; India’s job is to bring the engineering depth that accelerates it. The portfolio spans migrating the core to SAP TRBK and simplifying the legacy HOST estate, modernising cards across issuing and acquiring, the full payments technology agenda, scaling Pega across decisioning, workflow, lending and financial crime, modernising the data estate onto a cloud data platform, and re-platforming integration.
  
  
Underpinning all of it are CBA Group engineering foundations — cloud-first architecture, Golden Pathways and DevSecOps, automation-first testing, and AI-powered engineering at scale. This is not a support function. It is real engineering accountability, delivered from India.
  
  
You will lead ASB’s India-based engineering capability — engineers, platform and architecture specialists, testing, data and delivery talent — organised into squads that sit inside ASB’s tribes and into chapters that hold the engineering craft. The teams operate as a genuine extension of ASB, not a resource pool: named outcomes, shared tribe governance and cadence, common engineering standards, and direct partnership with ASB tribe leads, product owners, architecture, risk and operations across both geographies.
  
  
**Impact & Contribution:**
As Executive Manager – Technology Modernisation, you lead the India engineering capability that delivers across ASB’s modernisation portfolio — SAP TRBK core migration and legacy simplification, Cards Modernisation, the payments technology agenda, and the Pega estate — together with the cloud, integration, data and quality engineering that make them land. You will work in genuine partnership with the ASB New Zealand leaders who own the modernisation agenda, translating their roadmaps into executable engineering plans, mobilising squads inside ASB tribes, setting and holding the engineering bar, and carrying delivery, operational and regulatory risk for what India commits to.
  
  
Success is a world-class engineering capability across these domains — one that measurably accelerates ASB’s modernisation journey, delivers to committed timelines, holds the compliance and regulatory bar without exception, takes risk out of complex migrations, and does it at materially better cost. Alongside the immediate commitments, you will build the longer-term edge: automation-first quality engineering, AI-powered engineering, and the engineering depth that lets ASB retire legacy with confidence.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Commercial Services
jobs.description:
**About Tide**

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

**Tide Facts**

* Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* 3,000 Tideans globally
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

**About The Team**

Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Commercial Services. You will report to the CDTO and partner with Product and Design leadership as one leadership team accountable for the outcomes of the domain.

Commercial Services is where Tide extends from helping members run their business to helping them grow it. You will shape how quickly every member becomes discoverable, how much of their buying and selling runs through Tide, and how far AI can turn that into a lasting advantage across every market we serve.

Sell gives every member a live, discoverable presence, from the Tide Business Pages we are launching for 2 million members across the UK and Europe, to Own Website, catalogue, bookings, CRM and lead capture, and embedded fulfilment through Delivery as a Service.

Buy turns that member base into a two-sided marketplace through the Tide Online Network, alongside Tide Promotions (gift cards, cashback and personalised offers), business supplies from partners, and Vendor Hub for e-procurement.

You will be the single owner accountable for engineering delivery, architecture and people across both.

**About The Role**

This role sits at the intersection of SME commerce, marketplaces and banking. Our members sit on both sides of the marketplace, our partners extend what we can offer them, and our banking platform lets us layer payments, credit, insurance and rewards into the experience at the point of need, which few commerce players can do. We need someone who can bring both streams onto one consistent engineering bar, ship quickly and build the platforms that turn Commercial Services into a material recurring revenue line for Tide.

As Director of Engineering you will

* Set the engineering strategy and technical direction across the Sell and Buy value streams, from launch through to scale.
* Lead the Heads of Engineering for Sell and Buy, build the leadership bench underneath them, and own headcount planning, hiring and organisation design.
* Partner with Product and Design leadership on one shared plan, jointly owning delivery and outcomes, including members activated through real sales and purchases, engagement and recurring revenue.
* Scale the Tide Business Pages and Tide Online Network into a trusted, high-traffic marketplace, including search, listings, member-to-member leads, chat and buyer requests.
* Build the partner integration platform behind our website, gift card, business supply and logistics partners, enabling new partners and offers to be onboarded quickly and safely.
* Work with Payments, Acquiring, Credit, Insurance and Wealth to embed payments, credit, insurance and rewards into commerce journeys at the point of need.
* Build trust into the marketplace in partnership with Ongoing Monitoring and Risk, from verified seller status to initial and ongoing monitoring of listings and member-to-member communication.
* Set a consistent engineering practice and quality bar across architecture, delivery health measured through DORA metrics, reliability and security.
* Lead our move towards AI-assisted and agentic commerce, where a member describes what they need and Tide finds, compares and sources it.
* Apply our OnePlatform principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Director engineering leadership of a multi-team organisation of around 50 engineers across backend, frontend, data and analytics, led through at least one layer of engineering leaders.
* Domain experience in e-commerce, two-sided marketplaces, CRM or procurement platforms, including the trust and safety controls they need, with fintech or SME banking experience a plus.
* Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable product and commercial outcomes.
* Experience building partner and third-party integration platforms at scale.
* Strong product and design partnership instincts.
* Comfortable setting direction through ambiguity and launching new products into multiple markets.
* Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, architecture and technical quality.
* Experience bringing AI or agentic experiences into customer-facing commerce products would be a bonus.

**Our Tech Stack**

* Backend: Java, Spring/Spring Boot, microservices architecture
* Mobile/Web: Flutter / Angular
* Infrastructure: AWS (SNS+SQS), PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora, GCP (BigQuery, Vertex)
* Observability: Coralogix (OpenTelemetry
* Claude for agentic ways of working

**What You’ll Get In Return**

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:

* Competitive Compensation - Competitive salary and share options.
* Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
* Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
* Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
* Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options.
* Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
* Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
* Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
* Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
* WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
* Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.
* Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
* Snacks & Meals – Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent).

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a
**flexible workplace**
model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.

In India, it is also where a great deal of everyday life gets done — people message businesses, coordinate their families, and increasingly send money as easily as they send a message.We are building a new team to take WhatsApp further in that direction. The newly established WhatsApp Services team is focused on making WhatsApp more useful for more of what people already use it for, and on building what comes next.This engineering leader for India will oversee the newly established WhatsApp Services team, treated as a zero-to-one effort so we can move fast, take risks, and build as we go. Staffed and prioritized, like every other WhatsApp team, from day one. Payments on WhatsApp aren’t a bet on paper: live and growing in India; the existing WhatsApp payments engineering team moves across as the foundation.As an engineering leader at WhatsApp, you will use your start-up mindset and your full range of engineering leadership skills to produce elegantly simple products. You’ll be expected to push the boundaries of what’s possible in a mobile app, while sharing in our commitment to quality and attention to detail. This is a role for someone who can hold both the ceiling and the floor: sets an ambitious long-term technical vision for what WhatsApp can become in India.

* Define and execute engineering strategy and multi-team roadmaps that balance technical investment, emerging capabilities and business priorities.
* Establish a shared technical vision across the company (WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, Messenger) and ensure all teams are clear on the strategy, the problem to solve, the timeline and the contribution required of them.
* Build and scale the engineering organization by attracting, developing and retaining engineers and engineering managers across multiple teams.

* Partner with product, design and data science counterparts to drive shared accountability for outcomes across the full product development lifecycle.
* Proactively identify and resolve the largest cross-functional execution risks, including vision gaps, dependency conflicts and organizational blockers, escalating clearly when team priorities conflict.
* Cultivate a culture of executional excellence and analytical rigor, driving process improvements across teams and functions that reduce operational overhead and accelerate delivery.
* Champion engineering craft and quality standards across teams, fostering a self-reinforcing culture of continuous improvement.
* Monitor and act on organizational health signals to maintain high engagement, low attrition and effective team dynamics across reporting lines.
* Develop a leadership bench through both external hiring and internal growth, and contribute to company-wide engineering initiatives including recruiting, mentorship and technical standards.

Minimum Qualifications:

* 7+ years of engineering management experience, including managing other engineering managers
* Track record of building and scaling engineering organizations, including recruiting, developing and retaining engineers and engineering managers
* Proven track record of delivering and operating large-scale production systems
* Experience establishing technical strategy and organizational roadmaps across multiple teams, with demonstrated ability to drive execution against them
* Experience forming cross-functional partnerships across product, design and data science to deliver large-scale engineering outcomes

* Experience building 0-to-1 organizations or standing up new product areas

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

jobs.title: Sr Mgr Software Engineering
jobs.description:
Senior Manager, Software Engineering
  
Connetic Account-to-Account
  
Division Job Family Location Level Global Technology & Innovation (GTI) Software Engineering Hybrid / global Second-Level Manager (M4)
  
  
About the team
  
The Connetic Account-to-Account organization owns high-value payment processing, instant payment processing and batch payment processing end to end. As Senior Manager, Software Engineering, you'll lead the teams who build and run it — on infrastructure that is cloud-native, with AI-assisted engineering practices built into how the organization works day to day, not treated as a separate initiative.
  
  
  
What You'll Own
  
- Own delivery across two or more teams for instant payments and high-value payments, reporting to you directly or through other managers or leads
  
  
- Lead and grow multiple teams of 7-12 full-time engineers each: hire, onboard, run 1-on-1s and performance reviews, and create a climate where people are motivated to do their best work, not just show up. Overall span of control may extend beyond this range once contractor staff augmentation is factored in
  
  
- Coach and develop your engineers' careers — identifying growth opportunities, giving direct feedback, and mentoring the team through technical and professional challenges
  
  
- Own delivery and quality trends across your teams — aggregate deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, and MTTR, and drive the fixes a single team can't solve alone
  
  
- Own reliability outcomes across your teams — set the incident response and postmortem standards your managers follow, and step in personally on the most severe or cross-team incidents
  
  
- Stay technically credible across multiple codebases or domains: participate in architecture reviews at a higher altitude, and know when to go deep versus trust your team members' judgment
  
  
- Drive AI adoption across multiple teams — set targets, track adoption and impact, and share what's working across the teams you lead
  
  
- Advise your senior engineers on moderately complex technical and people matters, without doing their job for them
  
  
- Modify and execute policies that affect your area of the organization, and recommend changes that should apply more broadly
  
  
- Communicate regularly with senior and peer leadership on matters spanning several teams, functions, or customers
  
  
- Own budget and headcount planning for your area, balancing near-term delivery against longer-term investment
  
  
  
  
Our Tech Stack
  
You don't need full hands-on competency in this stack, but you should be fluent enough to review designs, make staffing calls, and comfortable enough to earn credibility with the team building on it.
  
- Java / Spring for backend and Angular for frontend — enough depth to evaluate trade-offs across multiple codebases and coach your team on technical judgment
  
  
- Gen AI / LLM tooling — fluent enough to set adoption strategy and evaluate tool or vendor choices across multiple teams
  
  
- Low-latency systems — familiar enough to guide design decisions and set the technical bar across teams working on transaction processing or high-throughput systems
  
  
- Microservices & APIs — solid enough grounding to review cross-team architecture decisions and API contracts
  
  
- Containers & Kubernetes — working knowledge sufficient to evaluate infrastructure decisions across multiple teams
  
  
- Cloud platforms — working familiarity with Azure; exposure to AWS a plus
  
  
- CI/CD & DevOps — comfortable evaluating pipeline standards across teams, not just one
  
  
What You Bring
  
You don't need to check every box below to apply — if most of this resonates, we want to hear from you.
  
- 9+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years managing other managers, tech leads, or multiple teams directly
  
  
- Strong critical thinking applied across a broader, less clearly-defined set of problems — you're comfortable when principles alone don't fully apply
  
  
- Strong systems thinking across multiple teams' systems, spotting where complexity crosses team boundaries
  
  
- Solid grounding in SaaS and cloud-native fundamentals, applied at a multi-team level
  
  
- Genuine curiosity that drives you to dig into problems that don't have a strategic direction yet
  
  
- A track record of leading through other leaders — developing managers and senior ICs, not just individual engineers
  
  
- Strong understanding of software architecture across multiple systems or domains
  
  
- Working familiarity with major cloud platforms, container orchestration, and CI/CD at a multi-team scale
  
  
- A track record of using AI-assisted engineering as a lever across a broader organization
  
  
- Demonstrated ability to persuade senior stakeholders in sensitive or complex situations while preserving relationships
  
  
- Excellent communication with executives, peers, and the teams several levels below you
  
  
  
Bonus Points
  
- Experience in payments, financial services, or another regulated industry
  
  
- Experience managing distributed or remote teams across multiple time zones
  
  
- A track record of turning around an underperforming team or function
  
  
- Experience owning a departmental budget
  
  
  
What We Offer
  
- Lead engineering for a platform processing mission-critical payment transactions for financial institutions worldwide
  
  
- Be part of a truly global product development organization — real centers of engineering excellence spread across multiple regions, organized around product families and technical capabilities rather than geography for its own sake, with engineers everywhere shaping our core products and technical direction
  
  
- A cloud-native, automation-first engineering culture that treats quality, security, and developer experience as competitive advantages, not compliance checkboxes
  
  
- Real leadership growth — ACI actively develops managers into senior engineering leaders; your trajectory here is yours to define
  
  
- An organization that holds managers accountable for AI adoption outcomes, not just tool advocacy — you'll have real latitude to drive that
  
  
- Hybrid model — typically 2–3 days in-office across ACI's global hub locations
  
  
- Some domestic and international travel (10–15%) for team meetings, conferences, or cross-site collaboration
  
  
- Flexible schedule, with occasional extended hours around critical releases or team needs
  
  
  
Equal Opportunity & Compliance
  
ACI Worldwide is an Equal Opportunity Employer; all qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. This role requires adherence to ACI's Code of Business Conduct and Ethics, and — given access to sensitive payment data — compliance with applicable security and data-protection standards (PCI-DSS, SOC 2, GDPR, CCPA). Comprehensive background screening is required. Responsibilities may evolve with business needs.

jobs.title: Director, Payment Acceptance
jobs.description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
  
  
**Job Title**
Director, Payment Acceptance
  
  
**Job Location: Pune**
**5 Days Work from Office**
**Shift Timing : 6:30PM to 3:30AM**
**What does a great Director of Business Analysis I do?**
The
**Director, Payment Acceptance**
provides strategic and operational leadership for Payment Acceptance operations functions within Merchant Solutions. This leader is accountable for delivering consistent, controlled, and efficient operations across least cost routing, interchange reconciliation, network reporting and fee oversight, merchant data integrity and PCI compliance support, and Payment Acceptance inquiries while ensuring the organization meets client commitments, network requirements, financial controls, service levels, quality standards, and productivity expectations.
  
  
The Director leads through other leaders and is responsible for translating business strategy into operational execution across a complex Payment Acceptance environment. The role provides oversight across credit deibt and dispute operation routing and configuration, interchange and settlement reconciliation, network fees and reporting, merchant compliance requirements, inquiry management and escalation, production workflow, reporting and analytics, and continuous improvement.
  
  
This leader is expected to think beyond daily operations. They anticipate operational, financial, network, and compliance risk; identify opportunities to simplify and modernize processes; develop scalable operating models; and establish the controls, metrics, talent, and governance necessary to support Payment Acceptance.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Provide strategic leadership for Payment Acceptance operations, establishing priorities, operating standards, performance expectations, and long-term direction across supported functions.
* Lead through managers, supervisors, and professional staff, creating clear accountability for operational execution, service delivery, quality, productivity, associate development, and results.
* Oversee Least Cost Routing support, ensuring debit network routing requirements, eligibility indicators, configuration values, and related data are accurate and support appropriate transaction routing.
* Provide leadership for interchange reconciliation activities across payment, interchange, settlement, and billing processes, ensuring variances, exceptions, and out-of-balance conditions are identified and resolved in a timely manner.
* Oversee network reporting and fee governance activities, ensuring reporting accuracy, data integrity, merchant compliance support, fee validation, and timely resolution of discrepancies.
* Provide leadership for Payment Acceptance inquiry support, ensuring Account Management and lines of business receive timely research, clear answers, appropriate issue tracking, and escalation to Technology when technical investigation or system changes are required.
* Provide oversight of payment and debit network requirements that affect routing, interchange, reporting, fees, merchant compliance, and Payment Acceptance operations.
* Lead production workflow and capacity management, ensuring inventory, staffing, skills, and resources are aligned to volumes, service-level requirements, and business priorities.
* Maintain strong financial and operational controls across interchange reconciliation, network fees, routing, reporting, exceptions, adjustments, and other activities affecting merchant or corporate financial positions.
* Establish and monitor performance metrics across productivity, quality, SLA attainment, inventory, aging, financial accuracy, data quality, operational risk, and client experience. Use data to identify trends, root causes, and opportunities requiring leadership intervention.
* Establish consistent processes for issue intake, research, ownership, escalation, aging, resolution, and communication across Payment Acceptance support functions.
* Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement by simplifying processes, eliminating manual activity, improving controls, expanding automation, and partnering with Technology on system and reporting enhancements.
* Lead Payment Acceptance technology and modernization initiatives, representing Operations in the design and enhancement of routing, reconciliation, inquiry, reporting, workflow, automation, and control capabilities.
* Drive a scalable operating model that provides resiliency, knowledge transfer, cross-training, and appropriate site redundancy while maintaining consistent operational standards across locations.
* Manage operational risk by proactively identifying process breaks, control gaps, financial exposure, network or compliance concerns, data-quality issues, and emerging trends and ensuring appropriate remediation and escalation.
* Support audit and control activities, maintaining strong documentation, process adherence, evidence management, and sustainable controls.
* Partner across the organization with Product, Technology, Finance, Risk, Compliance, Network Relations, Account Management, and other business partners to resolve complex issues and deliver strategic objectives.
* Provide leadership for client, merchant, and business escalations, ensuring complex Payment Acceptance issues are researched thoroughly, root causes are understood, and sustainable corrective actions are implemented.
* Develop organizational talent and succession, strengthening leadership capability and Payment Acceptance subject-matter expertise while building clear development paths for associates, analysts, supervisors, and managers.
* Create an accountability-driven culture where leaders and associates demonstrate ownership, sound judgment, follow-through, continuous learning, and commitment to client and business outcomes.
* Communicate operational performance and risk to senior leadership, translating complex operational data and issues into clear business impacts, recommendations, decisions, and action plans.

**What You Need To Have**

* Demonstrated experience in business analysis, Payment Acceptance, payment operations, network reporting, fee oversight, merchant compliance, or a related field, ideally within financial services.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large data sets, identify trends, validate data integrity, and resolve discrepancies.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex network requirements into clear business requirements and operational direction.
* Proven ability to lead multiple projects and priorities simultaneously with strong organization, accountability, and attention to detail.
* Strong knowledge of payment networks, merchant compliance requirements, network fees, reporting processes, and industry regulations.
* Proficiency with CRM systems, reporting tools, and Microsoft Office applications.
* Experience working with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI, and Excel macros.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate complex issues, assess business impact and risk, and coordinate solutions with payment networks and internal teams.
* Ability to work effectively across payment networks, lines of business, and cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
* High attention to detail, adaptability, and commitment to data quality, compliance, accuracy, and strong operational controls.

**What Would Be Great To Have**

* Experience leading Paymen

jobs.title: Revenue Accounting Engineering and Delivery Tech Lead - India
jobs.description:
**Role Purpose**
The Head of Engineering for Revenue Accounting India will provide senior technology and engineering leadership for the Revenue Accounting organization in India, building a world-class engineering capability and driving modernization, engineering excellence and predictable delivery across the Revenue Accounting technology estate.
  
  
The role will establish India as a
**strategic engineering centre supporting end-to-end delivery**
, partnering with global Technology and Finance leadership to deliver critical Revenue Accounting capabilities and strategic transformation.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong engineering and technology leadership with the ability to lead a large, complex organization, develop exceptional talent, modernize the technology estate and deliver consistently in a highly regulated environment.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
**Engineering Leadership & Strategy**

* Lead the Revenue Accounting engineering organization in India, with accountability for engineering excellence, talent, technology and delivery outcomes.
* Define and execute the India engineering strategy, aligned to the global Revenue Accounting technology strategy and broader Finance transformation agenda.
* Provide strong technical leadership across the engineering organization, ensuring strategic technology decisions balance business outcomes, architecture, resilience, risk and long-term sustainability.
* Establish clear engineering standards across software design, architecture, development, testing, DevSecOps, observability, resilience and production engineering.
* Champion a culture of engineering ownership where teams are accountable for solutions throughout the technology lifecycle, from design and build through deployment and production.

**Technology Modernization**

* Drive modernization of the Revenue Accounting technology estate, including MOTIF and the broader subledger ecosystem, simplifying legacy architecture and moving toward strategic target-state capabilities.
* Actively manage technical debt and drive simplification of applications, infrastructure, data flows and engineering processes.
* Promote modern architecture and engineering patterns including cloud, APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture, automation and modern data capabilities where appropriate.
* Ensure technology investment balances immediate business and regulatory requirements with the long-term strategic health of the platform.

**Delivery & Transformation**

* Drive predictable execution of the Revenue Accounting engineering roadmap, aligning engineering capacity to the highest-value business, regulatory and strategic outcomes.
* Provide senior engineering leadership to major Finance transformation initiatives, ensuring Revenue Accounting capabilities integrate effectively with the target front-to-back accounting architecture.
* Establish transparent measures of engineering health, delivery effectiveness, quality, risk and productivity.
* Identify and proactively manage material technology dependencies, delivery risks and capacity constraints.

**Talent & Organizational Leadership**

* Build and develop a high-performing engineering organization across India, strengthening both engineering leadership and deep technical capability.
* Attract, retain and develop outstanding engineering talent while creating clear career paths for technical specialists and engineering leaders.
* Build a strong succession pipeline across Director, VP, technical leadership and senior engineering roles.
* Strengthen institutional knowledge and reduce key-person or third-party dependencies through targeted insourcing, mobility, cross-training and capability development.
* Foster an inclusive, collaborative and high-performance engineering culture where teams are empowered to challenge, innovate and continuously improve.

**Innovation & AI**

* Champion the responsible adoption of AI-enabled software engineering, intelligent automation and modern developer tooling across the engineering lifecycle.
* Identify opportunities to improve developer productivity, test automation, software quality and speed to market through AI and automation.
* Create an environment that encourages experimentation while ensuring innovation is governed appropriately for a regulated technology environment.

**Partnership & Stakeholder Leadership**

* Act as a senior member of the global Revenue Accounting technology leadership team, ensuring India is fully integrated into global strategy and decision-making.
* Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Finance, Product, Architecture, Operations, Risk, Controls and Technology.
* Influence enterprise technology and engineering decisions beyond the immediate Revenue Accounting organization.
* Represent Revenue Accounting within the broader India technology leadership community and strengthen India's position as a strategic engineering hub.

****Desirable Skills****
The following would be advantageous:
  
  
  

* Experience within financial accounting technology, including subledger, general ledger, financial control or regulatory reporting platforms.
* Understanding of front-to-back accounting flows, including transaction capture, accounting event generation, subledger processing, reconciliation, financial controls and general-ledger integration.
* Experience delivering large-scale Finance or enterprise transformation within a global financial institution.
* Experience with large-scale platform or cloud modernization.
* Knowledge of modern technologies and patterns including Java, APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture, AWS/cloud technologies, DevSecOps and modern data platforms.
* Experience implementing AI-assisted software engineering, developer productivity tooling or intelligent test automation at enterprise scale.
* Experience developing product-oriented and Agile engineering organizations.
* Experience implementing insourcing strategies and transferring critical technology or domain capability from third-party providers into permanent engineering teams.
* Experience leading globally distributed engineering organizations, particularly across India, the UK and US.
* Understanding of technology economics and experience optimizing engineering investment, infrastructure costs and third-party expenditure.

****Accountabilities****
The Head of Engineering will have clear accountability across the following areas:
  
  
**Technology & Architecture**

* Technical health and strategic evolution of the Revenue Accounting technology estate within the role's remit.
* Alignment to enterprise architecture, engineering and technology standards.
* Reduction of legacy complexity and technical debt.
* Creation of sustainable, resilient and scalable technology solutions.

**Engineering & Delivery**

* Quality, predictability and effectiveness of engineering delivery.
* Engineering standards and controls throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Effective management of engineering capacity, dependencies and technology risks.
* Continuous improvement of engineering productivity, quality and time to market.

**Service, Resilience & Controls**

* Stability, resilience, security and maintainability of technology platforms.
* Effective management of production risk, recurring incidents and systemic technology issues.
* Compliance with applicable technology, cyber, data, resilience and regulatory requirements.
* Timely identification, escalation and remediation of material technology risks and control weaknesses.

**People & Organization**

* Organizational health and effectiveness of the India Revenue Accounting engineering function.
* Workforce strategy, organizational design and location strategy.
* Attraction, retention, development and succession of engineering talent.
* Development of strong engineering and technology leadership capability.
* Reduction of key-person risk and inappropriate dependency on external providers.

* Represent architecture in governance and Design Authority forums, presenting options, trade-offs, recommendations and exception impacts

The Principal Enterprise Architect is responsible for defining, upholding, and communicating the Business and Information Technology Architecture that supports the Bank's vision and strategic intent. Education

**IINSPIRE | EXHILARATE | DELIGHT**

For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. **What you’ll need to succeed**

* Deep expertise in SAP S/4HANA Finance, with strong functional understanding across Record-to-Report (R2R), Order-to-Cash (O2C), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), and Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A).

* Working knowledge of responsible-AI and AI-governance practices: reviewing and challenging proposed AI use cases, risk classification, control definition, and sign-off for AI applied to financial data.
* Ability to translate AI and data-governance policy into Finance-specific guidance and controls, and act as an escalation point for responsible AI use across the finance function.
* Broad SAP Finance module knowledge across General Ledger, AP, AR, Asset Accounting, Controlling, Advanced Financial Closing, Group Reporting and Consolidation, PAPM, Cash and Liquidity, Advanced Payment Management, Bank Account and Communication Management, Tax and DRC, RE-FX, Project Systems, Intercompany (ICMR), and Open Text VIM.
