jobs.title: Wealth Management-Bengaluru-Associate-Software Engineering
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

At Goldman Sachs, we connect people, capital and ideas to help solve problems for our clients. We are a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments and individuals.

In Private Wealth Management, we help our clients pursue their wealth management goals through careful advice & astute investment management. PWM Engineering plays a pivotal role in building the tools and applications our business needs to effectively manage and support our client’s diverse requirements. We support the entire user experience starting with onboarding through to trading, reporting, as well as providing clients access to their portfolios online via native iOS and Android apps. We also build and support numerous applications for our Business and Operations users to help them effectively manage risk and provide the best white-glove service possible to our clients.

The Data Distribution team supports PWM's Quantum data distribution platform which is considered the primary source of data relating to Client Holdings, Transactions, Taxlots and reference data like Accounts, Products and Prices in PWM. Several teams/projects requires this data and our team has built several distribution channels for different usage patterns.

We are currently enhancing our platform based on new business requirements as well as increasing stability and scalability needs to support a growing business. The platform will be required to manage very high volumes of requests with varying time sensitivities and prioritizing across multiple tenants via an event based framework.

**Your Impact**

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced **Cloud Database Specialist** to join our core data platform team. The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise in managing and optimizing modern cloud data stacks, specifically focusing on **Snowflake**, **Databricks**, and/or **SingleStore Helios**. You will be responsible for architecting scalable data environments, implementing robust performance tuning strategies, and ensuring the seamless integration of high-performance analytical and operational workloads.

This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of Data Engineering and Cloud Infrastructure, driving the evolution of our global data platform. You will serve as a technical authority, mentoring junior engineers and influencing the strategic direction of our multi-cloud data architecture to support mission-critical business intelligence and AI/ML initiatives.

**HOW YOU WILL FULFILL YOUR POTENTIAL**

* You will develop financial products with direct impact on millions of consumers
* Systems under your watch will be the primary sources of revenue for the organization
* You build it: engineers are in control of decisions about systems they own from the first line of code written
* You run it: engineers with assistance from global SRE guild are responsible for operation of systems they built
* You own it: engineers do not wait for orders here. They do research, pitch projects. Great ideas are valued and implemented
* Professional network: you will meet and collaborate with very influential people within the global organization and the entire industry

**Key Responsibilities:**

*Back-End Development:*

* Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs and microservices using Java , Spring Boot etc.
* Implement business logic, database interactions, and integrations with third-party services.
* Optimize application performance and ensure scalability.

*Front-End Development:*

* Develop responsive and user-friendly interfaces using modern front-end frameworks (e.g., Angular, React, or Vue.js).
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers to implement designs and ensure a seamless user experience.
* Ensure cross-browser compatibility and mobile responsiveness.

*Database Management:*

* Design and manage relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL) and/or NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB).
* Write efficient queries and optimize database performance.

*DevOps and Deployment:*

* Collaborate with DevOps to deploy applications in cloud environments

*Testing and Debugging:*

* Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure code quality.
* Debug and resolve application issues in a timely manner.

**SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* Between 1-3 years experience
* B.S. or higher in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent work experience)
* Expertise in Java, React JS, HTML5
* Familiar with one or more of the following:

  + Distributed systems
  + NoSQL and relational databases
  + Distributed messaging
  + Transactional services
* Experience integrating with Restful web services
* Ability to establish trusted partnerships with product heads, and executive level stakeholders
* Comfortable with Agile Operating Models

*Preferred Qualifications:*

* Experience with microservice based architecture
* Experience with Kafka, MongoDB, Spring, vert.X

**Goldman Sachs Engineering Culture**

At Goldman Sachs, our Engineers don’t just make things – we make things possible. Change the world by connecting people and capital with ideas. Solve the most challenging and pressing engineering problems for our clients. Join our engineering teams that build massively scalable software and systems, architect low latency infrastructure solutions, proactively guard against cyber threats, and leverage machine learning alongside financial engineering to continuously turn data into action. Create new businesses, transform finance, and explore a world of opportunity at the speed of markets.

Engineering is at the critical center of our business, and our dynamic environment requires innovative strategic thinking and immediate, real solutions. Want to push the limit of digital possibilities? Start here!

Goldman Sachs is an equal employment/affirmative action employer Female/Minority/Disability/Veteran/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity.

We Offer Best-In-Class Benefits

Healthcare & Medical Insurance

We offer a wide range of health and welfare programs that vary depending on office location. These generally include medical, dental, short-term disability, long-term disability, life, accidental death, labor accident and business travel accident insurance.

Holiday & Vacation Policies

We offer competitive vacation policies based on employee level and office location. We promote time off from work to recharge by providing generous vacation entitlements and a minimum of three weeks expected vacation usage each year.

Financial Wellness & Retirement

We assist employees in saving and planning for retirement, offer financial support for higher education, and provide a number of benefits to help employees prepare for the unexpected. We offer live financial education and content on a variety of topics to address the spectrum of employees’ priorities.

Health Services

We offer a medical advocacy service for employees and family members facing critical health situations, and counseling and referral services through the Employee Assistance Program (EAP). We provide Global Medical, Security and Travel Assistance and a Workplace Ergonomics Program. We also offer state-of-the-art on-site health centers in certain offices.

Fitness

To encourage employees to live a healthy and active lifestyle, some of our offices feature on-site fitness centers. For eligible employees we typically reimburse fees paid for a fitness club membership or activity (up to a pre-approved amount).

Child Care & Family Care

We offer on-site child care centers that provide full-time and emergency back-up care, as well as mother and baby rooms and homework rooms. In every office, we provide advice and counseling services, expectant parent resources and transitional programs for parents

**1. Financial Reporting & Accounting**

* Prepare, review, and ensure timely finalisation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with Ind AS.
* Oversee month-end and year-end closing, general ledger reviews, balance sheet reconciliations, and financial reporting.
* Ensure accuracy, completeness, and integrity of financial records and accounting systems.

**2. Direct & Indirect Taxation**

* Oversee Income Tax, TDS/TCS, GST, and other applicable tax compliances, including returns, assessments, reconciliations, and notices.
* Develop tax planning strategies and evaluate tax implications of business transactions.
* Manage tax assessments, appeals, litigations, and representations before relevant authorities.

**3. Corporate & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure timely ROC filings and statutory compliances under the Companies Act, 2013.
* Monitor regulatory developments and ensure adherence to applicable statutory and corporate governance requirements.
* Coordinate with legal advisors, company secretaries, and regulatory authorities.

**4. Audit & Internal Financial Controls**

* Lead statutory, internal, tax, and other regulatory audits.
* Coordinate with auditors, resolve audit observations, and ensure timely closure of audit findings.
* Establish, strengthen, and monitor internal financial controls, risk management systems, and compliance frameworks.

**5. Financial Planning, Budgeting & MIS**

* Lead annual budgeting, financial planning, forecasting, and periodic budgetary reviews.
* Prepare and present MIS reports, financial dashboards, variance analysis, and profitability reports to senior management.
* Monitor financial KPIs and provide actionable insights to improve business performance.
* Analyse revenue, expenses, margins, and cost structures to drive profitability.

**6. Strategic Financial Management**

* Partner with senior management in financial planning, business strategy, and key commercial decisions.
* Evaluate capital expenditure, investment proposals, business expansion plans, and financial feasibility.
* Drive cost optimisation, working capital efficiency, cash flow management, and profitability improvement.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to support business growth and long-term sustainability.

**7. Treasury & Working Capital Management**

* Oversee cash flow forecasting, fund management, liquidity planning, and banking operations.
* Manage banking relationships, credit facilities, fund-based and non-fund-based limits.
* Monitor receivables, payables, inventory, and working capital requirements.

**8. Process Improvement & Digital Transformation**

* Review and improve finance and accounting processes, policies, and standard operating procedures.
* Drive automation, ERP optimisation, and digital transformation of finance operations.
* Implement robust financial controls and reporting systems to improve accuracy and operational efficiency.

**9. Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Lead, mentor, and develop the finance and accounts team, ensuring effective delegation and performance management.
* Act as a key finance business partner to senior management and other functional heads.
* Liaise with auditors, banks, tax authorities, consultants, investors, and other external stakeholders.
* Ensure timely delivery of financial information and maintain high standards of financial discipline and governance.

Pay: ₹1,200,000.00 - ₹1,400,000.00 per year

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

* **Company:** Niyo (Finnew Solutions Pvt. Ltd.)
* **Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka (On-site / Hybrid)
* **Experience:** 4–7 Years (post-qualification)
* **Qualification:** Chartered Accountant (CA) / MBA (Finance) from a Tier-1 institute
* **Department:** FP&A & Business Finance

### **About Niyo**

Niyo is a leading Indian consumer fintech platform transforming how millions of Indians bank, save, and spend globally. Operating in partnership with regulated banking and financial institutions, Niyo offers zero-forex-markup international travel cards, digital savings and salary accounts, remittances, and wealth solutions. As we scale across product verticals and global corridors, we are looking for a sharp, commercially driven **Business Finance Partner** to act as a strategic co-pilot to our Product, Growth, and Business leaders.

### **Role Overview**

Reporting to the CFO, the Business Finance Partner will own unit economics,revenue modeling, cost optimization, and strategic decision support for key business verticals . Moving beyond traditional reporting, this role sits at the intersection of finance, data analytics, and product strategy—translating user cohorts, transaction volumes, and partner-bank commercials into actionable insights that drive profitable growth.

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **1. Unit Economics & Product P&L Ownership**

* Own end-to-end **Product P&Ls and contribution margin tracking** across assigned business lines
* Build dynamic **cohort-level LTV/CAC models** in partnership with Growth and Data Science teams to evaluate customer acquisition payback periods and retention economics.
* Identify margin leakage, optimize payment routing/vendor costs, and recommend pricing or fee-structure refinements to improve net take-rates.

#### **2. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting (FP&A)**

* Lead the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), quarterly re-forecasting, and rolling monthly financial projections for assigned verticals.
* Track actuals vs. budget rigorously—conducting deep-dive variance analyses on Gross Transaction Value (GTV), active card metrics, forex volumes, and operating expenses.
* Partner with Corporate Finance / Controllership during month-end close to ensure accurate revenue accruals, marketing spend provisions, and cost allocations.

#### **3. Commercial Deal Structuring & Business Cases**

* Build robust financial models and scenario analyses for **new product launches, international corridors, bank/card-network partnerships, and co-marketing campaigns**.
* Evaluate commercial terms with partner banks, payment aggregators, KYC vendors, and card manufacturers, supporting leadership during contract negotiations.
* Establish clear ROI guardrails and post-launch performance reviews for growth experiments, referral programs, and brand campaigns.

#### **4. MIS, Board Reporting & Automation**

* Design real-time executive dashboards (using SQL, Power BI/Tableau, and Excel) giving business heads daily/weekly visibility into key financial and operational KPIs.
* Prepare monthly business review (MBR) decks, board materials, and investor-ready financial narratives highlighting business drivers and strategic risks.

### **Qualifications & Skills**

**Criteria**

**Requirements**

  

**Education**

**Chartered Accountant (CA)** or **MBA in Finance** from a premier institution.

  

**Experience**

**4–7 years** in Business Finance, FP&A, or Strategic Finance—with at least **2+ years in FinTech, Payments, Consumer Internet, or Banking/NBFCs**.

  

**Analytical & Data Skills**

Advanced Excel financial modeling; working proficiency in **SQL** and BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, or Looker) to query large transaction datasets independently.

  

**Domain Acumen**

Strong grasp of fintech unit economics (interchange, MDR, forex spreads, CAC/LTV, cohort retention, and contribution margins).

  

**Stakeholder Management**

High-ownership, consultative mindset with the ability to challenge assumptions constructively and influence Product and Growth leaders using data.

jobs.title: Head of New Verticals Business Planning and Performance
jobs.description:
**Our Global Structure**

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

**The Team**

Deliveroo is on a mission to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders.

Our Grocery & Retail team manages Deliveroo's Grocery and non-food Retail businesses. We work closely with our partners and cross-functional teams to drive growth, strengthen the customer proposition and improve business performance.

As the scale and complexity of Grocery & Retail continues to grow, the Strategy & Performance function plays a central role in setting market strategy, leading business planning, embedding strong performance management and ensuring we continue to improve the customer experience.

**The Role**

The Head of Strategy & Performance, New Verticals - Middle East is responsible for setting the strategic direction of Deliveroo's Grocery and non-food Retail business and ensuring we translate that strategy into measurable growth and performance.

This is a high-impact leadership role with significant exposure to senior local and global stakeholders, sitting at the centre of some of the most important decisions shaping the future of Grocery & Retail in the Middle East. You will work closely with the Director of Grocery & Retail and wider leadership team across strategy, business planning, performance, customer value proposition and high-priority cross-functional initiatives.

You will lead two core functions: Strategy & Performance and Category Management, setting their direction, building strong teams and bringing together data, customer insight and commercial context to determine where we should focus, what needs to change and how we deliver against our ambitions. Through Category Management, you will shape the customer proposition across key levers including conversion, selection, catalogue quality, pricing, promotions and merchandising, ensuring priorities translate into tangible improvements across the customer journey.

The role combines big-picture strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will need to be equally comfortable defining long-term priorities, diagnosing why the business is performing the way it is, influencing senior stakeholders and getting into the details to unblock complex initiatives.

You will directly manage the Strategy & Performance Manager and Senior Category Manager, with the wider Category Management team also sitting within your organisation.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* **Own Grocery & Retail strategy and planning:** Set the strategic direction for Grocery and non-food Retail, lead annual and quarterly planning, identify and size the biggest growth opportunities, and partner closely with Finance to translate strategic priorities into financial plans, business cases and clear targets.
* **Drive business performance:** Own the overall performance framework for Grocery & Retail, ensuring leadership understands what is driving performance and where action is required. Set the direction for WBRs, MBRs and performance diagnostics, and build a strong culture of accountability and follow-through.
* **Shape the customer proposition and Category Management agenda:** Own the overarching CVP strategy and set the direction for Category Management across key levers including selection, availability, pricing, promotions, merchandising, catalogue quality and conversion. Ensure priorities are grounded in customer behaviour, commercial performance and competitor insights.
* **Lead high-impact strategic initiatives:** Take ownership of complex, cross-functional opportunities and problems that do not naturally sit within one team, from initial diagnosis and strategic direction through to alignment, delivery and handover into BAU.
* **Lead and develop high-performing teams:** Lead the Strategy & Performance and Category Management functions, directly managing the Strategy & Performance Manager and Senior Category Manager. Set clear priorities, coach and develop the team, and build the capabilities, tools and operating models needed for both functions to scale effectively.
* **Influence senior stakeholders and shape decisions:** Act as a strategic partner to the Director of Grocery & Retail and wider leadership team, representing Grocery & Retail in key local and central discussions and shaping decisions on the business's most important strategic priorities.

**Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of experience in Strategy & Operations, strategy, consulting, investment banking, commercial, growth or business operations, ideally in a high-growth technology, marketplace or startup environment; experience in on-demand delivery, Grocery, Retail or digital category management is a strong advantage.
* Strong commercial and analytical judgement, with the ability to understand business performance, diagnose root causes and make clear recommendations grounded in data and commercial context.
* Strong ability to structure ambiguity, taking broad or loosely defined business problems, framing the problem clearly, identifying the right questions and translating them into a practical strategy and execution plan.
* Strong influencer and relationship builder, able to bring senior and cross-functional stakeholders on the journey, communicate in a way that resonates with different audiences and drive alignment without relying on formal authority.
* Proven end-to-end execution capability, including mobilising the right teams and resources, securing investment or headcount where needed, removing blockers and driving complex initiatives through to measurable outcomes.
* Proven people leadership experience, with the ability to set clear direction, develop high-performing teams, coach managers and build the capabilities and ways of working needed for teams to scale effectively.
* Strong data literacy and comfort using analytical and AI tools to accelerate analysis, problem-solving and decision-making; experience with tools such as Looker, Cursor, Claude or similar is an advantage.

**Benefits and Diversity**

* Annual Holiday Leave
* Annual flight allowance
* Free Deliveroo Plus - Free delivery and access to special offers
* Enhanced Maternity & Paternity benefits
* End of year parties & regular social events
* An extremely fun team to work alongside!

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business, and we prioritize their welfare. We offer many great benefits in areas including health insurance, family, financial coverage, community, convenience, growth opportunities, time away, and relocation.

We believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgment when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion, or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing start-ups around.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**  
  
At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your

The Associate Director holds a significant role in supporting regulatory learning initiatives related to Emiratisation in the UAE, working closely with regulatory bodies, educational institutions, and internal stakeholders to ensure compliance, readiness for audits, and alignment with government requirements.

Through collaborative partnership with Hub Leads and Tribal Heads, they play an instrumental role in ensuring that learning programs meet both local regulatory expectations and global standards, driving consistency and quality across teams and geographies.

* Develop comprehensive awareness of the banking industry's dynamic economic and market environment, enabling proactive adjustment of learning designs to align with business demands.

* Introduce and embed external thought leadership, creative storytelling methods, and innovative learning technologies to enhance practitioner competencies.

* Relevant experience in Learning & Developement

* Proficiency in Arabic is highly desirable and considered an advantage to effectively engage with local stakeholders and regulatory bodies within the UAE.

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. * **A continuous learning culture** to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management, Context Engine
jobs.description:
**Our Company:**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
As Director of Product Management, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for the capabilities that let Teradata's Enterprise Context Engine understand customer data on its own: schema and ontology discovery, natural language processing, and AI driven workflow and policy extraction. The Context Engine extracts, curates, and continuously improves metadata and business context, grounded in Teradata's industry knowledge models, so that human analysts move faster and AI agents are grounded in trusted enterprise meaning.
  
  
You will serve as the Context Engine's senior product leader in the region and partner closely with local engineering, data science, and architecture teams along with product and engineering leaders across the US. You will set direction, make prioritization decisions, and hold your team accountable for customer outcomes, from discovery and design through launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Strategy, Roadmap & Outcomes**

* Own the roadmap knowledge graph completion / Ontology Learning, Reflexion-based memory extraction, and reinforcement learning-focused feature sets within the Context Engine portfolio. Translate customer needs and business priorities into clear requirements, prioritization decisions, and success criteria.
* Act as the primary touchpoint and evangelist for Context Engine to customers, executives, and field teams in the APJ region.
* Define how these capabilities are reusable by and drive value across Teradata products, personas, and business domains, and across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
* Shape the competitive position and differentiation of the Context Engine against competitors such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft, Google, and emerging AI data platform and semantic layer vendors.

**Automated Workflow Assembly**

* Define the product vision for automatically assembling workflows from discovered schemas and semantics, including data preparation, mapping, validation, enrichment, and publication of context, without hand-built pipelines for each customer.
* Specify how agents plan, compose, and execute these workflows, including reusable workflow templates, orchestration, approval checkpoints, and rollback.
* Set requirements for observability, explainability, and auditability so that customers can see why a workflow was assembled the way it was and trust what it produced.
* Define how workflows and discovered context are exposed to external agents and frameworks through Model Context Protocol (MCP) and other open agent interfaces.

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

This requires someone adept at integrating efforts and activities across many leadership levels and organizations, including regular engagement with managers and senior leaders from product management, product engineering, field/sales enablement, technical enablement, sales, marketing, customer success, legal, finance, IT, and more.
  
  
Impact this role has: Global Program Managers oversee the end-to-end product introduction process for their programs. At Level V, that scope extends across multiple teams, components, or a full product theme, with significant revenue, field, and customer impact. Role impact is defined by enabling day-one revenue at launch through strong stakeholder alignment on launch criteria, integration of customer feedback into the product, and delivery of high-quality assets across teams. This role delivers measurable improvements in launch quality, Go-To-Market readiness, field and support readiness, and technical enablement, and delivers the training needed to achieve full Teradata corporate-wide readiness. Level V GPMs also raise the execution capability of the GPMs they mentor. Work is guided by product-line goals and program-level success metrics; impact is bounded to your programs and product area.
  
  
What success might look like: Shape and execute program strategy by translating plans into outcomes through structured planning, agile execution, and cross-functional leadership. Lead a large program with several sub-programs, or multiple related programs at once, and direct other project and program managers to keep overall program health strong. Define program objectives, milestones, owners, and measurable success criteria, and adapt the plan as dependencies, scope, and risks change. Resolve ambiguity in approach, sequencing, and ownership, bringing options and a recommendation rather than waiting for direction. Identify risks, dependencies, and handoff gaps across workstreams and adjacent programs, and mitigate them before they become blockers. When a process gap extends beyond your programs, document it, quantify its impact, and recommend a fix to Directors. Communicate program status, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to Directors and VPs in concise written narratives and verbal form. Manage handoffs to Product, Engineering, and Implementation teams while maintaining overall program health, and capture customer learnings and lessons learned for future programs. Mentor Level IV and newly hired GPMs by reviewing program plans and status narratives, modeling sound escalation judgment, supporting onboarding, and giving specific, constructive feedback. Participate in recruiting, interviewing, and calibration for GPM roles.
  
  
Demonstrate key leadership behaviors by focusing on the most impactful work, taking smart risks, speaking up to challenge when needed, and fostering a culture of learning, creativity, and collaboration. Act with urgency while simplifying and prioritizing efforts, making decisions that benefit the broader enterprise, leading with inclusion, strengthening the company’s reputation, and cultivating a growth mindset grounded in trust. Be recognized as a trusted ally to all stakeholders, consistently driving the highest-value work into the hands of customers with minimal friction.
  
  
Who you will work with on the team: This requires someone adept at integrating efforts and activities across many leadership levels and organizations, including regular engagement with Directors, VPs, and senior leaders from product management, product engineering, field/sales enablement, technical enablement, sales, marketing, customer success, legal, finance, IT, and more. You will also direct other project and program managers and mentor GPMs.
  
  
Who this position reports to: This position reports to the Senior Director of Core Program Management within the Product Operations, PMO and Partnerships organization.
  
  
**Non-negotiable Qualifications**

* This role requires someone who is: (1) an eager and quick learner; (2) enjoys dynamic responsibilities and can work fluidly across many disciplines; (3) is methodical and pragmatic as a program manager and business strategist; and (4) is a natural integrator and team leader.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Head of Engineering (India)
jobs.description:
**Head of Engineering, India**  
  
Location: Bangalore, India (on-site or hybrid)  
  
Reports to: Chief Technology Officer  
  
Level: Vice President  
  
Team size: 50–100 engineers  
  
About Machinify  
  
Machinify is a healthcare payment integrity company formed through the 2024–2025 merger of five industry-leading businesses: Apixio Payment Integrity (CPS/ClaimLogiq), Varis, Rawlings Company (Right Payer Solutions), legacy Machinify, and Performant Health. Machinify's customers are health insurance companies and healthcare payers, and its products combine SaaS platforms with professional services to detect and prevent improper healthcare payments. The company is in the midst of consolidating four distinct technology organizations onto a unified platform and operating model.  
  
Role Summary  
  
Machinify is hiring a VP, Head of Engineering to lead the company's India-based engineering organization. This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for building and scaling a unified engineering team of 50–100 engineers in India, delivering against the global product roadmap, and serving as the senior technical and people leader for the India site. The role reports directly to the CTO and is a key partner in consolidating engineering practices across Machinify's four legacy entities onto a single technology and delivery model.  
  
Key Responsibilities

* Own end-to-end delivery for the India engineering organization, partnering with global product, design, and engineering leadership to ship on the committed roadmap.
* Build, scale, and lead a high-performing engineering team in India, including hiring, org design, career development, and performance management.
* Drive the technical and cultural integration of engineering teams and practices inherited from Machinify's legacy entities (Apixio/CPS, Varis, Rawlings, legacy Machinify, Performant) into a single, unified engineering organization.
* Establish and maintain engineering standards for code quality, architecture, testing, and operational excellence appropriate for a healthcare payer-grade SaaS platform.
* Ensure engineering practices meet HIPAA/HITECH requirements and support the company's HITRUST r2 and SOC 2 compliance obligations; work with security and compliance teams on control implementation and audit readiness.
* Partner with the CTO and global engineering leaders on technical architecture decisions, particularly around integrating mixed cloud and on-premise infrastructure across entities.

machinify.com

* Serve as the senior Machinify leader on the ground in India: represent engineering in cross-functional planning, manage stakeholder relationships, and act as an escalation point for the India team.
* Manage engineering budget, vendor relationships, and resourcing for the India site.
* Champion engineering culture, retention, and talent development in a competitive India tech talent market.

Requirements

* 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering organizations of 50+ people.
* Proven experience building and scaling engineering teams in India, ideally within a global, multi-site organization.
* Experience operating in a regulated industry (healthcare, fintech, insurance, or similar) with exposure to compliance frameworks such as HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, or equivalent.
* Track record of leading technology integration following M&A, or unifying engineering practices across previously separate teams or codebases.
* Strong technical background across modern SaaS architecture, cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP), and data-intensive systems; able to engage credibly in architecture and design discussions.
* Experience managing distributed/cross-time-zone engineering organizations and collaborating with US-based executive leadership.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and people-leadership skills.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

* Prior experience in healthcare payment integrity, claims processing, or health insurance technology.
* Experience with the specific technology stack used by Machinify's platforms (details shared during interview process).

What Machinify Offers

* The opportunity to lead engineering for a fast-growing, market-leading healthcare payment integrity company at a pivotal moment of technical consolidation.
* Direct partnership with the CTO and executive leadership on company-defining technology decisions.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.

jobs.title: Customer Data engineer
jobs.description:
**About the role**  
  
This role is a strong fit for data engineers with 2 to 4 years of experience who want to take their technical depth into a customer-facing role. If you have spent the last few years building pipelines, working with cloud warehouses, and solving real data problems, but you are starting to wonder what comes next, this is worth a closer look.  
  
In this role, you will work directly with Heads of Data, Data Engineering Managers, and CTOs at companies evaluating Hevo across the US, Europe, Southeast Asia, and ANZ. You will help them design the right data architecture, walk them through trade-offs, and earn the technical trust that turns an evaluation into a partnership. You will do this independently, often as the sole technical person on the call. There is no senior SE in the background. You need to walk into a Zoom with a VP of Data Engineering at a US fintech or a Head of Analytics at a European e-commerce company, earn their technical respect in the first five minutes, and hold it for the rest of the engagement.  
  
The technical depth you have built does not go away. It gets applied to a much wider set of problems, a much larger audience, and a global stage.  
  
Hevo runs real-time data pipelines from 150+ sources into modern warehouses for over 1,000 companies, including DoorDash and Shopify. You will be the person customers rely on to make sure Hevo fits their stack, their scale, and their goals.  
  
**Why this role is worth considering**  
  
A. You move from building pipelines to shaping data strategy  
  
In your current role, you build what is specified. In this role, you sit with senior data leaders and help them decide what to build across the modern data stack. Your existing experience in CDC, warehouse design, and pipeline reliability becomes the foundation for higher-leverage work.  
  
B. You get global exposure that is hard to find elsewhere  
  
You will be in regular technical conversations with Heads of Data and CTOs at fast-growing companies across North America, Europe, and beyond. You will run discovery, defend architecture choices, and present in rooms where decisions get made. This is rare exposure for someone at the 2 to 4 year mark, and almost unheard of from Bangalore.  
  
C. Your technical depth stays central  
  
This is not a pivot away from engineering. Everything you know about Postgres, CDC, Kafka, dbt, Snowflake, and pipeline reliability gets used every day. The difference is that your technical opinion shapes the customer’s architecture instead of staying inside a Jira ticket.  
  
D. The career path is real  
  
Strong performers in this role grow into senior individual contributor roles, lead the function, or move into product, customer success leadership, or founding-engineer roles at their next company. The optionality this role builds is significant.  
  
**What you will do**  
  
Run technical discovery calls with Heads of Data, Data Engineering Managers, and CTOs to understand their stack, pain points, and constraints. These are global conversations, primarily with customers in North America and Europe, and you will own them end to end.  
Design and present reference architectures showing how Hevo fits into their existing data stack (e.g., Salesforce, Postgres, GA4, Snowflake, dbt).  
Run live product demos tailored to the customer’s stack. These are not scripted walkthroughs. You will need to read the room, adapt on the fly, and handle unexpected technical questions with confidence.  
Own the technical evaluation from first conversation to closed deal by addressing deep technical questions and earning trust with engineering teams.  
Build proofs-of-concept by configuring real pipelines from source systems (Salesforce, Outreach, Postgres, MySQL) into destinations like Snowflake or BigQuery.  
Develop deep expertise in the data integration landscape, including native solutions from AWS, GCP, and Azure (AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, Google Cloud Dataflow) as well as other data pipeline and integration platforms, and articulate Hevo’s technical advantages in a way that lands with both technical and non-technical buyers.  
Partner with Account Executives to drive technical wins, and with Customer Success to ensure smooth handoffs after a deal closes.  
Share customer feedback and patterns with Product and Engineering to influence the roadmap.  
  
**What we are looking for**  
  
**Must-haves**  
  
2 to 4 years of hands-on experience as a data engineer, analytics engineer, ETL/ELT developer, or data warehouse engineer.  
Experience building and operating real data pipelines in production, including handling source schema changes, failures, and reliability issues.  
Strong fundamentals in SQL and at least one cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift).  
Experience with at least one orchestration or transformation tool (Airflow, dbt, or similar).  
Exceptional communication and presentation skills. This is non-negotiable. You will be the face of Hevo’s technical capability to a global customer base. That means:  
Your spoken English is clear, confident, and easy to follow for an international audience. You are comfortable presenting to groups of 5 to 15 people, including senior technical leaders, over video calls. You can structure a technical narrative, not just answer questions but guide a conversation toward the right conclusion. You can hold your own when a customer pushes back or challenges your recommendation. You have presented or demo’d something technical to an audience before, in any context: internal reviews, client calls, meetups, or conferences.  
Genuine interest in customer-facing work, even if you have not done it formally before.  
  
**Good to have**  
  
Experience with CDC tools or data integration platforms, whether cloud-native (AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, Google Cloud Dataflow) or third-party pipeline and integration tools.  
Exposure to multiple source system types such as CRMs, ad platforms, SaaS APIs, and OLTP databases.  
Public technical writing, conference talks, or open-source contributions.  
Prior experience in customer conversations, even informally. For example, presenting to internal stakeholders, analytics teams, or working with international teams across time zones.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Head of Marketing & Content
jobs.description:
ABOUT HYPEFLY

Hypefly India is an authenticated premium marketplace for sneakers, streetwear, wearables, beauty, collectibles and luxury bags.

THE ROLE

You own marketing at Hypefly: organic and paid, every channel, every campaign, every shoot. You work directly with the founder, who is available to you 24/7. You build your own team, and you set the brand's language for everyone else to follow.

Drops happen at all hours. A product lands, the internet notices, and we need a reel out before the competition wakes up. This role is for someone who can conceptualise, script, shoot and ship content on immediate notice, then plan a festive season three months out the same afternoon.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Content and social:

- Instagram and all social channels: organic content, reels, statics, stories, campaigns

- Short-form and long-form content, from ideation to final edit, including YouTube Shorts and long-form YouTube content

- Run and direct shoots; direct, approve and oversee every edit

- Creator and UGC pipeline: brief, source, negotiate, approve

- Monthly content and campaign calendar: festive, drops, sales, always-on

Campaigns and sales:

- Plan and execute every sale, deal and campaign end to end

- Website campaigns, banners, landing pages and site copy

- Email marketing: campaigns, flows, revenue attribution

- Store marketing: help launch the first Hypefly store and everything after

Paid:

- Ads are run by our agency. You lead the calls, set the direction, and own the results

- Conceptualise, script and produce every ad creative, from ideation to execution

- Own the numbers: ROAS, CAC, campaign revenue, email revenue, reach and growth, reported weekly

- Own the content and shoot budget

Brand and team:

- Brand language and brand study: the playbook captions, emails, DMs and site copy are written from

- Public voice: how the brand sounds in comments, reviews and on Reddit, alongside CX

- Manage the Marketing Executive (your junior, hired alongside you) and the video team; hire the next two as the function grows

- Bring new, fresh ideas constantly; this is a hype business

WHAT WE NEED

- 5-8 years in marketing, ideally including 3-4 years in e-commerce or D2C. This range is preferred, not a hard cutoff. Strong candidates with fewer years and standout work should apply

- Brand-side D2C background preferred. Creator-led or agency-side backgrounds also qualify if the work speaks for itself

- Fashion, lifestyle, sneakers, streetwear or beauty category experience. FMCG or fintech marketers will not be a fit

- Proven work. You'll be asked to show: campaigns that went viral; a sale or campaign that moved revenue, with the before and after; shoots and video edits you directed end to end, not just briefed; creative you built with a performance agency that lowered CAC; email marketing with revenue attribution; something you launched, whether a product, a store or a category

- Deep interest in sneakers, streetwear, beauty and wearables: sizing, drops, hype cycles, product names. Content that gets a product wrong gets torn apart in the comments

- Quick on your feet. Comfortable with zero planning time and same-day turnarounds

- Uses AI daily: ideation, scripts, captions, ad variations, research

- Comfortable on camera or directing the founder on camera; a lot of what works for Hypefly is founder-led

jobs.title: Founding Product Manager Voice AI - Karta AI
jobs.description:
**Founding Product Manager – Voice AI**

**Department:** Product

**Reports to:** Founders

**Location:** HSR Layout, Bengaluru

**Stage:** Seed

**Role Type:** Founding Team / Individual Contributor

**Scope:** Voice AI, Conversational Intelligence, Product Strategy, Agent Performance, Customer Outcomes

  

**About Karta**

Karta is building the AI operating system for customer-facing teams. We build AI agents that handle complex customer conversations across voice, chat and WhatsApp. Our agents don't just respond to questions—they understand context, reason through workflows and take action across business systems. We're building for high-volume, complex industries like fintech, where conversations require contextual understanding, objection handling, multilingual communication and reliable execution. Our ambition is to make AI conversations indistinguishable from great human interactions—not just in how they sound, but in how intelligently they work. We need a product leader who can turn this ambition into reality.

**Why This Role Exists**

Voice AI is moving beyond speech recognition and text-to-speech. The real challenge is building agents that can listen, understand, respond, interrupt, reason and act in real time. A great voice agent must know when to speak, when to listen, how to handle objections, when to retrieve context and how to recover when a conversation goes wrong. Your job is to own this experience end-to-end. You will work directly with customers, engineers and AI researchers to identify the biggest problems, design solutions and ship improvements that materially change agent performance.
  
You won't just build voice features. You'll build agents that perform better in real conversations.

**What You Own**

**1. Voice Experience**

Build natural, low-latency, human-like voice interactions.

Latency and response-time optimisation

Interruption handling and turn-taking

Natural pauses, speech rhythm and conversational flow

Full-duplex voice experiences

Multilingual conversations across Indian languages

Emotion-aware responses and contextual acknowledgement

**2. Conversational Intelligence**

Make agents better at handling complex conversations.

Intent and context understanding

Objection handling and root-problem identification

Memory across turns and sessions

Contextual personalisation

Conversation recovery when agents misunderstand

Natural transitions between listening, reasoning and responding

The goal is to move beyond agents that sound human to agents that think and respond appropriately in human conversations.

**3. Agent Evaluation & Observability**

Build the system that tells us whether our agents are actually good.

Voice-specific evaluation frameworks

Automated conversation simulations

Golden evaluation datasets

Failure categorisation and root-cause analysis

Real-time monitoring and agent observability

Metrics across latency, resolution, CSAT and conversation quality

You will turn production failures into systematic product improvements.

**4. Product Discovery & Customer Outcomes**

Work with customers and business leaders to understand where voice AI creates measurable value.

Identify high-value use cases

Shadow real customer conversations

Analyse human-agent performance

Translate customer pain into product requirements

Prioritise features based on business impact

Define success metrics and validate outcomes

Start with the problem, not the feature request.

**5. Product Execution**

Own the product lifecycle from idea to production.

Product strategy and roadmap

PRDs and feature specifications

UX and conversational flow design

Engineering and research prioritisation

Release quality and adoption

Feedback loops from customers and production data

You will work closely with engineering, AI/ML and GTM teams to ship quickly without compromising reliability.

**What We're Looking For**

**Voice AI experience:** Hands-on experience with conversational AI, speech systems, voice agents or real-time AI products.

**Technical depth:** Understand ASR, TTS, speech pipelines, latency, LLMs, tool calling and agent architectures.

**Product judgment:** Can distinguish a technically interesting feature from one that materially improves customer outcomes.

**Customer obsession:** Will listen to hundreds of conversations to understand what is actually going wrong.

**Execution intensity:** Can move from an ambiguous problem to a shipped solution quickly.

**High agency:** Comfortable operating without a fully defined roadmap, process or team.

**Data-driven:** Comfortable designing evaluations, analysing failures and prioritising based on evidence.

We care more about what you've built and how you think than the title you held previously.

**What This Role Is Not**

This is not a feature factory PM role.

It is not a role where you simply write PRDs and hand them to engineering.

It is not limited to managing a speech API or improving a voice interface.

You will be expected to understand the technology, listen to actual conversations, investigate failures, make trade-offs and drive solutions into production.

**You own whether the product works—not just whether it ships.**

**What Success Looks Like**

**First 30 days — Understand**

Understand the voice stack, listen to production calls, identify major failure modes and establish a baseline for quality and latency.

**First 60 days — Improve**

Ship improvements to conversational quality, interruption handling, latency or objection resolution, with measurable results.

**First 90 days — Systematise**

Establish a repeatable evaluation and improvement loop that makes every release more reliable and effective.

**Core Metrics**

End-to-end conversational latency

Interruption and turn-taking quality

Task completion and resolution rates

Conversation quality and objection handling

Agent failure rates and recovery

CSAT and customer business outcomes

**Why Take It**

**Ownership:** Shape the core product experience at an early-stage AI company.

**Technical depth:** Work at the intersection of voice, LLMs, real-time systems and agent intelligence.

**Customer impact:** See your work change how thousands of customer conversations are handled.

**Founder exposure:** Work directly with founders and influence product direction, architecture trade-offs and company strategy.

**Career trajectory:** Build toward Head of Product or Product Leadership as Karta scales.

**The Person We're Really Looking For**

Someone who listens to a voice agent call and doesn't stop at saying:

"The voice sounds robotic."

They ask:

Why did the agent interrupt the customer?

Why did it miss the underlying objection?

Why did it repeat the same question?

Why did it respond without retrieving the right context?

What should the agent have done differently?

How do we measure that improvement and prevent the failure from recurring?

Then they work with engineering and AI researchers to fix it, test it and ship the solution.

**Obsessive. Technical. Customer-first.**

**That's the Founding Product Manager at Karta.**

jobs.title: Director of Product Design (B2C)
jobs.description:
Looking for a **Director of Product Design** to lead the design charter for its B2C business. This is not a role about managing design output. It is about shaping how an entire team thinks, and co-owning product decisions alongside Product and Business leaders.

Insurance in India is a hard design problem. Trust is low, financial literacy varies widely, and the market grew up on agent-led distribution. You will turn those constraints into a clear design vision, from a customer's first encounter with Acko to a multi-year relationship.

What You Will Do

**Vision and strategy**

* Define a well-reasoned design vision for how Acko customers experience insurance across the full lifecycle.
* Build and maintain a strong point of view on the Indian insurance market: trust dynamics, purchase psychology, financial literacy and the legacy of agent-led distribution.
* Turn strategy into a prioritised design agenda the team can execute with clarity.

**Raise the standard of thinking**

* Set the bar for how problems are framed before solutions are proposed, with rigour in hypothesis formation, assumption mapping and contextual research.
* Review design work at a strategic level: are we solving the right problem, for the right user, within the right constraints?
* Build a culture where the first idea is the beginning of the process, not the end.

**Coach and lead**

* Work closely with product designers to sharpen how they think, not to manage what they produce.
* Coach designers on problem framing, questioning briefs and building hypotheses before reaching for solutions.
* Create the conditions for great work: strong briefs, structured critique sessions and a design review culture that asks hard questions.

**Drive business outcomes**

* Own design's contribution to key B2C metrics: conversion, activation, retention and claims satisfaction.
* Partner with Product and Data to build a feedback loop between design decisions and business results.
* Make the case for design investment in the language of business impact.

Who You Are

**You must have:**

* 12+ years in product design, including at least 3 years leading a design *function* (not just a project or a team), and at least 2 years in B2C in a recent role.
* Experience operating and solving for scale in a consumer-facing business. Pure 0-to-1 experience will not be a fit.
* A background in a scaled B2C business, preferably a pure digital product. FinTech, InsurTech and Healthtech are strongly preferred over Mobility or E-commerce.
* Strong first-principles thinking: you start from the user, the market context and the constraints to form a hypothesis, not from a competitor audit.
* Deep consumer psychology and creative problem-solving, with real curiosity about how people relate to complex, low-familiarity products (trust gaps, financial literacy, decision-making).
* The ability to form a clear, defensible strategic point of view and persuade product, business and leadership stakeholders.
* A track record of leading design through how you shape your team's thinking (coaching through problem framing and questions), not through personal output. Strong ICs with demonstrated leadership are also considered.
* Ownership of design's contribution to business outcomes (conversion, activation, retention, claims or equivalent), and experience making the case for design in business terms.
* A current title such as Director of Design or Head of Design, or you are a founder with a strong design background.
* A strong portfolio showing original thinking and a distinctive point of view, not just polished execution. Talks, writing or case studies are a plus.

Pay: ₹5,100,000.00 - ₹8,500,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Do you currently hold a title such as Director of Design, Head of Design, VP Design, or are you a founder with a strong design background?
* How many years have you led a design function (owning the design charter, hiring, team direction and standards), not just a project or a single team?
* Have you worked in a B2C / consumer-facing product for at least 2 years in a recent role?
* How many total years of product design experience do you have?

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Product Design to lead the design charter for its B2C: 10 years (Required)

jobs.description:
### **A****BOUT TIDE**

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

**Tide facts:**

* Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* 3,000 Tideans globally
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

### **ABOUT THE TEAM:**

Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Commercial Services. You will report to the CDTO and partner with Product and Design leadership as one leadership team accountable for the outcomes of the domain.

Commercial Services is where Tide extends from helping members run their business to helping them grow it. Sell gives every member a live, discoverable presence, from the Tide Business Pages we are launching for 2 million members across the UK and Europe, to Own Website, catalogue, bookings, CRM and lead capture, and embedded fulfilment through Delivery as a Service.

Buy turns that member base into a two-sided marketplace through the Tide Online Network, alongside Tide Promotions (gift cards, cashback and personalised offers), business supplies from partners, and Vendor Hub for e-procurement.

You will be the single owner accountable for engineering delivery, architecture and people across both.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**

This role sits at the intersection of SME commerce, marketplaces and banking. Our members sit on both sides of the marketplace, our partners extend what we can offer them, and our banking platform lets us layer payments, credit, insurance and rewards into the experience at the point of need, which few commerce players can do. We need someone who can bring both streams onto one consistent engineering bar, ship quickly and build the platforms that turn Commercial Services into a material recurring revenue line for Tide.

* Domain experience in e-commerce, two-sided marketplaces, CRM or procurement platforms, including the trust and safety controls they need, with fintech or SME banking experience a plus.
* Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable product and commercial outcomes.
* Experience building partner and third-party integration platforms at scale.
* Strong product and design partnership instincts.
* Comfortable setting direction through ambiguity and launching new products into multiple markets.
* Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, architecture and technical quality.
* Experience bringing AI or agentic experiences into customer-facing commerce products would be a bonus.

* Mobile/Web: Flutter / Angular

* Observability: Coralogix (OpenTelemetry
* Claude for agentic ways of working

* Competitive Compensation - Competitive salary and share options.
* Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

**Role**: Business Development Executive (AI Services)

**Location**: Jaipur

**Type**: Full-time

**Experience**: 3 to 6 Years

**Reports To**: CEO / Management

**About**

Concretio 75-person AI and Salesforce consultancy based in Jaipur. Alongside our Salesforce practice, we build custom AI agents, LLM-powered systems, and intelligent automation for mid-market and enterprise clients across India and the US. This role sits inside our pure AI services practice, which operates independently of the Salesforce stack.

**The Role**

You hunt for companies that are ready to build AI but haven't found the right partner yet. Your prospects are CTOs sitting on a backlog of AI ideas they can't execute internally, COOs running manual processes that should have been automated two years ago, and product leaders who want to ship AI-powered features without hiring a full ML team.

The entry point for almost every deal is a proof of concept: a focused, time-boxed build that proves value before a large commitment. Your job is to find the right company, frame the right problem, and get them into that PoC conversation, and everything follows from there.

**What You Will Do**

* Build a tiered target account list monthly. Tier 1: companies actively posting AI Engineer, ML Engineer, or Head of AI roles. They have a budget and intent. Tier 2: companies that have publicly announced AI initiatives but haven't shipped. Tier 3: ICP-fit companies with no visible AI signal yet.
* Run personalized outbound to CTOs, CDOs, VP Operations, and Heads of Product. Each message references a specific company signal: a job posting, a press release, a product update, or an industry pain point. No spray and pray.
* Run discovery calls independently. Surface the manual process or business problem, quantify the cost or volume, and propose a PoC scope. Pass a clean brief to the AI engineering lead, not a vague requirement.
* Work with the AI engineering lead to scope and price PoC proposals ($15K to $75K range). You co-own the proposal. You do not throw requirements over the wall.
* Attend AI-focused events as a prospecting channel: NASSCOM AI summits, PyCon India, industry-specific tech conferences, and relevant LinkedIn Live events.
* Own all inbound from digital platforms (Clutch, GoodFirms etc) for AI-tagged inquiries. Respond within 4 hours and qualify before escalating.
* Track every account and deal in HubSpot. Weekly pipeline report every Friday without prompting.

**You Are a Fit If You Have**

* 3 to 6 years selling custom tech services: software development, data engineering, AI/ML services, or automation consulting. Not SaaS. Not platforms. Services. ●Run discovery with CTO, CDO, VP Operations, or Head of Product, and translate a business problem into a technology solution scope without an engineer in the room.
* Pitched a proof of concept or pilot engagement as an entry point and closed it. You understand why buyers need a small win before a big commitment.
* Can explain in plain English: what an LLM does, what an AI agent automates, what RAG enables. You don't need to code, but you need to be credible in a room with engineers.
* Generated net-new pipeline through outbound prospecting. Not just followed up on warm inbound.
* Comfortable working in a flexible schedule environment, including late-night or off-hours calls / meetings, in line with the demands of a global client-facing role.
* While the primary focus is AI services, the ideal candidate is adaptable and willing to take on business development responsibilities across other IT services / products lines as opportunities and business demands grow.

**Bravura’s Commitment and Mission**

  
  

At Bravura Solutions, collaboration, diversity and excellence matter. We value your ideas, giving you room to be curious and innovate in an exciting, fast-paced, and flexible environment. The role helps drive consistency, quality and governance across enterprise application and data change initiatives.

**Enterprise Applications Analysis**

* Assess upstream and downstream impacts across applications, business processes, roles, controls, reporting and user adoption.

* Ensure solutions align with security and data governance standards, architecture principles and Bravura’s strategic enterprise technology direction.
  

  

**Enterprise Data Analysis**

* Drive impact assessment for changes involving data warehouse, reporting platforms, systems and integrations.
* Support adherence to security and compliance standards.
  

  

**Delivery, Documentation & Quality**

  
  

* Lead the establishment, standardisation and continuous improvement of business analysis practices across the enterprise applications and data portfolio. Draw on lessons learned across initiatives, develop and maintain reusable frameworks, templates, methodologies and quality standards that improve delivery outcomes
* Work closely with Product Owners, Project Managers, Application Specialists, Data Engineers, Developers, QA and vendors to refine scope and support delivery planning.
* Maintain high-quality documentation including requirements, process flows, data flows, enterprise architecture decision records, test inputs, release notes and knowledge articles where required.
* Define acceptance criteria and support functional, integration, regression and user acceptance testing activities.
* Validate delivered functionality against agreed requirements and support release readiness decisions.
* Support root cause analysis for application defects, incidents and operational issues, contributing to continuous improvement, where needed.
  

  

**Stakeholder Collaboration & Governance**

  
  

* Facilitate workshops, discovery sessions and decision forums with stakeholders from across IT, security and the wider business.
* Communicate requirements, risks, dependencies and impacts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Act as a trusted analysis partner to Enterprise Applications leadership and business stakeholders.
* Support governance forums with clear analysis, impact assessments and recommendations.
  

  

Drive consistent business analysis standards, templates and working practices across the Enterprise Applications function.

  
  

**Unleash your potential**

  
  

To be successful in this role, your background and experience will include:

  
  

* Significant experience as a Business Analyst in a back-office technology function.
* Proven experience working with enterprise applications and data, integrations and cross-functional delivery teams.
* Strong requirements elicitation, process mapping, stakeholder analysis, data analysis and documentation skills.
* Experience working with enterprise applications such as HR, Finance, Planning, CRM, Service Management, Collaboration, Reporting, Data Warehouse or Integration platforms.
* Working understanding of data architecture concepts including data flows, data lineage, master data, integration patterns, reporting layers and data quality.
* Strong capability in writing user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, impact assessments and decision papers.
* Familiarity with project and product (agile) delivery methodologies.
* Comfortable working in a global and hybrid setting and within a matrix organisation.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex business, data and technology topics into clear, actionable analysis.
* Strong analytical mindset, attention to detail and ability to balance immediate delivery needs with the wider enterprise picture.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, challenge assumptions constructively and work independently in a dynamic environment.
* Experience with platforms such as Workday HCM and Finance, Microsoft 365, ServiceNow, EPM, TM1, Snowflake, MS Power BI or comparable enterprise platforms is desirable.
* Understanding of SQL, relational databases, reporting tools or cloud data platforms is desirable.
* Business Analysis certification such as BCS, IIBA (CBAP/CCBA) or equivalent and Six-Sigma are highly desirable.
  

  

**Working at Bravura**

  
  

Our people are the heart of our business. We work hard to provide a rich employee experience and a robust framework for ongoing career development.

  
  

* Competitive salary and employee benefits scheme.
* Flexible working hours, we value work-life balance.
* Maternity/ Parental (including secondary) leave policy.
* A cab facility is available in Delhi/NCR.
* Meal facility available
* Free Medical Insurance
  

  

**So, what’s next?**

  
  

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion so even if you don’t match every listed skill or tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you.

  
  

Please note that interviews are primarily conducted virtually and if you require any reasonable adjustments or would like to note which pronouns you use, please let us know.
