jobs.title: Head of AI
jobs.description:
**About the Client**

ValCera is running this search for a client in Digital Assets, an early-stage company with teams in the UAE. The client builds infrastructure and financial products for institutions on its own network. AI now runs across several of its lines of business, from verifiable compute to investment. This role brings all of it under one owner.

**The Role**

**One owner for AI**

The Head of AI sets the AI strategy and decides what moves first. That covers compute, investment, new AI products and internal tools.

The role needs range. It takes the technical depth to judge how AI workloads run and get verified on-chain, and the commercial judgment to defend an investment thesis to institutional investors. It also takes someone who can explain the company's AI position to builders, investors and clients in terms each can act on.

**What is actually unsolved**

Today the core network is live, and the zero-knowledge layer runs on testnet. Proving a model's output in zero knowledge still costs far more than running it. So the first call is which AI workloads to prove, and which need a cheaper route. On the investment side, the thesis is still to be built and defended. Nobody has a playbook for doing both inside one company yet.

**Responsibilities**

• Set the AI strategy and decide its sequence across compute, investment, products and internal tooling.

• Scope which AI workloads the zero-knowledge layer verifies, including inference and agents acting on-chain.

• Build the AI and deep tech investment thesis and shape the deals that follow from it.

• Own the roadmap for a new AI product built on the network.

• Make the case for the company's AI work to developers, institutional investors and enterprise buyers, in writing and on stage.

• Advise the leadership team on which AI tools each function should adopt.

**Requirements**

• Has built ML systems hands-on, then owned AI product or strategy decisions in a company.

• Has worked hands-on with verifiable compute or AI agent systems, enough to judge an architecture, not describe one.

• Has written for engineers and for institutional investors, and can show work for both.

**Nice to Have**

• Has backed or advised AI or deep tech companies, as an angel, a fund or an operator.

• Has presented an investment thesis to limited partners or an investment committee.

• Has spoken at AI or deep tech conferences.

**Culture**

The team works across time zones and meets in person regularly. The core protocol is open source, and the founder is an engineer. The trade-off is breadth. The company is building several products at once and staffing most functions in parallel. Much of what this role touches is pre-launch, so the early work is deciding what launches first.

jobs.title: Global Head of Financial Cloud Product
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 90 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

About the Role

We are looking for a senior product leader to lead our Internal Platform Product organization and build the systems that enable our financial and digital-asset businesses to operate efficiently, reliably, and at scale.

You will own the product strategy, architecture, roadmap, and team development for internal platform products spanning payments and assets, user and security systems, CRM, customer engagement, and multi-jurisdiction compliance infrastructure. Your mandate is to turn fragmented business requirements into coherent, reusable capabilities and move the organization from requirement-taking and feature delivery to end-to-end ownership of business outcomes.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a senior product leader who combines technical product judgment, financial-services knowledge, and commercialization experience to turn existing financial and digital-asset technology capabilities into enterprise products for external customers.

Financial Cloud aims to provide digital-asset and Web3 technology infrastructure to traditional financial institutions and other enterprise customers. Starting with customer needs, you will determine which capabilities, including trading technology, wallets, and custody-related technology, should be productized first. You will establish a focused product proposition, a viable commercial model, and a repeatable delivery approach, progressing from customer validation toward sustainable growth.

**What You Will Own**

* **Target customers and initial use cases.**
  Conduct customer discovery and market validation to identify priority customer segments, critical problems, buying motivations, and decision-makers. Select a focused initial product and use case rather than commercializing every available capability at once.
* **Financial Cloud product strategy.**
  Turn underlying technology into products that customers can evaluate, purchase, integrate, and use over time. Define the product portfolio, module catalog, value proposition, functional boundaries, API contracts, and roadmap.
* **Enterprise productization.**
  Partner with technical teams to define tenant and data isolation, access controls, configuration, auditability, APIs and SDKs, customer-facing management interfaces, monitoring, and operational requirements. Choose appropriate hosted, private, or other deployment models based on validated customer needs.
* **Commercial models.**
  Work with sales, finance, and relevant teams on product packaging, pricing, and billing. Validate willingness to pay, implementation economics, and ongoing service costs. Support presales, pilots, and the definition of product scope and commitments in customer contracts.
* **First-customer adoption.**
  Partner with sales, solution, and delivery teams to move customers through proof of concept, pilot, acceptance, and production use. Define clear success criteria and turn customer learning into product improvements without allowing customization to expand without limits.
* **Repeatable delivery.**
  Establish the boundary between standard products and customization. Improve documentation, onboarding, implementation standards, version compatibility, and lifecycle management to reduce per-customer delivery effort and improve the customer experience.
* **Technology-provider boundaries.**
  Work with legal, compliance, security, and architecture teams to clarify service scope, data and access responsibilities, key-control responsibilities, customer regulatory obligations, and service commitments. Ensure product design and commercial representations remain consistent with approved activities.
* **Team and investment priorities.**
  Build a product team suited to the zero-to-one stage and lead cross-functional execution. Align with the Internal Platform product leader on capability reuse, engineering dependencies, and priorities, avoiding customer-specific duplication of core systems.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Senior enterprise product experience, with end-to-end ownership of product definition, delivery, and commercialization from zero to one. You can explain how you selected customers, established product boundaries, and validated paid demand.
* Experience building platform or technical products such as financial infrastructure, developer platforms, API products, enterprise SaaS, financial cloud, payment infrastructure, or digital-asset infrastructure.
* A track record commercializing products for external enterprise customers, with an understanding of procurement, security reviews, pilots, contracts, deployment, acceptance, and ongoing service requirements.
* The ability to translate complex technology into customer value and engage deeply with engineering on architecture boundaries, APIs, data isolation, deployment models, and non-functional requirements.
* Strong judgment in pricing, packaging, implementation economics, and standardization, including explicit trade-offs between customer customization and the long-term product roadmap.
* An understanding of regulatory constraints in financial services and digital assets. You can identify matters requiring legal or compliance review and translate confirmed boundaries into product and delivery requirements.
* Cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to make progress with a lean team while the product proposition and market are still being validated.
* Professional working proficiency in English for product discussions with international customers and partners. Mandarin language skill is a big plus.

**Strongly Preferred**

* Experience turning internal technology capabilities into standardized external products with paying customers.
* Experience serving banks, brokerages, payment institutions, asset managers, or other regulated financial institutions.
* Experience with trading technology, wallets, MPC, custody-related technology, digital-asset infrastructure, or asset tokenization.
* Experience with multi-tenant products, private or hybrid deployments, international delivery, or channel and ecosystem partnerships.
* A track record turning pilots or custom implementations into repeatable products and delivery models, demonstrated through adoption, revenue, or cost improvements.

**Leadership Profile**

You understand technology and actively engage with customers to test demand. You can select the most valuable initial product from a broad set of capabilities, make evidence-based decisions, and decline customization that undermines the product direction. You distinguish validated customer needs from assumptions and explain both clearly.

**What Success Looks Like**

* A validated target customer segment, priority use case, and value proposition translate into concrete purchasing or paid-use behavior.
* Initial customers integrate and use

jobs.title: Chief Product Officer
jobs.description:
**About The Role**
**About US:**
Soar is a Saudi fintech startup that specializes in financing and investment. Currently headquartered in Saudi Arabia, Soar is growing throughout the region with a mission to help people achieve their financial goals with innovative financial and property investment solutions and tools through its multi-purpose platform, designed to offer a simple and seamless user experience.
  
**The Mission:**
Real estate is one of the largest, slowest-to-change markets on earth — trillions of dollars in transactions still run on fragmented data, manual workflows, and software that automates paperwork instead of doing the work. We believe that era is over. At Soar, we are building an agentic-first platform: products where AI agents don’t just assist people, they do the work — sourcing, analyzing, negotiating, coordinating, and closing — with humans setting direction and judgment. We are looking for a Chief Product Officer to define what that product is, build it from zero, and use it to fundamentally reinvent how real estate works. This is not a role for someone who wants to optimize an existing roadmap. It is for a builder who wants to create a category. What “agentic-first” means here
  
Most companies are bolting a chatbot onto legacy software. We are doing the opposite: designing the product around autonomous and semi-autonomous agents as the primary way work gets done, with interfaces, data, and trust models built to match. As CPO, you will own this thesis end to end.
  
**What “agentic-first” means here:**

* Most companies are bolting a chatbot onto legacy software. We are doing the opposite: designing the product around autonomous and semi-autonomous agents as the primary way.
* work gets done, with interfaces, data, and trust models built to match. As CPO, you will own this thesis end to end.
* Agents as the core unit of the product, rather than features that wrap a model around old workflows.
* Outcomes over interfaces — the product should accomplish outcomes, not just surface information.
* Trust, transparency, and human-in-the-loop by design — designing for the moments
* where the agent acts on the user’s behalf, and where the human stays in control.
* Data and feedback as a moat — a learning loop where every transaction makes the next one smarter.

**Requirements**
**What you’ll do:**

* Set the vision. Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for an agentic-first real estate platform — and the conviction behind it.
* Build 0 to 1, then 1 to n. Take products from blank page to launch to scale. Define the first wedge, ship fast, learn faster, and expand.
* Hire and lead the team. Recruit, lead, and grow a world-class product, design, and product-engineering culture from the ground up.
* Push the technology. Work hands-on with frontier models, agent frameworks, and emerging tooling. Run experiments others consider too early or too risky.
* Take real risks. Make bold, calculated bets with incomplete information — and own the outcomes, good or bad.
* Be a force across the company. Partner with engineering, design, GTM, and leadership to align the company behind a coherent product strategy.
* Stay obsessed with users. Talk to agents, brokers, buyers, sellers, and investors
* constantly. Translate the messy reality of real estate into products people love.

**Who you are:**

* A proven builder. You have built and shipped products that real people used, ideally including 0-to-1 work where you defined the problem, not just the solution.
* Creative and unconventional. You think from first principles, question defaults, and are energized by problems with no established playbook.
* Fluent in cutting-edge AI. You’ve worked with LLMs, agents, or applied AI in production— or you’ve gone deep enough to lead a team that does.
* Comfortable with calculated risk. You take bold action, decide with conviction under uncertainty, and treat smart failures as the cost of moving fast.
* Strategic and hands-on. You can set strategy and dive into the details — prototypes, specs, prompts, data, and metrics.
* A magnet for talent. You inspire great people to do the best work of their careers, and you raise the bar on everyone around you.
* High velocity. You move with urgency, communicate with clarity, and care more about impact than process.

**Bonus points:**

* Experience fintech, marketplaces, Agentic Applications, and AI Research and R&D space.
* Founder or early-stage operator experience.
* A technical background or the ability to go toe-to-toe with engineers on agent architecture.

jobs.title: Legal Counsel – Corporate, Commercial & Regulatory | AED 20,000/month
jobs.description:
**Legal Counsel – Corporate, Commercial & Regulatory**

Dubai, UAE | Full-time, office-based | AED 20,000 per month, all-inclusive | Start: as soon as possible

**About Dreevo**

Dreevo is building a new kind of service marketplace in the UAE: one place where customers can discover, book and trust the services they need. We are live in Dubai with 8 service categories, 75 services and more than 300 SKUs, giving customers access to over AED 12 million worth of services through our provider network and our own mobile EV operation. We partner with vehicle manufacturers and are expanding across the UAE and into other verticals.

We are still an early-stage company. Product, technology, operations, partnerships, brand and commercial models are being built in parallel, which gives Legal a direct hand in how the business is structured and scaled.

**The Role**

We are looking for a Legal Counsel – Corporate, Commercial & Regulatory to become Dreevo's first dedicated in-house legal hire.

Reporting directly to the CEO and working closely with the Founder/Director and leadership team, you will take practical ownership of Dreevo's day-to-day corporate, commercial and regulatory legal matters.

This is a hands-on role for a commercially minded lawyer who is comfortable in a fast-moving environment. You will need to understand what the business is trying to achieve, identify the genuine legal and regulatory risks, recommend practical solutions, draft and negotiate agreements yourself, and decide when specialist external counsel is needed.

**Your First 90 Days**

- Redraft our service provider terms, customer terms and privacy policy, starting with how our marketplace contracting model should work.

- Finalise NDA and confidentiality documentation for upcoming partnerships.

- Put intercompany agreements in place across the Dreevo group.

- Support licensing and permits as we expand into new emirates.

- Register and protect the Dreevo brand and trademarks.

- Set up contract templates, a contract register and signing authorities.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Commercial contracts***

- Draft, review and negotiate commercial agreements, including NDAs, MoUs, heads of terms, service, supplier, procurement, technology, SaaS, API and development agreements.

- Support partnerships with vehicle manufacturers and energy, technology and institutional partners.

- Advise the CEO, Founder/Director and leadership team on new services, partnerships and operating models.

***Marketplace, consumer and data***

- Build the legal framework for service providers on the marketplace, covering onboarding, service levels, payments, insurance, liability, suspension and termination.

- Draft and maintain customer terms, refund and cancellation policies, privacy notices and marketplace disclosures in line with UAE consumer protection and e-commerce rules.

- Lead UAE PDPL compliance, including data processing agreements, data retention and cross-border data.

- Protect Dreevo's intellectual property, including source code, designs, data, AI workflows and brand assets, and review open source and AI licensing terms with Product and Engineering.

***Regulatory and corporate***

- Manage licensing, permits and activity requirements for the marketplace and new verticals, working with the RTA and other UAE and Dubai authorities.

- Advise on mainland and free zone structures and intercompany arrangements.

- Coordinate entity set-up, constitutional documents, shareholder and director records and UBO filings with corporate service providers.

- Support fundraising, investor due diligence and corporate transactions alongside external counsel.

***Employment and legal operations***

- Advise on UAE employment matters and prepare employment, contractor, consultancy, IP assignment and confidentiality documents.

- Manage disputes, claims and settlement discussions, and instruct and manage external counsel.

- Build Dreevo's legal operating framework: templates, approval processes, signing authorities, contract register and governance records.

**Required Experience**

- Qualified lawyer in a recognised jurisdiction.

- A minimum of 5 years' post-qualification experience.

- Strong UAE/GCC experience, with exposure to corporate, commercial, employment, consumer and regulatory matters.

- A track record of drafting and negotiating commercial and technology agreements through to signature.

- Experience in-house, on secondment or in a commercially focused law firm.

- A strong understanding of technology, data, intellectual property and digital platform contracts.

- The ability to run several workstreams independently and prioritise by commercial and legal risk.

- Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain legal issues clearly and commercially.

**Preferred Experience**

Experience in startups, scale-ups, marketplaces, mobility, automotive, logistics, energy, fintech, e-commerce or on-demand services would be particularly valuable.

Experience with marketplace agreements, SaaS and API licensing, data sharing, strategic partnerships, privacy, intellectual property, AI or open source matters is an advantage.

Arabic is an advantage but not essential.

**Who We're Looking For**

We are looking for someone commercially minded, practical and decisive. You should be comfortable giving clear recommendations rather than simply identifying legal issues, and confident enough to challenge senior leadership when necessary.

This is not a passive contract review role or a traditional company secretarial role. You will help create Dreevo's legal foundations from the beginning.

You will draft, negotiate, organise, build systems and solve problems yourself, while developing repeatable legal processes that can scale with the company.

**What We Offer**

- Salary of AED 20,000 per month, all-inclusive

- UAE employment visa

- Medical insurance

- 24 working days' annual leave

- The chance to build Dreevo's legal function from the ground up

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Director - Visa Direct Business Strategy & Planning
jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Role Summary:

The Visa Direct CEMEA - Business Strategy and Planning - Director is the Business Planning & Strategy lead for Visa Direct in CEMEA, based in Dubai. The role works closely with the head of Strategy and Business Planning for CMS, as well as the VP, Head of Money Movement Solutions CEMEA, as strategic and planning partner on all internal and external initiatives. This role will help drive the strategy and transformation of Money Movement Solutions CEMEA while collaborating with key members of the CEMEA Leadership Team, Global Visa Direct Team, and other stakeholders.

This role encompasses:

Strategy**:**

* Own the end-to-end Visa Direct CEMEA strategy, and translate Visa 2030 priorities into sub-regional and country plans with clear owners and milestones.
* Set product and use-case priorities by market with Regional and Global Visa Direct Commercialization and Product teams; prioritise opportunities through market sizing, whitespace, competitor and market-share analysis.

jobs.title: Head of MarTech & Personalisation
jobs.description:
**Head of MarTech & Personalisation**
=====================================

The **Head of MarTech & Personalisation** makes sure every inDrive user sees the right service, offer and communication at the right moment - and, as a result, uses more of the app’s verticals, more often.

inDrive grew out of ride-hailing and is becoming a super app: rides, delivery, intercity, food, groceries and financial services. Most users still live in a single vertical. The SuperApp platform owns multi-vertical growth and frequency, and personalisation is its main lever; MarTech is the layer that makes personalisation run at scale.

The role sits in SuperApp Platform and reports to the Product Director. The Head defines the strategy for the domain, builds and leads a team, and is accountable for the impact of personalisation on multi-vertical growth.
  
  
It is a role at the intersection of Product, Marketing and Data, with a clear split of ownership:

* **Owns:** the orchestration layer (which user sees what, where and when), personalisation of the main screen and cross-sell placements, the communications platform, the MarTech stack strategy, and the experimentation that proves impact.
* **Influences:** campaign content and promo budgets (Marketing), offer business rules (vertical and loyalty owners), ads inventory rules (Ads), predictive models (Data Science).

Department

SuperApp and Growth Businesses Product

Employment Type

Full Time

Location

United Arab Emirates

Address Abu Dhabi, Emirate of Abu Dhabi

Workplace type

Hybrid

Requisition ID

6911

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Set the strategy:** Define the personalisation and MarTech strategy, from the user segments and intents we act on to which service, offer or message each user gets, where, and through which channel.
* **Build the orchestration layer:** Create one system that decides who sees what, where and when, with frequency caps to avoid overload. Offer and ads owners set their own rules. You own how those rules are combined and delivered.
* **Personalise the main screen and cross-sell:** Replace one-size-fits-all layouts with ones that adapt to each user, so more users try new verticals and use current ones more often.
* **Shape the MarTech stack:** Map current tools, set build-vs-buy criteria, and consolidate onto one platform, so teams launch communications without manual integrations.
* **Grow the communications platform:** Own triggered and segmented scenarios, channels (push, in-app, email, messengers), opt-outs and delivery quality.
* **Build and lead the team:** Grow a team focused on strong discovery, rigorous experimentation and outcomes over feature launches.

**What success looks like**

* Personalised surfaces and communications drive more multi-vertical users and higher order frequency.
* All offers and messages go through one orchestration layer, with proven lift and controlled communication load.
* Marketing and the verticals launch segmented communications without engineers.

**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
-----------------------------------

* **Product Experience:** 8+ years of product management experience in large-audience consumer products (Marketplace, Super App, E-commerce, FoodTech, or FinTech).
* **Leadership:** 3+ years leading and developing product managers.
* **Platform Products:** Proven track record of building scalable, platform-based product solutions in data-rich environments.
* **MarTech & Personalisation:** Deep expertise in MarTech ecosystems, personalisation, and customer data.
* **Strategy:** Strong ability to define product strategy and roadmap, and to turn business goals into product capabilities.
* **Data & Experimentation:** Data-driven mindset with a solid understanding of analytics, experimentation, and data governance.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Experienced in leading alignment across Marketing, Tech, and Data teams and leadership.
* **Communication:** Business-fluent English proficiency (B2/C1+ or equivalent).

**Why join us**
---------------

* Help us challenge injustice by creating fair choices for millions of people across 47 countries.
* Develop your professional skills with access to mentoring, career consulting, and learning programs.
* Collaborate with teams around the world and gain international experience through our Global Talent Exchange Program.
* Engage in company-wide challenges, awards, sports activities, employee-led social impact and volunteering projects.
* Work alongside people who take initiative, speak openly, and challenge themselves to grow.
* Improve your language skills through co-financed courses and internal speaking clubs.

Final benefits may vary depending on the location.

**About inDrive**
-----------------

inDrive is a global tech company on a mission to challenge injustice through fair choices. We started in 2012 in the coldest city on Earth, when a group of friends created a way for people to agree on fair ride prices. That idea grew into one of the world’s top ride-hailing apps, now with 400M installs across 47 countries.

  
  

Today, we offer more than rides: from freight and delivery to intercity travel and financial services, all designed to put people first. We are committed to having a positive impact on people’s lives both through our core business, which supports local communities via a fair pricing model; and through the work of our impact programs.

Ready to ignite your inner drive?

jobs.title: PR & Communications Manager

* Build and maintain strong relationships with journalists, editors, and key media stakeholders across financial services, business, commercial real estate, and digital assets.

**Location**: Dubai, United Arab Emirates

**Department**: Marketing

**Company Description:**

At STARTRADER, we combine trusted foundations with advanced technology to empower traders worldwide. As a global brand operating across 200+ regions and regulated by leading authorities, we provide secure access to 1,000+ CFDs through platforms such as MT4, MT5, STAR Copy, and the award-winning STARTRADER app.

Our international presence is strengthened through strategic collaborations, including our role as an Official Partner of the NBA, Official Partner of Porsche Carrera Cup Middle East, and Official Partner of the UAE National Cricket Team for the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup.

Since our launch in 2019, our vision has been to make trading more accessible, trusted, and empowering - shaping both our products and our culture as we continue to grow by listening, evolving, and supporting our global community.

*STARTRADER is the brand representing a network of regulated and licensed entities across various jurisdictions, each authorised to provide specific financial services in compliance with local regulations. STARTRADER Global Financial Consultation & Financial Analysis (Dubai-based entity) is licensed and regulated by the Capital Market Authority in the UAE to conduct promotion and client introduction activities only. All trading services are provided by STARTRADER entities regulated in other jurisdictions*

**Role Overview**

The Marketing Manager is responsible for developing and executing the marketing strategy for Startrader across brand, content, social media, email marketing, events and demand generation. The role builds Startrader's market presence among institutional clients and generates qualified pipeline for the sales team. Positioned within the Global Marketing team, the role works closely with group marketing functions to apply shared resources and brand standards, while aligning marketing priorities with Startrader's commercial objectives through a reporting line to the Head of Marketing.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Marketing strategy:**develop and deliver Startrader's annual marketing strategy, aligned with the business's commercial targets and the global marketing plan.

* **Brand and positioning:**define and manage the Startrader brand and value proposition for institutional audiences, ensuring clarity and consistency with global brand standards.

* **Demand generation:**plan and run B2B demand-generation programmes, including account-based marketing, industry events, webinars and partner co-marketing, to build qualified pipeline in partnership with the sales team.

* **Content, social media and PR:**lead Startrader's content and social media presence, thought-leadership and industry media relations, in coordination with the group PR and content functions.

* **Email marketing and client communications:**own prospect nurture, client newsletters and product communications through the global marketing automation platform.

* **Digital presence and sales enablement:**oversee the Startrader website and develop sales materials, proposals and presentations.

* **Coordination with Global Marketing:**work closely with group marketing teams to plan activities in a shared calendar and make effective use of shared design, content, research and AI-enabled capabilities.

* **Performance and reporting:**define marketing KPIs, track pipeline contribution and campaign performance, and report regularly to the Head of Marketing

* **Compliance:**ensure all marketing activity meets applicable regulatory and internal compliance requirements for institutional financial services.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Finance or a related field; a master's degree is an advantage.

**Experience**

* 7+ years of marketing experience, with at least 3 years in FX-CFD , B2B or institutional financial services - such as liquidity provision, prime brokerage, trading technology or fintech.

* Proven experience owning an integrated marketing mix: strategy, brand, content, social media, email marketing and events.

* Track record of B2B demand generation and pipeline contribution.

* Experience working in a matrix organisation or with multiple senior stakeholders.

**Skills and Knowledge**

* Understanding of the FX and CFD institutional market, including liquidity models and trading technology (e.g. FIX connectivity, MT4 / MT5, bridges and aggregators).

* Strong B2B marketing skills: positioning, account-based marketing, LinkedIn marketing, event marketing and marketing automation.

* Data-driven, with the ability to measure and report marketing performance against commercial outcomes.

* Practical use of AI tools in marketing workflows.

* Awareness of marketing compliance in regulated financial services.

* Excellent written and verbal communication in English.

**Competencies**

* Strategic thinking with hands-on execution

* Stakeholder management and influence across reporting lines

* Commercial orientation and accountability for results

* Ability to work independently and prioritise in a fast-paced environment

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Established network within the brokerage and FX technology industry.

* Experience representing a business at major industry events such as IFX EXPO or Finance Magnates.

* Experience with AI software and marketing automation platforms (e.g.Chatgpt, Claude code, Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, Braze).

jobs.title: Financial Crime Operations Executive Manager
jobs.description:
**Organization:**
At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in other people’s financial wellbeing. Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward to progress, make better financial decisions, and achieve their goals. Every day, our people use technology, data, and innovation to create better experiences and outcomes for our customers.
  
  
**Job Title:**
Executive Manager, Financial Crime Operations
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Business & Team:**
Economic Crime Services - Financial Crime Operations
  
  
Financial Crime Operations plays a critical role in protecting our customers, the financial system and society from economic crime. We bring together operational expertise, risk-based decision-making, data, technology and strong partnerships to detect, investigate and respond to financial crime threats.
  
  
**Impact & Contribution:**
As Executive Manager, Financial Crime Operations, you will provide strategic and operational leadership for a significant portfolio supporting CommBank’s Australian operations from India.
  
  
You will be accountable for delivering safe, sustainable and high-quality operational outcomes across one or more financial crime disciplines. These may include Transaction Monitoring, Enhanced Customer Due Diligence, Customer and Payment Screening, fraud-related investigations, remediation, Suspicious Matter Report preparation, specialised risk queues, Quality and Performance, or other enabling capabilities.
  
  
You will lead through a period of significant regulatory, technological and operational change. Working closely with Financial Crime Operations, Financial Crime Compliance, Risk, Quality Assurance, Strategy and Performance, Technology and Transformation teams, you will ensure effective detection, investigation, escalation and mitigation of financial crime risk.
  
  
The role requires an enterprise leader who can balance customer, risk, people and performance outcomes while building a future-ready operation.
  
  
The existing role profile also establishes responsibility for Australian financial crime operations, close collaboration across Operations, Risk, Compliance, Quality and Technology, and leadership of the India-based team.
  
  
**Reporting to:**
General Manager, Financial Crime Operations, CBA India
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**
**Strategic and operational leadership**

* Lead the strategy and execution of a large and complex Financial Crime Operations portfolio.
* Translate enterprise and Economic Crime Services priorities into clear operational plans, measures and accountabilities.
* Deliver agreed service, quality, productivity, customer and risk outcomes.
* Maintain effective oversight of operational capacity, queue health, demand, productivity, ageing, service levels and emerging risks.
* Ensure the operating model remains sustainable, scalable and aligned to changing business and regulatory requirements.
* Provide clear, timely and evidence-based reporting to senior leadership and governance forums.
* Make sound decisions across competing priorities, balancing immediate operational requirements with long-term strategic outcomes.
* Support operational resilience and continuity through effective workforce, succession and contingency planning.
* The current FCO operating model includes Transaction Monitoring, CDD/KYC, screening and focused risk queues, Performance and Enabling capabilities, and Quality Assurance, with a future-state focus on rationalised leadership spans and increased work complexity.

**Financial crime risk and governance**

* Promote strong risk ownership and ensure financial crime risks are identified, assessed, escalated and managed within applicable frameworks.
* Maintain effective oversight of operational controls, incidents, issues, quality results, audit actions and remediation commitments.
* Ensure operations comply with relevant policies, procedures, regulatory obligations and agreed risk appetite.
* Oversee complex investigations and escalations, ensuring decisions are appropriately evidenced, documented and governed.
* Partner with Compliance, Risk and Quality teams to interpret requirements and implement them consistently across operations.
* Champion a proactive risk culture where colleagues feel safe and accountable to identify concerns, challenge decisions and raise emerging risks.
* Ensure changes to processes, controls, detection approaches and operational procedures are assessed and implemented through appropriate governance.
* FCO governance includes oversight of operational risks, queue performance, process changes, detection-rule changes, policy application, issues and incidents, and the prioritisation and implementation of change.

**Transformation, simplification and technology**

* Lead the successful operational implementation of strategic change, including new processes, platforms, analytical models and risk-based detection and investigation approaches.
* Identify opportunities to simplify work, improve controls, remove duplication and increase operational efficiency.
* Use data and insights to improve decision-making, workforce deployment, quality and customer outcomes.
* Champion responsible adoption of automation, artificial intelligence and advanced analytics to improve financial crime detection and operational effectiveness.
* Ensure new technology and process changes are supported by appropriate operational readiness, capability, controls and governance.
* Build a culture of curiosity, experimentation and continuous improvement while maintaining effective risk management.

**Stakeholder engagement**

* Act as a senior FCO representative and trusted partner between the India-based operation and Australian business, operations, risk and compliance teams.
* Build strong, transparent and constructive relationships with senior stakeholders across Economic Crime Services, Financial Crime Compliance, Risk, Quality Assurance, Technology, Transformation, Workforce and Human Resources.
* Surface risks, dependencies and trade-offs early and provide practical recommendations to support decisions.
* Influence outcomes across organisational boundaries without relying solely on formal authority.
* Promote a whole-of-organisation mindset and ensure that local delivery decisions support broader enterprise outcomes.
* Represent the portfolio in senior operational, risk, governance and transformation forums as required.

**People and culture leadership**

* Lead and inspire a large, diverse workforce through a clear sense of purpose and shared accountability.
* Build a strong leadership team with clear responsibilities, effective spans of control and robust succession plans.
* Attract, develop and retain high-quality financial crime and operations talent.
* Coach senior leaders to strengthen strategic thinking, risk ownership, commercial judgement and people leadership.
* Set clear performance expectations and ensure fair, consistent and timely performance and development conversations.
* Build capability through targeted learning, cross-skilling, leadership development and career pathways.
* Foster an inclusive and psychologically safe environment where diverse perspectives are welcomed.
* Role-model the organisation’s values and leadership principles, including care, courage and commitment.
* Strengthen engagement, wellbeing and connection across teams while maintaining accountability for outcomes.

**Success measures**
Success in the role will be demonstrated through:
  
  

* Sustainable achievement of service, quality, productivity and customer outcomes.
* Effective management of operational and financial crime risks.
* Timely identification, escalation and closure of incidents, issues and control gaps.
* Strong audit, assurance and regulatory outcomes.
* Successful implementation and embedding of strategic change.
* Improved process efficiency, simplification and use of technology.
* Strong colleague engagement, capability and lead

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. The Business Management (BM) role provides centralized financial, operational, risk, and governance oversight for Accounting & Fund Services. The role focuses on producing executive-level reporting and dashboards, tracking, and managing financial targets and timely delivery of management information to senior leaders and governance forums. This role combines strategic oversight, financial and operational performance monitoring, business planning, regulatory and risk management, and cross-functional coordination to support the business head and leadership team. The Specialist works closely with business leaders and functions to develop and implement strategy, monitor results, and embed strong governance and controls. Success in this role requires a blend of big-picture strategic thinking and hands-on execution to optimize performance, manage risks, and deliver on business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Financial & Business Oversight**

* Manage workforce planning, including headcount tracking and resource allocation.

* Support development and maintenance of dashboards for decision making.

**Reporting & Dashboards**

**Post, Headcount & Workforce Management**

**Risk, Audit & Regulatory Oversight**

* Monitors risk events, audit findings, and control issues, ensuring timely escalation and remediation.

* Monitor, consolidate, and report on operational risk events, data privacy events, regulatory breaches, audit issues, and remediation programs.
* Create content and reporting for Risk Committee, COO Risk Committee, and other governance forums.
* Track remediation actions, escalate risks, and ensure compliance with enterprise standards and regulatory programs.

**Governance & Controls**

* Coordinate operational reviews and consolidate business reporting.
* Oversee governance deliverables including SLDs, SLAs, service reviews, exceptions, and deferrals.
* Ensure documentation meets enterprise requirements and is refreshed on defined cycles.

**People & Engagement Support**

* Work with HR to produce recruiting metrics, attrition reporting, and workforce analytics.

**Financial Analysis Experience**

* Minimum 2+ years of hands-on experience in financial analysis
* Experience working with management reporting, dashboards, or financial data models
* Ability to review, consolidate, and validate financial data for accuracy and completeness
* Experience identifying trends, variances, and key drivers of business performance

**Key Activities**

* Review data submissions for accuracy and completeness.
* Produce consolidated reporting and executive-ready materials.
* Track trends, risks, exceptions, and performance vs. plan.
* Escalate issues and provide insights to senior leadership.

* Partner closely with Practice Leads, Finance, Operations, Risk, and India BM teams
* Collaborate with Finance, HR, and other functional partners.

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

**Senior Financial Controller**  
Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat | Department: Finance | Reports to: CEO / CFO

**About the Company**

Our client is one of India's fastest-growing workspace and business infrastructure companies, offering Managed Offices, Coworking Spaces, Enterprise Workspace Solutions, Build-to-Suit Offices, Design & Build Services, and Business Infrastructure Solutions.

Founded with the vision of transforming how businesses experience workspaces, the company partners with startups, SMEs, large enterprises, GCCs, and multinational corporations by providing scalable, technology-enabled workplace solutions across India.

Today, it operates across multiple cities with a rapidly expanding footprint and manages millions of square feet of commercial real estate through long-term strategic partnerships. As it scales nationally through organic growth, strategic partnerships, acquisitions, and new business ventures, the company is looking for a strong, hands-on finance leader to own the controllership backbone of the organization while partnering closely with the CFO on strategic finance initiatives.

**Business Ecosystem**

The Senior Financial Controller will drive financial control and reporting discipline across the group's ecosystem, which includes multiple business verticals and associated entities involved in workspace development, operations, technology, and business services. The role operates in a multi-entity, high-growth environment and requires strong governance, process ownership, and financial discipline across:

* Managed Office Solutions
* Coworking Spaces
* Enterprise Workspace Solutions
* Commercial Real Estate
* Design & Build
* Infrastructure Development
* Facility & Workplace Operations
* Technology-enabled Workplace Solutions
* Business Support Services

**Role Purpose**

The Senior Financial Controller will own end-to-end Finance & Accounts, Compliance, Taxation, and MIS Reporting across the organization, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and control at every stage of the financial close and reporting cycle. As a senior member of the Finance leadership team, the role will work closely with the CFO and business heads to translate financial strategy into disciplined execution, and will step in on select strategic finance, treasury, and fundraising-support responsibilities that a growing multi-entity business demands.

This is a controllership-first role with meaningful exposure to strategic finance, ideal for a finance leader who wants to build and run the core finance engine of a fast-scaling company while growing into broader CFO-level responsibilities over time.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Finance & Accounting Operations (Core Ownership)**

* Own end-to-end Finance & Accounts, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Revenue Recognition, Fixed Assets, and Payroll Accounting.
* Lead timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing across all entities.
* Prepare and review Consolidated Financial Statements for the group.
* Own MIS Reporting and ensure accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of management reports.
* Build and maintain scalable accounting processes and standard operating procedures across a multi-entity structure.

**Taxation & Regulatory Compliance (Core Ownership)**

* Ensure full compliance across GST, Income Tax, TDS, and Companies Act requirements.
* Oversee Secretarial Compliance and ROC filings in coordination with company secretarial support.
* Lead Statutory Audits and Internal Audits, and act as the primary point of contact for auditors.
* Strengthen Internal Financial Controls (IFC) and overall financial governance.

**Treasury & Working Capital**

* Manage day-to-day cash flow planning and working capital optimization.
* Maintain and strengthen banking relationships across the group.
* Support debt servicing, liquidity management, and treasury operations.

**FP&A and Business Finance**

* Support the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), budgeting, forecasting, and rolling forecasts.
* Track financial KPIs and business intelligence reporting for leadership review.
* Partner with business leaders to evaluate profitability, support pricing decisions, and improve operational efficiency.
* Recommend and drive cost optimization initiatives across business units.

**Strategic Finance Support (Partnering with CFO)**

* Support financial due diligence for M&A, investments, and joint ventures as needed.
* Assist in preparing financial models, investor presentations, and materials for lender / PE / VC interactions.
* Contribute financial insights to Board-level and leadership reporting.
* Support post-merger financial integration for acquired businesses.

**Risk Management & Governance**

* Strengthen internal controls and enterprise risk management practices.
* Ensure compliance with corporate policies across all entities.
* Identify and mitigate financial and compliance risks proactively.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and mentor the accounting, taxation, and compliance teams.
* Build a high-performing, process-driven finance function capable of supporting rapid national growth.
* Act as a key escalation point for finance operations, deputizing for the CFO on controllership matters when required.

**Requirements**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) or MBA Finance is mandatory.
* Minimum 10+ years of progressive experience in Finance & Accounts, with strong hands-on controllership exposure.
* Proven experience owning the complete accounting close, MIS, and compliance function.
* Strong exposure to Accounting, Taxation, Compliance, Audit, and Financial Governance; working exposure to FP&A and Treasury preferred.
* Experience managing finance teams in a multi-location / multi-entity organization.
* Exposure to fundraising, due diligence, or investor reporting is an added advantage but not mandatory.
* Strong process orientation with the ability to build scalable financial systems and controls.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Pay: Up to ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic, target-driven **Relationship Manager (RM)** with strong B2C and B2B sales acumen. You will be responsible for both **generating and converting borrower leads**, as well as **identifying, pitching, and building long-term corporate relationships** to unlock recurring retail employee loans and corporate/MSME credit business.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Lead Generation & End-to-End Conversion**

* **Self-Sourced & Inbound Lead Conversion:** Actively generate new borrower leads through field outreach, cold calling, networking, and referrals, while converting company-provided leads into sanctions and disbursements.
* **Multi-Product Advisory:** Pitch and close Home Loans, Loan Against Property (LAP), Personal Loans, Business/MSME Loans, and Working Capital solutions across salaried and self-employed segments.
* **Profile Assessment & Bank Matching:** Evaluate borrower financials (CIBIL score, ITR, bank statements, GST returns, balance sheets, and property documents) to place each file with the optimal bank or NBFC.
* **Login-to-Disbursement Execution:** Manage end-to-end documentation, coordinate with bank/NBFC sales, credit, legal, and technical teams to resolve queries, and ensure timely disbursement.

**2. Corporate Relationship Building (B2B)**

* **Corporate Pitching & Onboarding:** Pitch **Maklav CredBridge** to HR heads, CFOs, business owners, and finance teams as an authorized multi-bank credit desk for their employees (Personal Loans, Home Loans, Balance Transfers) as well as corporate credit requirements (MSME Loans, Working Capital, Machinery/Equipment Finance).
* **On-Site Helpdesks & Employee Engagement:** Organize periodic loan awareness camps, financial wellness sessions, and on-site helpdesks at partner corporate offices to drive high-volume employee conversions.
* **Account Retention & Expansion:** Maintain ongoing relationships with corporate decision-makers and local influencers (CAs, builders, property consultants, and sub-DSAs) to build a predictable, recurring pipeline.

**3. Pipeline & Compliance Discipline**

* Maintain accurate daily updates on lead generation, corporate pitches, follow-ups, and file status in the CRM/tracker.
* Ensure complete accuracy in KYC/financial verification and strictly adhere to RBI and partner bank fair-practice guidelines.

**Candidate Requirements**

* **Experience:** 2–5 years of proven experience in retail/MSME loan sales, corporate/institutional banking sales, or B2B financial product distribution with a Bank, NBFC, or established DSA.
* **Corporate Pitching Ability:** Strong executive presence with the confidence to pitch and negotiate with HR managers, founders, CFOs, and business owners.
* **Product & Credit Acumen:** Sound working knowledge of CIBIL assessment, salaried vs. self-employed eligibility norms, financial statements, and documentation across secured and unsecured loans.
* **Hunter Mindset:** Demonstrated track record of self-generating leads and closing targets independently, alongside managing inbound leads.
* **Education:** Graduate in any discipline (MBA / PGDM / Commerce or Finance background preferred).
* **Local Network:** Existing corporate contacts, CA/builder networks, or familiarity with bank/NBFC credit teams in [Target City/Region] will be a distinct advantage.

We’re seeking an experienced professional to join our Securities Services team as **NFR Senior Manager.**

  

**In this role, you will:**

* Report to the FMI NFR Head, the Senior Manager will act as a key partner in shaping and delivering the FMI non-financial risk agenda. The role holder will recommend priorities, take ownership of agreed deliverables and lead implementation across in-scope FMI activities and NTTPs, ensuring alignment with Group mandatory procedures, the Risk Management Framework (RMF) and Third-Party Risk Policy requirements.
* This newly created position will lead the design, implementation and ongoing enhancement of the FMI NTTP risk management operating model. The Senior Manager will translate policy requirements into effective governance, controls and management information (MI), challenge existing practices and drive consistent adoption. Success will be measured through demonstrable improvements in risk management and sustainable control outcomes, rather than completion of activities alone.
* Working across Network Management and Market Intelligence (N2MI), Trading Facilities and CCP Management (TFCM), CSD Management and PS Management, the role holder will influence senior stakeholders and lead resolution of complex risk and control matters. The role will operate autonomously within an agreed mandate, escalating material exposures, unresolved disagreements and decisions requiring the FMI NFR Head’s authority. The FMI NFR Head retains overall functional accountability, while business and control owners retain responsibility for their risks, controls and remediation.
* Partner with the FMI NFR Head to establish a prioritised programme of activity that strengthens the control environment for in-scope FMI NTTPs. Lead delivery of agreed outcomes, ensuring risk management practices are consistent, evidence-based and aligned with Third-Party Risk Policy requirements, FMI-specific expectations and applicable risk appetite.
* Lead the development of clear, forward-looking risk insight and recommendations to inform governance and senior decision-making. Challenge control weaknesses, emerging exposures and the adequacy of proposed responses, holding accountable owners to agreed remediation outcomes and escalating material concerns or delivery risks.
* Drive change across FMI by leading implementation of CIB-led Third-Party Risk Management initiatives and improvements to mandatory procedures, operating instructions, reporting and tooling. Assess market infrastructure and regulatory developments, recommend proportionate responses and secure stakeholder commitment to changes that are practical, consistently embedded and sustainable.
* Partner with the FMI NFR Head to shape priorities and lead implementation and enhancement of mandatory FMI procedures and associated controls across in-scope NTTPs. Lead annual reviews and updates across N2MI and TFCM, challenge gaps and drive consistent application as business and regulatory requirements evolve.
* Lead oversight of FMI third-party controls and monitoring, critically assess results and challenge the adequacy of control design, operation and supporting evidence against Third-Party Risk Policy requirements and FMI-specific expectations. Drive resolution of weaknesses with accountable owners and maintain audit-ready documentation standards.
* Lead development and quality assurance of monthly governance packs and MI for the FMI Business Control Committee and N2MI Governance Committee. Translate complex matters into clear risk assessments, recommendations and decisions required; present and defend key messages, challenge senior stakeholders and escalate material concerns through the appropriate governance channels.
* Lead end-to-end oversight of NFR actions, issues and remediation, including Management Self-Identified Issues (MSIIs) and Audit Identified Issues (AIIs). Challenge root-cause analysis, action plans, milestones and closure evidence; hold accountable owners to agreed outcomes and escalate delays, unresolved exposures or remediation that does not deliver sustainable risk reduction.
* Lead FMI’s coordination of internal and external audits and assurance reviews. Establish coherent responses across the FMI team, challenge evidence quality and consistency, identify cross-cutting themes and drive delivery of agreed remediation with accountable owners, escalating significant matters to the FMI NFR Head.
* Lead FMI’s implementation and embedding of CIB-led Third-Party Risk Management initiatives. Assess business impacts, establish clear delivery plans and accountabilities, influence stakeholders across business, operations and Risk and Control functions, and resolve implementation challenges to secure effective adoption.
* Drive continuous improvement and simplification of FMI NFR processes, reporting and tooling. Challenge inefficient practices, prioritise changes that strengthen control effectiveness, data quality and management insight, and lead delivery from design through implementation and embedding within an agreed mandate.
* Lead analysis and preparation of responses to regulatory requests and senior management queries. Proactively assess emerging market infrastructure and regulatory developments, determine implications for FMI NTTP operational performance and the control environment, and recommend prioritised, proportionate responses to the FMI NFR Head and relevant stakeholders.
  

**To be successful you will:**

* Substantial experience in non-financial risk, operational risk, third-party risk or governance and controls within financial services or a similarly regulated environment, with a demonstrated record of leading complex risk and control initiatives.
* A self-starting, solution-oriented approach, independently setting priorities aligned with the FMI NFR agenda and driving delivery without close supervision. Takes proactive initiative and end-to-end ownership, remaining accountable for outcomes and exercising sound judgement on when to engage or escalate.
* Strong practical expertise in risk and control frameworks, including the ability to challenge risk assessments, control design and effectiveness, root-cause analysis, remediation plans and closure evidence, and maintain audit-quality documentation.
* Strong analytical capability and sound judgement to interpret complex information, identify emerging risks and cross-cutting themes, and recommend priorities based on materiality.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with senior leaders, influence and constructively challenge stakeholders, resolve competing priorities and secure delivery across business, operations and Risk and Control functions without relying on direct reporting authority.
* Strong executive communication skills, including producing concise MI, dashboards and governance papers, presenting complex matters clearly, making evidence-based recommendations and articulating the decisions and actions required from senior stakeholders.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional change from design through implementation and embedding, establish clear accountability and manage multiple priorities with disciplined delivery and attention to detail. Evidence of sustainable improvements in risk management or control effectiveness, supported by proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint and Word.
* Knowledge of FM

JOB DESCRIPTIONAREA MANAGER – CREDIT & OPERATIONS

**Industry:** NBFC- Gold Loan  
**Location:** Thiruvananthapuram / Assigned Area  
**Department:** Credit & Operations  
**Reporting To:** Regional Manager / Head of Operations

1. Job Purpose

The Area Manager – Credit & Operations will be responsible for managing credit operations, customer visits, loan appraisal and approval, branch performance, business development and portfolio quality across assigned branches.

The position requires an experienced professional who can balance credit discipline with business growth, regularly visit branches, motivate employees, support customer acquisition and ensure efficient branch operations.

The Area Manager will play a key role in improving business performance across Gold Loan, Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan products.

2. Duties & Responsibilities

**A. Branch Visits & Business Development**

* Visit every assigned branch at least once a week.
* Review branch-wise business performance, loan disbursements, outstanding and collection efficiency.
* Motivate Branch Managers and employees to improve business sourcing and achieve assigned targets.
* Conduct regular meetings with branch teams to review performance and business plans.
* Identify local business opportunities and support branches in acquiring new customers.
* Participate in important customer meetings and assist branch teams in converting high-value loan proposals.
* Identify operational and business challenges and provide suitable solutions.
* Monitor staff productivity and provide guidance to improve individual performance.
* Develop strategies to improve branch business across Gold Loans, Business Loans and Commercial Property Loans.
* Submit weekly branch visit reports with observations, business updates and action plans.

**B. Customer Visits & Credit Assessment**

* Conduct regular customer visits for Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan proposals.
* Visit business premises, commercial establishments and properties to assess customer credentials and business activities.
* Evaluate customer repayment capacity, business operations and financial position.
* Independently verify information provided in loan applications and identify discrepancies.
* Meet prospective and existing customers to understand their financial requirements.
* Support branch teams in handling high-value and critical loan proposals.
* Ensure proper field verification and due diligence before recommending loan proposals.

**C. Credit Appraisal & Loan Approval**

* Review and evaluate loan applications across assigned branches.
* Assess customer eligibility, repayment capacity, income documents and credit history.
* Ensure proper assessment of collateral, property valuation and legal documentation.
* Review and approve or recommend loan proposals within delegated authority.
* Ensure adherence to credit policies, lending norms and product-specific eligibility criteria.
* Identify potential credit risks and take preventive measures.
* Ensure proper documentation and verification before loan disbursement.
* Improve credit processing turnaround time without compromising lending standards.

**D. Gold Loan Operations**

* Monitor gold loan appraisal procedures and ensure adherence to company guidelines.
* Ensure accuracy in gold purity testing, weight assessment and valuation.
* Monitor Loan-to-Value (LTV) compliance and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Conduct surprise inspections and verification of gold packets and vault procedures.
* Ensure proper custody, security and reconciliation of pledged gold ornaments.
* Monitor gold loan renewals, closures, overdue accounts and auction procedures.

**E. Business Loan & Commercial Property Loan Operations**

* Supervise credit evaluation and processing of Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan applications.
* Review financial statements, bank statements, income documents and business cash flows.
* Ensure proper property valuation, legal scrutiny and title verification for property-backed loans.
* Coordinate with legal, technical and credit teams for timely processing.
* Ensure compliance with approved lending policies and sanction conditions.
* Monitor documentation, disbursement and post-disbursement compliance.

**F. Branch Operations & Process Control**

* Monitor daily branch operations and ensure operational discipline.
* Conduct periodic branch inspections and operational audits.
* Ensure proper cash management, document custody and record maintenance.
* Review daily transactions, disbursement reports and operational MIS.
* Identify process gaps and implement corrective measures.
* Ensure adherence to internal SOPs and operational guidelines.

**G. Portfolio Monitoring, Collections & Recovery**

* Monitor branch-wise portfolio performance and overdue accounts.
* Track NPA, delinquency and collection efficiency.
* Identify early warning signals and potentially stressed accounts.
* Coordinate with Branch Managers for recovery and overdue reduction.
* Ensure timely follow-up of maturing and overdue loan accounts.
* Recommend corrective actions to improve portfolio quality.

**H. Team Management & Motivation**

* Guide, supervise and motivate Branch Managers and branch employees.
* Train branch teams on credit policies, documentation and operational procedures.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and operational training.
* Ensure accountability and adherence to defined responsibilities.
* Support branch teams in achieving business and collection targets.
* Build a customer-focused and result-oriented working culture.

**I. Compliance, Risk Management & Audit**

* Ensure compliance with applicable RBI regulations and internal policies.
* Monitor KYC, AML and customer due diligence requirements.
* Coordinate internal, concurrent and statutory audits.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Report operational irregularities, fraud indicators and policy violations to management.
* Ensure effective implementation of risk management practices across branches.

**J. MIS & Management Reporting**

* Prepare and review branch-wise credit and operational performance reports.
* Monitor loan sanctions, disbursements, outstanding, collections and overdue positions.
* Submit periodic reports to Regional Management / Head Office.
* Analyse operational bottlenecks and recommend process improvements.
* Prepare weekly branch visit reports and follow up on pending action points.
* Support management in implementing business growth and risk management strategies.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* **Branch Visits:** Minimum one visit to every assigned branch every week.
* **Business Growth:** Improvement in branch-wise sourcing and loan disbursements.
* **Customer Visits:** Regular field visits for customer verification and credit assessment.
* **Credit Approval:** Timely appraisal and decision-making.
* **Branch Motivation:** Regular performance meetings and staff engagement.
* **Credit Quality:** Effective control over NPA and overdue accounts.
* **Gold Loan Operations:** Accuracy in appraisal, LTV compliance and gold security.
* **Operational Efficiency:** Audit scores, process adherence and documentation quality.
* **Collections:** Improvement in recovery and collection efficiency.
* **Reporting:** Timely submission of weekly and monthly MIS reports.

4. Candidate Profile

* Graduate / Postgraduate in any discipline; finance or banking qualifications preferred.
* 8–15 years of experience in Banking or NBFC operations.
* Strong experience in credit appraisal, loan operations and branch administration.
* Exposure to Gold Loans, Business Loans and Loan Against Property / Commercial Property Loans.
* Experience in handling multiple branches or geographical areas preferred.
* Good knowledge of RBI regulations, KYC, AML and credit risk management.
* Strong customer relationship, business development and team leadership skills.
* Willingness to travel regularly

We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible accountant with practical experience in Zoho Books and GST compliance to manage our accounting operations. 2. Key Responsibilities A. Zoho Books Management - Maintain complete and accurate accounting records in Zoho Books. - Record daily sales, purchases, receipts, payments and journal entries. - Maintain customer and supplier ledgers. - Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable. - Ensure timely and accurate accounting entries. - Maintain proper documentation of all financial transactions. B. GST & Statutory Compliance - Prepare and verify GST sales and purchase data. - Coordinate preparation and filing of GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B. - Reconcile GSTR-2B with purchase records. - Verify GST input tax credit eligibility. - Coordinate with external auditors and tax consultants. - Maintain TDS records and assist with statutory compliance. C. Banking & Financial Transactions - Perform bank reconciliations regularly. - Monitor customer collections and supplier payments. - Maintain cash and bank books. - Prepare payment schedules. - Track outstanding receivables and payables. D. Inventory & Stock Accounting - Maintain inventory records in Zoho. - Monitor raw cashew nut purchases and stock. - Track cashew kernel grades and quantities. - Maintain stock records of finished goods, packing materials and by-products. - Reconcile physical stock with accounting records. - Coordinate with factory and stores personnel for stock verification. E. Sales & Purchase Accounting - Verify purchase invoices, sales invoices and debit/credit notes. - Ensure correct GST rates, HSN codes and tax classifications. - Track customer outstanding balances. - Monitor supplier balances and payment due dates. - Maintain proper records of domestic and export transactions. F. MIS & Management Reporting Prepare periodic reports for management, including: - Daily sales and purchase reports. - Customer outstanding and ageing reports. - Supplier outstanding reports. - Stock and inventory reports. - Monthly Profit & Loss statement. - Cash flow and fund position. - Expense analysis. - Product-wise and business-wise profitability reports, wherever data is available. 3. Required Qualifications & Experience - B.Com / M.Com or equivalent qualification. - 2–5 years of accounting experience. - Hands-on experience in Zoho Books is essential. - Good knowledge of GST and Indian accounting practices. - Experience with inventory accounting. - Knowledge of Excel and spreadsheets. - Experience in manufacturing, processing or trading businesses will be an advantage. 4. Skills & Competencies - Strong accounting fundamentals. - High accuracy and attention to detail. - Good analytical and reconciliation skills. - Ability to independently manage daily accounting operations. - Good communication and coordination skills. - Integrity, confidentiality and accountability. - Ability to meet deadlines. 5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) The performance of the accountant will be evaluated on: 1. Accuracy and completeness of accounting entries. 2. Timely completion of bank reconciliations. 3. jobs.title: Director of Software Engineering
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
Make your mark by leading a major modernization that replaces legacy reconciliations capabilities with a new, resilient platform at scale
  
  
As a Director of Software Engineering at JPMorgan Chase, within the Commercial and Investment Bank, at reconciliations platform you are accountable for the target-state architecture and delivery outcomes of a new reconciliations stack replacing multiple legacy capabilities. You define reference architectures, approved patterns, and measurable non-functional targets, and you drive consistent implementation across multiple engineering teams. You lead modernization execution from parallel run through cutover and decommission, with strong operational discipline in a controls-heavy domain. You set expectations for production readiness, performance engineering, and auditability to sustain reliability at extreme scale.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Owns the target-state platform architecture and ensure consistent implementation through reference architectures, approved patterns, and reusable “golden path” guidance.
* Defines measurable non-functional requirements and targets (for example throughput, latency, recovery objectives, correctness guarantees, and cost boundaries) and drive adoption across teams.
* Decides and documents key engineering trade-offs (for example consistency versus latency, streaming versus batch, storage layout, replay strategy, partitioning and compaction approach, and disaster recovery posture) for governance and reuse.
* Leads delivery outcomes across multiple workstreams, including real-time processing, batch processing, workflow and state, controls and reporting, and migration tooling.
* Drives execution discipline through dependency management, milestone planning, risk reduction, capacity planning, and escalation of cross-organization blockers.
* Owns the modernization and migration strategy, including parallel run, parity validation, acceptance criteria, phased cutovers, rollback plans, and legacy decommission sequencing.
* Establishes production readiness standards across the software delivery lifecycle, including testing strategy, continuous integration and delivery expectations, observability, incident management, and change governance aligned to a controls-heavy environment.
* Leads performance and cost engineering for Java services and large-scale data pipelines, ensuring capacity planning and optimization are proactive and measurable.
* Ensures auditability and explainability through reproducible outputs, lineage expectations, immutable retention strategy, and controlled reprocessing approaches.
* Coaches senior engineers and technical leads through design reviews, code review standards, post-incident learning, and stakeholder-facing architecture communication.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**

* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 10+ years applied experience. In addition, 5+ years of experience leading technologists to manage, anticipate and solve complex technical items within your domain of expertise
* 8+ years of technical leadership experience owning system design and delivery for complex platforms.
* Demonstrated accountability for production outcomes (reliability, incident management, and operational discipline) for large-scale distributed systems.
* Strong Amazon Web Services production experience, including Elastic MapReduce, Lambda, Elastic Container Service, and DynamoDB.
* Proven expertise designing distributed systems with idempotency, ordering, retries, consistency controls, and replay or reprocessing strategies.
* Experience delivering large-scale data processing solutions using lakehouse patterns and table formats.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**

* Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg at scale (partitioning strategy, compaction, schema evolution, and maintenance automation).
* Advanced Apache Spark tuning experience at very large scale (skew, shuffle optimization, partition sizing, and cost-performance trade-offs).
* Experience building reconciliations or matching engines within financial services.
* Experience leading large migration programs that replace legacy platforms with parallel run and controlled cutover.

jobs.title: Associate Director/Director - GenAI Business Strategy & Transformation
