jobs.description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $115 billion in investment capital as of September 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are looking for a GenAI Business Strategy & Transformation Lead to anchor the DESIS GenAI-for-Business ("GAIBiz") effort. Depending on the candidate’s location preference, the position is open for either of our Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram offices in India. This person will be responsible for translating the firm's GenAI strategy into tangible adoption and measurable outcomes across the DESIS environment, working in close partnership with the strategy and transformation core based in the firm's global offices. This is a role largely built around execution and adoption. The strategy setting and transformation agenda is driven centrally; the mandate here is to land that agenda well within DESIS, shaping it for the local context, driving uptake, and delivering results on the ground. There will be real opportunities to influence direction and expand scope over time, but a candidate who thrives will be one who is energized by making things happen, not solely by setting up the agenda. This role will offer a good mix of strategy formulation and hands on delivery experience, tilting more towards later.

You will partner with the global strategy and transformation core, acting as the DESIS anchor for firmwide GenAI strategy, ensuring initiatives are contextualized, sequenced, and executed effectively in and for the DESIS environment. You will engage credibly with technical teams, working shoulder to shoulder with engineering and data teams, understanding architecture, model capabilities, and tradeoffs well enough to challenge, prioritize, and unblock. You will embed risk, compliance, and data governance, ensuring GenAI initiatives meet the firm's standards for data protection, model risk, regulatory expectations, and responsible-AI practice from the outset, not as an afterthought. Finally, you will measure and communicate impact by defining the metrics that matter, tracking adoption and value realization, and reporting progress clearly to senior stakeholders across DESIS and the global firm.

The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* 15 or more years of progressive experience leading technology transformation, including recent hands-on leadership of Generative AI initiatives
* Sound instincts on when to buy, when to build, and when a middle path serves best, with the commercial sense to weigh cost, speed, and control (Strategic and commercial judgment)

* Pragmatic and outcome-obsessed approach, with a high tolerance for ambiguity and rapid change. Ability to influence without authority across a distributed, matrixed organization, and comfort in operating primarily in a delivery-focused capacity within a globally driven agenda (Temperament and influencing skills)
* Creativity, critical thinking with excellent written and verbal communication skills and an entrepreneurial mindset to take on challenging, high-impact projects

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/ADGenAIOct26

**Position Summary**
The Executive Director - Managed Services Transition Principal is a senior individual contributor accountable for defining, shaping and assuring the most complex and strategically significant Finance Managed Services transitions across Finance Managed Services. The role operates as EY’s authoritative transition specialist on major pursuits and mobilizations, providing independent judgement, deep subject-matter expertise and executive-level client counsel from RFP strategy through stable operations.

Its Executive Director scope is created through enterprise-wide influence, ownership of high-value and high-risk transition outcomes, direct engagement with C-suite and Partner stakeholders, and stewardship of EY transition methods, intellectual property and digitally enabled practices. * Ensure transition designs protect financial control, statutory and regulatory obligations, close and reporting timetables, cash flow, working capital and business continuity.
* Provide transition leadership for the largest, most complex and highest-risk Finance Managed Services opportunities, including deals with multi-tower, multi-country, regulated, carve-out, transformation or accelerated-mobilization characteristics.
* Own the integrity of transition solutions and mobilization outcomes for assigned strategic deals, acting as the single senior subject-matter authority rather than as a people leader.

jobs.description:
**About Us:**

Solytics Partners is a Global Analytics firm, recognized with multiple industry awards for innovation and excellence. Our team comprises experts with deep domain knowledge in risk, analytics, AI/ML, AML/FCC, and fraud. By converging this expertise with cutting-edge technologies like AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Models (LLMs), we deliver powerful automated platforms and incisive point solutions.

Our offerings enable clients to streamline and future-proof their risk, AML, and analytics processes, comply seamlessly with global regulations, and safeguard financial systems. Whether it’s solving complex challenges or driving operational efficiency, Solytics Partners is committed to empowering organizations with transformative tools to stay ahead in an evolving regulatory landscape.

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking an experienced Principal Implementation Manager to lead end-to-end implementation of enterprise SaaS platforms for global financial institutions. This is a techno-functional leadership role requiring strong expertise in solution consulting, enterprise programme delivery, business process transformation, product configuration, and stakeholder management.

The role involves working closely with customers and internal Product, Engineering, QA, DevOps, and Customer Success teams to deliver scalable solutions, ensure successful go-lives, and drive platform adoption.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Solution Consulting & Design:**

* Lead client discovery, requirement gathering, and solution workshops.
* Conduct business process analysis and fit-gap assessments.
* Translate business requirements into functional solution designs.
* Define implementation strategies, rollout plans, and adoption roadmaps.
* Recommend scalable, standardised platform solutions.

**2. Programme & Implementation Management**

* Lead multiple enterprise implementation programmes simultaneously.
* Own project planning, scope, timelines, budgets, risks, and delivery governance.
* Manage implementation milestones, dependencies, and executive reporting.
* Drive production deployment, go-live, and post-implementation support.

**3. Product Configuration & Business Analysis**

* Oversee configuration of workflows, business rules, approval processes, roles, permissions, dashboards, and reporting.
* Gather functional and non-functional requirements.
* Define user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications.
* Lead change management and requirement traceability.

**4. Cross-Functional & Stakeholder Management**

* Coordinate Product, Engineering, QA, DevOps, Infrastructure, and Customer Success teams.
* Manage senior customer stakeholders, including Business Heads, Risk, Compliance, IT, and Executive Sponsors.
* Lead SIT, UAT, release planning, and production rollout.
* Provide executive updates and manage escalations.

**5. Customer Success & Product Improvement**

* Drive platform adoption, user training, and knowledge transfer.
* Develop implementation playbooks and reusable delivery frameworks.
* Identify product enhancements and process improvement opportunities.
* Improve implementation efficiency and customer satisfaction.

**Required Experience & Skills:**

* 10–15 years of experience in enterprise SaaS implementation, consulting, or programme delivery.
* Proven experience leading end-to-end enterprise software implementations.
* Strong solution consulting, business analysis, and programme management skills.
* Experience managing multiple enterprise customers and cross-functional teams.
* Experience working with banks, financial institutions, insurance companies, or regulated industries.
* Strong understanding of enterprise workflows, REST APIs, system integrations, IAM (SSO, LDAP, OAuth), databases, and cloud-based SaaS architecture.
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies, Jira, Azure DevOps, and Confluence.
* Ability to engage with technical teams on enterprise architecture and integration requirements.

**Preferred Domain Experience:**

* Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)
* Enterprise and Operational Risk Management
* Model Risk Management
* Regulatory Compliance and AI Governance
* Financial Services and Banking Technology
* Enterprise Workflow Automation

**Leadership Competencies:**

* Enterprise solution consulting and programme leadership.
* Executive stakeholder management and communication.
* Business process optimisation and change management.
* Team leadership, negotiation, and conflict resolution.
* Customer relationship management and decision-making.

**Key Success Metrics:**

* On-time and successful enterprise implementations.
* Customer satisfaction and platform adoption.
* Quality of solution design and successful go-lives.
* Reduced implementation timelines through reusable frameworks.
* Executive stakeholder satisfaction and customer expansion.

jobs.title: Director-Technology Controls Testing Team Lead
jobs.description:
**Why Mizuho**

At Mizuho, we provide the stability of an international industry leader with the career trajectory of a growing business. Our steady, strategic growth gives our people at all levels rewarding degrees of responsibility and richer work experience than a boutique firm or an established giant could offer alone

It’s the local expertise of our employees that makes our global network so powerful. By collaborating with colleagues and clients who have the same ambition and drive, you can amplify your sphere of influence and base of knowledge as part of one of the largest and growing banks in the world.

**Profile Summary:**

The Technology Controls Team Lead leads the India-based Chief Technology Controls Team and the EMEA Technology Internal Control Testing Programme.

The role is responsible for the risk-based assessment of technology controls, including control design and operating effectiveness testing, evidence quality, issue identification, remediation monitoring and management reporting. The role also develops data-led, automated and continuous control-assurance capabilities.

Working across EMEA Technology, the role partners with control owners, Technology leadership and relevant oversight and assurance functions to strengthen the technology control environment while maintaining clear accountability across the three lines of defense.

**Technology Controls Framework and Testing:**

* Own and maintain the EMEA Technology Controls Testing Framework.
* Lead the Technology Internal Control Testing Programme, including methodology, planning, scope, approval, execution, quality assurance and reporting.
* Develop a risk-based testing plan using RCSA results, process mapping, risk appetite measures, incidents, control failures, audit findings, regulatory priorities and material technology changes.
* Prioritize controls associated with Critical and High inherent risks, while including Moderate-rated controls where justified by risk concentration, limited assurance coverage, control failures or emerging risk.
* Maintain a technology testing inventory covering control ownership, risk linkage, testing frequency, previous results, existing assurance coverage and open issues.
* Lead control walkthroughs and assessments of control design and operating effectiveness.
* Define testing methods, evidence requirements, sampling approaches and quality standards.
* Ensure conclusions are supported by complete, reliable and traceable evidence.
* Coordinate with IT Risk Assurance lead on SOX, Compliance, Head Office and other assurance programmes to minimize unnecessary duplication.
* Continuously improve testing methodology, guidance, templates and supporting tools.

**Issues and Remediation:**

* Ensure control deficiencies, self-identified issues, risk acceptances and treatment plans are consistently identified, recorded and escalated.
* Challenge control ownership, testing conclusions, remediation plans and proposed issue closure.
* Ensure remediation actions have clear owners and target dates.
* Monitor remediation through to closure and arrange validation or retesting where required.
* Identify recurring or systemic control weaknesses requiring coordinated remediation.
* Escalate material control failures, overdue actions and risk appetite breaches through the appropriate governance channels.

**Audit and Regulatory Readiness:**

* Coordinate Technology responses to internal audit, external audit, SOX and regulatory assurance activity.
* Maintain a coordinated view of assurance activity, findings, evidence requests, management responses and remediation commitments.
* Improve the quality and timeliness of evidence, walkthroughs and management responses.
* Maintain a reusable regional evidence base to support assurance activity.
* Ensure recurring audit and regulatory themes inform the control framework, testing plan and remediation priorities.
* Support senior-management and regulatory briefings on material technology control matters.

**Reporting and Governance:**

* Own management information covering technology control testing delivery, control effectiveness, issues, remediation, risk acceptances and recurring themes.
* Provide concise, accurate and decision-oriented reporting to Technology leadership and relevant governance forums.
* Act as the central escalation and prioritisation point for Technology control-testing matters.
* Represent the Chief Technology Controls Team at relevant committees and working groups.
* Ensure material control weaknesses and risks are escalated promptly and transparently.

**Data, Tools and Continuous Assurance:**

* Own the Technology Controls testing toolset, workflows, dashboards and analytics capability.
* Ensure testing plans, evidence, samples, conclusions, issues and remediation records are accurately maintained in approved repositories.
* Establish standards for evidence quality, naming, ownership, version control, retention, permissions and audit traceability.
* Lead evidence coordination and quality review with process and control owners.
* Develop automated monitoring and continuous control-testing capabilities where supported by reliable data and repeatable testing logic.
* Define appropriate governance for automated testing, including data quality, access, change control, exception handling and periodic validation.
* Explore the responsible use of AI to support evidence review, control mapping, testing preparation, exception identification, thematic analysis and reporting.
* Ensure that automation and AI retain appropriate governance, validation and human oversight.

**Leadership and People Management:**

* Lead and develop the India-based Chief Technology Controls Team, initially comprising three VP-level control resources.
* Set team priorities and allocate coverage according to risk, assurance requirements and business demand.
* Lead implementation of the target operating model.
* Establish clear objectives, accountabilities and quality expectations.
* Build team capability through training, coaching and knowledge management.
* Promote a constructive, evidence-led risk and control culture.
* Provide broader local Technology Management or Operations oversight only where formally assigned.

**Decision Authority (Within delegated authority, the role may):**

* Approve the proposed testing plan and material scope changes before governance submission.
* Determine testing methods, evidence requirements, sampling approaches and quality standards.
* Require additional evidence, expanded testing or retesting.
* Escalate material control failures, overdue remediation and inadequate risk acceptance.
* Prioritise team activity and allocate testing resources.
* Recommend control improvements and automation opportunities.
  ***Control owners remain accountable for operating their controls and remediating identified weaknesses. Risk acceptance remains subject to approval under the applicable risk-management framework.***

**Experience and Skills:**

jobs.title: Associate Director/Director - GenAI Business Strategy & Transformation
jobs.company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
jobs.description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $115 billion in investment capital as of September 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are looking for a GenAI Business Strategy & Transformation Lead to anchor the DESIS GenAI-for-Business ("GAIBiz") effort. Depending on the candidate’s location preference, the position is open for either of our Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram offices in India. This person will be responsible for translating the firm's GenAI strategy into tangible adoption and measurable outcomes across the DESIS environment, working in close partnership with the strategy and transformation core based in the firm's global offices. This is a role largely built around execution and adoption. The strategy setting and transformation agenda is driven centrally; the mandate here is to land that agenda well within DESIS, shaping it for the local context, driving uptake, and delivering results on the ground. There will be real opportunities to influence direction and expand scope over time, but a candidate who thrives will be one who is energized by making things happen, not solely by setting up the agenda. This role will offer a good mix of strategy formulation and hands on delivery experience, tilting more towards later.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
In this role, you will drive GenAI adoption across DESIS by moving initiatives from pilot to production use; conceptualizing and executing novel ways to increase adoption; and owning the associated logistics and change-management scaffolding (enablement, incentives, communications, feedback loops) needed to turn well-designed programs into genuine, sustained uptake. You will partner with the global strategy and transformation core, acting as the DESIS anchor for firmwide GenAI strategy, ensuring initiatives are contextualized, sequenced, and executed effectively in and for the DESIS environment. You will engage credibly with technical teams, working shoulder to shoulder with engineering and data teams, understanding architecture, model capabilities, and tradeoffs well enough to challenge, prioritize, and unblock. You will embed risk, compliance, and data governance, ensuring GenAI initiatives meet the firm's standards for data protection, model risk, regulatory expectations, and responsible-AI practice from the outset, not as an afterthought. Finally, you will measure and communicate impact by defining the metrics that matter, tracking adoption and value realization, and reporting progress clearly to senior stakeholders across DESIS and the global firm.
  
  
**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* 15 or more years of progressive experience leading technology transformation, including recent hands-on leadership of Generative AI initiatives
* Sound instincts on when to buy, when to build, and when a middle path serves best, with the commercial sense to weigh cost, speed, and control (Strategic and commercial judgment)
* A demonstrated track record of driving uptake, not just designing programs. Evidence of moving organizations from intent to embedded behavior (Change management and adoption)
* Deep enough understanding of GenAI and modern data/ML systems to engage engineers credibly and make informed trade-offs. You need not be a builder, but you must be conversant (Technical literacy)
* Experience in or adjacent to market finance, hedge funds, or investment management, with enough fluency to earn the trust of demanding stakeholders (Domain credibility)
* Practical familiarity with the risk, regulatory, and data-governance considerations that shape how AI can responsibly be deployed in a financial-services setting (Risk, compliance and data governance)
* Pragmatic and outcome-obsessed approach, with a high tolerance for ambiguity and rapid change. Ability to influence without authority across a distributed, matrixed organization, and comfort in operating primarily in a delivery-focused capacity within a globally driven agenda (Temperament and influencing skills)
* Creativity, critical thinking with excellent written and verbal communication skills and an entrepreneurial mindset to take on challenging, high-impact projects

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/ADGenAIOct26
  
  
We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.
  
  
The firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers
  
  
Members of the D. E. Shaw group do not discriminate in employment matters on the basis of sex, race, colour, caste, creed, religion, pregnancy, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other protected class.

jobs.description:
#### **Job ID**

67909

#### **Work Style**

Hybrid Worker

HSBC

Technology

Full Time

Some careers shine brighter than others.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Service Management

**The Opportunity**

This role engineers and operates the trusted data and retrieval layer powering the enterprise Knowledge Graph and its AI-enabled consumers. You’ll build production-grade pipelines that transform structured and unstructured enterprise data into high-quality entities, relationships and retrieval-ready representations with strong controls for provenance, security, quality and operability. The focus is on creating traceable data that links back to authoritative source records and remains reliable as sources and AI use cases grow. Success means dependable graph construction and retrieval datasets that support graph traversal, semantic and vector retrieval and GraphRAG/RAG patterns. You’ll help embed automated testing, observability and recovery across environments so delivery is repeatable rather than bespoke. The outcome is a reusable engineering foundation that reduces one-off integrations and keeps critical knowledge within the permanent team.

**What you'll be doing**

* Design, build, test and operate batch, incremental and event-driven pipelines from enterprise sources into the Knowledge Graph
* Implement graph construction logic including node and edge creation, canonical identifiers, relationship derivation, provenance capture and temporal handling
* Engineer entity resolution, record linkage, de-duplication and reconciliation across heterogeneous sources to prevent conflicting identities and relationships
* Build AI-ready pipelines for structured and unstructured data including extraction, cleansing, chunking or segmentation, and metadata enrichment
* Implement embedding generation and vector indexing pipelines where required, including model and version metadata and repeatable re-indexing processes
* Develop retrieval data services and query patterns for graph traversal, vector or semantic retrieval and hybrid or GraphRAG use cases
* Embed automated data-quality and graph-quality controls covering completeness, validity, freshness, duplicate entities, broken relationships and reconciliation to source
* Establish test frameworks and regression testing for mappings, transformations and retrieval datasets as schemas, ontologies, models and feeds evolve
* Implement end-to-end observability with alerts and recovery runbooks for pipeline health, ingest latency, load failures, indexing status and data freshness
* Optimise loads, transformations, indexing and retrieval performance for scale, latency and cost while maintaining integrity and auditability

**What we're looking for**

* Demonstrate advanced Python and SQL with strong software engineering practice including modular design, automated testing, Git, code review and performance optimisation
* Bring substantial ETL and ELT pipeline engineering experience across APIs, relational data, semi-structured formats and large enterprise datasets
* Apply hands-on graph engineering experience including property graph concepts, schema or ontology implementation and graph query languages such as Cypher or equivalent
* Build data preparation and indexing layers for AI retrieval patterns including embeddings, vector search, semantic or hybrid retrieval and RAG or GraphRAG
* Implement entity resolution and data matching using deterministic and probabilistic approaches with canonical identifiers and source reconciliation
* Establish data quality, metadata, lineage, provenance, schema evolution and data contract practices in production environments
* Deliver CI/CD, containers and platform engineering patterns with production support and infrastructure-aware troubleshooting
* Apply secure data engineering controls including IAM or service identities, secrets management, encryption and auditability suitable for a regulated enterprise

**Building trusted retrieval at scale**

If you want your work to shape how AI systems retrieve and ground information across an enterprise this role offers the scope to do it with rigour. You’ll build pipelines and controls that keep the Knowledge Graph reliable, traceable and ready for real production use cases. The work spans ingestion, graph construction, quality, observability and retrieval services and it’s designed to scale as adoption grows. If you’re ready to turn complex enterprise data into trusted graph and retrieval foundations we’d welcome your application.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

jobs.description:
**Description**
===============

  

**Trintec** h is an award-winning AI-driven Fintech SaaS organisation transforming the way finance teams operate.

  

We are looking to hire a **Director of Software Engineering** for our growing operation in Bangalore.

  

This is a fantastic opportunity to build and scale a team of stellar engineers. The leader we are looking for will have natural confidence and charisma, a strong ability to influence up to executive level, with a true passion and curiosity for building next gen tech.

  

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

  

Essential functions include, but are not limited to the following:

  

* ***Strategic and Product Engineering Leadership***
  + Translate product portfolio priorities and business objectives into clear engineering goals, investment themes, capacity plans, and measurable outcomes.
  + Partner with Product Management and Architecture to shape executable roadmaps that balance customer value, platform modernization, quality, security, and maintainability.
  + Anticipate future product, scale, compliance, and operational needs, and influence engineering plans accordingly.
  Drive cross-functional alignment for major product portfolio initiatives, dependencies, risks, and delivery trade-offs.

  

* ***Portfolio Delivery and Governance***
  + Provide portfolio-level oversight across engineering teams supporting the product portfolio to ensure commitments are realistic, risks are visible, and delivery outcomes are predictable.
  + Establish governance mechanisms for planning, execution reviews, release readiness, quality health, dependency management, and stakeholder communication.
  + Use engineering and product metrics to improve delivery predictability, quality, productivity, and operational performance.
  Support budget planning, capacity forecasting, hiring prioritization, and investment trade-off decisions across the product portfolio.

  

* ***Engineering Excellence and Operational Maturity***
  + Raise the engineering bar across architecture, secure SDLC, design reviews, testing strategy, CI/CD, observability, release quality, and production readiness.
  + Drive improvements in reliability, performance, scalability, incident learning, vulnerability management, and customer-impacting defect reduction.
  + Promote consistent engineering standards across teams while enabling Engineering Managers and technical leads to own team-level execution.
  Champion the responsible adoption of automation and AI-assisted engineering practices that improve productivity, quality, and customer value.

  

* ***Product Portfolio Modernization and Technical Direction***
  + Partner with Architecture and senior engineers to evolve the product portfolio's technical roadmap, reduce technical debt, and improve long-term maintainability.
  + Sponsor modernization initiatives that improve platform resilience, scalability, user experience, cloud readiness, data capabilities, and integration patterns.
  Ensure major engineering decisions consider customer impact, enterprise SaaS requirements, security, compliance, total cost of ownership, and operational sustainability.

  

* ***People Leadership and Organizational Growth***
  + Build and scale a high-performing engineering organization through strong hiring, leadership development, succession planning, and retention practice.
  + Coach Engineering Managers and senior technical leaders to improve ownership, decision-making, communication, and execution maturity.
  + Create an inclusive, accountable, and collaborative engineering culture that supports innovation, customer focus, and continuous improvement.
  Partner with People Success and senior leaders on organization design, performance calibration, compensation inputs, and talent growth plans.

  
  

**WHO YOU ARE**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline; master’s degree preferred.
* 12+ years of relevant experience, including 7+ years in engineering leadership for enterprise SaaS products or platforms.
* Proven experience leading through managers and senior technical leaders across multiple engineering teams.
* Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS engineering, including scalability, performance, security, reliability, CI/CD, observability, and production operations.
* Experience partnering with Product, Architecture, Cloud Operations, Security, Support, and Customer Success teams in a global product organization.
* Ability to use KPIs, engineering metrics, financial inputs, and business context to make data-driven decisions.
* Experience with Agile delivery at scale, engineering governance, planning, risk management, and stakeholder communication.
* Excellent communication, executive presence, people leadership, coaching, influencing, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience in financial close, reconciliation, accounting software, banking, payments, ERP integrations, or finance transformation is preferred.
Experience working with distributed engineering teams and offshore/global delivery models is preferred.  

  
  
  
  
  

*At our core, Trintechers stand committed to fostering a culture rooted in our core values – Humble, Empowered, Reliable, and Open. Together, these values guide our actions, define our identity, and inspire us to continuously strive for excellence in everything we do.*

*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or disability.*

**Some careers have more impact than others.**

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a meaningful difference, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be. As one of the world’s largest banking and financial services organisations, HSBC operates across 62 countries and territories.

We aim to be where the growth is—enabling businesses to thrive, economies to prosper and people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We’re seeking an experienced professional to join our Securities Services team as **Associate Director - SSv NFR Governance and Client Risks**

  

**In this role, you will:**

* This role supports Securities Services (SSv) in executing consistent, high-quality Non-Financial Risk (NFR) governance and client risk capability, with specific emphasis on post-sales servicing risks across the client lifecycle. The Associate Director will help manage inbound and outbound client risks, produce senior-ready MI and insights, and support the ISAE reporting programme (e.g., ISAE 3402 / relevant assurance reporting).
* A core element of the role is building a modern, data-led risk insight capability—leveraging analytics and AI-enabled approaches (where appropriate) to improve early warning, trend detection, MI automation and control/evidence readiness, with suitable governance and sustainable BAU controls.
* Client Risk Management (Inbound & Outbound) – Post-Sales Servicing Focus; Support the framework to manage inbound client risks, including: client queries, escalations and service disruptions impacting clients; breaches, complaints, operational errors and remediation actions; identification of recurring issues, themes and root causes; governance of client commitments and tracking to closure
* Support the framework to manage outbound client risks, including: governance of client communications/notifications where risk is material (e.g., incidents, key disclosures, change notifications); ensuring agreed approvals, documentation and record-keeping standards are met; tracking and coordinating responses to client-driven assurance requests
* Help embed consistent playbooks for post-sales servicing risks (triage, severity assessment, escalation triggers, communications governance, decisioning and risk acceptance where appropriate).
* Manage governance forums, agendas, packs and decision/action tracking through closure; deliver concise senior-stakeholder MI on current/emerging product and client risks, severity and outlook, incidents, issue ageing, remediation and recurrence, client-outcome/product-performance indicators (KRIs/KPIs/OKRs), and thematic reviews of communications, servicing, resilience and change readiness; standardise reporting definitions, thresholds, taxonomy and escalation triggers for global comparability and actionability.
* Improve MI quality, efficiency and timeliness through trend, outlier and segmentation analytics, actionable insights, standardised dashboards, automated reporting and data controls covering reconciliation, lineage, definitions and ownership; apply AI where appropriate to identify emerging risks through clustering/common-cause analysis, automate packs and commentary with human review and approval, and index/retrieve assurance evidence, supported by documentation, testing, access controls, monitoring and applicable governance.
* Support the end-to-end ISAE reporting lifecycle through audit-ready evidence and documentation, stakeholder input and audit-query coordination, and findings/remediation tracking to closure; use outcomes to prevent repeat observations and improve control clarity, evidence quality and client confidence.
* Support product and client risk management through Risk & Control Assessments (RCA) of client-facing servicing processes and obligations, incident/issue triage, escalation, remediation tracking and lessons learned, client-impact and conduct reviews, and risk appetite monitoring of service stability, issue ageing and communication timeliness/quality.
* Drive continuous process and control improvement through control rationalisation, simplification and standardisation, governance/MI automation, stronger action tracking and shorter identification-to-remediation-to-closure cycles; partner with operations/change teams to embed improvements into BAU with clear ownership and measurable benefits.
* GCB3 SSv NFR Governance & Client Risks Lead (direct manager); SSv Client Coverage/Relationship Management, Product, Operations, Change/Transformation and Control Owners; 2LoD Risk and Compliance (as required); Internal Audit/external assurance (ISAE coordination).
* Deliver senior-ready governance and MI with clear insights, decisions and action follow-through; faster, consistent triage and closure of client-impacting servicing risks/issues; fewer repeat issues through root-cause remediation and stronger evidence; improved ISAE readiness with fewer late evidence gaps, smoother audits and timely findings closure; and measurable efficiencies through MI automation and streamlined governance.
  

**To be successful you will:**

* Strong experience in NFR / business risk & controls / governance / audit / controls roles within a global financial institution; exposure to Securities Services and/or client servicing models preferred.
* Demonstrated experience producing high-quality MI, running governance routines, and driving remediation to closure under senior scrutiny.

* Proven experience in MI analysis, including trend analysis, actionable insights, and turning data into executive-ready narrative; Track record in process optimisation (Lean-style simplification, standardisation and/or automation) with clear outcomes.
* Practical exposure to analytics and AI-enabled tooling to improve reporting, insight generation or operational control/evidence effectiveness (with appropriate governance and controls mindset).
* Strong stakeholder management and the ability to influence across business, operations and risk partners; Clear, concise written communication with sound judgement on escalation and messaging; Structured problem-solving, prioritisation and delivery focus; comfortable operating at pace.
* Strong attention to detail (documentation quality, evidence standards, audit trail, action tracking); Data-literate: comfortable working with dashboards, metrics, trend packs and narrative synthesis.

**Description**

At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd  
  
Treasury is the Vice Presidency, reporting to the Managing Director and World Bank Group Chief Financial Officer, performing treasury functions for the IBRD and IDA and, to varying degrees, for other members of the World Bank Group and other public sector investors. Its activities are organized and grouped into the following departments: Capital Markets & Investment Management, Client Asset Management and Advisory, and Treasury Operations.  
  
Treasury (TRE) has been a large and significant player in the international financial markets for over seventy years and has achieved a global reputation as a prudent and innovative borrower, investor and risk manager. Treasury is responsible for: (i) managing approximately $195 billion in assets for the World Bank and other official sector investors; (ii) leading IBRD’s and IDA’s triple-A rated financing programs in international and domestic bond and derivative markets; (iii) conducting asset and liability management for IBRD’s and IDA’s balance sheets; (iv) overseeing the development and outreach related to the financing and hedging products the Bank provides for its developing-country clients; and (v) collaborating with the World Bank member countries to help build their capacity. Staff in Treasury regularly interact and collaborate with other departments across the Bank and Finance Partners’ teams.  
  
The Treasury Operations Department (TREOP) provides a full range of operational support for Treasury’s asset management, capital markets and banking businesses. The Department is presently organized in 7 operational units: Asset and Liability Operations (TREAL), Quantitative Solutions and Analytics (TREQA), and Cash and Banking Operations (TREBK), Treasury Quantitative Modelling (TREQM), Treasury ALM & Collateral (TREAC), Treasury Market Data and Valuation (TREMV) and a Financial Technology coordination unit (TREFT).  
  
Treasury Asset and Liability Operations (TREAL) is the unit responsible for delivering on a range of operations functions supporting the funding, investment, and asset and liability management portfolios for internal World Bank Group (IBRD, IDA, MIGA, and Trust Funds) entities. In addition, the team supports investment portfolios for a growing roster of more than 60 client entities in domestic and international markets. The team provides integrated and end-to-end support for all trade execution and portfolio servicing activities including trade review, settlement and documentation, options monitoring, debt service and cash and collateral management across the full range of products including bonds, swaps, repos, deposits, and exchange-traded derivatives.  
  
In performing these functions, the team works closely with internal partners and market counterparts as well as external service providers such as technology vendors, custodians, and paying agents. In addition to managing the day-to-day operations, TREAL staff lead the research, coordination, and implementation of new products and markets across Treasury. The team has a heavy focus on, and takes a leadership role in, evaluating and deploying the latest products and technologies (core trading platforms and new initiatives and technologies like CBDC, blockchain, AI, robotics, etc.) to create efficiencies, reduce risk, and advance thought leadership amongst WB’s peers and clients. TREAL staff participate in capacity-building programs for clients in these areas of expertise. TREAL staff recently co-led projects where the World Bank issued innovative digital bonds using blockchain technology and CBDC. In recognition of their efforts to advance capital markets and asset management, the TREAL team received several industry awards including for “Innovation in Reserves Management” (2021) and “Asset Servicing Initiative of the year” (2023). The team has twice been shortlisted for “Operations Team of the Year” award (2023 and 2024).  
  
Treasury ALM & Collateral Operations (TREAC) delivers operations support for asset and liability management, client risk management and collateral activities across IBRD, IDA and IFC. It is the operational engine of Treasury Client Solutions (TCS) and the central collateral management provider for WBG entities and RAMP clients. Team covers the full transaction lifecycle for funding and client hedging transactions, from trade setup and confirmation through settlement, rate fixings, payment events, exception handling, reconciliations and reporting. On the collateral side, it manages margining for OTC derivatives, MBS and futures, including daily margin calls, dispute resolution, CSA agreement administration, and monitoring of valuation.  
  
The team also supports long-term local currency investment transactions through IFC in countries where market solutions are not sufficiently available under the IDA–IFC Private Sector Window. The team works closely with front office, risk, finance, legal and technology teams, and with external counterparties, custodians, brokers and clearing organizations. Operating from Washington, D.C., Chennai and Sofia give the unit time-zone coverage and continuity. Beyond daily operations, TREAC leads systems implementation, convergence and digital transformation, with a strong focus on operational risk, controls and governance. The team operates on a common WBG operating model that aligns with IBRD, IDA and IFC practices, reduces duplication and manual handoffs, and delivers scalable, traceable, automation-ready processes.  
  
**Duties and Accountabilities:**  
The TRE Operations Chennai (TRECH) is an integral part of TREOP and is responsible for a variety of duties providing vital support across its operational divisions. It works closely with the Headquarters in Washington D.C and another shared services center in Sofia, Bulgaria. Under the guidance and supervision of a Team Lead and/or Functional Lead, the incumbent will have responsibilities for specific individual tasks/projects as well as for working as an integral part of the team in executing the Treasury Operation’s work program, while maintaining close relationships with the other Treasury departments.  
  
The incumbent’s primary responsibilities will include, but are not limited to, some combination of the following activities:  
  

* Work closely with the team to understand various facets of post-execution activities for fixed income, derivatives, and cash products to identify, analyze and prioritize process reengineering, automation and streamlining opportunities focusing on enhancing efficiency and accuracy.
* Support data collection, analysis, visualization, and report writing, including by innovatively using data, stories, and analytics to build powerful narratives.

jobs.description:
Portage Point is a Chicago-headquartered advisory, interim management and investment banking firm focused on serving the middle-market. Backed by New Mountain Capital, the firm has grown at over 30% annually since its founding in 2016 and today operates from ten offices across the United States and an office in Gurugram.

The firm delivers integrated financial and operational solutions across Transaction Advisory Services, Transaction Execution Services, Office of the CFO, Valuations, Performance Improvement, Turnaround & Restructuring and Investment Banking. Engagement teams are lean and execution-oriented, working directly with senior stakeholders to navigate complex transaction, transitions and transformations.

Triple P India (TPI) is a strategic extension of the firm's platform, established to build a high-quality team that operates as an integrated part of U.S.-based teams. Professionals in TPI are involved in live engagements from the outset, contributing to analysis, execution and client deliverables in coordination with colleagues across the firm. The platform is designed to provide meaningful responsibility, direct exposure to senior leadership and long-term growth in a high-performance environment.

The Technology function serves as the strategic and operational core of the firm's AI platform – building the enterprise-grade infrastructure, AI product platform and data foundation that power Portage Point's AI-enabled advisory model. The team architects and operates the multi-tenant Portage Point Platform, the Enterprise Data Vault and a portfolio of 15 AI products spanning all practice lines. Working directly with US leadership and practice line leaders, the team translates the firm's ambition – a digital AI version of every advisory capability – into a governed, scalable and commercially deployable technology platform.

The Director, Enterprise Technology Build & Operations will report directly into the CTO, and holds unified accountability for Portage Point corporate technology environment and security posture. As firm scales, there is a need for robust IT operations, security and infrastructure planning and management. This Director ensures the firm's IT foundation is reliable, secure and audit-ready, integrating network and endpoint operations, Microsoft 365 governance, ITSM delivery, Zero Trust security architecture, SOC 2 Type II compliance and AI-specific security controls under a single point of ownership. The role approves IT operations and service management designs, security architecture decisions, vendor engagements and infrastructure implementation decisions within CTO-approved standards.

### **Responsibilities**

* Design and operate enterprise network infrastructure (for e.g. Cisco Meraki, SD-WAN, dual-ISP failover, next-gen firewall) and Microsoft 365 environment (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Microsoft Purview) — covering tenant governance, licensing optimisation, DLP, retention and compliance features; manage the endpoint platform (Intune / Autopilot) including device enrolment, configuration, patch management and Conditional Access compliance enforcement
* Partner with the Head of Innovation and Product Manager on the platform roadmap, product intake from practice lines and release readiness
* Own the ITSM framework (ServiceNow or Jira Service Management) across incident, change, problem, service request and asset management; operate the IT service desk with P1–P4 SLA tiers, CSAT measurement and self-service knowledge base; personally own IT onboarding (Day 1 device, accounts and access) and offboarding (account revocation and access audit) within defined SLAs
* Design and enforce end-to-end security architecture with Zero Trust Network Access, micro-segmentation, Azure AD / Entra ID PIM, Conditional Access, application-layer security (OWASP Top 10 controls for all AI products), encryption, key management (Azure Key Vault) and AI-specific controls covering prompt injection defenses, model access controls and audit trails for all LLM interactions
* Own the SOC 2 Type II program – map platform and corporate IT controls to AICPA Trust Services Criteria, manage gap remediation, coordinate the external audit and produce the SOC 2 report for client and PE sponsor review; maintain TPI's information security policy suite; ensure compliance (personal data mapping, legal basis documentation, breach notification); manage the third-party and vendor risk assessment program
* Design and operate the vulnerability management program (Tenable.io or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management) with automated scanning and enforced remediation SLAs; deploy and operate SIEM (Microsoft Sentinel) for identity, data exfiltration and AI-specific threat detection; own the Incident Response Plan and personally lead all P1 and P2 security incidents
* Lead and develop the combined IT and security team of engineers and analysts; own IT procurement (TCO analysis, with CTO) and the full vendor portfolio; design and test IT BCP and DR procedures; produce monthly ITSM performance review and quarterly security dashboard for the CTO and COO
* Support talent acquisition and firm development efforts
* Lead technical trainings on architecture, data engineering and AI infrastructure
* Contribute to a high-performing and inclusive engineering culture

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree from a top undergraduate program required
* 11 plus years in IT leadership with demonstrated ownership of both corporate IT operations (infrastructure, service management) and cybersecurity (architecture, compliance)
* Experience as the senior IT and security lead in a professional services, advisory or GCC environment; Big Four or comparable advisory GCC experience a strong differentiator
* Located in or willing to relocate to Gurugram, India
* ITIL 4 Managing Professional (or above) and CISSP, CISM or equivalent cybersecurity certification required; must have designed and operated a live ITSM framework and personally owned a SOC 2 Type II program
* Production experience with the Microsoft security stack at scale (500+ users): Entra ID, Conditional Access, PIM, Intune, Microsoft Sentinel, Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Purview; enterprise network infrastructure (Cisco Meraki, SD-WAN, NGFW); ZTNA implementation experiences a differentiator
* ServiceNow or Jira Service Management administration — must have built incident, change and asset management workflows from scratch; hands-on PAM (HashiCorp Vault or CyberArk) and secrets management program ownership; vulnerability scanning and CI / CD security integration (SAST / DAST) experience
* Prior exposure to private equity, M&A, or restructuring transaction environments preferred; ability to collaborate across US and India time zones and willingness to flex working hours for cross-border stakeholder engagement
* Superior written and verbal communication skills, including executive-ready presentation and reporting skills
* Proven ability to thrive in lean, fast-moving teams
* High attention to detail, responsiveness and ownership mindset
* Track record of success in high-pressure, client-facing environments

Own the revenue cycle, cash and controls for UK healthcare organisations, lead the receivables and payables teams, and deputise for the Director, Finance (Healthcare). A senior role in Dubai with real ownership.

About Salvone

Salvone Technology Solutions FZCO is a Dubai technology consultancy that delivers end to end transformation for organisations in healthcare, hospitality and other highly regulated industries. We have deep roots in UK health and social care and a growing presence across the Middle East and Asia.

Our healthcare clients include mental health hospitals, residential and nursing care, supported living, children's services and specialist complex care. In hospitality and F&B, we support multi-location brands with ERP, supply chain and workforce systems built to scale. We own the full journey, from discovery to optimisation, and design every solution around how our clients really operate.

The role

We are hiring a Financial Controller to own the revenue cycle and day-to-day finance operations for the UK healthcare organisations our Finance Healthcare team supports. You will be accountable for cash, billing integrity and financial controls across receivables, payables and banking, lead the teams that deliver them, and deputise for the Director, Finance (Healthcare). It is a senior role with real ownership in a function that is building to a corporate standard.

Reports to

Director, Finance (Healthcare)

What you will do

- Revenue cycle: own it end to end for the UK healthcare entities, from funding and contracts to cash, with full accountability for results.

- Leadership: lead and develop the receivables and payables functions, and set their standards, priorities and performance rhythm.

- Billing integrity: run billing as a controlled monthly close in Odoo, with every variance explained and leakage fixed at source.

- Cash and working capital: improve cash conversion and the aged debt profile, and handle escalated disputes with NHS bodies, ICBs and Local Authorities.

- Controls: own the control environment across receivables, payables and banking, to an audit-ready standard.

- Reporting: give the Director, Finance (Healthcare) a clear, timely view of cash, risk and the decisions needed.

- Deputy: act for the Director, Finance (Healthcare) within delegated authority.

What you bring

- Professionally qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or CPA).

- 6 to 8 years in finance, including at least 2 years leading a team.

- Proven ownership of a revenue cycle or receivables function in a multi-entity business, with measurable impact on cash.

- Strong control and close discipline; comfortable leading audit work.

- Advanced ERP capability (Odoo preferred), including process and reporting design.

- Senior stakeholder presence: credible with senior stakeholders, funders and banks.

Nice to have

- UK health and social care funding (NHS, ICBs, Local Authorities, Continuing Healthcare, self-funders); we teach this during induction.

- Experience with healthcare billing or practice management systems.

- GBP accounting and supporting UK operations from overseas.

- External audit support and building finance processes from scratch.

Working pattern and location

Full time, on site, Monday to Friday, 10:00 to 19:00.

Armada Tower 2, Jumeirah Lake Towers (JLT), Dubai.

How to apply

Please apply through our careers page using this link:

https://careers.salvone.com/jobs/financial-controller-255?utm\_campaign=Job+Campaign&utm\_medium=Website&utm\_source=Indeed+-+paid+ad

We review every application and will contact you about next steps. Questions? Email careers@salvone.com.

* Have you led a finance team for at least 2 years? Please give the team size and your role.
* Have you worked with Odoo? If yes, which versions and modules?

Experience:

* Finance: 6 years (Preferred)

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Visa is transforming the future of banking and payments through Pismo, Visa's cloud-native core banking and issuer processing platform. Built to help financial institutions modernize legacy infrastructure, launch innovative products faster, and scale securely in real time, Pismo is enabling the next generation of digital banking experiences across the globe.

As an Implementation Director, you will lead the successful delivery of some of Visa and Pismo's most strategic client transformation programs. Working with leading banks, fintechs, and financial institutions, you will be responsible for orchestrating large-scale platform implementations that redefine how clients issue cards, process transactions, manage accounts, and deliver modern payment experiences to their customers.

This is a highly visible leadership role that sits at the intersection of technology, payments, and transformation. You will act as the executive sponsor for complex implementation programs, partnering with senior client stakeholders and cross-functional Visa and Pismo teams to drive delivery excellence, mitigate risk, and accelerate value realization.

The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking, executive stakeholder management, and deep program leadership capabilities to guide clients through critical modernization journeys, helping them move from legacy platforms to cloud-native infrastructure that supports future growth and innovation.

* Technical knowledge of payments and banking platforms operating in the cloud in a microservice architecture, with REST/JSON API’s and data streaming.
* Educational background in solutions architecture and software engineering. Cloud certifications are a plus.
* Having completed a core banking, payments transformation implementation from contract signature to production live.
* Expertise in building and scaling high-performing teams, with a hands-on leadership style that emphasizes mentorship, empowerment, and a culture of accountability.

**Role Overview**
Fortinet is seeking a senior Global Account Manager to lead the strategic relationship with Etisalat Group worldwide, developing its potential as both a major enterprise customer and a strategic service-provider partner.
  
  
The role brings together two complementary growth strategies: sell-to, expanding Fortinet’s contribution to the Group’s own cybersecurity and infrastructure priorities; and sell-with, building joint propositions and go-to-market programmes that bring Fortinet-powered services to its customers.
  
  
The successful candidate will own the overarching global account strategy, build executive sponsorship and lead coordinated execution across Fortinet teams, Group functions, business units and operating companies. The role requires the ability to translate a complex multinational relationship into a focused business plan, strategic commercial agreements and measurable growth.
  
  
The Global Account Manager provides strategic leadership across local quota-carrying account owners, aligning priorities and enabling execution without replacing their direct sales accountability. Local account owners retain responsibility for their assigned quotas, opportunities and forecasts; the Global Account Manager leads the consolidated Group strategy, executive engagement and cross-market growth agenda.

**Job Summary**

* The Executive Director, Client Coverage, Public Sector is the strategic adviser and relationship lead for a portfolio of major public sector clients, primarily across the Middle East (GCC Region). The portfolio includes central banks, ministries of finance, government entities and agencies, export credit and development agencies, multilateral organisations, regional development banks and selected development organisations. The role is accountable for developing senior client relationships, originating and delivering relevant solutions across Transaction Banking, Financial Markets and Global Banking, and achieving sustainable revenues and returns while maintaining strong credit, financial crime, conduct and regulatory risk discipline. The role also supports the regional team head on origination and client engagement across the region and selectively develops approved prospect relationships.

**Portfolio Strategy And Financial Performance**

* Lead client strategies through disciplined account planning and deliver agreed revenue, profitability, RoRWA and franchise objectives for the designated portfolio.

**Origination And Trusted-adviser Coverage**

* Build senior relationships up to ministerial and C-suite level, anticipate client needs, originate new business and position the Bank as a consistent strategic partner rather than a transactional provider.

**Integrated Client Solutions**

* Mobilise Transaction Banking, Financial Markets, Global Banking, structuring, advisory and industry partners to deliver relevant solutions, deepen inbound flows and selectively deploy balance sheet where supported by appropriate ancillary returns and Group economics.

**Sustainable And Innovative Finance**

* Originate and structure sustainable finance solutions including debt-for-nature, debt-for-development and sustainable loans, and replicate successful structures across the public sector segment.

**Risk, Compliance And Portfolio Stewardship**

* Own client acceptance and ongoing risk management, including AML, CDD and credit; maintain accurate account plans, call reports and deal pipelines; identify, escalate and resolve conduct, regulatory, reputational and credit issues.

**Market Insight And Franchise Development**

* Maintain strong knowledge of political, macroeconomic, country-risk and industry developments; bring international best practice, investment opportunities and thought leadership to clients; support investor roadshows, RFPs and industry engagement.

**Collaboration And Execution**

* Maintain effective relationships with Country and Cluster leadership, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Client Management and product teams; ensure timely meeting notes, coordinated execution and high-quality client outcomes across the Bank network.

**Role Scope**

* This is a senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports. The role holder is expected to contribute to team capability, knowledge sharing, diversity initiatives and the development of colleagues through informal coaching and collaboration.

**Individual Contribution and Team Leadership**

* Operate as a senior individual contributor, providing leadership through client judgement, execution discipline and collaboration across the regional Public Sector franchise.
* Invest in personal development, share knowledge and support the development of colleagues through coaching, inclusive teamwork and participation in learning and diversity initiatives.
* Maintain mandatory learning, professional development and risk-awareness standards applicable to the role.
* Share sector, thematic and market insights with clients and internal partners to strengthen strategic engagement and the Bank’s market position.

**Motivations**

* Strategic client impact: Energised by solving complex public sector priorities and building trusted relationships with senior government, central bank and development-institution stakeholders.
* Origination and innovation: Motivated by creating commercially sound, differentiated solutions across financing, markets, transaction banking and sustainable finance.
* International collaboration: Thrives in a cross-border environment that requires judgement, resilience, teamwork and effective mobilisation of the Bank’s network.

**Key Experiences, Qualifications And Languages**

* Relevant banking experience, preferably in senior relationship management, origination or sales covering public sector, sovereign, financial institution or development-finance clients.
* Regional market knowledge and exposure is critical.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex client relationships, originating cross-product opportunities and coordinating execution across Transaction Banking, Financial Markets and Global Banking.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Banking, Finance, Economics, Business or a related discipline preferred.
* Strong knowledge of credit, AML, CDD, conduct and regulatory requirements. Any market-specific licence required to undertake banking business must be maintained.

Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
  
  
**What We Offer**

jobs.title: Growth (French speaking)
jobs.description:
**About Column**
For companies building financial technology and transforming the financial services space, the biggest bottleneck to their growth and innovation is often the underlying banks and infrastructure stack they rely on. We have spent our careers founding and scaling companies like Plaid, Square, Meta, Blend, and Affirm, and have seen this problem firsthand — builders and developers needing to partner with traditional banks, and creating API and abstraction layers over the patchwork that is the bank, its core, and many other vendors. All of this results in a complex (and often expensive) banking supply chain involving a user, fintech, BaaS middleware provider, bank, core and the Federal Reserve.
  
  
At Column, we set out to simplify and fix this. We are a bank and a software company built from the ground up, offering builders and developers technology-forward banking solutions that cut out the hundreds of vendors, middleware providers, and abstraction layers. This means a safer, more transparent, and less costly banking supply chain. Come build with us!
  
  
**The opportunity**
Column's Growth team is focused on managing our highly strategic customer relationships. As a member of the Growth team, you’ll be responsible for building and overseeing all aspects of our customer management while acting as a trusted partner, advisor and advocate for a wide variety of customers. You will also be in charge of designing and implementing the strategy, processes, and content needed to help us scale this key function.
  
  
This role has a unique international focus, helping build one of Column's most strategic expansion initiatives from the ground up. At least have of your work will be dedicated to building and managing partnerships with banks across Africa. The rest of your time will go to working with Column's core fintech partners.
  
  
Column's Growth team is not your typical Customer Success or Account Management team in that Column is a critical, often existential, partner for our customers, our customer relationships are deeply collaborative and complex, and each customer contributes meaningfully to our revenue. We're therefore looking for team members who are analytical, demonstrate great critical thinking, and have experience managing very strategic relationships.
  
  
This role is highly cross-functional and collaborative, partnering closely with Column’s Executive, Solutions Engineering, Sales, Compliance, and Correspondent Banking teams to ensure customers are onboarded smoothly, that we can anticipate and address both issues and opportunities for growth, and that these relationships are healthy and mutually beneficial. You’ll also represent the voice of the customer to help inform Column's strategy, including the product roadmap, go-to-market motions and more.
  
  
Success in this role also means having a desire to become an expert on the Financial Technology space and on how companies partner with Column (our customers include many key industry players such as Brex and Carta).
  
  
**This role reports to the Head of Growth and is an in-person role based out of Dubai, UAE. We will help secure any required visas.**
**What You’ll Do**

* Help establish our customer-facing strategy, processes, playbooks, systems and best practices. Identify patterns and build repeatability at every step
* Manage all aspects of a customer’s relationship with Column, from onboarding and implementation to ongoing management and expansion of the account
* Onboard and manage our emerging markets bank partners: Serve as the day-to-day lead for banks across Africa. Guide them through onboarding and own the ongoing relationship once they’re live.
* Build and nurture relationships across various functions within a customer's organization, identifying and creating advocates wherever you go, and helping find new use cases for partnering with Column
* Proactively identify challenges and opportunities for growth, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to find solutions in order to move the relationship forward
* Share key findings and recommendations on market feedback and trends to inform Column’s growth strategy and product roadmap
* Perform day-to-day activities consistent with safe and sound business practices and regulatory requirements
* This role includes periodic travel to Africa to meet with our bank partners in person.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful**

* 5+ years of relevant work experience -- strong preference for a mix of Consulting, Private Equity, Investment Banking, VC or an equivalent role plus operating experience in an early stage company and/or selling a new line of business
* Professional fluency in French and English required
* A desire to become very knowledgeable on the financial technology and payments space. Prior experience in financial services can be helpful but certainly not required
* A growth and critical thinking mindset: You’re comfortable navigating ambiguous environments and are energized by the prospect of helping build processes with little guidance
* Excellent project management: You’re organized, can manage all aspects of partnering with customers, and effectively work with other internal teams
* Ability to turn naysayers into champions: You’re a persuasive communicator and understand the importance of being helpful, responsive, and solutions-oriented
* Curiosity: You know what questions to ask to uncover and understand customer needs and proactively learn more about the industry, competitive landscape, and product offerings to better support your customers
* Insatiable hunger for improvement: you’re a naturally curious person, enjoy digging into the data, and regularly solicit feedback

**What You’ll Get From Us**

* 🏥 Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans, including options that are 100% covered by Column for you and 100% covered for your dependents!
* 🌴 Competitive time-off policy - take the time off that you want and need to relax and recharge
* 🧳 Sabbatical Program - Reach your 5-year anniversary to take up to 8 weeks of fully paid leave to rest, recharge, and pursue personal interest - with full salary and benefits
* 👶 100% paid parental leave, including 16 weeks for birth mothers, 12 weeks for primary caregivers, and 8 weeks for secondary caregivers
* 🎉 Regular team building events, including annual offsite

**We look forward to hearing from you**
Column is committed to working with the best and brightest people from the broadest talent pool possible. We value bringing together a team with different perspectives, educational backgrounds, and life experiences, and believe a diversity of ideas is what allows us to develop the best solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
  
  
If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application and recruiting process, please reach out to accommodations@column.com.
  
  
We participate in the E-Verify program in certain locations as required by law. Learn more about the E-Verify program here.

* Expand and deepen the Visa Government Solutions public sector strategy and commercial pipeline across UAE, developing and maintaining a prioritized portfolio of clients, use cases and solution opportunities.
