jobs.title: Head of Delivery, AI & Automation
jobs.description:
**Why we exist**
Most enterprise operations still run on people copying data between systems, chasing emails and working around tools that don't talk to each other. We're the Matterway team inside Cognizant, and we're changing that by running hybrid operations where people and AI agents work the same processes side by side. Our own platform makes this work with the systems and vendors our clients already have, and we've proven it on our own operations first.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
You'll run our client delivery, leading several intercultural squads of project and programme managers, engineers and specialists who deliver real savings on our clients' P&L. You'll make sure every squad delivers, jump in when a programme wobbles, and build the team and ways of working that let us grow without slowing down.
  
  
You'll report directly to our Head of Technology, a Matterway co-founder who also leads product, and own delivery end to end: outcomes, capacity, team shape, hiring and how we work.
  
  
**Your week**
**Delivering for clients**

* Own a portfolio of client programmes, each landing its committed outcome on time and on budget.
* Guide your squad leads from planning through delivery to handover.
* Match capacity to demand and decide who works on what.
* Be the person squads call when things get hard, and keep clients happy.

Running and improving the machine
  
  

* Own the delivery budget, P&L and business case, and keep leadership in the loop.
* Run the rhythm that keeps delivery healthy: design reviews, health checks, status and client satisfaction reporting.
* Keep improving and automating how we work, including how we use AI and agentic tools.

**Building the team**

* Own hiring end to end, from deciding what the team needs to the final interview, and keep raising the bar with Cognizant recruiters and partners.
* Get Cognizant's delivery teams up to speed when they take over programmes from us.
* Coach and grow your squad leads and team through 1-1s, mentoring and real career paths, and hold everyone, yourself included, to high standards.

Connecting with product and go-to-market
  
  

* Bring client insight back to the product team, and help sales shape new deals.
* Help set and hit our company OKRs.

**You'll thrive here if you have**

* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Curiosity, drive and resilience, with an optimistic outlook on life and a realistic one on delivery.
* 8+ years in client-facing delivery, including 3+ years leading delivery teams.
* A record of landing complex programmes on budget and growing strong teams.
* An international mindset and proven experience working in intercultural teams.
* A strong commercial instinct for budgets, margins and resourcing.
* Experience in or with large enterprises, ideally in fast-moving teams inside them.
* Early-adopter experience with agentic AI, using it regularly to improve your own work.
* A love of solving problems, treating them as opportunities rather than obstacles.
* A habit of owning outcomes end to end, including the unglamorous parts.

jobs.title: Delivery Leader
jobs.description:
The Delivery Leader turns five separate SHI towers into one seamless BluBiz-branded service,

owning end-to-end delivery outcomes rather than individual towers.

As the customer base, service catalogue and technical complexity grow, a tower-by-tower

model creates friction: incidents bounce between Service Desk, NOC, SOC and/or CloudOps;

projects hand over to run teams without readiness; and BluBiz has no single owner to hold to

account. This role closes those gaps.

The role exists to:

• Be the single accountable face of SHI delivery to BluBiz leadership.

• Integrate operations and projects into one service model, one governance rhythm and

one view of performance.

• Protect the white-label promise: BluBiz's end customers experience one brand, one

standard, no seams.

• Grow the partnership by turning operational insight into new services and revenue for

both companies.

Integrated delivery model · 5 towers, 1 leader

The leader sits between BluBiz and the five SHI towers and owns the shared layer that makes

them one service: governance, integrated ops, automation, knowledge and people.

**Key responsibilities**

1.
**Operations leadership**

• Own end-to-end service performance across NOC, SOC, SD & DC Ops and Cloud.

• Run one integrated major incident and problem management process, with clear cross tower ownership and escalation.

• Ensure consistent Succession management, People management and Service Level Operations as per the SOW

• Lead onboarding of new BluBiz customers into managed services with a repeatable transition playbook.

**2. Governance and client management**

• Run the governance cadence with BluBiz: weekly operations reviews, monthly service reviews, quarterly business reviews (QBRs).

• Own the integrated scorecard: SLAs, XLAs, risks, issues, changes and improvement backlog in one view.

• Support BluBiz in front of its end customers when needed

**3. Professional services and transition**

• Govern the PS projects (migrations, upgrades, implementations, integrations) for scope, schedule, margin and quality.

• Work with presales, solutions engineer, delivery resources and SME’s/PMO to maintain harmony and timelines

• Own the "project-to-run" handover wherever applicable

**4. People and capability**

• Lead tower leads as one leadership team with shared goals, not five silos.

• Plan capacity, shift coverage, skills and succession;

• Build a culture of ownership, customer empathy for Australian end users, and continuous improvement.

**5. Commercial and financial management**

• Own the account P&L: revenue, gross margin, and employee productivity

• Forecast demand and resourcing; manage change requests, renewals and pricing inputs.

**6. Transformation and growth**

• Lead with automation roadmap to improve service and lower cost.

• Spot new service opportunities from operational data and co-develop offers with BluBiz.

• Bring SHI's wider capabilities and OEM alliances to BluBiz's pipeline.

jobs.title: Consulting Practice Leader

Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
People Management
  
  
Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring.
  
  
Model - Live our culture; Embody our values; Practice our leadership principles.
  
  
Coach - Define team objectives and outcomes; Enable success across boundaries; Help the team adapt and learn.
  
  
Care - Attract and retain great people; Know each individual’s capabilities and aspirations; Invest in the growth of others.
  
  
Customer Focus
  
  
Creates a customer-centric culture within the practice that drives digital transformation and ensures customer satisfaction across the entire operating unit by maintaining stakeholder relationships, reviewing and acting on voice of customer (VoC) feedback (e.g., surveys, listening systems), sharing learnings across practices, alleviating customer blockers as a point of escalation, and sponsoring systemic improvements to the customer experience across workstreams. Holds accountability for portfolio, account, and financial management in presales and delivery. Owns highly strategic and complex customer relationships. Leads direct engagements with large, complex customers and serves as a delivery sponsor for a select number of assigned customers. Supports strategic relationships with key stakeholders in the customer portfolio, often as part of a steering committee, to ensure service delivery is on track and major issues are being anticipated, identified, and managed. Establishes accountabilities to drive customer outcomes and ensure internal stakeholders are in place.
  
  
Alleviates customer blockers as a point of escalation by working with direct reports and key stakeholders to manage customer escalations and resolve issues at the practice level. Ensures that customer opportunities, questions, and/or issues are brought to the appropriate internal teams (e.g., Sales, Architects).
  
  
Develops and maintains highly complex business relationships through conversations and in-person customer engagements, leveraging in-depth knowledge of customer's business and industry. Ensures relationship plans are part of account strategic plans and acts as an executive sponsor to maintain senior-level relationships across their business. Communicates current view of delivery to customer executives on a regular cadence, as appropriate. Supports new, high-impact customer opportunities in partnership with Sales with highly significant or global impacts for Microsoft.
  
  
For assigned customers and for their team, supports guidance of customers/partners through relevant change initiatives and leverages core change-management methods and techniques. For assigned customers and for their team, supports management of changes (e.g., negotiations, change requests, amendments, customer expectations) while overseeing financial accountability and overall responsibility between Microsoft and the client. 
  
  
Strategy
  
  
As needed, develops and executes a large, complex (e.g., global account, cross-territory impact) plan for their practice and assigned customers to achieve consumption metrics and revenue targets (e.g., delivered, billed, consumed) by supporting the team, collaborating with internal partners, and driving culture.
  
  
Establishes and drives rhythm of business (ROB) around consumption by managing financials (e.g., Enterprise Cloud Investment Funds [ECIFs], internal investments).
  
  
Oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all-up delivery of consulting engagements. Serves as a proven thought leader on the direction of the consulting offerings portfolio for a large, complex practice, leveraging insights from reports (e.g., efficiency, operations), internal team members, and across organizational boundaries. Develops and implements a strategic portfolio-wide plan to achieve targets by leading intentional delivery activities and leveraging intellectual property (IP) for reuse.
  
  
Promotes Industry Solution Delivery (ISD) consumption strategy with regional perspective by articulating ISD consumption strategy, goals, and mission to internal and external audiences, and aligning practice strategy with the customer and other internal organization objectives (e.g., Consulting Sales, Go-To-Market).
  
  
Supports sales activities (e.g., close planning, delivery sponsorship, strategy, management) to support the lifecycle of deals for a large practice, leveraging prior experience and expertise. As needed, negotiates, collaborates on, reviews, and contributes to deal approval processes, sometimes challenging deal construct to ensure Microsoft initiatives are incorporated appropriately. When appropriate, innovates and implements long-term, strategic plans, in partnership with Sales to create new opportunities and sustainable growth for customer accounts across the portfolio. Ensures delivery team alignment and holds delivery team accountable for delivering on sales strategy.
  
  
Collaborates on highly strategic (e.g., high profile) captures by ensuring a strategic capture plan, engaging the resources needed for pre-sales, and supporting the global pursuit team in winning large-contract deals.
  
  
Acts as an innovative agent of change by working within leadership communities to define and sponsor organizational change, driving consistent messaging and support to land organizational change initiatives within and across practices, and providing feedback on organization information/initiatives.
  
  
Delivery Excellence
  
  
Orchestrates a large cross-functional team to drive high-impact business growth, profitability, utilization, maturity, quality, etc., through delivery by developing a rhythm of business (ROB), fostering a culture of manager excellence, promoting teamwork and collaboration, recognizing and aligning team strengths to capability needs, and leveraging diverse perspectives to understand customers. Governs areas of fiscal responsibility, through delivery team, staying within budget while driving engagement profitability and risk management.
  
  
Ensures delivery excellence and maximizes efficiency of resources for a large practice by managing complex scopes and budgets, balancing funding and resources across workstreams, communicating resource needs (e.g., hiring, resource planning, capacity) with the business, collaborating to meet those needs, and leveraging in-depth resource-management experience and expertise.
  
  
Creates a problem solving climate across teams that resolves complex or high-impact delivery issues across lifecycle of deal (e.g., lead to order, order to cash, resourcing, pricing, invoicing, proof of execution) through cross-cultural collaboration and partnerships (e.g., Selling partners) to ensure sustained delivery quality. Interfaces at high levels in organization (e.g., executives) to resolve critical issues (e.g., subsidiary, worldwide issues).
  
  
Applies governance controls to mitigate and manage risks and ensure policy compliance in delivery and sales. Models and holds team accountable for execution and adherence to Microsoft Consulting processes (e.g., Enterprise Consulting Authorization Policy, Delivery excellence processes/procedures, time tracking/approvals). jobs.title: Senior Director, AI and Data Platform Delivery
jobs.description:
**Our Company:**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Director of AI and Data Platform Delivery is a senior leadership role accountable for
**end‑to‑end execution of Teradata’s foundational AI and data platform offerings**
, which underpin the company’s hybrid, multi‑cloud, and on‑premises solutions. This role is critical to ensuring that Teradata’s
**platform continues to scale, modernize, and reliably support customer workloads**
, while enabling company growth through platform differentiation, adoption, and expansion.
  
  
This leader owns the
**execution strategy, operating model, and talent development**
for a combined organization of
**Technical Program Managers (TPMs)**
and
**Global Program Managers (GPMs)**
. Together, these teams drive coordinated execution across the end-to-end
**New Product Introduction (NPI) process**
, ensuring that new platform elements are fully productized, operationally ready, and commercially viable.
  
  
Success in this role is measured by
**platform delivery predictability, quality, scalability, and business impact**
, rather than ownership of individual programs.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**
**Platform Execution & Growth Enablement**

* Own execution outcomes for significant areas of Teradata’s core data platform and AI roadmap, including platform modernization, scalability enhancements, cloud parity, and operational hardening.
* Be accountable for execution work that enables Teradata’s growth and retention targets, including platform readiness for new use cases, expansions, and customer adoption.
* Translate product and platform strategy into integrated execution plans that balance stability, innovation, customer commitments, and long‑term technical health.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and Commercial leadership to align platform execution with market needs, competitive positioning, and revenue objectives.
* Provide execution transparency and decision support to senior leadership for tradeoffs impacting delivery, quality, and customer trust.

**End‑to‑End New Product Introduction (NPI) Leadership**

* Lead the global NPI execution model for core and AI platform capabilities from concept through general availability and sustained customer adoption.
* Ensure cross‑functional coordination across:

+ Definition, development, and testing
+ Product setup, configuration, and entitlement
+ Legal, compliance, and contractual readiness
+ Pricing, packaging, and lifecycle management
+ Go‑to‑market readiness (Sales, Marketing, Solution Architects)
+ Cloud Operations, infrastructure, and SRE readiness
+ Customer support, field enablement, and documentation

* Establish scalable, repeatable NPI mechanisms that support frequent platform releases and long‑lived customer environments.

**Technical & Platform Leadership**

* Provide technical and execution leadership across large‑scale, distributed, data‑intensive platforms, spanning cloud, hybrid, and on‑prem deployments.
* Guide teams through complex platform delivery challenges involving performance, reliability, scalability, security, upgrade paths, and operational continuity.
* Ensure cross‑team technical and operational risks are proactively identified, clearly owned, and mitigated.
* Partner with senior engineering and architecture leaders to ensure execution plans align with long‑term platform sustainability and customer trust.
* Co-own with engineering platform economics and cost‑to‑serve by influencing execution tradeoffs that impact margin, scaling limits, and long‑term pricing power.
* Co-own with engineering and product the platform lifecycle governance and technical debt liquidation at the portfolio level.

**People & Organizational Leadership**

* Build, lead, and scale a high‑impact organization of Technical Program Managers and Global Program Managers.
* Clearly define and reinforce roles and interfaces between TPMs (engineering‑centric delivery) and GPMs (cross‑functional, post‑code, market and operational readiness).
* Own hiring, performance management, development, and succession planning for the platform execution organization.
* Develop senior TPM and GPM leaders capable of operating effectively at enterprise scale and high ambiguity.
* Establish clear leveling, expectations, and promotion readiness standards for both TPM and GPM career paths.

**Influence, Communication & Executive Partnership**

* Act as a trusted execution advisor to senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Cloud Operations, Sales Engineering, Legal, and Customer organizations.
* Communicate platform execution health, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs clearly at the VP and executive level.
* Drive alignment across a highly matrixed organization supporting long‑lived, mission‑critical customer environments.
* Provide executive clarity during high‑impact incidents, major releases, or customer‑sensitive platform transitions.

**Required Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering leadership, product operations, or related technical roles.
* 5+ years of experience leading senior technical and program management professionals.
* Proven success delivering large‑scale, enterprise data platform initiatives.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, database platforms, cloud infrastructure, and hybrid architectures.
* Demonstrated ability to drive execution that supports business growth, customer retention, and platform adoption.
* Exceptional executive‑level communication and influence skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience delivering or operating enterprise data platforms in cloud and hybrid environments.
* Background supporting platform modernization, cloud transitions, or large customer migrations.
* Experience building or scaling global NPI and release governance models.
* Familiarity with operational excellence, SRE practices, and enterprise reliability expectations.

**What Success Looks Like**
A successful Senior Director of AI and Data Platform Delivery:
  
  

* Enables Teradata to deliver and evolve its core platform with predictability and confidence.
* Holds the organization to best-in-breed standards across delivery quality, platform performance, and operational reliability — ensuring Teradata's core data platform earns a reputation for excellence.
* Scales execution capabilities to support platform growth, modernization, and increased customer demand.
* Ensures platform capabilities are fully productized, operationally ready, and commercially viable.
* Builds a strong TPM and GPM organization trusted across Product, Engineering, and GTM teams.
* Directly supports Teradata’s growth and retention goals by strengthening the foundation of its data platform.

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

Chubb is a world leader in insurance. With operations in 54 countries and territories, Chubb provides commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance and life insurance to a diverse group of clients. Technology

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* 15+ years of experience combining insurance domain depth and technology leadership.

We invest in the future of our employees through continuous learning opportunities and career advancement programs, while fostering a supportive and inclusive work environment. Our benefits include:

**Delivery Head**

**Location - Ahmedabad, India (on-site; travel to client geographies as needed)**

**Experience- 10+ years in software services, 6+ years leading multi-account delivery**

**Scope- Full delivery P&L across all practices: AI, Enterprise Platforms, Data Engineering, Custom Software,CRM,CMS**

**The role-**

The Head of Delivery owns every client engagement from signed SOW to renewal: scope, schedule, quality, margin and client satisfaction. This is a new leadership role, created to give our portfolio a single accountable owner as we scale AI-led and multi-system programs.

You will run delivery as a business, not a reporting function. You own the delivery P&L, the delivery operating model, and the managers who run our accounts. You collaborate with the CEO, who owns client relationships and new business, and with the CTO, who owns technology strategy, architecture standards and engineering practices.

**Key responsibilities:**

**Portfolio and P&L-**

· Own delivery revenue, gross margin and utilization across all active engagements.

· Run monthly portfolio reviews covering health, burn, forecast, risk and margin for every account.

· Approve staffing plans and resource allocation across fixed-price, time-and-materials and dedicated-team models.

· Cut revenue leakage: unbilled effort, scope creep, bench cost and write-offs.

**Delivery operating model-**

· Define and enforce one delivery framework: governance cadence, status reporting, change control, RAID management and release readiness.

· Set delivery KPIs and make them visible to leadership weekly.

· Embed AI-assisted delivery practices (planning, estimation, testing, documentation) in collaboration with the CTO.

· Standardize estimation so fixed-price bids reflect real delivery data.

**Client delivery governance-**

· Act as the senior escalation point for delivery issues and recover at-risk programs.

· Run delivery-side steering committees and quarterly reviews with client stakeholders, alongside the CEO.

· Turn delivery performance into expansion: surface phase-2 and adjacent opportunities to the CEO.

**Pre-sales support-**

· Validate scope, estimates, team shape and delivery risk on every proposal and SOW before it is signed.

· Join solutioning calls for large or high-risk deals.

**People and leadership-**

· Lead, hire and develop delivery and project managers; build a bench of account-level leaders.

· Run performance reviews and succession planning for the delivery organization.

· Work with HR and practice heads on capacity planning, skills mix and hiring forecasts.

**Quality and compliance-**

· Ensure delivery meets security and compliance obligations (GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2 where applicable) and client audit requirements.

· Run post-mortems on failed milestones and drive the fixes into the framework.

**Must-have requirements:**

· 10+ years in IT services or product engineering services, with 6+ years leading delivery across multiple concurrent client accounts.

· Has owned a delivery organization of 150+ engineers.

· Direct P&L accountability: has been measured on margin and utilization, not only on schedule.

· Has run fixed-price, time-and-materials and dedicated-team engagements and can explain where each one loses money.

· Has delivered for enterprise clients in the US, UK, Europe or Middle East, including C-level stakeholder management.

· Has turned around at least one failing program; can describe what was changed and the result.

· Hands-on with delivery governance: estimation, change control, RAID, SOW review and resource planning tools.

· Technical enough to challenge an architecture or estimate; engineering background strongly preferred.

· Bachelor's degree in engineering or computer science.

· Delivery leadership on AI/ML, GenAI or data engineering programs taken to production.

· Experience with Salesforce, SAP, NetSuite or HubSpot implementation programs.

### **About the Role**

Inc42 is looking for a Sales Manager – Events & IPs to drive sponsorship and partnership revenue across its events, conferences, communities and proprietary intellectual properties.

The role will focus on acquiring new brand partners, identifying sponsorship opportunities and building customised partnership proposals for companies looking to engage with India's startup and business ecosystem.

The ideal candidate should have a strong background in B2B sales and business development, with experience selling sponsorships, event partnerships, advertising solutions or other high-value B2B offerings. They should be comfortable pitching to marketing heads, founders, CXOs and senior decision-makers, and have the ability to take ownership of the complete sales cycle.

**Experience:** 4–6 years of experience in B2B sales, business development or sponsorship sales, preferably across events, media, publishing, experiential marketing agencies, advertising agencies or consulting firms. Front-end experience of selling to startups, technology companies and/or BFSI companies is mandatory.

### **Why This Role Is Unique**

**Impact:** Inc42's platforms collectively reach more than 300 Mn people online and have brought together over 50,000 attendees and 1,000 speakers. You will be responsible for building commercial partnerships across some of India's most influential startup and business events.

**Inc42 Network:** Engage directly with founders, CXOs, marketing leaders, investors and decision-makers across startups, enterprises,and consulting firms.

**Own a Revenue Vertical:** Drive sponsorship and partnership revenue across Inc42's flagship events, conferences, communities and proprietary IPs. Take ownership of pipeline creation, client acquisition, deal closure, receivables and account growth.

**Build Strategic Partnerships:** Work with brands to create meaningful associations with Inc42's platforms through sponsorships, event integrations, customised experiences and long-term partnerships.

### **About Inc42 Media**

Inc42 is India's #1 startup media and intelligence platform, informing, educating and empowering startup founders, business leaders and decision-makers through journalism, market intelligence, industry-leading events, executive communities and learning platforms.

Since launching in January 2015, Inc42 has grown into an authoritative voice on India's startup economy. Our reporting has been followed and cited by leading global publications, including The Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg, Reuters and TechCrunch.

Today, Inc42 tracks over 50,000 startups and delivers market intelligence through in-depth research reports, while bringing together the startup ecosystem through some of India's most influential conferences, executive communities and leadership experiences.

Over the years, Inc42 has built several business platforms and communities, including Inc42 Plus, Griffin Club and D2CX, creating opportunities for founders, operators, investors and business leaders to connect and engage.

### **What You'll Do**

**1. Business Development & Sponsorship Sales**

* **New Business Development:** Identify and acquire new sponsors and brand partners across startups, technology companies, BFSI, large enterprises and consumer brands.
* **Sponsorship Sales:** Drive revenue by selling sponsorship opportunities, event integrations, brand partnerships and customised association packages across Inc42's conferences and events including the D2C & Retail Summit and AI Summit, among others.
* **Pipeline Ownership:** Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective sponsors through market research, outbound prospecting, networking, referrals and industry connections.
* **Revenue Targets:** Own monthly and quarterly sales targets and drive revenue across assigned events, communities and IPs.
* **Consultative Selling:** Understand client marketing objectives and identify relevant opportunities for brands to engage with Inc42's audience through sponsorships, partnerships and event-led experiences.
* **Deal Closure:** Manage the complete sales cycle, including prospecting, pitching, proposal development, negotiations, closure and receivables.
* **Conceptualising Partnerships:** Work with internal teams to develop customised sponsorship ideas and brand integrations beyond standard event sponsorship packages.

**2. Account Management & Partnerships**

* **Client Relationships:** Build and maintain relationships with marketing heads, brand managers, founders, CXOs and other key decision-makers.
* **Account Growth:** Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities across Inc42's events, communities and other IPs to increase revenue from existing clients.
* **Partnership Delivery:** Coordinate with event, marketing, content, production and operations teams to ensure that sponsorship commitments and brand deliverables are executed as agreed.
* **Long-term Partnerships:** Build a strong portfolio of recurring clients and strategic brand partnerships across multiple Inc42 properties.
* **Client Feedback:** Gather feedback from partners, identify opportunities to improve sponsorship offerings and build case studies and testimonials.

**3. Sales Strategy & Market Development**

* **Market Research:** Track industry trends, competitor events, sponsorship opportunities and brand marketing spends to identify potential revenue opportunities.
* **Partnership Strategy:** Identify brands and categories that align with Inc42's events, communities and audience, and develop relevant partnership propositions.
* **Competitive Benchmarking:** Monitor competing conferences, media platforms and event properties to understand sponsorship models, pricing and market positioning.
* **New Revenue Streams:** Identify opportunities to build new partnerships and monetisation avenues across Inc42's existing and upcoming IPs.
* **Pipeline Analysis:** Maintain accurate sales forecasts, pipeline reports and revenue tracking. Share client insights and market feedback with internal teams to improve offerings and commercial strategy.

### **Who We Are Looking For**

* **Experience:** 4–6 years of experience in B2B sales, business development or sponsorship sales, preferably in events, media, publishing, experiential marketing, advertising agencies or consulting.
* **Industry Exposure:** Prior front-end sales experience with startups, technology companies and/or BFSI clients is mandatory.
* **Sponsorship & Partnership Sales:** Experience in selling event sponsorships, brand partnerships, conference integrations, media properties or other B2B solutions will be preferred.
* **New Business Acquisition:** A proven track record of generating new business, building a pipeline and achieving revenue targets.
* **Consultative Selling:** Ability to understand brand objectives and develop customised sponsorship and partnership proposals.
* **Relationship Management:** Comfortable engaging with founders, CXOs, marketing heads, brand managers and senior business stakeholders.
* **Commercial Acumen:** Strong negotiation, presentation and deal-closing skills, with the ability to manage revenue targets and account growth.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced startup environment and manage multiple sales opportunities independently.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering or an equivalent discipline.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and at least one CRM tool, with the ability to maintain accurate pipeline and sales records.

Business Development Manager

Full time

**Who we are**
--------------

CAI is a global services firm with over 9,000 associates worldwide and a yearly revenue of $1.3 billion+. We have over 40 years of excellence in uniting talent and technology to power the possible for our clients, colleagues, and communities. As a privately held company, we have the freedom and focus to do what is right—whatever it takes. Our tailor-made solutions create lasting results across the public and commercial sectors, and we are trailblazers in bringing neurodiversity to the enterprise.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a motivated Business Development Manager ready to take us to the next level! If you have experience in winning IT and business-process outsourcing opportunities within Global Capability Centers (GCCs) in India and the Philippines and are looking for your next career move, apply now

**Job Description**

We are looking for a **Business Development Manager** to identifying, qualifying, and winning IT and business-process outsourcing opportunities within Global Capability Centers (GCCs) in India and the Philippines. This position will be

**full-time** and **remote.**

**What You’ll Do**

* Target account mapping: Build and maintain a prioritized target list of GCCs, tiered by maturity (setup, scale, mature) and fit with CAI’s service portfolio
* Signal-based prospecting: Track triggers such as new GCC announcements, hiring surges, leadership changes, parent-company cost or restructuring programs, and vendor contract renewals, and act on them with timely outreach
* Multi-stakeholder engagement: Map and engage the full buying group: GCC head, site and operations leaders, parent-company CIO/CTO, CHRO, CFO, and procurement
* Existing-client and parent-company leverage: Mine CAI’s existing clients for GCC setup or expansion plans, and use parent-company relationships and existing MSAs as entry points
* Land and expand: Identify cross-sell and expansion opportunities within won accounts, moving from an initial tower to additional IT and business-operations services
* Activate and manage alliance channels (for example, Zinnov, ANSR, IBPAP/GiCC, KMC Solutions, NASSCOM, and PE operating partners), with a target of [3+] qualified warm introductions per month
* Position CAI’s IT and operations services as complementary to GCC enablers’ workspace, talent, and employer-of-record offerings
* Represent CAI at priority GCC events (for example, NASSCOM GCC Summit, Zinnov Confluence, IBPAP International Summit), with pre-scheduled meetings and documented follow-up
* Lead discovery with GCC and parent-company leaders to understand the operating model, tooling, scale-up plans, and security and compliance needs
* Match client needs to CAI’s services and shape the opportunity, including build-operate-transfer and hybrid models, working with solution architects and delivery leadership on detailed design, transition plans, SLAs/KPIs and governance
* Articulate CAI’s differentiation against Tier 1 IT providers, Big 4 firms, local MSPs and [GBS/BPO providers, if business operations is in scope]
* Own the commercial strategy and negotiation for each opportunity, working with finance and delivery leaders on pricing, ACV and margin targets, and dedicated vs. shared delivery models
* Coordinate proposal and SOW development, with solutions teams owning technical content and security/compliance teams owning responses on SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA and India and Philippines statutory requirements
* Drive complex deals through 4–8 month sales cycles, including parent-company procurement and legal processes
* Ensure a clean hand-off to the delivery and transition teams after signature
* Maintain pipeline, forecasts, account plans and contact data in Salesforce, and report against milestone gates and targets
* Support the VP, Global Operations with executive engagement and client HQ presentations
* Contribute to case studies and GCC Operations Leaders Forum content as needed

**What You’ll Need**

Required:

* 10+ years’ experience in business development, sales, or client leadership selling IT and/or business-process managed services, with meaningful exposure to GCCs, captive centers, or offshore delivery models
* Existing network of [30–50]+ contacts among GCC operations, IT, HR, or site leaders
* Track record of closing complex, multi-year managed services deals with 4–8 month sales cycles
* Working knowledge of GCC models (build-operate-transfer, captive, hybrid) and the GCC lifecycle from setup through scale and transformation, including the India and Philippines enabler landscape
* Solid understanding of managed services across IT (service desk, infrastructure, application management, cybersecurity) and BPO operations, with depth in at least two areas
* Commercial acumen: total cost of ownership, ACV and margin analysis, and negotiating multi-year agreements
* Level of familiarity with ITSM and ITIL practices, cloud and hybrid infrastructure operations, and security and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA etc) sufficient to lead credible client discussions
* Excellent written and oral communication, with executive presence across India, Philippines and US contexts
* Ability to work across sales, solutions, delivery, finance and security teams

Preferred:

* Batchelor/Master or Engineering and/or MBA
* Experience selling finance and accounting, procurement, customer support, or other process services to GBS/GCC organizations [if in scope]
* Prior experience at a GCC advisory or enablement firm, or at a managed services provider with a GCC practice
* Experience in one or more priority verticals [for example, BFSI, healthcare and life sciences, technology, retail]
* Forecast accuracy within [X]% and complete, current Salesforce records

**Physical Demands**

* Ability to safely and successfully perform the essential job functions
* Sedentary work that involves sitting or remaining stationary most of the time with occasional need to move around the office to attend meetings, etc.
* Ability to conduct repetitive tasks on a computer, utilizing a mouse, keyboard, and monitor

**Reasonable accommodation statement**

If you require a reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employment selection process, please direct your inquiries to application.accommodations@cai.io or (888) 824 – 8111.

1. Incremental sales / margin from identified initiatives

2. Speed and quality of launches; launch to scale conversion; new proposition performance

3. Training readiness, adoption of sales journeys/scripts, productivity

4. Effectiveness of incentive structures in driving desired sales behaviors

5. Delivery of strategic priorities and annual business plan

6. Sales Governance on daily business numbers

jobs.description:
Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.

  

Solace is the leading real-time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more — have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.

  

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your hard work!

  

**About the role**

You will be the technical lead on Solace opportunities across Indian government bodies, public sector undertakings and the country's largest enterprises, working with Account Executives, system integrators and channel partners.

  

**What You’ll Do**

Be a trusted advisor, not just a demonstrator

* Partner with Account Executives to qualify opportunities, shape account strategies and drive deals to closure.
* Educate customers on event-driven architecture (EDA) and agentic AI, and challenge them to think bigger about their real-time data and AI strategy.
* Guide customers on integration patterns and modernization strategies, including the convergence of EDA and multi-agent AI systems.

  

Build champions and relationships

* Build deep relationships with technical and business stakeholders, from enterprise architects and CTOs to CIOs, department heads and programme officers, and turn users into advocates.
* Run on-site visits, regular check-ins and discovery sessions to stay aligned with evolving needs.
* Translate the Solace platform, from Event Broker to Agent Mesh, into outcomes customers care about.

  

Own technical validation and proof of value

* Lead demonstrations, Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Proofs of Value (PoVs) that map to customer objectives, including tender-mandated PoCs and bid-stage technical presentations.
* Own the evaluation process, guiding prospects through workshops, hands-on trials and technical validation.

  

Government and public sector engagement

Serve as the technical lead for Solace opportunities across central and state government departments, public sector undertakings (PSUs), regulators, defense and strategic establishments, smart-city programmes and government-owned platforms, typically alongside system integrators and channel partners.

* Translate programme requirements into validated event-driven and agentic AI solutions for use cases such as citizen and agency services, transport and aviation operations, logistics and sustainment, command-and-control style situational awareness, and real-time data exchange between departments.
* Position Solace Event Brokers, Event Mesh and Agent Mesh for on-premises, private-cloud and air-gapped deployments, including constrained or intermittently connected sites, and for hybrid deployments across state data centers and Indian cloud regions.
* Speak credibly to Indian security, data and compliance expectations, including MeitY cloud empanelment and GI Cloud (MeghRaj) hosting, the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, CERT-In directions, and sector rules such as RBI and SEBI requirements where public sector banks and market infrastructure are involved.
* Support government acquisition motions: respond to RFPs, RFIs and Expressions of Interest, write technical bid volumes and compliance matrices, handle pre-bid queries and corrigenda, and work within tender portals, GeM, GFR procurement norms and L1 and QCBS evaluation models.
* Understand Make in India public procurement preferences and local-content requirements, and help partners position Solace within them.
* Enable system integrators, OEM partners and channel partners (for example, national and global SIs with large public sector practices) so they can qualify, architect and deliver Solace-based solutions to government customers.
* Align Solace with national modernization priorities such as Digital India, data-centric and interoperable platforms, open standards, and responsible AI adoption.

  

Large enterprise engagement

Lead technical engagements with India's largest enterprises, where scale, resilience and regulatory pressure make real-time event infrastructure a board-level topic.

* **Banking, financial services and insurance (BFSI):** real-time payments and transaction flows, market data distribution, core banking modernization, fraud and risk signals, and AI agents for operations and customer service, within RBI, SEBI and IRDAI expectations on resilience, outsourcing and data localization.
* **Telecom and digital platforms:** real-time provisioning, recharge and balance events, customer 360 and channel modernization at very high volumes.
* **Aviation and transport:** airport and airline operations, flight and baggage events, and partner data exchange across heavily siloed ecosystems.
* **Manufacturing and energy:** plant-to-cloud event meshes, IoT and MQTT connectivity, supply chain visibility and Industry 4.0 programmes.
* **Logistics and retail:** shipment and fleet tracking, order orchestration and omnichannel inventory events.
* Help enterprises evolve beyond batch and request/response integration, and move from legacy middleware (IBM MQ, TIBCO, ESBs) towards a distributed, event-driven enterprise that can support real-time AI.
* Work with global system integrators and consulting partners that run large Indian enterprise transformation programmes.

  

Evangelise event-driven architecture

* Show deep command of core EDA concepts and patterns: publish/subscribe, event sourcing, CQRS, event streaming, and choreography versus orchestration, applied to real Indian enterprise and government architectures.
* Articulate the business value of EDA to executive and technical audiences: faster time-to-insight, operational resilience, accelerated digital transformation, and the ability to scale AI applications on a live data fabric.
* Position Solace Event Brokers against Apache Kafka, IBM MQ, RabbitMQ, TIBCO and cloud-native brokers, and against locally hosted open-source deployments that customers often start with. Be ready to explain where multi-protocol support, hybrid and multi-cloud event mesh, enterprise-grade QoS and dynamic topic routing create clear differentiation, and to defend total cost of ownership in L1-driven evaluations.
* Guide customers through an EDA maturity model, from point-to-point integration and basic messaging to a distributed, event-driven enterprise ready for real-time AI and autonomous systems.

  

Solace Agent Mesh subject matter expert

* Position Solace Agent Mesh Enterprise as the production-grade foundation for agentic AI, bridging event-driven infrastructure with LLM orchestration and multi-agent workflows.
* Show how Agent Mesh extends an existing Solace Event Mesh investment into agentic AI and shortens time-to-production for AI initiatives.
* Explain horizontal scalability, fault-tolerant asynchronous messaging and governance to technical teams and executives, including how agents can run with models and data kept inside the customer's own or sovereign environment.
* Develop use cases where real-time event triggers drive autonomous agent actions: banking operations and service, airport and airline disruption handling, supply chain and plant operations, citizen service workflows, and public infrastructure monitoring.
* Serve as the field voice for Agent Mesh adoption in India, feeding real use cases and objections back to Product and GTM teams.

jobs.title: Presales Director
jobs.description:
The Impact You'll Drive
  
  
At Vegapay, a bank's idea for a new credit card or credit line on UPI shouldn't take months to reach customers. We build the configurable infrastructure behind next-generation credit and payment programs for banks, NBFCs and fintechs. We're looking for a Director, Presales to lead the function that turns a first conversation with a bank into a signed program: the person who can walk into a CXO room, understand the business problem and show how Vegapay solves it.
  
  
This isn't a pure sales role, and it isn't a pure solutioning role. You'll own the technical and commercial story of every strategic deal, from discovery and demos to RFP responses, proofs of concept and the handover to delivery.
  
  
As Director, Presales, you'll sit between our banking and fintech prospects, sales leadership, product and engineering. You'll shape how Vegapay is positioned across credit cards, credit line on UPI (CLOU), embedded lending, BRE, rewards, ledgering and reconciliation, and you'll build the team and playbooks that make every pursuit faster and sharper than the last.
  
  
You'll work directly with senior stakeholders at banks and NBFCs (heads of cards, lending, risk, technology and compliance) to understand how they operate, find the problems that matter most and define clear success criteria. Then you'll win them over with a solution they can see working. Success in this role takes deep fintech domain knowledge, credibility with technical and business leaders, and the ability to turn an ambiguous requirement into a clear, winning proposal.
  
  
The Hats You Will Wear
  
  

* Own the presales strategy and function end to end: set the operating model, targets and quality bar across discovery, solutioning, demos, RFPs and proofs of concept.
* Lead discovery with bank, NBFC and fintech prospects to map their current stack, workflows and regulatory constraints, identify the real bottleneck and define measurable success criteria.
* Partner with the CEO and sales leadership on strategic pursuits: qualify opportunities, build the win strategy and join CXO-level meetings as the solution and domain voice for Vegapay.
* Design tailored solutions across credit cards, credit line on UPI, embedded lending, BRE, rewards, forex, ledgering and reconciliation, with clear architecture, integration approach and timelines.
* Own RFP/RFI responses and commercial proposals, working with product, engineering, legal and finance on scope, pricing, SLAs and risk.
* Run high-impact demos and proofs of concept that show the configurable platform working on the prospect's own use cases, including sandbox and demo environments that stay current.
* Build, mentor and scale a team of solution architects, presales consultants and solution engineers, with clear career paths and performance standards.
* Create the presales playbook: reusable solution blueprints, battlecards, competitive positioning, objection handling, ROI and business-case models, and a library of RFP answers.
* Act as the voice of the market inside Vegapay: feed prospect needs, competitive gaps and regulatory shifts (RBI, NPCI) back to product and engineering to shape the roadmap.
* Hand over won deals cleanly to implementation and customer delivery, so what was promised in the pursuit is what gets built.
* Track and report presales metrics: pipeline coverage, win rate, sales-cycle length, POC conversion and RFP turnaround time.

The Perfect Fit
  
  

* 10 - 12 years of experience in presales, solution consulting or solution architecture at a fintech, payments or core-banking/card-processing vendor, with at least 5 years leading a presales or solutions team.
* Proven record of winning large, multi-stakeholder deals with banks, NBFCs or large fintechs, from first discovery to signed contract.
* Deep domain knowledge of at least one of credit cards, lending (BNPL, credit lines, personal loans), UPI or payments processing, including how card programs and lending products work end to end.
* Strong technical grounding: APIs, microservices, integrations, cloud deployment, security and data-privacy norms, enough to lead architecture conversations with a bank's CTO and CISO.
* Working knowledge of the Indian regulatory landscape: RBI guidelines on digital lending and credit cards, NPCI's UPI ecosystem, PCI-DSS and data localisation.
* Strong executive presence and storytelling: comfortable presenting to CXOs and boards, and equally comfortable in a whiteboard session with architects.
* Experience building and mentoring high-performing presales teams, with clear ownership and a culture of accountability.
* Skilled at RFP/RFI responses, commercial proposals, ROI and business-case modelling.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to work across sales, product, engineering and legal in a fast-moving startup.
* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science or Engineering; an MBA is a plus.

Your Edge Over the Rest
  
  

* Hands-on experience with card management systems, credit line over UPI, loan management systems, ledger and reconciliation flows, or card network integrations (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay).
* An existing network among senior leaders at Indian banks, NBFCs and fintechs.
* AI-native: you use AI tools in your own work, and you can show prospects how AI-led workflows improve underwriting, servicing and operations.
* You've built a presales function from scratch, or scaled one through a sharp growth phase.
* Full ownership: a deal is yours until the program is live, not just until the contract is signed.
* Highest standards: you won't promise a bank what the platform can't deliver, and you care about getting the solution right the first time.

The Problem We're Solving
  
  
Financial institutions today are held back by legacy systems that are slow, rigid, and expensive to scale. Launching or evolving credit, lending, and UPI products often takes months, requires heavy engineering effort, and limits the ability to create personalized customer experiences.
  
  
At the same time, customer expectations have changed - speed, flexibility, and tailored financial products are no longer optional. Banks and fintechs need infrastructure that allows them to innovate quickly, adapt continuously, and scale without friction.
  
  
This is where we come in. At Vegapay, we are building modern, configurable fintech infrastructure that enables banks, NBFCs, and enterprises to design, launch, and manage credit and payment programs with ease. Our platform brings together flexibility, speed, and control - helping our partners unlock new growth opportunities and deliver personalized banking experiences at scale.
  
  
The Opportunity Ahead
  
  

* Shape and lead the presales function of a fast-growing B2B fintech from an early stage, with a direct line to the founders.
* Work with top banks and cutting-edge credit infrastructure on high-visibility, high-value deals.
* Own the story behind products that run for millions of end users.
* Fast-paced, high-learning environment with strong growth opportunities.

jobs.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Executive Director - Transition Solution Design & Execution Lead, Tech Ops Managed Services**
**Portfolio**
-Technology, Cyber and Data Solutions
  
  
**Primary focus**
-Enterprise transition strategy, deal shaping, mobilisation assurance and transition innovation
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Executive Director - Managed Services Transition Solution Design & Execution Lead is a senior individual contributor accountable for defining, shaping and assuring the most complex and strategically significant Managed Services transitions across Technology, Cyber and Data Solutions. The role operates as EY’s authoritative transition specialist on major pursuits and mobilizations, providing independent judgement, deep subject-matter expertise and executive-level client counsel from RFP strategy through stable operations.
  
  
The role does not rely on formal line-management authority. Its Executive Director scope is created through enterprise-wide influence, ownership of high-value and high-risk transition outcomes, direct engagement with C-suite and Partner stakeholders, and stewardship of EY transition methods, intellectual property and digitally enabled practices. The incumbent personally intervenes at critical points, resolves ambiguity across commercial, operational, technology and people dimensions, and sets the standard for transition quality across portfolios and geographies.
  
  
**Role Scope and Impact**

* Provide transition leadership for the largest, most complex and highest-risk Managed Services opportunities, including deals with multi-tower, multi-country, regulated, carve-out, transformation or accelerated-mobilization characteristics.
* Provide domain authority across AMS, Cyber, Data & AI transitions, adapting the scope to the services included in each client solution
* Own the integrity of transition solutions and mobilization outcomes for assigned strategic deals, acting as the single senior subject-matter authority rather than as a people leader.
* Shape pursuits with Service Line Leads, Managed Services Deal Leads, solution architects, commercial teams and delivery executives, translating client requirements into differentiated, executable and commercially viable transition strategies.
* Exercise enterprise-level influence across EY member firms, regions, service lines and third parties to secure alignment where priorities, risk appetites, contractual commitments or delivery models conflict.
* Create reusable transition assets, reference architectures, control frameworks, benchmarks and AI-enabled techniques that improve quality, speed, predictability and margin across the wider Managed Services business.
* Represent EY’s transition proposition with senior client executives during orals, negotiations, governance forums and critical mobilization decisions.

**Essential Functions Of The Job**
**Strategic deal shaping and client leadership**

* Develop compelling transition strategies for complex RFPs, sole-source opportunities and strategic renewals, integrating people, process, technology, data, security, controls, service management and commercial considerations.
* Lead the transition narrative in client orals and executive workshops, using evidence-based storytelling to demonstrate value, manage concerns and establish confidence in EY’s ability to mobilize safely.
* Advise client C-suite and senior EY leaders on transition feasibility, sequencing, risk exposure, investment choices and trade-offs, particularly where requirements are incomplete or competing objectives cannot all be achieved.
* Challenge deal assumptions and contractual commitments where transition risk, dependency, cost or timing is not adequately understood.

**Transition solution design and execution assurance**

* Architect end-to-end transition approaches for highly interdependent service towers and geographies, defining critical paths, entry and exit criteria, governance, control points, dependencies and operational acceptance requirements.
* Provide independent assurance across mobilization, identifying systemic risks early and directing corrective action through accountable delivery owners without assuming permanent line-management responsibility.
* Act as the senior escalation point for transition issues with material client, regulatory, financial, reputational or service-continuity implications.
* Confirm that transitions achieve safe landing into steady-state operations, with clear ownership, measurable readiness and no unmanaged residual risk.

**Functional authority and innovation**

* Own and evolve selected elements of EY’s Managed Services transition methodology, playbooks, quality standards and governance principles.
* Develop industry-leading transition techniques using AI, automation, data-led assurance and digital collaboration tools.
* Convert experience from strategic deals into reusable intellectual property, patterns, benchmarks and lessons that can be adopted across portfolios.
* Provide expert coaching and technical direction to deal and transition practitioners through communities of practice, design reviews and targeted interventions, without direct supervisory accountability.
* Build external market credibility through client forums, thought leadership, alliance activity and selected industry engagement.

**Analytical And Decision-Making Responsibilities**

* Solve novel, ambiguous and enterprise-scale transition problems for which established precedents may not exist.
* Make or recommend high-consequence decisions on transition design, sequencing, risk treatment, governance and readiness within delegated authority.
* Evaluate complex commercial and delivery trade-offs, including speed versus control, standardization versus client specificity, investment versus risk, and short-term mobilization needs versus long-term service sustainability.
* Form an independent point of view from incomplete and sometimes conflicting information and communicate that view credibly to Partners and client executives.
* Determine when EY standard methods are sufficient, when they require tailoring, and when a new approach or control is needed.
* Use quantitative indicators, scenario analysis, dependency mapping and expert judgement to forecast transition outcomes and prioritize intervention.

**Key Relationships and Influence**

* External: client C-suite, business and technology executives, procurement leaders, incumbent providers, alliance partners and strategic subcontractors.
* Internal: Global and Area Managed Services leadership, Service Line Leads, Deal Leads, Account Partners, solution architects, commercial and finance leaders, risk and legal teams, technology leaders, service delivery executives and transition practitioners.
* Influence model: leads through expertise, credibility, challenge and executive sponsorship rather than positional authority or direct reports.

**Success Measures**

* Quality and executability of transition solutions for strategic pursuits.
* Client confidence and executive sponsorship secured during pursuit and mobilization.
* Predictable achievement of transition milestones, readiness outcomes and safe landing into operations.
* Early identification and effective mitigation of material transition risks and dependencies.
* Commercial value protected through realistic assumptions, disciplined change control and avoidance of preventable mobilization failure.
* Adoption and measurable reuse of transition methods, intellectual property, AI-enabled techniques and lessons across the Managed Services business.
* Market and internal recognition as a trusted authority for compl

jobs.title: Manager, Tax Process Strategy & Solutions
jobs.description:
The Tax Process Strategy & Solutions Manager supports process leads and the Tax Practice to understand how one or more product(s) fit into the overall “vision” for one or more business area(s). The goal of this role is to drive long-term scalability and sustainability of the business for a competitive advantage. To execute their area of responsibility, this role collaborates with staff, the tax practice, product teams, IT, other functional areas within the broader RSM firm, and field offices to ensure we achieve the vision cohesively and effectively.

You will play a key role in the build-out and continued improvement and stewardship of our process and technology for US individual and trust/estate taxation.

The ideal candidate will be a self-directed problem solver with an ownership mindset and will have: (a) extensive experience independently preparing and reviewing complex Form 1040 and 1041 tax returns, as well as having handled and advised on diverse issues and complexities (federal, state and foreign) arising from ownership of complex flowthrough (partnership, S-Corporation) operating businesses, real estate entities, fund of funds, hedge funds and private equity; and (b) played a key hand in technology, tax research, process improvement or workpaper standardization initiatives: whether at the practice, region or market level, or within the context of one or more large or complex engagements.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES**

* Collaborates with process leads and Tax practice SMEs to understand how products fit into the overall "vision" for one or more business area(s).
* Acts as primary internal functional process owner/SME for how assigned third party or custom developed solutions are used in tax engagement team processes, maintaining expertise on products through their lifecycle, developing an in depth understanding of user experience and needs by partnering with tax professionals.
* Works with process leads, Change Management, and practice leaders to establish usage and product-related targets; assesses performance against these targets.
* Understands the long-term strategy of how the products fit into the overall digital ecosystem and end user process (e.g., assists with process-related deliverables, such as process mapping and business requirements).
* Partners with practice leaders and SMEs to understand, analyze, and prioritize business needs for providing requirements to BAs and product teams for custom developed solutions or for enhancement requests to vendors.
* Responsible for end-user product documentation/content including user guides, knowledge docs, and training materials.
* Leads efforts to improve internal processes, controls, and procedures through documentation, validation, and testing.
* Partners with tax practice subject matter experts in the development and maintenance of tax content within and between applications.
* Designs and develops workpapers, data mappings, and other tax specific deliverables and content within applications, actively using expertise in accounting, tax, and the tax engagement lifecycle.
* Elicit, gather and define business needs and prioritize functional business requirements with BAs
* Conduct tax research on tax technical topics and determine process implications
* Maintain currency of integrations with other solutions and assists in the pertinent testing
* Coordinates with RSM product team or vendor to understand new features/functionality and works with Change Management, process leads, and business teams to socialize the timing of new capabilities and how they fit into end-to-end process.
* Assists process lead(s) and business analysts with end-to-end process development, data flows, end-user process documentation including user guides, process flows, and training materials
* Represents the "voice of the business" and balances management needs with end-users' requests.
* Acts as a key contact for internal stakeholders and clients on complex tax technology matters, resolving issues with autonomy.
* Partners with Change Management and practice leaders to help lead implementation and ongoing adoption of products.
* Serves as a Performance Advisor to Associates and Senior Associates providing coaching, feedback, and development support.

**EDUCATION / CERTIFICATION REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor's degree (preference given to accounting, business or technology major)
* Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Chartered Accountant (CA), Enrolled Agent (EA) or JD, or actively pursuing

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**

* Minimum of 10 years’ experience having done tax compliance and advisory for high net-worth individuals within mid to large size public account firms (required).
* Must be capable of dealing confidently and professionally at executive level and with customers (required).
* Results driven; high integrity; ability to influence, negotiate and build relationships; superior communications skills; make complex decisions and manage change (required).
* Effective communication skills for differing audiences and situations (required).
* Tax compliance or advisory experience with deep expertise in accounting or tax fundamentals (required)
* Proficient in individual and fiduciary taxation, with an understanding of complex investments (e.g., real estate, fund of funds, hedge funds, private equity) and their implications (required), such as but not limited to the following:
* Multiple activity streams with differing passive/non-passive and NII determinations
* Partnership basis and pertinent limitations
* Passive activity losses (Form 8582)
* Trader income and materially participating real estate professional rules
* Net investment income tax / Form 8960
* Section 199A / QBI deduction
* Foreign tax credit / Form 1116
* International disclosures: Forms 926, 8621, 8938, 8865
* Trust accounting / figuring distributable net income
* Proficient with multi-state taxation and familiar with foreign disclosures (required)
* Proficient in investment partnership taxation (preferred)
* Proficient in preparing and reviewing returns with CCH Axcess Tax or Thomson Reuters GoSystem (required)
* Proficient in using SurePrep to prepare and review returns (preferred)
* Proficient in conducting tax research and effectively consulting and using various resources (e.g., government authority form instructions, statutes, regulations, and secondary resources and research products) (required)
* Must effectively operate with limited supervision (required)

**SUCCESSFUL CHARACTERISTICS / SKILLS**

* Strategic, out-of-the-box thinker and problem-solving experience to assess, analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve issues and think through and identify the implications of issues or proposed actions or designs.
* Excellent analytical skills, extraordinary attention to detail, and ability to present recommendations.
* Strong leadership capabilities, experience and passion for talent development, and proven experience leading teams through change and digital transformation.
* Passion for technology and providing exceptional experiences both internally for our employees and externally for clients and prospects.
* Strong ownership, bias to action, and know-how to succeed in ambiguity.

jobs.title: Director, Solution Architecture - Consulting
jobs.description:
**Overview**
Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
People Management
  
  
Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring.
  
  
Model - Live our culture. Embody our values. Practice our leadership principles.
  
  
Coach - Define team objectives and outcomes. Enable success across boundaries. Help the team adapt and learn.
  
  
Care - Attract and retain great people. Know each individual’s capabilities and aspirations. Invest in the growth of others.
  
  
Understanding Customer/Partner Technical Environment
  
  
Provides support for their team in gathering and propagating customer/partner insights to help shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of the project. Holds teams accountable for mapping architecture and digital transformation solutions to customer/partner business outcomes, and ensures that proposed solutions are aligned with broader organizational strategy. Leverages prior work, customer/partner insights, and industry trends, and shares insights with team to apply.
  
  
Supports their team in working with customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Development Team, Operations Team) and business sponsor to socialize both the business solution and the project approach. Advises team on managing changes and facilitating feedback. Uses broad patterns of feedback to develop strategic and actionable insights and presents a compelling business case to program managers that influences product roadmaps and decision making. Contributes to Microsoft-centric operations and cadences to align with customer feedback.
  
  
Drives internal advocacy by facilitating insight sharing with Product Engineering teams, and providing guidance through escalation, acceleration, and prioritization. Looks across multiple customers/partners for opportunities to consolidate and prioritize items across the business. Mentors peers and teams on best practices around internal resources usage. When appropriate, establishes accountabilities to drive customer outcomes and ensure internal stakeholders are in place. Ensures that customer opportunities, questions, and/or issues are brought to the appropriate internal teams.
  
  
Architecture Design and Deployment
  
  
Holds teams accountable for leveraging existing architecture approaches to achieve Microsoft's agreed commitments to the customer/partner and developing new solutions to scale across multiple customers/partners and markets. When appropriate, governs areas of fiscal responsibility, through delivery team, staying within budget while driving engagement profitability and risk management.
  
  
Guides team in defining and documenting the architecture through an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix. Ensures team is equipped to communicate the value proposition of the business solution along with the project approach. Guides team in cost-based and technology-based discussions to explain the architecture in terms of its build, deployment, and ongoing operational use to determine customer appetite for the business solution. Promotes a business-value approach that values return on investment (ROI) and customer costs-savings over technical ease of execution. Provides coaching to allow architects to scale solutions. Support new customer opportunities in partnership with Sales with highly significant or global impacts for Microsoft, as needed.
  
  
Collaborates with the other managers to jointly drive project/technical governance of the design, build, and deployment into use of proof of concepts (POCs) and pilots. Provides end-to-end governance, oversight, and thought leadership within assigned account. Provides guidance to team in understanding and demonstrating business value (e.g., release of revenue, cost savings) that the business solution realizes.
  
  
Guides team in working with the business sponsor and customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Business users, Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Operations Team) to gather and ratify requirements and constraints. Supports team in managing and resolving highly complex ambiguity in the requirements and constraints and documents assumptions and implications where it cannot be resolved. Ensures maintenance of the requirements/constraints traceability matrix to prove that solution components have a rationale/justification for inclusion in the architecture of the business solution. Oversees development and execution of test plans to prove that each requirement/constraint has been implemented as expected by the customer.
  
  
Leads team in collaborating to understand the business solution/problem. Drives agreement, based on the customer’s priorities, requirements/constraints, approach, principles, concepts, and expectations. Ensures team builds and documents a realistically costed, advanced/complex solution approach. Provides thought leadership on oversight and governance sets expectations for quality practices and standards to realize the business solution. Promotes a cohesive build methodology so the solution can be transitioned to live operations, leveraging solution expertise. Ensures communication of and adherence to the pre-sales value proposition. Ensures that customer opportunities, questions, and/or issues are brought to the appropriate internal teams. When appropriate, negotiates, collaborates on, reviews, and contributes to deal approval processes. Challenges deal construct to ensure Microsoft initiatives are incorporated appropriately. Communicates current view of delivery to customer executives on regular cadence, as needed. When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary. Innovates and implements long-term, strategic plans, in partnership with Sales to create new opportunities and sustainable growth for customer accounts across the portfolio, as needed. Ensures delivery team alignment and holds delivery team accountable for delivering on sales strategy.
  
  
Creates a culture and clarity around technical insights and escalations, and ensures broad sets of projects move forward. Provides support and guidance to team in identifying scenarios that could slow or impede pre-sales/delivery. Anticipates blockers and resolves escalations as needed and coaches team on best practices for handling escalations. Ensures that issues and blockers and addressed by the appropriate groups. Identifies widespread patterns in blockers across business areas or territories. Develops strategies to prevent blockers and issues in the future. When necessary, attends steering committee meetings with strategic customers to remove blockers and ensure delivery success.
  
  
Works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Account Team to anticipate, identify, categorize, and communicate business and technical risks. Defines risk mitigation activities that are foundational to the project plan. Defines risk contingency plans for invocation should the risk occur. Outlines methodology and governance principles and practices for the broader organization that allows others to minimize risks.
