The successful candidate will shape solutions across KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud while remaining close enough to the technology to guide architecture, review critical designs, resolve delivery risks, and assure quality.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced Manager with strong Python and advanced SQL capability, practical cloud and AI delivery experience, and broad Financial Crime Compliance knowledge. The role owns outcomes from discovery and estimation through design, build, testing, deployment, transition, and production stabilization. It also includes team leadership, work planning, governance, financial oversight, client communication, and development of reusable assets and delivery standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of Financial Crime technology workstreams, programs, or managed-service outcomes.
* Own solution scope, delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, quality, resource needs, and stakeholder commitments.
* Provide technical direction for Python applications, advanced SQL solutions, cloud architecture, data pipelines, APIs, analytics, and AI components.
* Translate KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud requirements into scalable technical solutions and delivery roadmaps.
* Partner with compliance SMEs, product owners, architects, engineering teams, data teams, model-risk stakeholders, QA, infrastructure, and operations.
* Lead design reviews, code and SQL quality reviews, architecture decisions, defect triage, performance tuning, release readiness, and production stabilization.
* Ensure appropriate security, privacy, auditability, explainability, data lineage, model governance, monitoring, and regulatory-control considerations.
* Drive automation, reusable components, engineering standards, knowledge assets, and continuous improvement across the delivery lifecycle.
* Prepare and present status, decisions, risks, dependencies, and recovery plans to senior client and internal stakeholders.
* Support proposals, solutioning, effort estimation, staffing, capability development, and account growth activities.

**Deliverable ownership**

* Accountable for agreed deliverables, acceptance criteria, delivery schedule, quality, and business outcomes across assigned workstreams.
* Build and maintain integrated delivery plans covering requirements, design, data readiness, engineering, testing, deployment, transition, and support.
* Establish governance routines, delivery metrics, RAID management, change control, escalation paths, and executive reporting.
* Validate estimates, capacity, sequencing, dependencies, and release scope; act early on slippage, quality gaps, or unresolved decisions.
* Ensure traceability from business and compliance requirements to technical design, test evidence, deployment artefacts, and operational handover.
* Coordinate cross-team dependencies and secure timely sign-offs from business, compliance, technology, model-risk, security, and operations stakeholders.
* Own defect closure, production-readiness checks, go-live decisions, warranty support, and lessons learned for assigned deliveries.

**Team management and leadership**

* Lead multidisciplinary teams of software engineers, data engineers, analysts, QA professionals, and domain specialists.
* Define team structure, roles, goals, operating model, work allocation, and individual accountability for delivery outcomes.
* Provide regular coaching, technical mentoring, feedback, recognition, and career-development support.
* Monitor capacity, utilization, skills coverage, onboarding, knowledge transfer, succession needs, and delivery continuity.
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive, quality-focused environment with clear standards for ownership and communication.
* Resolve delivery conflicts, remove blockers, manage escalations, and support sound decisions under competing priorities.
* Identify capability gaps and create targeted upskilling plans across Python, SQL, cloud, AI, and Financial Crime domain knowledge.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**

* Python: Strong hands-on experience designing and reviewing production-grade Python solutions, including object-oriented design, data processing, APIs, testing, logging, exception handling, security, and performance optimization.
* Advanced SQL: Expert-level capability in complex joins, common table expressions, window functions, stored procedures, query optimization, large-volume analysis, reconciliation, data profiling, and investigation queries.
* Cloud: Mandatory delivery experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP, covering solution design, deployment, data services, security, monitoring, integration, scalability, and operational support.
* AI: Mandatory practical experience delivering AI or machine-learning capabilities, including generative AI or predictive analytics, model or prompt evaluation, API integration, responsible AI controls, security, explainability, and production monitoring.
* Engineering leadership: Ability to guide architecture, review code and designs, define standards, oversee CI/CD, manage non-functional requirements, and resolve complex technical issues.
* Data and integration: Experience with data pipelines, APIs, batch processing, data quality, lineage, metadata, and integration across enterprise platforms.

**Mandatory Financial Crime domain knowledge (2 or more mandatory)**

* KYC / CDD / EDD: Customer onboarding, identity and document checks, customer risk rating, beneficial ownership, periodic review, remediation, and enhanced due diligence.
* AML: Financial crime risk indicators and typologies, alert and case workflows, investigations, escalation, regulatory reporting concepts, and control effectiveness.
* Transaction Monitoring (TM): Scenario and rule logic, thresholds, segmentation, alert generation, tuning, back-testing, false-positive reduction, and data-quality controls.
* Sanctions: Customer and payment screening, watchlists, potential-match handling, disposition workflows, screening effectiveness, and data quality.
* Fraud: Fraud indicators, transaction and event analysis, rules or models, alert prioritization, investigation workflows, case outcomes, and prevention controls.

**AI leadership expectations**

* Identify and prioritize AI use cases for alert triage, investigation support, entity resolution, anomaly detection, document analysis, quality assurance, and engineering productivity.
* Ensure human oversight, explainability, privacy, security, bias assessment, auditability, model-risk alignment, and appropriate use of regulated data.
* Define measurable acceptance criteria and monitoring for accuracy, grounding, latency, reliability, operational risk, and business value.
* Use AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly for code, testing, documentation, and analysis while maintaining review and security controls.

jobs.title: Accordion India - Director - Data & Analytics Consulting
jobs.description:
**Company overview**

Accordion is a global financial consulting and technology firm helping CFOs and their teams drive value creation. Rooted in private equity rigor and powered by data, analytics, and AI, we partner with companies across industries to turn insight into impact.

Accordion works at the intersection of Private Equity sponsors and portfolio companies’ management teams across every stage of the investment lifecycle. We provide hands-on, execution-oriented support, driving value through the office of the CFO by building data and analytics capabilities and identifying and implementing strategic work, rooted in data, analytics and AI.

Accordion is headquartered in New York City with 10 offices worldwide, including the India office

based out of Hyderabad. Join us and make your mark on our company.

**Data & Analytics (Accordion | Data & Analytics)**

Accordion's Data & Analytics (D&A) practice in India delivers cutting-edge, intelligent solutions to a global clientele, leveraging a blend of domain knowledge, sophisticated technology tools, and deep analytics capabilities to tackle complex business challenges.

We partner with Private Equity clients and their Portfolio Companies across diverse sectors, including Retail, CPG, Healthcare, Media & Entertainment, Technology, and Logistics.

D&A team members deliver data and analytical solutions designed to streamline reporting capabilities and enhance business insights across vast and complex data sets ranging from Sales, Operations, Marketing, Pricing, Customer Strategies, and more.

Working at Accordion in India means joining 800+ analytics, data science, finance, and technology experts in a high-growth, agile, and entrepreneurial environment to transform how portfolio companies drive value. It also means making your mark on Accordion’s future—by embracing a culture rooted in collaboration and a firm-wide commitment to building something great, together.

Join us and experience a better way to work!

**Location:**
Hyderabad, Telangana

**Role Overview:**

The Business Director at Accordion will own multiple client relationships and provide analytics- oriented thought partnership. (S)he will oversee multiple project teams to facilitate delivery of high-quality analytics services and identify opportunities for deeper client engagement.

**What You will do:**

* Develop a thorough understanding of client's business challenges to proactively recommend analyses that can deliver results for the client.
* Facilitate value addition to the client's business by driving the problem-solving process and bringing an independent perspective based on domain knowledge and past experience.
* Regularly engage in peer level discussions with the C-Suite of client companies, to partner with them as a trusted analytics advisor.
* Develop a robust knowledge of functional areas (Marketing, Finance, Pricing, Supply Chain etc.) across a diverse set of industries to provide relevant and actionable insights backed by robust analytics.
* Facilitate people development and proactively ensure that development agenda is fulfilled for all.
* Think from a company point-of-view and take up additional responsibilities outside of regular client projects to support the growth of the company.

**Ideally, you have:**

* Undergraduate degree (B.E/B.Tech.) from tier-1 colleges
* MBA degree from top tier colleges is preferred
* Should have 6 - 9 years of experience
* Strong analytical reasoning & problem-solving capabilities to identify patterns, draw insights and recommend solutions live
* Ability to share complex thoughts and tailor written and verbal communication based on the context
* Strong multi-tasking skills to manage multiple projects across diverse industries
* Experience in client facing/professional services environment

**Why Explore a Career at Accordion:**

**A Culture of Impact & Excellence**

* **A culture of merit & recognition:**
  Thrive in a meritocratic, high-growth environment with semi-annual performance and promotion cycles.
* **Multi - dimensional exposure**
  : Navigate complex, high stakes workstreams across diverse industries and domains. At Accordion, you will engage with varied intellectual challenges that keep your perspective sharp, and your curiosity fuelled.
* **Entrepreneurial environment:**
  Exercise the intellectual freedom to make definitive decisions and the autonomy to own their outcomes. We reward initiative, encouraging you to expand your influence and assume larger responsibilities.
* **Collaborative vitality**
  : Experience a non-bureaucratic, high-energy culture alongside high-calibre peers. Our environment is designed to challenge your thinking and accelerate your growth through shared expertise and collective ambition.

**Our Commitment to Your Well-being**

We believe that our collective success is rooted in the personal well-being and growth of our people. We have curated a suite of benefits designed to support you and your family’s health, celebrate your milestones, and empower your professional journey.

* **Comprehensive health & security:**
  We provide fully covered Health and Group Term Life Insurance for you, with health insurance coverage extending to your immediate family.
* **Care on your terms:**
  Access expert medical guidance through on-site health camps or our integrated tele-health services. This ecosystem includes free professional consultations alongside discounted healthcare services including dental and vision care.
* **Integrated family support:**
  We support working parents with a fully sponsored, premium on-site Day Care facility.
* **Empowering leave structures:**
  Our robust leave policy is an intentional commitment to work-life integration, featuring dedicated maternity and parental support designed to help new parents through life’s major transitions.
* **A culture of recognition:**
  We believe every breakthrough deserves an audience. Through our dedicated rewards platform, we pause to celebrate both your professional triumphs and your most meaningful personal milestones.
* **Architecting your growth:**
  Thrive in a positive & transparent environment designed for the continuous evolution of your craft. We provide the infrastructure - through learning programs and engagement initiatives - to bridge the gap between your personal aspirations and professional mastery.

jobs.title: AGM Design
jobs.description:
Decorpot is a Series B-funded, vertically integrated home interiors and modular furniture company with 38+ Experience Centres across 25+ Indian cities. We are hiring an **AGM – Designs** to run the **operations backbone** of a large, distributed, high-throughput design function — team management, client experience, data discipline, productivity, and attrition control.*This is an operations leadership role, not a creative role. Candidates from a pure design / architecture background are not the fit — we are specifically looking for a strong operations leader who can run a large team at scale.*

**Reports to** Associate Director – Design

**Team size** 50–100+ (direct + matrix) across multiple cities and Experience Centres

**Travel** Regular travel to Experience Centres across operating cities (mandatory)

**Type** Full-time, on-roll

What You'll Own

* Run the design function like an operations shop — SLAs, throughput, capacity, quality, and cost per project — measurable, visible, and reviewed weekly.

* Own end-to-end management of a 50–100+ member distributed workforce spread across cities and Experience Centres — hiring, onboarding, allocation, workload balancing, performance.

* Own the client experience — proactive project tracking, communication cadence, escalation handling, and closure. Senior-most escalation point for the function on any customer issue.

* Own the productivity dashboard — designer productivity, project timelines, revisions, drop-offs, revenue per designer, EC-level scorecards. Turn a large volume of operating data into weekly decisions.

* Own attrition — build the levers (career growth, incentives, recognition, workload sanity, manager quality) that pull the number down and hold it there.

* Own team motivation and culture — daily rhythm, city visits, town halls, recognition, and a healthy, high-performance environment.

* Partner with Sales, Operations, Factory, and Finance to drive project-level margin, delivery timelines, and customer satisfaction.

* Enforce process discipline — briefs, sign-offs, approvals, revisions, and the paper trail that keeps large projects from going off the rails.

What We're Looking For

* 10–15 years of operations leadership experience, with at least 4–5 years running a team of 50–100+ people.

* **Not from a design or architecture background.** We want a career operator — someone who has scaled and stabilised large teams and delivered on tough operating metrics.

* Strong preference for candidates from: large retail chains, BPO / customer operations, ed-tech delivery, telecom / DTH field ops, banking / insurance sales ops, consumer services (Urban Company / equivalent), consulting delivery, hospitality, aviation ground ops, or high-volume services businesses. Interiors ops backgrounds (Livspace / HomeLane / Sleek) welcome, but only in a pure operations mandate.

* Track record of managing a distributed workforce across multiple cities — with the travel and field discipline that comes with it.

* Data-fluent — comfortable running weekly reviews off dashboards, cutting operating data, building trackers, and driving decisions from numbers.

* Sharp client communication skills — verbal, written, and on-call. Poised under pressure; strong at de-escalating angry customers and rebuilding trust.

* Proven track record of attrition management in high-churn environments; demonstrated ability to build engaged, motivated teams.

* Process discipline, ownership, low ego, high pace. Go-getter who runs at problems, not away from them.

* MBA preferred; strong operators without an MBA will be considered on the strength of their track record.

* Open to any gender; willing to travel is mandatory.

Pay: ₹2,000,000.00 - ₹2,200,000.00 per year

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

jobs.title: Assistant Director - GDS Treasury-Treasury Controllership
jobs.description:
Location: Bengaluru

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: 25 Nov 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1763627

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Assistant Director – Treasury (EY GDS)**

  

**Role Overview**

The Assistant Director – Treasury will lead core treasury middle-office operations, including reporting, compliance, and risk monitoring, while supporting selected financial planning activities. The role requires strong analytical capabilities, cross-functional collaboration, and a focus on process automation to enhance hedging effectiveness, economic yield, liquidity management, and capital protection.

  

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Performance & Exposure Reporting: Monitor and report global foreign exchange (FX) exposures and outstanding hedges. Provide timely exposure updates to the Front Office
* MIS & Policy Compliance: Prepare management information system (MIS) dashboards covering FX, investments, and liquidity. Monitor compliance with investment policies and applicable regulatory guidelines.
* Monthly & Quarterly Close: Manage monthly close activities for derivative mark-to-market (MTM) valuations and related charges, investments, and borrowings. Lead quarterly close deliverables, including portfolio and economic yield reporting, accounting yield reconciliation, investment register maintenance, other income analysis, and contributions to the Quarterly Treasury Report
* Cross-Functional & Tax Optimization: Support internal requirements related to advance tax, accounting, and EDPMS. Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to optimize tax, accounting, and economic outcomes
* Financing, Ratings & Structuring: Support external financing and banking arrangements across entities, as required
* Process Automation: Drive automation of recurring treasury workflows and reporting processes to improve efficiency and consistency

  

**Time Allocation & Additional Scope**

* 75–80% Middle Office: Core treasury reporting, valuations, close processes, exposure monitoring, and compliance.
* 20–25% FP&A and Process Automation: Support financial planning and analysis (FP&A) alignment and process automation, as required.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Education: Chartered Accountant (CA) or Master of Business Administration (MBA).
* Experience: At least 8 years of experience in corporate treasury

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

jobs.title: Financial Advisory Job Opportunities (Manager, Associate Director, Director & Managing Director)
jobs.description:
**Financial Advisory Service Offerings**
----------------------------------------

Teneo guides companies and their stakeholders through periods of uncertainty and stress to assess options, address financing and/or balance sheet stresses, create liquidity headroom, reduce costs, improve profitability, more efficiently run their businesses and turnaround and/or exit underperforming businesses, whilst communicating appropriately with stakeholders. Our expert team also brings market-leading experience in developing and delivering contingency plans and insolvencies across multiple jurisdictions, providing credible fallback plans to protect value or helping to shape and affect a restructuring.

We advise clients on strategies and actions to create, protect and realize value across the full spectrum of stressed or distressed transactions and industries, while helping leaders solve complex business challenges and achieve their goals. No two situations are the same, and our advice and approach is tailored to each set of circumstances and client priorities.

**The Role**
------------

As part of ambitious growth plans for our already successful Middle East Financial Advisory business, we are looking for Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors to join our Financial Advisory team in the UAE. Our Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors have the opportunity to lead on a diverse range of engagements across different sectors and geographies, with responsibility for leading projects or key workstreams, managing junior staff and supporting senior leadership in client-facing delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Client service

* Lead and/or manage key parts of engagements, providing support to senior team members or often directly to the Senior Managing Directors.
* Support client management teams in preparing and challenging business plans, short and/or longer term cash flow forecasts and restructuring plans.
* Providing cash management services to clients to identify working capital and other cash flow improvements.
* Reviewing and stress-testing integrated business plans, budgeting and forecasting models using a fact-based, data driven approach, including KPI definition, data visualization, reporting automation and touchless forecasting.
* Reviewing detailed, integrated 3 statement forecasts (profit & loss, cashflow and balance sheet), and discounted cashflow (DCF).
* Preparing report outputs that may range from business plan documentation and board reports when working for a company, through to preparation of independent business reviews when working for creditors.
* Developing, analysing and presenting restructuring, refinancing and/or insolvency options using input from other teams, e.g. insolvency or tax analysis, sector and financial modelling.
* Liaising with the Company’s legal advisors to understand key aspects of legal documentation and also drive any documentation processes (term sheets, waivers, loan documentation etc.).
* Preparation of engagement letter(s) and ensuring adherence to all compliance requirements to support financial and risk management.
* Apply an understanding of engagement economics.

Knowledge acquisition

* Build client relationship skills, sector knowledge and continue to develop leadership skills.
* Continue to build technical expertise, broader business advisory and people management skills.
* Understand the market, topical issues and our Financial Advisory propositions.

People and leadership

* Support practice and talent development.
* Provide on-job coaching and development to staff.
* Develop junior staff outside of jobs through appraising and mentoring.
* Support wider Financial Advisory training initiatives.
* Manage diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution.

Business development

* Own elements of business development including actively supporting business development activities, building and expending your own contact network and supporting Middle East Financial Advisory marketing and sales activities.
* Participate in existing business development programmes and key client accounts.
* Identify opportunities to expand jobs as well as opportunities to provide wider Teneo services to existing clients.
* Take responsibility for leading marketing initiatives aimed at specific channels to market, or events.

jobs.title: Associate Director- IRRBB Management, India Hub
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**Job Summary**
Treasury works closely with senior management, the businesses, Country CEOs / CFOs, and Finance to manage and promote the bank’s liquidity, capital, and balance sheet position. Treasury is laser-focussed on its vision to be “Open, progressive and trusted, working commercially with our partners” to create sustainable value by balancing the supply and demand of liquidity and capital.
  
  
Within Treasury (which comprises Capital, Liquidity & Markets), the Treasury Liquidity function is responsible for driving the strategic liquidity agenda and Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Booking (‘IRRBB’).
  
  
The Associate Director – IRRBB, India hub will support the Head of IRRBB, India Hub in advancing IRRBB Analytics for overseeing and executing comprehensive internal analyses. The role holder will help in migrating and centralising global IRRBB processes from Group and Clusters, performing detailed stress tests and scenario analyses, leveraging IRRBB data to provide insightful risk assessments and mitigation strategies. This position requires a deep understanding of IRRBB, strong analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with senior stakeholders across the organization.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Strategy**

* Keep up to date with the Group’s business strategy (incl. SC Ventures) and ensure the IRRBB frameworks are aligned to that.
* Partner with Global Head of IRRBB in developing and recommending risk mitigation strategies based on the findings from stress tests and scenario analyses.
* Ensure that these strategies are effectively communicated and implemented across relevant business units.

**Business**

* Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates, with a focus on the Group’s participation in the Digital Assets and platforms space.
* Provide insights on current and forward looking IRRBB exposures, impact assessments on interest income and actions available for balance sheet optimisation.
* Lead the engagement with businesses on balance sheet optimisation strategies including but not limited to asset & liability mix to manage IRRBB while optimising returns.

**Processes**

* Analytics: Support the newly developed IRRBB analytics capabilities on a regular basis, including operating the RCO IRRBB calculation engine to run bespoke scenarios and extracting and analysing the results, covering key metric including, but not limited to, Weekly NIIS Flash, Hedging Strategy Assessments, Corporate Plan NII impact simulations and PV01 analysis. This will also involve working with CPM and Finance closely to prepare MI slides for relevant committees like GALCO, ALCO and IRRBB Steering Forums.
* Strategy: Support IRRBB strategy by engaging Treasury Markets on NII sensitivities, hedging performance and P&L forecasting. Support investor relations for quarterly results, including GALCO/ALCO hedging updates, and contribute to annual disclosures through slide preparation, briefing notes, Q&A drafting and investor query responses.
* Framework & Governance: Support IRRBB governance through preparation of monthly GALCO/ALCO packs with commentary, review of risk metrics and monitoring of group, solo and local limits. Lead regulatory submissions and challenge returns, oversee MAT and risk appetite reviews, maintain IRRBB policies, support disclosures and audits, escalate emerging topics and drive regulatory engagement and interpretation.
* Modelling & Methodology: Apply and maintain IRRBB models per regulatory requirements, including PTR and CASA assumptions. Review and update IRRBB and structural hedging policies, maintain standards, and perform annual forecasts of NII, EBE, and P2A. Conduct policy effectiveness, self-assessment, gap and impact analyses, harmonize models with group, and run simulations and scenario analyses to support regulatory and corporate planning.
* Structural Hedging: Support the structural hedging in planning, executing, and monitoring hedges, including P&L sign-off and capacity management. Support group IRBB hedging programs, assess available instruments, forecast and quantify hedge requirements, run analytics and simulations, and provide MI for GALCO discussions to drive informed hedging decisions.
* Stress Testing: Support IRRBB stress testing including ICAAP and Pillar 2 assessments, NMD parameter stress, country/cluster ICAP, and reverse stress testing. Conduct basis risk evaluations, Pillar 2 charge reviews, and prepare Pillar 3 disclosures. Support IRBB-related GIA and audit reviews, ensuring all stress testing aligns with ORF requirements and regulatory expectations.
* IRRBB Technology Journey: Support delivery of new system rollouts, enhancements and data fixes by providing requirements, validating functionality, and ensuring data accuracy. Collaborate with stakeholders to implement changes efficiently, maintain alignment with IRRBB policy and reporting standards, and drive continuous improvement of systems and processes.

**People & Talent**

* Be part of a diverse team of skilled and experienced professionals in India.
* Collaborate within Treasury and with key partners in Finance, CPM, Technology, and Change in India and the clusters.
* Lead by example in reinforcing the appropriate culture and values of the function.
* Contribute to ongoing training and development of team members.

**Risk Management**

* Oversee enterprise-wide interest rate risk in the banking book ensuring alignment with risk appetite and regulatory requirements.
* Monitor, measure and manage exposures, set limits, and perform scenario analysis and stress testing.
* Maintain robust frameworks, policies and governance, validate models, provide insights for strategic planning and support senior management, GALCO/ALCO and regulators on risk mitigation, reporting and capital optimisation.

**Governance**

* Assess the effectiveness arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the IRRBB frameworks and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas
* Understand the regulatory framework in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.
* Contribute to delivering ‘effective governance’ by actively challenging Treasury / Business / Risk counterparts; and willingness to work with the Prudential Regulatory Authority in an open and cooperative manner.

**Key stakeholders/Committees**

* Global Treasurer
* Treasury Liquidity, Capital, Recovery & Resolution Planning, Issuance, Markets
* Regional & Country Treasury teams

* Financial Planning & Analytics
* Country & Business Finance
* Various other Finance teams (e.g., Regulatory Reporting, BSA and Disclosures)
* Treasury CRO
* Technology & Change organisation
* Investor Relations
* Rating Agencies, Investors
* Regulators
* GALCO
* Board Risk Committee (BRC)
* Digital Asset Risk Committee (DRC – attending as permanent invitee)

**Skills And Experience**

* Balance Sheet Management
* Funding & Liquidity Risk
* Funding & Liquidity Regulations
* People management
* Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Book
* Funds Transfer Pricing
* Product / Business Knowledge
* Strategic Change Leadership
* Financial Reporting and Performance Management
* Planning, Modelling, Forecasting
* Banking Technology Infrastructure

**Motivations**

* Motivated by protecting customer and organisational data through practical, proportionate and sustainable privacy solutions.
* Energised by solving complex risk and control challenges with stakeholders from different business, legal, compliance and technology disciplines.
* Thrives in environments that value sound judgement, continuous improvement, collaboration and personal accountability.

**Qualifications**

jobs.title: Sr Client Consulting Manager (Cards Benefits/vendor management/ Operations Lead)
jobs.description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Overview**
**Job Description**
Visa Consulting & Analytics (VCA) is Visa's consulting division, serving Visa's clients (including card issuers, acquirers and merchants) and solving their strategic problems focused on improving performance. Drawing on our expertise in strategy consulting, payments, data analytics, marketing, operational and macroeconomics, VCA drives high impact and tangible financial results.
  
  
Cards benefits team within VCA manages the deployment of cards benefits programs for Visa’s clients in AP. This is to support Visa’s clients with differentiated card propositions and stay relevant to and drive preference amongst consumers.
  
  
As a Senior Manager, Operations – Card Benefits, you will define and drive the regional operations strategy for Visa’s card benefits program. You’ll lead transformation initiatives that establish scalable operating frameworks, enhance delivery performance, and strengthen cross-market collaboration. This role is ideal for a strategic operator and people leader who thrives in ambiguity, brings structure to complexity, and inspires a team to achieve sustainable, high-impact outcomes.
  
  
This role involves a significant component of cross-functional work and will require the Senior Manager to work closely with the VCA market teams, Product, Sourcing and partners to streamline operations across AP.
  
  
**What a Senior Manager Does At Visa**
In this role, you are expected to:
  
  

* Shape and Scale Operations: Lead the transformation of Visa’s card benefits operations across Asia Pacific, designing scalable frameworks, automation opportunities, and governance models to support long-term growth.
* Own Client Onboarding and Delivery: Oversee onboarding for new clients, managing vendor relationships, contracts, and financial processes—including POs, renewals, and top-ups—to ensure seamless implementation.
* Operational Intelligence and Insight: Define and implement analytics and reporting frameworks that provide visibility into performance, benefits utilisation, and commercial optimisation opportunities.
* Drive Financial Discipline: Oversee billing, revenue, and expense recognition, ensuring accurate and efficient financial management across multiple markets.
* Vendor and Partner Leadership: Build and manage strategic vendor partnerships, driving consistency, efficiency, and value across service delivery.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with key internal stakeholders—such as finance, sourcing and legal—to optimise processes and enhance operational outcomes.
* Build Capabilities and Lead Talent: Recruit, lead, and develop a high-performing operations team, championing a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Strategic Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor to regional leadership and market leads on operational strategy, cost optimization, and delivery excellence. Ensure at all times timely and relevant communication.
* Lead Through Ambiguity: Navigate complex, evolving business contexts with agility and composure, bringing clarity, alignment, and focus to teams and stakeholders.
* Champion Innovation: Lead or support special projects that modernise processes, expand services, and enhance client and cardholder experiences across Asia Pacific.
* Client Relationship Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for market teams and issuing/acquiring/merchant/fintech bank clients across assigned markets, building trusted, long-term partnerships and ensuring high levels of satisfaction and retention
* Stakeholder Coordination: Collaborate closely with internal teams - including product, operations, sourcing, and legal to ensure seamless onboarding, implementation, and ongoing delivery of benefits services
* Kssue Resolution: Proactively address and resolve client concerns, operational challenges, or service escalations to maintain strong relationships and protect the company’s reputation.

**Projects You Will Be a Part Of**
You’ll spearhead the delivery of Visa’s premium card benefits helping issuers enhance customer value, deepen engagement, and differentiate in competitive markets.
  
  

* Work with the Consulting and Product team to operationalize card benefits program that can help us transform the way issuer and Visa drive PV and engagement amongst Visa cardholders
* Development and maintenance of relationships with merchants and third-party suppliers
* Negotiation of terms and agreements to secure relevant benefits for Visa’s clients at compelling terms to ensure card benefits provision drives payment volume as well as Value Added Service revenue.
* Collaborate with stakeholders within VCA, Regional Products & Solutions, and in-market counterparts to align benefits with business goals and strategies
* Monitor and evaluate the performance of secured benefits, report on these findings and make recommend changes to strategy as may be necessary to clients
* Manage the budget, financial planning and forecasting for benefits.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**
What you will need:
  
  

* Minimum 8+ years of experience in financial services or consulting or loyalty programs across operations and execution
* Minimum 6+ years of strong experience utilizing analytical and project management skills
* Ability to build and maintain professional relationships, with proven negotiation and communication skills, used to secure deals and offers, ideally from merchants and third parties
* Strong team player internally and with clients, working independently to coordinate cross functional activities, obtaining critical support from multiple stakeholders
* Proven ability to define operational strategy and build scalable processes for long-term success
* Deep experience managing vendors, contracts, and commercial negotiations, including rate setting and performance review
* Strong financial acumen to manage budgets, forecasts, and multi-market billing accuracy
* Demonstrated success as a people leader, fostering high-performing, collaborative, and empowered teams.

**What Will Also Help**

* Master’s Degree in business, engineering or a related field
* Experience in consulting, managed services, or large-scale operations within payments or financial services
* Familiarity with card products, loyalty programs, or premium benefit ecosystems
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office and analytical tools
* Proven experience leading automation, transformation, or process redesign initiatives

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Manager within Policy Admin System or FAST product configuration your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines
*.*

**Senior Manager/Manager - Underwriting Operations Job Description**

**About the Role**

Consolidated Analytics Inc is a key player in the US Real Estate space offering full suite of Mortgage support services to its clients. These comprise of Valuation services, Post Close Audit support, Fulfilment support, Default support, Investor Claims and consulting advisory services. Most importantly, the Due Diligence Division of CA Inc offers third party rating services (FITCH, SsP GLOBAL, KROLL, MORNINGSTAR, AND DRBS) through its unique underwriting solutions to customers in the Capital Markets space. The underwriting solution is also extended to both originations and default operations to some of the clients.

This is a competitive space that CA has positioned itself as a formidable player in. To stay competitive and ahead of the game, CA constantly endeavors to reengineer its UW processes and the supporting tech to stay agile, relevant and most sought after by its clients.

The Due diligence businesses won by nimble players who can turn around files faster and in an accurate fashion. Bids are won on who has the largest capacity, quicker throughputs and scalable options.CA is seeking Senior Manager - Underwriting Operations, who can develop strategies, re-engineer process workflows, adopt cutting-edge technologies faster, build capacity and churn deliverables in a timely manner.

**Current Operation Model**

The current model of operations follows a seamless integrated model comprising of onshore and offshore team members. The offshore unit predominantly assists in performing bookmarking and data extraction activities on a loan file. The Data extraction is performed across Credit, Income and Compliance sections of the loan file. Bookmarking ensures bookmarking consistency across the labelling of each document, chronologically arranging similar documents, removal of duplicate documents, re-arranging misplaced documents and nesting bookmarks under a header bookmark. Currently both bookmarking and data extraction are performed using a third-party AI driven software. From the Offshore side, the Underwriters collect data and review on the following areas: Credit (Income Calculation) and Compliance.

**Description of the Role**

As part of the responsibility, the Senior Manager - Underwriting Operations, is required to conceive, design, develop and roll out strategies that can result in the following outcomes:

1. Process Transformation in the Offshore Underwriting Operations
2. Daily Throughput Management
3. Staffing Optimization s Productivity Enhancement
4. Knowledge Transfer s Process Stabilization
5. Client Services s Engagement

**Key Performance Indices**

As part of performance management, the SOC will be assessed on the following KPIs. The weightage of the KPI parameters can be discussed and agreed between the SOC and the President of the organization.

**Responsibilities**

1. Support in screening, interviewing and hiring new underwriters
2. To provide effective strategies for building and growing the DIS Underwriting Operations. The goal is to build a strong team of 100 offshore underwriters.
3. Oversee progress of classroom and on job training.
4. Oversee Production ramp up to meet the required level.

6. Work with Presales manager to pitch for new business.
7. Provide the necessary day-to-day business report (MIS, Executive Summary Report, Business Insights)
8. Manage the SLA and delivery obligations made with the client.
9. Other activities that are mutually agreed over email or as an amendment to this agreement, as the project progresses.

**Qualifications**

1. Should possess a minimum of 15 years of experience in US real estate underwriting operations
2. Should have managed US Clients in the Real Estate Underwriting space (Collateral, Capital, Capacity, Credit)
3. Should be open to supporting the US Time zone
4. Should be open to travel to US on a periodic basis and hence should have a B1/B2 business visa.

Position: Director – Product Engineering Capability  
Experience: 20+years  
Category:
  
Shift Timing: General Shift
  
Location: Chennai  
Position ID: J1126-0178  
Employment Type: Full Time  
  
Job Description:  
CGI Advantage is a large enterprise product portfolio supporting complex government operations across Financials, HRM/Payroll, Procurement, Framework, Analytics and related capabilities.  
As we evolve our Product Engineering organization toward stronger end-to-end Build & Run accountability, we are looking for a Director – Product Engineering Capability to build and sustain the functional, domain and specialist capabilities required across the Advantage portfolio.  
The Director will be accountable for ensuring that Advantage has the right capability, in the right roles, at the right level of maturity, when the business needs it. The role will establish common capability standards, strengthen domain and functional depth, build leadership and specialist pipelines, reduce critical-person dependencies and enable scarce expertise to be leveraged effectively across products.  
This is not a traditional learning or training role. It is a senior Product Engineering leadership position working closely with Product Engineering Directors, Product Leaders and functional leaders to ensure that the organization has the capability required to deliver product outcomes today while building the skills required for the future.

**Your future duties and responsibilities**

Key Responsibilities  
Capability Strategy & Workforce Readiness  

* Define the capability strategy and operating model across critical Product Engineering roles including functional/product roles, business analysis, domain SMEs, solution architecture and specialist engineering disciplines.
* Translate product strategy, roadmap, modernization, SaaS, cloud and AI priorities into future capability requirements.
* Develop product- and portfolio-level capability maps identifying critical skills, capacity risks, succession gaps and future capability needs.
* Ensure persistent/core capabilities and shared specialist capabilities are appropriately identified and developed.

Role & Competency Model  

* Establish clear role charters, competency expectations and proficiency models for critical roles.
* Create consistent expectations across Product Lines while allowing appropriate domain specialization.
* Define career and progression pathways that build deep functional, domain and technical expertise.

Talent Depth & Succession  

* Build strong pipelines for critical roles and reduce dependence on individual experts.
* Drive succession and readiness planning for business-critical positions.
* Enable mobility of talent and specialist expertise across Product Lines.
* Partner with Engineering Directors and leadership on build/buy/borrow decisions for emerging capability requirements.

Capability Excellence & Communities  

* Establish and strengthen communities of practice and capability forums across Advantage.
* Drive common methods, standards, reusable patterns, templates, accelerators and knowledge assets.
* Promote adoption of leading engineering, solutioning, analysis and product practices across teams.
* Ensure lessons and capabilities developed in one Product Line can be effectively leveraged across the broader portfolio.

Transformation & Future Skills  

* Lead capability transformation required for the evolving Build & Run model.
* Accelerate skills in AI-assisted engineering, cloud/SaaS, automation, modern architecture, product engineering and data-driven delivery.
* Identify opportunities where capability improvements can materially improve quality, productivity, predictability and engineering effectiveness.
* Create mechanisms for rapidly developing and scaling new capabilities as technology and market needs evolve.

Partnership with Product Engineering  

* Partner closely with Product Engineering Directors to understand capability demand and delivery challenges.
* Ensure capability development remains grounded in real Product Engineering outcomes rather than becoming a centralized or theoretical function.
* Support product organizations with the right specialist capability while avoiding unnecessary organizational hand-offs or approval layers.
* Provide transparent visibility into capability health, gaps, risks and readiness.

Capability Measurement  

* Establish a capability health framework and measurable indicators.
* Track areas such as critical-role coverage, proficiency maturity, succession readiness, capability-gap closure, specialist availability, mobility and reduction in key-person dependencies.
* Demonstrate tangible impact of capability initiatives on engineering quality, productivity and organizational effectiveness.

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**

Must to have skill:  

* Typically 18+ years of experience in enterprise product engineering, software/product organizations, technology consulting or equivalent environments.
* Significant leadership experience in a large, complex, multi-product engineering organization.
* Demonstrated experience building capabilities, practices, CoEs, engineering excellence organizations or cross-product competency models.
* Strong understanding of enterprise software/product development across the lifecycle — product definition, architecture, analysis, engineering, quality and production support.
* Demonstrated ability to work across both functional / domain and technology disciplines.
* Experience developing senior specialists, architects, functional leaders, domain experts or engineering leaders.
* Strong track record influencing senior stakeholders in a matrix organization.
* Experience driving organizational transformation and establishing new operating models.
* Exposure to enterprise SaaS, cloud modernization, AI-enabled engineering and contemporary product-development practices strongly preferred.
* ERP, government solutions or large mission-critical enterprise-platform experience would be advantageous, but is not mandatory.

  
Good to have skills:  
The successful candidate should be someone who:  

* thinks several years ahead about capability rather than simply responding to today's staffing needs;
* has enough credibility with Engineering Directors and architects to challenge them constructively;
* equally values functional / domain depth and engineering excellence;
* can create standards without creating bureaucracy;
* develops strong specialist leaders rather than centralizing expertise around themselves;
* is comfortable working through influence in a matrix;
* uses evidence and data to identify capability risks;
* understands that capability development must ultimately translate into better product outcomes.

**Position Summary**

The Executive Director - Managed Services Transition Principal is a senior individual contributor accountable for defining, shaping and assuring the most complex and strategically significant Finance Managed Services transitions across Finance Managed Services.   + Architect transition waves that account for period-end and year-end close, statutory reporting, audit dependencies, tax calendars, treasury cut-offs and business-critical finance cycles.

jobs.description:
**BPM Overview:**

What does BPM stand for? Innovation, opportunity, community, diversity, inclusivity, flexibility and so much more. B-P-M stands for “Because People Matter,” because at our core, our people drive everything we do and how we do it.

We are a forward-thinking, full-service accounting firm providing modern solutions to businesses across the globe. We focus on comprehensive assurance, tax, and consulting services for our clients, and we provide our people and our community with the resources to lead meaningful and purposeful lives.

While we are one of the largest California-based accounting firms, our flexible work locations and schedules mean we have professionals across the continent. Our teams and our clients drive us to provide quality services and ignite unique insights and ideas that contribute to our continued success. Our clients come from different backgrounds and industries, which keep our people intellectually challenged every day.

**BPM India Advisory Service Private Limited** - Formerly known as “Burr Pilger Mayer India Private Limited”. (BPM India) is a subsidiary of BPM LLP. Founded in 1986, BPM is one of the largest California-based accounting and consulting firms, ranking in the top 50 in the country. With 19 different office locations, BPM serves emerging and mid-cap businesses as well as high-net-worth individuals in a broad range of industries, including financial services, technology, life science, manufacturing, food, wine and craft brewing, automotive, nonprofits, real estate and construction. The Firm’s International Tax Practice is one of the largest on the West Coast and its well-recognized SEC practice serves approximately 35 public reporting companies, mostly in the technology industry.

  

**About the Role**

BPM is looking for an experienced **Tax Senior Manager** to join our Bengaluru team and play a key leadership role in delivering high-quality U.S. tax services.

This position is designed for an experienced tax professional who is ready to operate beyond traditional preparation and review responsibilities. The Senior Manager will take meaningful ownership of engagements, exercise sound technical and professional judgment, develop the capabilities of our Bengaluru team, and work directly with BPM Partners, Directors and Managers in the United States.

The successful candidate will be more than a technical reviewer. We are looking for a leader who can **take ownership, anticipate issues, develop people, drive work forward and help expand the work BPM's Bengaluru team can lead from India.**

### **What You Will Do:**

**Lead and Own Tax Engagements**

* Take ownership of U.S. tax engagements from planning through completion, including workflow, staffing, budgets, deadlines, review and delivery.
* Manage multiple engagements and competing deadlines while maintaining a high standard of technical quality and client service.
* Review complex federal, state and local income tax returns and related workpapers.
* Identify technical and engagement issues early, research alternatives and recommend practical solutions.
* Exercise professional judgment in determining when matters can be resolved within the engagement team and when consultation or escalation is appropriate.
* Monitor engagement progress, economics and staffing needs and proactively address potential issues before they affect delivery.
* Help establish repeatable processes that allow greater portions of engagements to be effectively owned and managed from Bengaluru.

**Demonstrate Technical Leadership**

* Apply strong knowledge of U.S. federal, state and local tax requirements to complex engagements.
* Provide thoughtful review comments that improve both the immediate work product and the technical capabilities of the professionals completing the work.

* Stay current on relevant changes in U.S. tax law, regulations, guidance and firm methodology.
* Promote consistent application of BPM's quality standards, documentation requirements and risk-management practices.
* Identify opportunities to improve engagement processes, standardization and use of technology.

**Develop and Lead People**

* Lead, coach and develop Managers, Seniors and Associates within the Bengaluru tax practice.
* Build technical competence, confidence, judgment and accountability throughout the team.
* Provide timely, specific and constructive feedback rather than relying solely on review notes.
* Help team members understand not only **what** needs to be changed, but **why** it matters.
* Delegate effectively and expand responsibilities as team members demonstrate readiness.
* Participate in staffing, performance discussions, recruiting, onboarding and development of tax professionals.
* Help identify and develop future leaders for the Bengaluru practice.

**Work as One Global Team**

* Work directly with U.S.-based Partners, Directors and Managers as an integrated member of the engagement leadership team.
* Develop strong working relationships across locations, service teams and levels of the firm.
* Communicate engagement status, risks and issues clearly and early, accompanied whenever possible by a recommended solution.
* Participate confidently in engagement planning, technical discussions and appropriate client conversations.
* Ensure effective handoffs and coordination across time zones.
* Help U.S. and Bengaluru teams determine which responsibilities and workstreams can appropriately transition to greater Bengaluru ownership.
* Promote a culture in which global delivery is viewed as **one engagement team with shared accountability for quality and client service**.

### **What We're Looking For:**

* **10+ years of progressive U.S. tax experience**, including substantial experience reviewing complex tax engagements.
* CPA, EA, CA or comparable professional credential mandatory.
* Strong technical knowledge of U.S. federal, state and local taxation.
* Demonstrated experience managing engagements from planning through delivery.
* Ability to manage staffing, workflow, deadlines, budgets and technical review across multiple engagements.
* Proven experience reviewing and developing the work of Managers, Seniors and Associates.
* Strong technical research, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Sound professional judgment and the ability to distinguish between routine issues and matters requiring consultation or escalation.
* Ability to work directly and effectively with U.S.-based engagement leadership.
* A proactive mindset, with a demonstrated ability to **anticipate problems and recommend solutions rather than simply respond to instructions or review comments**.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex tax matters clearly.
* Strong organizational and project-management capabilities.
* Experience working successfully across global teams and time zones.
* Demonstrated commitment to quality, client service, continuous improvement and professional development.

### **What Success Looks Like:**

A successful Senior Manager will increasingly become a **trusted extension of BPM's U.S. engagement leadership** while building greater leadership capability in Bengaluru.

Success in this role means:

* Engagements are delivered accurately, efficiently and on time.
* Issues are identified early and communicated with proposed solutions.
* Work moves through the engagement with fewer unnecessary review cycles and handoffs.
* U.S. engagement leaders have confidence in the Senior Manager's technical judgment and ownership.
* Managers, Seniors and Associates demonstrate measurable growth in technical ability, judgment and confidence.
* More engagement responsibilities can be managed effectively from Bengaluru without compromising quality or client experience.

**About Cencora**
-----------------

Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

**Job Details**
===============

**Role Summary**

The Senior Manager, Technology Services Category Management owns technology spend sourcing activity within Technology Services category. The role develops and executes category strategy, partners with business and IT stakeholders to capture value, and leads and coaches the team supporting the category. This is a critical role in delivering savings, risk reduction and supplier performance for the enterprise.

**Category Focus**

* Technology Services: IT consulting, systems integration, application development and managed services, staff augmentation, outsourcing and offshore delivery models.

**Primary Duties and Responsibilities**

* **Category strategy and pipeline**: Define and manage category strategies, sourcing plans and pipeline priorities for assigned technology spend, aligned with business demand, service, quality and cost objectives; develop the annual category plan and contribute to the five-year strategy and long-range plan.
* **Productivity identification**: Own category productivity (cost savings and cost avoidance); analyse spend, demand and market data to identify opportunities such as consolidation, demand management, renegotiation, rate and license optimization and process improvement; build and maintain a prioritized opportunity pipeline.
* **Sourcing and negotiation**: Lead sourcing events, supplier evaluations, negotiations and award recommendations, including select enterprise contracts end-to-end with support from Sourcing Managers, to secure commercial value and category continuity within policy and control requirements; guide the team on complex commercial and contractual issues.
* **Productivity delivery**: Drive delivery of negotiated productivity through realization, validating savings against baseline spend with Finance, ensuring negotiated terms are implemented and adopted by the business, and tracking benefits to completion.
* **Supplier management**: Manage supplier performance, contract compliance and issue resolution across the category portfolio, addressing service, quality, risk and supply concerns; run business reviews, track SLAs and KPIs, monitor financial and cyber risk, and drive innovation and sustainability commitments. Lead QBR with strategic technology suppliers to evaluate performance and drive supplier accountability.
* **Stakeholder coordination**: Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders (business, IT, Legal, Finance, Security, Sourcing and Corporate Program Managers, Regional Sourcing/Country Leads) to align requirements, specifications, timelines and handoffs; serve as primary contact with business, IT and vendor leadership and provide timely status updates with risks and recommendations to senior leadership.
* **Financial and performance management**: Manage category budgets, savings tracking, resource utilization and short-term delivery plans using financial, capacity and quality metrics; guide team analysis of category performance to improve results.
* **Market and technology insight**: Maintain current knowledge of market trends, emerging technologies (e.g., cloud, AI, cybersecurity) and vendor capabilities to inform strategy and negotiation positions.
* **Process improvement and standardization**: Lead process improvements, onboarding, cross-training and local standardization efforts to stabilize throughput, strengthen quality and support adoption of approved tools and practices; review and update category policies, procedures and playbooks.
* **Team leadership**: Oversee team performance across onshore and offshore locations; assign and review work, set goals, coach development, and support talent decisions to maintain clear routines, accountability and escalation paths; hold regular team meetings to review progress and remove obstacles.
* **AI Adoption**: Bridge traditional procurement domain knowledge (strategic sourcing, category management, and procure-to-pay) with scalable AI deployment, driving operational efficiency, cost-out strategies, and automated workflows.
* **Director support**: Support the Director in stakeholder engagement and relationship management, fostering innovation, collaboration and alignment across functions.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, Information Technology or related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
* 15 to 20 years of experience in strategic sourcing, category management or procurement, with at least 7 years focused on technology services category required.
* 7+ years of experience leading or coaching team members; experience managing teams across multiple geographies is preferred.
* Demonstrated success negotiating complex, high-value technology contracts and delivering measurable savings.
* Strong understanding of technology commercial models (IT consulting, systems integration, application development and managed services, staff augmentation, outsourcing and offshore delivery models) and related risk, data privacy and security considerations.
* Advanced analytical skills; proficiency with spend analytics and sourcing tools (e.g., Ariba, Power BI, Excel).
* Excellent communication and executive presence; proven ability to influence senior business and IT stakeholders.
* Experience with MA&D sourcing support, and healthcare, pharma or other regulated industry, is a plus.
* Professional certification (CPSM, CPP, ISM or similar) a plus.

Strategic thinking | Negotiation and commercial acumen | Stakeholder influence | Data-driven decision making | People leadership | Vendor and risk management | Collaboration across regions
