jobs.title: Head of Banking & Payment Partnerships
jobs.description:
**Who we are**
We are a global wealth-tech company powering the next generation of trading. We deliver cutting-edge centralised trading solutions and robust B2B financial infrastructure. Our proprietary trading platform offers clients seamless access to stocks, ETFs, bonds, futures, options, swaps, funds, and currency pairs- all within a single, multi-currency account.
  
  
We believe in the boundless flow of capital and information. Whilst developing EXANTE, we saw technology as a means to improve global connectivity of the financial services industry. Over the years, we have earned a reputation for providing superior service and for getting the results our clients and customers want.
  
  
Most importantly, people have come to know us for our technological insights and focus on privacy. Our inspiration stems from the talent and ambition of our clients. We are offering an ecosystem of financial products and services that would provide the most tailored assistance to traders.
  
  
**Our culture**
Everything at EXANTE starts with our people. We bring together almost 800 minds across 70 locations. We place trust in our team with real autonomy - the freedom to drive change across products, processes and everything in between. That trust fuels innovation, and the demands of the markets build resilience; we adapt, push forward, and we look after each other while we do it.
  
  
That freedom is matched by real investment in growth: we back our people with ongoing learning, hands-on development and the kind of stretch opportunities that turn good careers into great ones.
  
  
**The Role Purpose**
We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven Head of Banking & Payment Partnerships to lead the development, expansion and management of EXANTE’s global banking and payment partner network.
  
  
This is a senior, hands-on role with end-to-end responsibility for establishing and maintaining strategic relationships with banks, payment service providers and e-money institutions across multiple jurisdictions.
  
  
You will play a critical role in strengthening our banking infrastructure, diversifying counterparty relationships, optimising commercial terms and ensuring reliable banking and payment services that support our international business and clients.
  
  
Working closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams, you will combine strong industry relationships, commercial negotiation skills and operational expertise to build a resilient, cost-effective and scalable banking network.
  
  
**Reporting Line**
— Chair Of Executive Committee
  
  
**Worksite**
— Remote
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Develop and expand our global banking network: Identify, evaluate and establish new relationships with banks, payment service providers and e-money institutions across key jurisdictions, including Malta, Cyprus, the UAE and Mauritius, supporting EXANTE’s international growth and operational needs.
* Own the end-to-end counterparty lifecycle: Lead the entire process from initial engagement and commercial negotiations through due diligence, onboarding, account opening and ongoing relationship management, ensuring timely and successful execution.
* Drive commercial value: Negotiate competitive banking and payment terms, including transaction fees, interest on client balances, credit facilities, account conditions and service levels, with a focus on cost optimisation and long-term value.
* Manage and strengthen strategic partnerships: Build trusted, sustainable relationships with existing banking partners through regular engagement, proactive issue resolution and ongoing management of compliance requirements, account restrictions and service performance.
* Lead banking due diligence and onboarding: Coordinate complex KYC, AML and regulatory due diligence processes, working closely with internal Compliance, Risk and other stakeholders to address counterparty requirements and facilitate successful onboarding.
* Ensure operational readiness and resilience: Partner with Finance, IT and Operations to establish effective banking and payment processes, including account structures, payment connectivity, transaction flows, reconciliations and contingency arrangements.
* Optimise counterparty diversification and performance: Monitor banking relationships, service quality, costs and counterparty concentration, identifying opportunities to mitigate risks, improve efficiency and strengthen the resilience of our banking infrastructure.
* Drive cross-functional execution and reporting: Collaborate with senior leadership and teams across the business to prioritise banking initiatives, manage multiple onboarding projects and provide clear visibility of partnership pipelines, commercial outcomes and emerging risks.

**What You Will Bring**
- Extensive relevant experience: At least 8 years of experience in banking relationship management, treasury, payment partnerships or financial institution coverage, ideally within a brokerage, fintech, payment institution, e-money business or financial services environment.
  
  

* Established banking network: Strong, active relationships with banks, financial institutions and payment providers, ideally across key international markets, including Europe, the UAE and other relevant jurisdictions.
* Proven track record of establishing banking partnerships: Demonstrable success in securing new banking relationships, opening corporate and client-money or safeguarding accounts, and establishing payment solutions for regulated financial services businesses.
* Strong commercial and negotiation skills: Experience negotiating banking fees, interest arrangements, credit facilities and service agreements, with the ability to demonstrate measurable commercial improvements and cost efficiencies.
* Deep understanding of banking due diligence: Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, regulatory requirements and financial institution onboarding processes, particularly for businesses operating across multiple jurisdictions with complex international client bases.
* Knowledge of banking and payment infrastructure: Solid understanding of banking operations, client-money arrangements, payment flows and relevant payment systems, such as SWIFT, SEPA, local payment rails and banking APIs.
* Excellent stakeholder and relationship management skills: Ability to engage confidently with senior banking executives, compliance and risk teams, internal leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, building credibility and maintaining productive long-term partnerships.
* Strong execution and project management capabilities: A proactive, structured and results-oriented approach, with the ability to manage multiple complex banking initiatives simultaneously and drive them through to completion.
* International financial services exposure: Experience supporting brokerage or financial services businesses with international client bases, particularly across European, CIS or Middle Eastern markets, would be a strong advantage.
* Communication skills: Fluency in English, with excellent communication, presentation and influencing skills

EXANTE is a global prime broker backed by proprietary technology and dedicated service. All regulated group companies and fully controlled affiliates and subsidiaries are committed to compliance with data protection laws, including the GDPR. We process personal data in line with the GDPR principles of fairness, purpose limitation, transparency, data minimisation, storage limitation and deletion, accuracy, confidentiality and integrity, and accountability. We rely on legitimate interests to assess and manage your application, after determining that our interests are not overridden by your rights and interests. You have the rights of access, rectification, data portability, erasure, restriction of processing, and objection to processing. To exercise your rights or contact our Data Protection Officer, please see our GDPR policy at https://exante.eu/

jobs.title: Director - Visa Direct Business Strategy & Planning
jobs.description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Role Summary:
  
  
The Visa Direct CEMEA - Business Strategy and Planning - Director is the Business Planning & Strategy lead for Visa Direct in CEMEA, based in Dubai. The role works closely with the head of Strategy and Business Planning for CMS, as well as the VP, Head of Money Movement Solutions CEMEA, as strategic and planning partner on all internal and external initiatives. This role will help drive the strategy and transformation of Money Movement Solutions CEMEA while collaborating with key members of the CEMEA Leadership Team, Global Visa Direct Team, and other stakeholders.
  
  
**Strategy**
This role encompasses:
  
  

* Own the end-to-end Visa Direct CEMEA strategy, and translate Visa 2030 priorities into sub-regional and country plans with clear owners and milestones.
* Set product and use-case priorities by market with Regional and Global Visa Direct Commercialization and Product teams; prioritise opportunities through market sizing, whitespace, competitor and market-share analysis.
* Lead analysis and recommendations on Visa Direct pricing, incentives and IRF changes, and support M&A, investment and partnership opportunities with due diligence and business cases.
* Scan market, regulatory and ecosystem trends (e.g. real-time payments, stablecoins, fintech disruption) and provide insights on impact to strategy and key initiatives; coordinate with the VCS BPO Director on topics spanning CMS.

**Business Planning & Performance**

* With Finance and key business partners, lead the annual operating plan (AOP) and multi-year outlook, target setting, OKR planning and review, scorecards and business reviews; track quarterly Opex and investment.
* Maintain one consolidated view of revenue, net revenue, AANR and other KPIs, flag gaps and risks early, and reuse CMS Data, Analytics & AI and global dashboards rather than duplicating reporting.
* Drive AANR-to-net-revenue conversion by tracking signed agreements through launch to live volume; run pipeline and AANR governance with sub-regional sales leaders and shape priority deal strategy with CMS Deals Management.

**Sales And Account Management Excellence**

* Support the sales and account management center of excellence (COE): manage sales and implementation pipelines, share sales goals with partnering client segment units and define the optimal client coverage model.
* Plan sales targets in line with the AOP; provide inputs to incentive design (SIP) and recognition programs; monitor team performance against targets.
* Optimize sales processes, tools (MS Dynamics) and funding programs (e.g. VIK, MDF), with training to improve the team's skills.
* Orchestrate account planning to identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities, and drive the annual Global Client Engagement Survey (GCES) and corrective actions.

**Communications**

* Maintain internal communications (all-hands, newsletters) and share success stories across the CEMEA Money Movement organization.
* Lead materials for key cadences (MBRs, QBRs, all-staffs, Global and CEMEA LT sessions, client councils) and run the leadership operating rhythm with clear agendas, decisions and actions.
* Liaise with Global Money Movement, Investor Relations and Communications for Visa CEO, CFO, President and investment community forums.

**Execution**

* As a strategic partner to the CEMEA CMS head of BPO and head of Money Movement, organize and prioritize critical information and data for efficient decision-making and manage time-sensitive senior requests.
* Deliver strategic initiatives, from spinning up cross-functional teams to deal due diligence, and build the program management function to drive execution of key CEMEA Money Movement initiatives.
* Coordinate planning cycles with Global Visa Direct and Global CMS BPO, bring global best practice to the region and reuse CMS BPO and Centers of Excellence capabilities rather than rebuilding them.
* Work as one team with the other CMS functional BPOs and CoE to share best practices from Visa Direct with the wider team

This role sits at the intersection of multiple functions, so organizational savvy and interpersonal skills are critical. It works with Product groups, AEs, Merchant Sales, Regions, Operations, Technology, Risk, Data Science, Marketing, Communications, Legal, Corporate Strategy, Interchange/Pricing and Finance. About 60% of the role is the recurring operating rhythm (planning, OKRs, MBR/QBR, pipeline and performance reviews, Opex) and 40% strategic, project and ad-hoc work. The individual will be a thought leader in strategy and business growth with a proven track record in fast-paced environments with demanding timelines.
  
  
Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g., Masters, MBA, MD, PhD).
* Prior experience in management consulting or corporate strategy.
* Proven track record in annual and multi-year planning, OKRs and executive business reviews; strong financial acumen, including business cases and financial modeling.
* Financial/payment industry knowledge mandatory (money movement, cross-border flows); experience across emerging, multi-country markets such as CEMEA.
* Excellent problem-solving skills, customer-centric mindset and thought leadership, with evidence of tangible business results.
* Excellent communication, collaboration and influence skills; able to explain complex concepts to broad audiences and lead cross-functional teams to obtain buy-in.
* Strong sense of urgency and experience driving to successful commercialization; takes prompt, decisive action after analyzing relevant information.
* Ability to explain complex business and technical concepts to broad audiences in an approachable way.
* Experience leading and developing people; inclusive, learning-agile, with a real interest in the fintech ecosystem and a technology / digital-first approach; English required, Arabic, Russian or French an advantage.
* High levels of learning-agility with a real interest in the fintech ecosystem and a ‘technology / digital-first’ approach.
* Diversity of thought and experience. Continually seeks new perspectives and feedback, takes an inclusive approach, and engages diverse points of view.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Services Analytics Team Leader
jobs.description:
**Services Analytics Team Leader**
==================================

You will lead analytics for the **Services** cluster — the set of domains that protect trust, safety, and quality across every interaction on our platform. This is where the integrity of the marketplace is safeguarded and where millions of passengers and drivers experience inDrive as a safe and reliable place to be. Your teams will span five closely connected areas: **Watchdocs** (driver document verification and work with the compliance base), **Trust & Safety** (everything related to trust and safety in rides — incidents and safety features), **Customer Support** (both the product tooling for handling user requests and the automation of that work, plus WFM analytics of support agents' performance), **Customer Experience** (Voice-of-the-Customer feedback and connecting satisfaction metrics such as CSAT/DSAT to business metrics), and **Antifraud** (protecting rides, transactions, ratings, and more from abuse across inDrive).

  

You will build and manage a team that partners closely with **product, operations, support, and compliance** to turn a large volume of behavioral, operational, and feedback signals into decisions that reduce risk and improve experience at the same time. From detecting and quantifying fraud across rides and transactions, to measuring the real business impact of safety features and support automation, to linking customer-feedback metrics (CSAT/DSAT) with core business outcomes — your work will define how the company balances protection, cost, and user satisfaction.

  

In this role, you will act as a **strategic partner** to product and business leaders, as well as to Trust & Safety and Compliance stakeholders — shaping the analytics agenda for the Services cluster, defending its strategy in front of senior leadership, and building scalable processes, metrics, and standards that make trust and safety measurable across the whole platform.

  

Department

Analytics Department

Employment Type

Full Time

Location

United Arab Emirates

Workplace type

Fully remote

Requisition ID

1635

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own the **analytics strategy and roadmap** for the Services cluster (Watchdocs, Trust & Safety, Customer Support, CX, Antifraud), align it with company-level priorities, and defend it in front of senior leadership
* Build, grow, and develop a **team of 11+** (analysts) — hiring, mentoring, and setting quality standards across the cluster
* Lead **Antifraud analytics**: detect and quantify fraudulent behavior across rides, transactions, and ratings; evaluate the effectiveness of anti-fraud rules and models and their trade-off with false positives
* Drive **Trust & Safety analytics**: measure incident rates, evaluate the impact of safety features, and help prioritize initiatives that reduce risk for passengers and drivers
* Oversee **Customer Support analytics**: assess support tooling and automation effectiveness, contact-rate drivers, resolution quality, and WFM analytics for agent capacity and performance

jobs.title: Enterprise Solution Marketing Partner (Health Systems & Strategic Accounts)
jobs.description:
Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  
Die Position
  
  
TheEnterprise Solution Marketing Partner is responsible for orchestrating Account-Based Experience (ABX) strategies and high-value customer engagement for top-tier health systems, hospital networks, supreme health authorities, and non-traditional healthcare payers across the Middle East.
  
  
Grounded in the strategic priorities established by Regional Strategic Marketing in the Integrated Marketing Plan, you move beyond individual laboratory instrumentation to position Roche as an indispensable, long-term strategic partner for institutional C-suite executives (CEOs, CFOs, CMOs, and Chief Digital Officers). In this role, you bridge enterprise healthcare economics with clinical innovation, leading customized account-based campaigns, executive engagement forums, and strategic value propositions that accelerate multi-year institutional partnerships and health system transformations across the region.
  
  
Your Responsibilities
  
  

* Design and execute bespoke, multi-stakeholder account marketing programs tailored to the region’s largest and most strategic private and public healthcare accounts, driving executive alignment, customer retention, and multi-portfolio growth.
* Build and deliver compelling value propositions addressing the financial, operational, and clinical priorities of C-level executives, regional healthcare authorities, public health transformation bodies, and private healthcare networks.
* Translate complex diagnostics, digital health algorithms, enterprise automation, and consulting services into bundled, health-economic narratives that articulate total cost of ownership, operational efficiency, and population health impact.
* Serve as the regional voice for the Middle East on global enterprise and customer marketing councils. Ensure Middle Eastern institutional archetypes, government health transformation agendas, and regional commercial realities shape global enterprise marketing toolkits from inception.
* Design the strategic narrative and executive journeys for flagship customer experiences, including C-suite advisory boards, high-level hospital leadership roundtables, and international reference site visits showcasing cutting-edge diagnostic ecosystems.
* Leverage global enterprise messaging frameworks and collaborate with central creative and content operations teams to adapt executive collateral, thought leadership publications, and health-economic summaries for Middle Eastern healthcare leadership.
* Define hyper-targeted digital engagement channels (executive LinkedIn strategies, personalized content hubs, thought leadership webcasts, and direct executive communications), collaborating with central digital hubs to engage key buying committees.
* Partner directly with Strategic Account Managers, Enterprise Sales Directors, and Commercial Excellence leads to arm account teams with customized pitch decks, C-suite objection handling tools, and value-based procurement frameworks for major tenders and commercial negotiations.
* Lead the Medical, Legal, and Regulatory review process for enterprise messaging, health-economic claims, and executive materials, ensuring absolute compliance with local healthcare regulations and ethical standards.

Who You Are
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Healthcare Management, Biomedical Sciences, or a related field (Master’s or MBA is highly preferred)
* Typically 8+ to 10+ years of progressive commercial or marketing experience within Healthcare, Medical Technology, In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD), or Life Sciences, including substantial experience dedicated to enterprise healthcare solutions, strategic account marketing, or Account-Based Marketing (ABM/ABX)
* Proven track record of interacting with and presenting value propositions to executive-level stakeholders (CEOs, CFOs, medical directors, and healthcare authority officials)
* Solid understanding of hospital operational dynamics, health economics, public and private reimbursement systems, and regional healthcare transformation agendas across the Middle East
* Deep experience moving beyond product specifications to design holistic commercial narratives encompassing hardware, software, reagents, and consulting services
* Exceptional cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to orchestrate complex projects across commercial, medical, and global teams without direct authority
* Full professional proficiency in written and spoken English is required; fluency in Arabic is an advantage

Wer wir sind
  
  
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.
  
  
Gemeinsam können wir eine gesündere Zukunft gestalten.
  
  
Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber, der die Chancengleichheit fördert.

jobs.title: House Manager
jobs.description:
**About Zeta**

  

Build the future of banking.

  

Zeta is a next-generation banking technology company providing cloud-native, fully stackable processing and core banking platforms for issuers. With a focus on scalability, compliance, and innovation, Zeta empowers financial institutions to modernize their technology infrastructure and deliver secure, seamless digital banking experiences.

Our impact runs at real-world scale. Today, **over 25 million cards are live on Zeta-powered platforms across 7 countries, supported by a passionate team of 1,700+ Zetanauts** across India, the US, EMEA, and Asia. Backed by **SoftBank Vision Fund, Mastercard**, and other reputed strategic investors, we reached a valuation of **$2 billion** in 2025.

  

Our focus is on establishing product lines that focus on key outcomes by addressing real customer pain points, modernizing legacy systems, and strengthening core fundamentals. As a result, our systems and platforms support a wide range of banking and payments capabilities, including:

1. **Tachyon**, our cloud-native banking stack built for population-scale systems
2. **Cipher**, our unified authentication platform for secure, high-volume banking environments
3. **Digital Credit as a Service**, enabling banks to launch credit lines on UPI
4. **Elena**, our intelligent and conversational AI platform for banking
5. **Pixel**, Indias first digital-native credit card, launched in partnership with **HDFC Bank**, for whom we also revamped their **PayZapp** mobile app: Winner of the **Celent Model Bank Award for Payments Innovation 2024**
6. **Sparrow**, the leading card experience for non-prime cardholders in the US   
    and more across cards, payments, lending, and core banking.

  

We are an engineering-first organization that values ownership, bias for action, and long-term thinking. Together, we solve some of the hardest problems in banking tech.

  

Our culture is built around trust, collaboration, and creating the conditions for you to drive impact proportionate to your potential. Reinforcing our commitment to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace, we have been consistently recognized as a **Great Place to Work**.

  

**If you want to build cutting-edge banking tech that enables banks to serve millions reliably, securely, and at a population scale, Zeta is your playground.**

  

If you would like to learn more about how we have grown and evolved over the years, **watch our journey here**. You can also explore **our website** and follow us on **LinkedIn, Instagram,** **YouTube, and X.**

  

**About the Role**

The Household Supervisor / House Manager will be responsible for the smooth, efficient, and discreet operation of the household. The candidate will act as the primary point of coordination between the family, household staff, and external vendors, ensuring that the home is maintained to high standards of organization, hospitality, and service.

  

The ideal candidate should have a strong hospitality background, proven leadership ability, and the capacity to manage people, processes, and day-to-day household operations with professionalism and discretion.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Supervise and coordinate all household staff to ensure efficient daily operations.
* Maintain high standards of housekeeping, wardrobe organization, and overall household presentation.
* Manage household inventory, purchases, and expense records within approved budgets.
* Oversee meal service, guest hospitality, and family service standards.
* Coordinate vendors for maintenance, deep cleaning, laundry, and other household services.
* Prepare the household and family for travel, including wardrobe and packing coordination.
* Conduct regular reviews of household expenses, inventory, and staff performance and keep a track of all the details accordingly.
* Delegate responsibilities effectively to ensure uninterrupted household operations during absences.
* The candidate should be able to handle day-to-day household situations calmly, patiently, and with sound judgment, while always maintaining professionalism and discretion.

  

**Skills:**

* Should be fluent in Tamil; conversational proficiency in at least one of English, Hindi, or Telugu.
* Professional communication skills while interacting with family members, staff, and vendors.
* Highly trustworthy, discreet, and committed to maintaining confidentiality.
* Strong leadership with empathy and professionalism.
* Highly organized, with strong attention to detail.
* Proactive and able to anticipate family requirements.
* Calm, dependable, and solution oriented.
* Service-focused, with a hospitality mindset.
* Maintains the highest standards of discretion and confidentiality.

  

**Experience:**

* Minimum 5 years in household management, luxury hospitality, estate management, or a similar environment.
* Strong experience in housekeeping, inventory management, wardrobe organization, scheduling, and travel preparation.
* Should have basic computer literacy to put in all the expenses in excel tracker and update maintenance details of all the other household items for their warranty, AMC etc.
* Proven ability to recruit, train, supervise, and motivate domestic staff.
* Comfortable managing petty cash, household budgets, expense records, and vendor payments.

  

**Equal Opportunity**

Zeta is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds, cultures, and communities to apply and believe that a diverse workforce is key to our success.

At Azentio, we believe that growth is a continuous journey. We believe that each step of this journey must be taken by committing to excellence - excellence in our products, our services, our ideas, and our people.

  

**Job Title:** Enterprise – Business Consultant – Financing

**Years of Experience:** 4– 6 years

**Location:** Bangalore, India

  

**Role Summary:**

The Business consultant – Treasury/ Investment is responsible for a variety of roles as a consultant and system implementor specialist either as a sole contributor or as part of a larger team of the proposed solution. He/she will manage requests and requirements if our customers, through a proven, structured methodology ensuring a necessary solution is provided meeting the need, having knowledge transferred, while best practices are adhered to. Projects assigned to may be either on-site or remote and required to be in a dynamic work environment with willingness/ flexibility to travel.

  

**What will you do?**

* Gather and analyze client requirements via workshops, questionnaires, surveys, workflow storyboards, use cases, scenarios, and other methods.
* Perform workflow and gap analysis, documentation, and optimization based on a bottom-up analysis of client business rules and transactions.
* Prepares well-structured quality official documentation (e.g. Analysis and build documents, training presentations, BRD, UAT test cases, etc.) to be submitted to the client or for internal use.
* Liaise with business representatives, stakeholders, and users to ensure the validity of inputs to business analysis tasks and to validate the results of any proposed changes.
* Responsible for the implementation of Islamic Banking application, performing Gap Analysis, SIT, UAT, and support of our solutions either remote or at customer’s sites.
* Provide training to our customers on the solution functionalities where applicable as well as to internal teams as requested.
* Provide mentorship for junior members sharing expert knowledge and guiding on improving respective domain knowledge.
* Raising and coordinating with the internal teams for solving the system issues in day-to-day operations.
* Taking support of and working together with the technical team wherever needed to facilitate troubleshooting of issues and finding solutions.
* Work in close collaboration with business stakeholders and other IT system delivery teams to ensure business specifications are properly understood by all stakeholders and translated into effective solution designs.
* Conduct necessary validation tests before solution delivery to customers as well as participate in user acceptance testing during iterative implementation cycles to ensure that products meet functional specifications and customer quality expectations.
* Respect and obey company rules, policies, and procedures.

  

**Qualifications:**

Good to have both below or one of these:

  

**Investments/ Assets**

* Different types of Market Instruments (Islamic/Conventional): Shares, sovereign and corporate bonds/Sukuk, derivatives (options, Repos), and commodities.
* Managing different types/categories of Portfolios and Fund Management
* Market trading flows and corporate actions (front office, and back-office operations)
* Custodian management
* Limits managements like portfolio, dealer, broker, transaction, security, eco sector limits,
* Concept of Mark to Market, revaluation, amortization, and accruals.
* Collateral management and cash Margin
* SWIFT Payments – Securities Markets Categories
* Preparations and reporting portfolio positions, performance, and inflows.

  

**Treasury**

* Treasury Instruments (Islamic/Conventional): Client and Interbank management:
* Money Market products (Overnight deals – different types of Placements/borrowings);
* Foreign Exchange trading products (FX, Forwards);
* Promissory FX, Swap FX
* Forward FX revaluation
* Derivatives (Cross-currency swaps/Interest-Profit swaps)
* Trading flow (Front office, and back-office operations)
* Different limits managements
* SWIFT Payments - Treasury Markets: Precious Metals and Syndications categories
* Preparations and reporting of currency positions, cash management, etc

  

**Good to have knowledge and experience worked on:**

* Islamic Treasury products like Musharaka, Wakala, Murabaha, Tawaruq etc.
* Bloomberg or Reuters platforms or integrations
* Business analysis for IT software application development projects of Banking Treasury domain.

  

**General skills:**

* Ability to learn new business and module through self-study
* Good communication skills
* Should be able to work independent and part of a group
* Committed to provide quality results
* Ability to operate comfortably under stress
* Able to properly manage his/her time and tasks
* Analysis and problem solving
* Willing to travel on assignments as required
* Previous experience in implementing and supporting banking solutions is a plus
* Have good verbal and written communication skills in English, (Arabic/French - will be added advantage).

  

**What we Aim for?**

Azentio aims to be the leading provider of Banking, Financial Services & Insurance (BFSI) & Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software products in Asia Pacific, Middle East & Africa & United States. We will achieve this by:

* Providing world class software products, built on the latest technologies.
* Providing best in class customer service, built on a deep understanding of our domains and local nuances.
* Being an employer of choice, attracting high quality talent.
* Achieving top quartile growth and margins.

  

**Azentio Core Values:**

We work as one, **Collaborate** without boundaries, and win together.

We work with **Uncompromising Integrity** and **Accountability. Customer** is at the core of all that we do.

We are **Diverse and Inclusive**. We treat our people, our customers and our wider community with **Respect and Care.**

We **Innovate**, we **Excel** and we **Grow Together**.

We **Give Back** to our communities through our business and our people. We take **Pride** in all that we do and together we **Enjoy** the journey

jobs.title: Deputy Manager - Finance
jobs.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

  

1. **Financial Reporting, MIS & Planning**

* Prepare and review financial statements, management information reports (MIS) and periodic financial performance reports.
* Lead budgeting, forecasting and financial planning processes in coordination with business stakeholders.
* Conduct cost, margin and variance analysis to identify financial performance trends, deviations and improvement opportunities.
* Ensure timely and accurate month-end and year-end closing processes.
* Provide financial insights and analysis to management to support business decisions.

2. **Accounting & Statutory Compliance**

* Oversee general ledger (GL) review, accounts payable, fixed asset accounting and reconciliation processes.
* Ensure accuracy, integrity and completeness of financial records and accounting transactions.
* Monitor compliance with applicable statutory and tax requirements, including GST and TDS.
* Coordinate internal audits, statutory audits and other financial reviews.
* Ensure timely bank, vendor and other account reconciliations.

3. **Treasury, Banking & Working Capital Management**

* Manage cash flow forecasting, liquidity planning and fund management.
* Monitor working capital, receivables, payables and cash conversion efficiency.
* Oversee banking operations, corporate finance activities and foreign remittances.
* Ensure optimal utilization of funds and effective management of cash and liquidity requirements.
* Coordinate with banking partners and financial institutions for operational and financial requirements.

4. **Cost Optimization & Cash Flow Improvement**

* Identify opportunities for cost reduction, operational efficiency and financial savings.
* Monitor budgets, expenditure and financial performance to ensure disciplined financial management.
* Drive cash generation initiatives through investment optimization, recoveries and efficient working capital management.
* Identify opportunities to improve margins, cash flow and overall financial efficiency.

5. **Internal Financial Controls & Risk Management**

* Design, implement and strengthen Internal Financial Controls (IFC) across financial and operational processes.
* Ensure adherence to financial policies, procedures, approval matrices and control mechanisms.
* Identify financial risks, control gaps and process inefficiencies and implement corrective actions.
* Strengthen payment controls, transaction accuracy, compliance and risk mitigation processes.

6. **ERP & Financial Systems**

* Manage and leverage ERP and accounting systems to ensure accurate financial processing, reporting and control.
* Work with systems including SAP Business ByDesign, Microsoft Dynamics AX, ERPNext, Tally ERP9 and Busy.
* Support system improvements, automation and process standardization across finance operations

jobs.title: Regional Manager - South (Large Format Retail)
jobs.description:
**Role Summary**

  

We are seeking a commercially astute **Regional Manager South** to drive sales, brand visibility, and operational excellence across our **sales counters** within leading Large Format Retail (LFR) chains across South India. You will manage a team of Territory Managers, Area Operation Managers, and Brand Staffs, acting as the primary regional bridge between our brand and LFR store leadership to maximize counter productivity and market share in the mens apparel category.

  

**Role & responsibilities**

  

**1. Sales Growth & LFR Counter Productivity**

* Achieve regional secondary sales targets and drive consistent Like-for-Like (LFL) growth across all LFR counters in Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, and Kerala.
* Track and optimize LFR specific KPIs, including **Sales Per Square Foot (SPSF)**, **Stock-to-Sales Ratio**, **Sell-Through %**, and **Promoter Productivity**.
* Execute joint promotional calendars, End-of-Season Sales (EOSS), and regional festive campaigns in alignment with LFR partner guidelines.

  

**2. LFR Stakeholder & Space Management**

* Build and maintain strong working relationships with LFR Regional Heads, Store Managers, and Department Managers to secure prime counter locations, high-footfall aisles, and additional seasonal space (wall bays, and focal points etc).
* Negotiate visibility enhancements and resolve store-level operational bottlenecks swiftly.

  

**3. Inventory, Replenishment & Shrinkage Control**

* Coordinate closely with the central Key Account Management (KAM) teams to ensure timely replenishment, optimal core-size availability, and balanced stock ageing across counters.
* Manage Inter-Store Transfers (IST) and timely Return-to-Vendor (RTV) processes for slow-moving or end-of-season stock.
* Conduct regular stock audits to reconcile inventory and minimize shrinkage/shortages.

  

**4. Visual Merchandising & Brand Standards**

* Ensure strict compliance with brand Visual Merchandising (VM) guidelines across all counter fixtures, signage, and lightingwhile adhering to each LFR partners floor standards.
* Oversee seamless seasonal range launches and fixture upgrades across the region.

  

**5. Team Leadership & Promoter Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and review a regional team of Territory & Area Managers and Brand Staffs
* Drive Brand Staff attendance, grooming standards, product knowledge (fabric, fit, styling), and consultative selling skills to boost Units Per Transaction (UPT).
* Control manpower attrition and build a bench of high-performing counter staff.

  

**Preferred candidate profile**

  

1. **Education:** Graduate in any discipline; MBA in Sales/Marketing or Retail Management preferred.
2. **Experience:** 10–12 years in apparel sales/retail operations, with at least 3–5 years managing **LFR key accounts** in men’s fashion (formals, casuals, denim, suit & blazer etc).
3. **Domain Expertise:** Proven track record of working with national LFR chains and deep familiarity with SOR (Sale or Return) and commercial terms.
4. **Skills:** Strong negotiation skills, analytical proficiency (MS Excel, secondary sales tracking, sell-through analysis), and relationship-building acumen.
5. **Languages:** Fluency in English and Hindi; working knowledge of at least one South Indian language (Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, or Malayalam) is strongly preferred.
6. **Mobility:** Willingness to travel 50–60% of the month across South Indian metros and Tier-1/Tier-2 cities.

* Improvement in lead conversion and closure rates.

**Job Summary**  

Acquire and convert eligible Education Loan customers through compliant counselling, disciplined funnel management, complete documentation, coordinated fulfilment and active ownership of portfolio quality.

  
  
**Responsibilities**  

* Generate and manage leads from direct, referral, consultant, institution and partner channels.
* Counsel students and co-applicants on course, country, institution, funding requirement, repayment construct and documentation.
* Capture complete application data, customer consent and source attribution in approved systems.
* Collect and validate admission, academic, KYC, income, banking and collateral documents before login.
* Coordinate with Credit, Operations, Verification and partners to resolve queries and progress files within agreed service levels.
* Track the lead-to-login, login-to-sanction and sanction-to-disbursement funnel and record lost reasons and corrective actions.
* Communicate sanction terms, conditions and pending requirements accurately to customers.
* Maintain compliant selling, customer confidentiality, audit trails and approved communication standards.
* Support portfolio quality through appropriate sourcing, fraud vigilance and early issue escalation.
* Drive cluster portfolio quality through regular review of X-bucket and early-delinquency trends, allocation and monitoring of follow-up actions, root-cause identification and coordinated resolution with Collections, Credit, Risk and Operations.
* Translate business plans into cluster execution priorities.
* Review team productivity, sourcing quality, controls and capability.
* Resolve cross-functional bottlenecks and escalate structural issues with evidence.

  
  
**Key Decisions / Dimensions**  

* Make day-to-day sales and customer-management decisions within approved policy, process, pricing and delegated authority.
* Prioritise and allocate customer follow-ups, including portfolio-quality and X-bucket actions, within the assigned scope.
* Escalate policy deviations, material customer impact, fraud indicators, persistent overdue cases and unresolved dependencies.
* Commercial, hiring and budget authorities are to be defined in the approved delegation matrix.
* Key interactions: Internal Sales, Product, Credit/Underwriting, Risk, Operations, RCU/Fraud Control, Collections, Compliance, Finance, Technology, HR and COE.
* External Students, co-applicants, universities, education consultants, DSAs, referral partners and other approved service providers.

  
  
**Major Challenges**  

* Balancing growth, customer experience, turnaround time and portfolio quality.
* Managing incomplete or inconsistent customer, academic and financial information.
* Driving timely customer engagement for pre-due, pre-bounce and overdue cases while following approved conduct standards.
* Coordinating Sales, Collections, Credit, Risk and Operations to address X-bucket and early-delinquency issues.

  
  
**Required Qualifications and Experience**  

Graduate or postgraduate with demonstrated experience managing a sales team, geography or lending portfolio.

* Education Loan customer counselling
* Sales execution and relationship management
* Portfolio-quality and X-bucket management awareness
* Customer repayment engagement and early-delinquency follow-up
* Understanding of academic, income and KYC documents
* CRM/LOS usage and MIS discipline
* Communication, negotiation and customer orientation
* Compliance, fraud and customer-conduct awareness
* Excel, presentation and business MIS capability
* High standards of integrity and customer confidentiality

jobs.title: Oracle Fusion Payables (AP) Functional Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Title: Oracle Fusion Payables (AP) Functional Analyst

**Client:** eClerx  
**Employment Type:** Contract-to-Hire (C2H)  
  
**Locations:** Mumbai, Pune, Gurugram & Chandigarh

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Oracle Fusion Cloud Payables Functional Analyst with strong hands-on experience in Oracle Fusion Financials, particularly the Accounts Payable (AP) module and end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes.

The candidate should have experience in functional configuration, implementation, production support, business requirement gathering, invoice processing, payment configuration, approval workflows, accounting, integrations, testing, and quarterly Oracle updates.

The ideal candidate should have worked on at least 2 full-cycle Oracle Fusion Cloud implementations or major support engagements and be capable of independently managing functional workstreams.

Key Responsibilities

* Configure and support Oracle Fusion Cloud Payables, including Business Units, Payables Options, Invoice Options, Invoice Types, Payment Terms, Distribution Sets, Tax, Withholding Tax, Holds, Releases, Payment Methods and Payment Process Profiles.
* Manage the complete Invoice-to-Pay lifecycle, including invoice creation, validation, approvals, payment processing and accounting.
* Work on invoice capture through manual entry, spreadsheet uploads, IDR (Intelligent Document Recognition) and e-invoicing.
* Configure invoice approval workflows using BPM and approval rules.
* Configure 2-way, 3-way and 4-way matching with Procurement, including matching tolerances and exception handling.
* Configure and troubleshoot Subledger Accounting (SLA) rules, accounting distributions and integration with General Ledger (GL).
* Support integration touchpoints with Procurement, Cash Management and Fixed Assets.
* Manage AP period-end closing activities, including accruals, reconciliation, uninvoiced receipts and accounting validations.
* Prepare supplier and open invoice data migration requirements and validate FBDI uploads.
* Configure and support Supplier Portal functionality, including supplier self-service invoicing and payment status visibility.
* Work on payment processing, payment file generation, bank configuration and payment-to-bank reconciliation touchpoints with Cash Management.
* Review Oracle Fusion quarterly updates, Redwood UI changes and new features impacting Payables.
* Conduct regression testing for quarterly releases and validate business-critical AP processes.
* Prepare functional specifications, test scenarios, test scripts and configuration documents.
* Participate in SIT, UAT, defect tracking, root-cause analysis and defect resolution.
* Prepare user manuals, SOPs and deliver end-user training.
* Coordinate with business stakeholders, technical teams and offshore delivery teams across different time zones.

Mandatory Skills

* 58 years of Oracle ERP Finance / Oracle Fusion Financials experience.
* Strong hands-on experience in Oracle Fusion Cloud Payables (AP).
* At least 2 full-cycle Oracle Fusion implementations or major support engagements.
* Strong knowledge of Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Invoice-to-Pay processes.
* Hands-on configuration experience using Setup and Maintenance / Functional Setup Manager.
* Experience with AP invoice validation, holds, approvals, payment processing and accounting.
* BPM approval workflow configuration and approval rules.
* 2-way, 3-way and 4-way matching.
* Subledger Accounting (SLA) configuration and AP-to-GL reconciliation.
* FBDI data migration and supplier/open invoice migration validation.
* Experience in SIT, UAT, testing and defect management.
* Exposure to Oracle Fusion quarterly updates and Redwood UX.
* Strong stakeholder communication and documentation skills.

Preferred Skills

* Oracle Fusion Financials certification.
* Experience with Supplier Portal, Cash Management or Expenses.
* OTBI, BI Publisher and Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI) reporting exposure.
* Multi-entity, multi-currency and multi-country implementations.
* Experience with localization, tax and withholding tax configurations.
* Exposure to e-invoicing and Intelligent Document Recognition (IDR).

Candidate Profile

Candidates should be able to independently handle functional configuration, business requirement analysis, solution design, testing, implementation and production support activities.

**Interested candidates should be comfortable with Contract-to-Hire (C2H) employment.**

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a driven and detail-oriented Business Analyst to join our Technology PMO team. In this role, you will help bridge the gap between our BFL technology platform and line of businesses by designing and orchestrating complex automated workflows for our Apps Web Platform. This role is ideal for a professional with a strong technical foundation who understands that true integration goes beyond point-to-point data exchange and requires deep expertise in end-to-end workflow automation. You will collaborate closely with engineering, design, and business teams to take ownership of product features from discovery through delivery and then support.

**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with Center of Excellence team to define and execute the product roadmap for core platform integrations, APIs, and business workflows.
* Design, document, and optimize end-to-end integration workflows that automate complex business processes and ensure seamless data orchestration across multiple platforms.
* Translate business needs and business requirements into clear, actionable technical user stories, workflow diagrams, and product specifications.
* Partner with engineering teams in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and backlog grooming to ensure timely delivery of integration features and automated workflows.
* Monitor and analyze platform performance metrics to measure the uptime of launched integrations and identify areas for workflow optimization.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Minimum 3-4 years of career experience, with hands-on Mobile Apps Web Platform (PO/PM) or technical business analysis experience in technology products.
* Experience over workflows is a must. You must have a proven track record of designing, mapping, and managing complex automated workflows, state machines, or business logic, rather than just simple data transfers.
* Solid product sense with the ability to identify core user problems and collaborate on effective, workflow-driven solutions.
* Working knowledge of software development lifecycles (Agile/Scrum) and the ability to communicate technical requirements effectively to engineering teams.
* Familiarity with defining and launching APIs and software integrations. Must possess a foundational understanding of core API concepts (e.g., REST/GraphQL, authentication/authorization, versioning, error handling, and rate limiting) and Database like SQL or Postgres
* A keen interest in emerging technologies and a readiness to adopt an AI-first mindset to explore how AI can improve efficiency and unlock new customer value within automated workflows.
* Ability to work closely with engineering and architecture teams; comfortable reading API documentation, reviewing system designs, and understanding technical tradeoffs regarding performance and cost.
* Adaptability to navigate ambiguity and facilitate alignment during complex, cross-functional discussions.
* Strong interpersonal skills to build collaborative relationships across all levels of the organization.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, ensuring clarity and directness in both technical and business contexts.
* Demonstrated experience participating in at least one software integration or workflow automation project from the discovery phase through to delivery and measurement.

jobs.title: Data Engineer, Specialist (PITech- Core - Middle Office Team 1)
jobs.description:
**About Vanguard**    
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe-directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.

**Vanguard India**

Vanguard's office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.

**Role Summary**

The Data Engineer, Specialist is responsible for building and maintaining scalable data pipelines to ensure seamless integration and efficient data flow across various platforms. This role involves designing, developing, and optimizing ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes, managing databases and leveraging big data technologies to support analytics and business intelligence initiatives.

**Responsibilites**   
1. Design, develop and maintain scalable ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes to efficiently extract data from various structured and unstructured sources, ensuring accuracy, consistency and performance optimization.  
2. Architect and manage database systems to support large-scale data storage and retrieval, ensuring high availability, security and efficiency in handling complex datasets.  
3. Integrate and transform data from multiple sources including APIs, on-premises databases and cloud storage, creating unified datasets to support data-driven decision-making across the organization.  
4. Collaborate with business intelligence analysts, data scientists and other stakeholders to understand specific data needs, ensuring the delivery of high-quality, business-relevant datasets.  
5. Monitor, troubleshoot and optimize data pipelines and workflows to resolve performance bottlenecks, improve processing efficiency and ensure data integrity.  
6. Develop automation frameworks for data ingestion, transformation and reporting to streamline data operations and reduce manual effort.  
7. Work with cloud-based data platforms and technologies such as AWS (Redshift, Glue, S3), Google Cloud (Big Query, Dataflow), or Azure (Synapse, Data Factory) to build scalable data solutions.  
8. Optimize data storage, indexing, and query performance to support real-time analytics and reporting, ensuring cost-effective and high-performing data solutions.  
9. Lead or contribute to special projects involving data architecture improvements, migration to modern data platforms, or advanced analytics initiatives.  
   
 **Qualifications and Skills**

* Minimum 5 years of relevant work experience, with at least 2 years in designing and maintaining data pipelines, ETL processes and database architectures.
* Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science or IT, or bachelor's in data science, Statistics, or related field cloud Platforms
* AWS (S3, EMR, Glue, Lambda, Kinesis, Athena, Iceberg, Step Functions, SNS/SQS, IAM, CloudWatch
* Databricks: Delta Lake, Unity catalog volumes, Lakeflow connect, Dataframes, Apache Spark Database: Redshift, Aurora,
* Languages & Frameworks: Pyspark, Python/ Pandas/ NumPy/SQL
* Orchestration & Streaming: Airflow, Kafka, Lakeflow declarative pipelines
* Monitoring & DevOps: Docker / Terraform, GitHub Actions, Code Pipeline, spark UI, Git integration
* Product Build skills: Data design: Exposure to Medallion architecture, DWH and data mart build
* Should have functional domain exposure from Wealth and asset management / investments / Banking domain.
* AI Exposure: Claude Code / GitHub copilot

**Location**

This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.

  

**Our mission**

Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.

**Our commitment to you**

Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success-at work and in life-with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:

**Financial wellness**     
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.

  

**Physical wellness**     
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.

  

**Personal wellness**     
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.

  

**How we work**

Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

jobs.title: Factory Manager / Plant Manager (Food Manufacturing)
jobs.description:
***Role:-*** Factory Manager / Plant Manager

(Food Manufacturing)

***Employment Type:-*** Full time, Permanent

***Location:-*** Jigani, Bangalore

***Experience:-***  8 to 12 years in food/FMCG manufacturing, incl. 5+ years leading a plant.

***Direct reports:-*** Production Officer, QC, Stores & Warehouse In-charge, Dispatch team

  

***About US:-***

  

We are a long-established brand with a proven track record of strong, long-standing customer base. We are looking to expand our product portfolio. While deeply rooted in our legacy, our focus remains on innovation and growth.

  

***The Role:-***

  

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Factory Manager to run day-to-day operations at our food plant in Jigani. You will know the shop floor, understand food safety deeply, and build a strong culture of hygiene, safety and continuous improvement.

  

***Responsibilities:-***

  

* **Production:** Plan and run production to meet volume, quality and delivery targets. Track KPIs (OEE, yield, wastage, downtime, cost per unit, OTIF) and act fast on gaps. Make the best use of materials, utilities and manpower, and support new product trials with R&D.
* **Food safety and quality:** Own the plants food safety system and FSSAI compliance, including batch traceability, mock recalls, root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* **Safety and compliance:** Ensure compliance with the Factories Act, Legal Metrology, Pollution Control Board, fire safety and other laws. Build a zero-harm safety culture, manage effluent and waste, and be the plants contact for inspectors.
* **Maintenance:** Keep equipment and utilities (DG sets, water treatment) reliable through planned maintenance. Plan and manage capex projects on time and budget.
* **People:** Lead and develop supervisors, operators and contract workers. Plan shifts and training, handle grievances fairly, and drive discipline and accountability.
* **Cost, inventory and dispatch:** Manage the plant budget and cost targets. Control stock with FIFO/FEFO to minimise expiry. Plan daily dispatches, manage transporters, and handle paperwork (invoices, e-way bills) and returns.
* **Reporting and improvement:** Share regular MIS reports with management. Lead Lean, 5S, Kaizen and Six Sigma initiatives, and bring in automation and ERP/digital tools.

  

***Required Qualification:-***

  

* Bachelors degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Dairy Technology, Chemical/Mechanical Engineering or related field.
* 8 to 12 years in food, beverage or FMCG manufacturing, with 5+ years as Plant/Factory Manager or equivalent, including hands-on shop-floor experience.
* Strong knowledge of FSSAI, HACCP, GMP and ISO 22000 / FSSC 22000, plus working knowledge of the Factories Act, labour and environmental laws.
* Experience managing a large multi-shift workforce, including contract labour.

  

***Preferred:-***

  

* MBA/Masters in Operations; FSSC 22000 / ISO 22000 / BRCGS Lead Auditor or FoSTaC certification; Lean Six Sigma belt.
* Experience with SAP or another ERP, and knowledge of the local regional language.

  

***Key skills:-***

  

* Leadership that motivates teams and leads by example on the shop floor.
* A food safety mindset, treating hygiene and safety as non-negotiable.
* Data-driven problem solving (5 Why, Fishbone, FMEA) and calm decision-making in breakdowns or recalls.
* Good planning, budgeting and communication with management, regulators, auditors and staff.
* Knowledge of Kannada and Hindi.

  

***How success is measured:-***

  

* Production vs plan and on-time-in-full (OTIF) delivery.
* OEE, yield, wastage and cost per unit vs budget.
* Customer complaints, zero recalls and zero lost-time injuries.
* Inventory accuracy, low expiry write-offs, and team attrition and training.

  

***Working conditions:-***

  

* Based at the plant, with shop-floor presence across shifts as needed.
* Must follow hygiene and GMP rules (protective clothing, health checks) and be available for emergencies.

jobs.title: Underwriting Enablement Manager
jobs.description:
**About The Team :**

The Senior Specialist, Frontline Support, Enablement empowers Zillows sales teams by designing and delivering enablement programs, training, and resources that drive seller effectiveness and business results. This role leads cross-functional initiatives to streamline onboarding, continuous learning, and sales playbooks, ensuring sellers have the tools and knowledge needed to excel. Operating with high autonomy, the Senior Specialist partners across Sales, Marketing, Product, and Operations to identify gaps, optimize processes, and enhance the adoption and impact of enablement strategies.

  

**About The Role (Job Description)**

  

The Underwriting Enablement Manager owns the role-specific onboarding and continuing education programs for Zillow Home Loans' India-based Credit Specialists. Credit Specialists perform credit file reviews and the training for this role requires deep familiarity with underwriting fundamentals, credit analysis, and ZHL's underwriting tools and decision framework.

You will design the curriculum, build the content, deliver live training sessions, and keep all materials current as tools, workflows, and credit policies evolve. Training and facilitation expertise is the most critical qualification for this role. Underwriting subject matter knowledge is the operational foundation you build on top of that.

* Design, build, and own the end-to-end new hire onboarding program for Credit Specialists, covering the full ramp period from Day 1 through independent production.
* Facilitate live training sessions covering credit file review, Encompass and underwriting tools, underwriting decision-making, condition writing, income and liability analysis, and AUS interpretation.
* Build and maintain role-specific SOPs, job aids, Encompass workflow guides, and reference documentation in Highspot.
* Develop and maintain Zillow University (ZU) e-learning courses with embedded knowledge checks.
* Design and coordinate structured shadow and nesting schedules with US-based underwriters, team leads, and senior managers.
* Coach new hires through their ramp; providing feedback on early file reviews, monitoring condition quality, and partnering with team leads on readiness decisions.
* Maintain and update all training materials on a quarterly cadence and when Encompass tools, workflows, or credit policy changes require it.
* Deliver department-level re-enablement training when significant changes roll out; including workflow launches, Encompass enhancements, and new product guidelines.
* Track new hire progress and milestone completion; communicate readiness status to operations leaders and IC managers.
* Partner with the Underwriting Director, senior managers, and team leads, as well as the Fulfillment Enablement team, to prioritize training needs and align the program with operational and quality standards.
* Contribute to broader enablement work including AI tool adoption support, Highspot content validation, and Encompass enhancement communication.

  

**Who You Are (Additional Job Description)**

* 5+ years in a training, instructional design, facilitation, or learning enablement role.
* Demonstrated ability to design and deliver structured, multi-week onboarding programs in a mortgage or financial services environment.
* Strong content creation skills: you can build SOPs, training decks, job aids, and e-learning courses from scratch without significant support.
* Hands-on mortgage underwriting or credit analysis experience; including working knowledge of credit report review, income calculation, DTI analysis, AUS (DU/LP), and underwriting decision documentation.
* Experience facilitating live virtual training to distributed or global audiences; comfortable running live file reviews and shadow sessions over Zoom.
* Working knowledge of Encompass or a comparable loan origination system.
* Familiarity with Highspot or similar knowledge management and LMS platforms is a plus.
* Strong organizational skills; able to manage multiple roles, programs, and incoming cohorts simultaneously.
* Clear, concise communicator, written and verbal, with the ability to make complex mortgage concepts accessible to new learners.
* Collaborative working style; comfortable building relationships and partnering across time zones with US-based operations leaders and subject matter experts

jobs.title: Product Manager II (Technical Product Owner)
jobs.description:
**Job: Product Manager II (Technical Product Owner)**   
**Location: Bangalore**   
**Job Description:**   
The Enterprise Integration and Architecture Modernization (EIAM) team is looking for a technically oriented Product   
Owner to join its Bangalore team.   
This individual will work closely with the US-based Senior Product Owner, engineering leadership, enterprise   
architects, developers, QA teams and business stakeholders to support the definition, refinement and delivery of   
EIAM product capabilities and modernization initiatives.   
This is a supplemental offshore product ownership role, designed to extend and strengthen the existing product   
ownership function in the US. The individual will partner closely with an experienced Senior Product Owner with   
deep business and technical domain expertise, progressively developing a comprehensive understanding of the EIAM   
landscape and taking ownership of defined product areas and initiatives.   
The ideal candidate should have a strong technical foundation, an understanding of modern enterprise architectures   
and the ability to participate meaningfully in technical and architectural discussions. They should be capable of   
translating business needs, technical discussions and architectural decisions into clearly defined requirements,   
functional scopes, user stories and acceptance criteria.   
This role requires a combination of technical acumen, analytical thinking, requirement engineering, stakeholder   
collaboration and product ownership capabilities. It is particularly suited for someone who enjoys working at the   
intersection of product management, enterprise architecture and engineering.

**Responsibilities:**   
**Product Ownership & Strategic Alignment**   
- Partner closely with the US-based Senior Product Owner to understand EIAM's product vision, strategy,   
roadmap and priorities.   
- Act as an offshore extension of the product ownership function, supporting day-to-day product activities,   
requirement definition and execution.   
- Develop a comprehensive understanding of EIAM capabilities, architecture, technology landscape,   
modernization initiatives and enterprise integration patterns.   
- Collaborate with engineering, architecture, QA and business stakeholders to understand requirements,   
dependencies, challenges and delivery expectations.   
- Support product backlog management, prioritization discussions, refinement sessions and sprint planning.   
- Proactively identify gaps, dependencies, risks and opportunities for improvement and bring them to the   
attention of the Senior Product Owner.   
- Gradually assume ownership of defined product capabilities, initiatives and workstreams as domain expertise   
develops.

objectives.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

As a Principal Product Manager, you will own the strategy, vision, and market success of critical Security Operations platform capabilities spanning Security Analytics, Log Management, Adversary Intelligence, Search, Data Exploration, and AI-powered intelligence services. You will identify customer needs, define investment priorities, and lead the evolution of platform capabilities that transform security telemetry into actionable insights, helping customers improve threat detection, accelerate investigations, enhance threat hunting, and increase operational visibility across complex environments.

This role operates at the intersection of product strategy, customer outcomes, market leadership, and technology innovation. Working closely with engineering, architecture, data science, security research, product marketing, sales, customer success, and executive stakeholders, you will define and execute a portfolio strategy that drives customer retention, competitive differentiation, platform adoption, and profitable growth. As a recognized subject matter expert, you will influence product direction across the Security Operations portfolio while helping shape OpenText's long-term vision for analytics, threat intelligence, and AI-driven security operations.

**What the Role Offers**

* Ownership of product vision, strategy, roadmap, and business performance for Security Analytics, Log Management, Adversary Intelligence, Search and Data Exploration, and AI-enabled platform services.
* Accountability for defining and prioritizing product line investments that drive growth, improve customer retention, strengthen competitive positioning, and support long-term business objectives.
* Creation and maintenance of a multi-quarter strategic roadmap aligned to customer requirements, market opportunities, and portfolio strategy.
* Leadership of cross-functional initiatives involving engineering, architecture, data science, user experience, security researchers, product marketing, support, cloud operations, and go-to-market teams.
* Responsibility for defining analytic and threat-hunting capabilities that identify indicators of compromise, adversary behaviors, attack signals, investigative leads, and emerging threats from large-scale security telemetry.
* The opportunity to shape the strategy for artificial intelligence, machine learning, and advanced analytics across the Security Operations portfolio to improve analyst productivity, detection efficacy, investigation speed, and overall customer outcomes.
* Ownership of platform analytics, search experiences, telemetry processing capabilities, and data exploration workflows that enable customers to derive greater value from security and machine data.
* Leadership in gathering customer, partner, field, and analyst feedback to validate requirements, inform investment decisions, and continuously improve product-market fit.
* Accountability for product lifecycle governance, release readiness, compliance, accessibility, localization, security, certifications, and customer-facing communications associated with product releases.
* Ownership of competitive analysis, market positioning, and differentiation strategies across key competitors including SIEM, security analytics, and AI-driven security operation platforms.
* The opportunity to contribute to analyst briefings, customer advisory councils, field events, sales enablement activities, strategic customer engagements, and executive presentations.
* A visible role as a subject matter expert supporting portfolio strategy reviews, business planning activities, architecture discussions, and company-wide initiatives involving analytics, AI, and cybersecurity technologies.
* The ability to influence the growth and development of Product Management capabilities through mentoring, thought leadership, and collaboration across the business unit and broader OpenText product organization.

**What You Need to Succeed**

* 8+ years of Product Management experience within enterprise software, cybersecurity, cloud, analytics, observability, or data platform markets.
* Proven success owning products or product lines throughout the full lifecycle from strategy and investment planning through customer adoption and market success.
* Experience developing product strategies, roadmaps, requirements, business cases, positioning, and go-to-market plans for highly technical software products.
* Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and executive communication skills with the ability to influence decisions across multiple functions and organizational levels.
* Experience collaborating closely with engineering, architecture, technical stakeholders, and executive leadership to drive product outcomes.
* Experience with SIEM, security analytics, threat detection, security operations, threat hunting, threat intelligence, investigation platforms, or related cybersecurity technologies.
* Experience with large-scale telemetry platforms, observability platforms, logging technologies, data analytics systems, search technologies, or distributed data architectures.
* Familiarity with artificial intelligence, machine learning, generative AI, predictive analytics, or AI-enabled operational workflows.
* Experience building and delivering cloud-native or SaaS-based software solutions across public cloud environments including AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.

**Desired Candidate Profile:**
