jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager
jobs.description:
Today, through BHN s single global platform, businesses of all kinds can tap into the world s largest network of branded payment solutions. BHN helps businesses grow revenue, increase loyalty, motivate and reward their teams, disburse funds and engage consumers. Branded payment solutions include the issuance and distribution of gift cards, egifts, corporate payouts and rewards, along with the technology to deliver these products in seamless, integrated ways. BHN s network spans the globe with more than 400,000 consumer touchpoints. Learn more at BHN.com.

Overview:

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to shape and deliver the evolution of BHN s Core  Enterprise  Services. In this role, you will partner across Product, Engineering, Architecture, and business teams to strengthen the shared platforms and services behind capabilities such as catalogue management, partner onboarding, order processing, settlement, and servicing.

You will bring a platform mindset to complex technical and business challenges-building reliable, reusable capabilities that reduce fragmentation, enable teams to move faster, and improve outcomes for BHN and its customers. This is an opportunity to influence foundational systems used across product areas and to help define how those systems evolve over time.

Responsibilities:

* Define the product strategy, roadmap, and priorities for assigned core services and platform capabilities, aligning investment with broader business and technology goals.

* Partner with Engineering, Architecture, and business stakeholders to improve the reliability, scalability, security, and extensibility of foundational services.

* Identify  opportunities to create or enhance shared services, APIs, and integration capabilities that support multiple teams and product areas.

* Advance platform standardization and interoperability while reducing fragmentation, duplication, and technical debt.

* Use customer, operational, and business data to prioritize investments and measure platform health, efficiency, uptime, adoption, and outcomes.

* Lead cross-functional alignment on customer and business needs, requirements, dependencies, trade-offs, risks, and delivery plans.

* Communicate product decisions, progress, risks, and results clearly to both technical and business audiences.

* Contribute to a strong product culture by sharing practices, developing collaborative ways of working, and keeping teams focused on measurable outcomes.

* Explore emerging technologies and use AI tools thoughtfully to improve product work, streamline processes, or deliver measurable results.

Qualifications:

* 8+ years of Product Management experience, including 3+ years working on platforms, core systems, enterprise products, or highly integrated technology solutions.

* Strong technical fluency and experience working with APIs, microservices, cloud infrastructure, and integration frameworks.

* A track record  of delivering and improving platforms or shared capabilities used by multiple teams, domains, or product lines.

* The ability to connect system design and technical trade-offs to customer, operational, and business outcomes.

* Strong communication  and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to build alignment across technical and business teams.

* A product mindset grounded in reusability, operational excellence, interoperability, and long-term scalability.

* Experience in payments, fintech, or large-scale enterprise systems is highly desirable.

* Curiosity and adaptability, including an interest in continuous learning and the thoughtful use of AI to create meaningful impact

*We seek candidates who not only demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in emerging technologies but have also successfully implemented and utilized AI tools to enhance their work, improve processes, or deliver measurable results. Our teams embrace continuous learning and the thoughtful integration of AI to create meaningful impact - for our employees and the future of work.*

*Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check.*

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager
jobs.description:
### Job Summary

Product Teams at Target are accountable for the delivery of business outcomes enabled through technology and analytic products that are easy to use, easily maintained and highly reliable. Product teams have one shared backlog that is inclusive of all product, technology, discovery and design work. The Space Presentation and Transitions data product portfolio provides enterprise-scale data powering how Target plans, optimizes, and evolves physical store space. These products enable business users to design store presentations, understand the financial performance and productivity of space, and strategically plan future transitions and merchandising changes. By integrating data from multiple source domains and delivering it through governed, scalable platforms and self-service capabilities, the team empowers data-driven decision making across space planning, category management, merchandising, and store operations. Product Managers partner with engineers, source system teams, analysts, and business stakeholders to define product strategy, prioritize investments, and deliver reliable data products that create measurable business value and improve the guest experience.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will work in the product model and will partner to develop a comprehensive product strategy, related roadmap, and set key business objectives (OKRs) for your respective product. You will need to leverage the knowledge of your product, as well as customer feedback and establish other relevant data points to assess value, develop business cases, and prioritize the direction and desired outcomes for your product. You will lead a product and work in unison with engineers, UX designers, data scientists and business partners to deliver a product.

You will be the voice of the product to key stakeholders to ensure that their needs are met, and that the product team is getting the direction and support that it needs to be successful. You will develop and actively understand the market, maintain a product roadmap and backlog outlining the customer themes, epics, and stories while prioritizing the backlog to focus on the highest impact work for your team and stakeholders.

You will encourage the open exchange of information and viewpoints, as well as inspire others to achieve challenging goals and high standards of performance while committing to the organizations direction. You will foster a sense of urgency to achieve goals and leverage resources to overcome unexpected obstacles, and partner with product teams across the organization to help them achieve their goals while pursuing and completing yours.

Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

### Requirements

* Four-year degree or equivalent experience
* 6+ years of product management experience or equivalent domain experience
* Experience with technology and ability to facilitate communication between business and technology teams
* Experience working in an agile environment (e.g., user stories, iterative development, scrum teams, sprints, personas)
* Ability to lead a body of work with cross-functional partners
* Strong communication skills

jobs.title: Sr Product Manager
jobs.description:
### Job Summary

Couchbase is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own its SDKs, connectors, and AI framework integrations. This role requires a technical, hands-on PM with a strong developer and database background. The portfolio is mature and widely adopted; this role owns the execution rigor that keeps it excellent as the platform and the AI ecosystem evolve. The individual will need the flexibility to work with a US/UK based team.

### Responsibilities

* Own the SDK and connector roadmap. Track the Couchbase platform roadmap across all services, assess its impact on SDKs and connectors, and prioritize against Couchbases strategic and technical objectives, product strategy, and customer requirements.
* Define how Couchbase integrates into enterprise data ecosystems as both an operational and analytical database, including connectors for data streaming, processing, and orchestration platforms.
* Own the AI framework integration strategy for LangChain, LlamaIndex, and LangGraph - vector stores, retrievers, semantic caching, agent memory, and checkpointing - and partner with engineering and framework maintainers to deliver it.
* Partner closely with a global engineering to execute on the roadmap: write technical product requirements, validate pre-release features hands-on, contribute to product documentation, and drive the operational cadence (JIRA, sprint and roadmap reviews, release planning, agile ceremonies).
* Bring operational rigor to a mature portfolio: improve release quality, close gaps in developer experience, and remove friction that has built up across established products.
* Work directly with customers and field teams to validate use cases and make build/dont-build decisions, and own the product response on customer escalations through to engineering fixes.
* Track market trends and competition across SDKs, data platforms, and AI frameworks, and factor competitive insight and customer feedback into product direction.
* Lead technical enablement for solutions engineering, support, and field teams, including support with reference implementations.

### Qualifications

We are looking for someone with a technical background who has designed and built software hands-on, is detail-oriented, and has strong interpersonal skills.

* 7+ years of combined software engineering and product management experience, including 3+ years of hands-on software development and 2+ years of product management on SDKs, connectors, databases, or data platforms.
* Hands-on experience designing and building enterprise applications in one or more mainstream programming languages such as Java, .NET, Python, Go, Rust etc
* Strong database fundamentals - data modeling, SQL, indexing, transactions, consistency, and distributed architecture - and an understanding of operational and analytical workloads in enterprise data stacks.
* Experience shipping SDKs or connectors, including cross-language API design, versioning, and compatibility.
* A track record of improving execution on a mature, widely adopted product.
* Fluency with agile development process and tooling (JIRA or equivalent), and experience driving execution in a fast-moving, cross-functional organization without waiting to be told what to do.
* Experience with event-driven architectures and data streaming, processing, and orchestration platforms such as Kafka, Spark, Flink, Airflow, Solace etc. Familiarity with equivalent public cloud services is highly desirable.
* Hands-on experience building AI or agentic applications with popular agent frameworks, and working knowledge of vector search and RAG.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills is a must, with the ability to distill use cases into detailed functional and product requirements.
* AI-forward in how you work: you use AI tools in day-to-day PM work (requirements, research, competitive analysis, prototyping) and push that adoption across the team.

Senior Product Manager - Ads Monetisation & Retention  
About the Role  
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to drive ads monetisation and user retention for a high-scale consumer mobile application.  
This role sits at the intersection of product, content, data, engineering, ad technology and business growth. You will be responsible for building and optimising the product experiences, systems and strategies that maximise advertising revenue while maintaining a healthy user experience and long-term retention.  
The ideal candidate is highly analytical, strong in first-principles thinking, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and capable of translating complex business problems into actionable product solutions.  
You will own critical business metrics, identify growth opportunities, design experiments, and work closely with cross-functional teams to drive measurable business outcomes.  
Key Responsibilities  
1. Ads Monetisation & Revenue Growth  
Own and drive advertising revenue growth through improvements in ad impressions, fill rates, eCPM, yield and overall monetisation efficiency.  
Identify opportunities to optimise ad placements, formats, frequency, timing and user-level ad experiences.  
Work on ad mediation strategy, demand partner performance and monetisation infrastructure.  
Build a deep understanding of the advertising ecosystem, including ad networks, mediation platforms, bidding, waterfall optimisation and revenue attribution.  
Identify opportunities to improve revenue per user without compromising user experience.  
2. User Retention & Engagement  
Own key user engagement and retention metrics across the product lifecycle.  
Identify drop-offs and friction points in the user journey through quantitative and qualitative analysis.  
Develop strategies to improve user engagement, session frequency, consumption and long-term retention.  
Understand the relationship between advertising load, user experience, engagement and retention.  
Drive initiatives that balance short-term monetisation with long-term user and business value.  
3. Data, Analytics & Experimentation  
Develop a strong understanding of product and business metrics, identify trends and proactively surface opportunities or problems.  
Perform deep-dive analysis and root cause investigations to understand changes in business performance.  
Formulate hypotheses, design experiments and evaluate results using data-driven approaches.  
Build measurement frameworks to assess the incremental impact of product and monetisation initiatives.  
Work with analytics and data teams to improve dashboards, tracking and decision-making frameworks.  
4. Product Strategy & Execution  
Identify, evaluate and prioritise product opportunities based on business impact, user value and execution complexity.  
Translate business objectives into product roadmaps, detailed requirements and actionable execution plans.  
Work closely with engineering, design, data science and business teams to drive initiatives from ideation to launch.  
Take end-to-end ownership of product outcomes, from problem identification to post-launch optimisation.  
Navigate ambiguity, challenge existing assumptions and continuously look for better ways to solve business problems.  
Requirements  
3+ years of experience in Product Management, Growth, Monetisation or related roles.  
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down ambiguous problems using first-principles thinking.  
Strong understanding of product metrics, funnels, cohorts, retention and monetisation.  
Experience using data to identify problems, generate hypotheses and drive product decisions.  
Ability to independently conduct deep-dive analysis and root cause investigations.  
Strong business acumen and an understanding of revenue drivers, unit economics and growth levers.  
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.  
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with high ownership and accountability.  
Good to have:  
Experience in consumer mobile applications, particularly content, gaming, entertainment or other high-engagement products.  
Understanding of mobile advertising ecosystems, including AdMob, AppLovin, Unity, Meta Audience Network, mediation platforms and programmatic advertising.  
Experience with A/B testing, experimentation frameworks and product analytics tools.  
Familiarity with SQL, analytics platforms and working with large datasets.  
What Success Looks Like in 6 Months  
Build and execute a prioritised product roadmap for ads monetisation and retention, aligned with key business objectives.  
Drive measurable improvements in advertising revenue and monetisation efficiency through data-driven initiatives and experimentation.  
Identify key drivers of user behaviour and implement initiatives that improve engagement and long-term retention while balancing ad experience.  
Develop deep business and product understanding, demonstrate strong first-principles thinking, and independently drive initiatives end-to-end with high ownership and accountability.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Role Overview**    

CDW is seeking a Product Manager to help define, build, launch, and continuously improve strategic solutions that solve meaningful customer business and technology challenges.

The Product Manager will own the end-to-end solution lifecycle-from customer discovery and solution definition through launch and ongoing enhancement-for one or more solutions within CDW's Solutions portfolio.

This role partners closely with customers, Practice Areas, Engineering, AI teams, Delivery, Sales Enablement, Partner Management, and Solution Owners to develop scalable, repeatable offerings that combine technology, services, partner capabilities, AI, accelerators, and delivery methodologies.

This role requires strong customer empathy, structured problem solving, and the ability to lead cross-functional teams in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

  
   
  **Key Areas of Responsibility**    
   
  **Customer Discovery & Solution Definition**    

* Define customer problem statements, target personas, use cases, business outcomes, and solution requirements through customer engagement and market research.

  
   
  **Solution Strategy & Roadmap**    

* Develop solution strategies, value propositions, business cases, and roadmaps aligned to customer needs and CDW priorities.
* Create and manage a prioritized backlog of solution enhancements, features, and capabilities.

  
   
  **Solution Development & Delivery**    

* Lead solution development across Engineering, Delivery, Practice Areas, and Partner teams.
* Drive solutions through the defined lifecycle from discovery and planning through build, testing, launch, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, commercially viable, and operationally ready for delivery.
* Define implementation guidance, delivery playbooks, reference architectures, reusable assets, and supporting documentation.
* Manage priorities, dependencies, risks, and tradeoffs while aligning diverse stakeholder groups.

  
   
  **AI, Feedback & Continuous Improvement**    

* Gather customer, seller, and delivery feedback and translate insights into solution improvements.
* Leverage AI, automation, and reusable intellectual property to improve customer outcomes and delivery efficiency.
* Establish success metrics and measure solution adoption, customer impact, and business outcomes.

  
   
  **Working Model**    

The Product Manager partners closely with a Solution Owner.

The Solution Owner is responsible for commercial strategy, go-to-market execution, portfolio performance, seller adoption, and business success.

The Product Manager is responsible for customer discovery, solution strategy, roadmap management, cross-functional execution, and ensuring solutions are scalable, repeatable, and ready for successful customer adoption.

  
   
  **Key Performance Indicators (Examples)**    

* Customer problem statements and solution requirements validated through discovery activities.
* Roadmap commitments delivered on time and with quality.
* Time-to-market for new solutions and enhancements.
* Solution adoption and customer satisfaction.
* Delivery readiness, including documentation, playbooks, and implementation guidance.
* Reuse of accelerators, automation, AI capabilities, and reusable assets.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and cross-functional execution effectiveness.
* Measurable customer and business outcomes delivered through solutions.

  
   
  **Qualifications**    
   
  **Education and/or Experience Qualifications**    

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Solutions Management, Presales, or related roles.
* Experience building enterprise solutions that combine technology, services, partner capabilities, and delivery models.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives without direct authority.
* Strong customer discovery, requirements definition, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience translating customer needs into scalable, repeatable offerings.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to balance customer needs, business priorities, and technical feasibility.
* Experience working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

  
   
  **Preferred Qualifications**    

* Experience in one or more of the following:
* Artificial Intelligence & Automation
* Cloud Platforms
* Data & Analytics
* Cybersecurity
* Infrastructure Modernization
* Experience with Design Thinking
* Jobs-to-be-Done
* Agile Product Management
* Lean Product Development

  
   
  **Customer Focus and Quality Management Responsibilities**    

Each CDW coworker is responsible for maintaining customer focus and conforms to the CDW quality management system. Specific responsibilities include:

* Periodic reviews of CDW Circle of Service Philosophy and the Quality Policy to understand CDW's commitment to excellent client service and continual improvement and to conform to these policies and philosophies at all times.
* During your orientation period, review with your supervisor as needed the quality procedures and operating instructions listed at Connect / Departments / Resources / ISO intranet site that apply to your specific assignment(s) within the scope of this job position.
* And after the orientation period to conform to these procedures and instructions, including any reporting (and/or record keeping) responsibilities.
* Report any client problem, or any service outage that may cause potential client problems to your supervisor.
* Communicate improvement ideas that you have regarding CDW service quality or client satisfaction per established means.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

As a Senior Product Manager, you will collaborate closely with senior leaders to shape a dynamic product strategy that solves for user problems, business and partner objectives. This role will require you to define the commerce experience on JioHotstar across multiple categories that enables users to get inspired and transact without disrupting their content watching experience. You will also be required to look at the commerce funnel and identify innovative ways to grow the conversion. We are very early in our commerce journey and growing rapidly. Come join this rocketship!

**About the Team:**

JioHotstar is embarking on a journey to grow Content Commerce on the platform. We believe that there is true value to be unlocked for our large user base by building inspiration, consideration and transactions all while watching their favourite content. We have traditionally had 2 monetisation channels: Advertising and Subscriptions. This team intends to work with our partners and build commerce as the third monetisation channel.

Key responsibilities

* Conduct thorough research and analysis to generate actionable insights and determine ROI
* Translate abstract problem statements into clear requirements by assessing market trends and shifts
* Influence roadmaps within and outside the functional area to enhance the overall ecosystem
* Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, contributing to roadmaps and prioritization beyond the immediate domain
* Show agility in responding to external signals, enabling swift roadmap adjustments, and ensuring transparent communication of impacts
* Take ownership of at least one key KPI that directly aligns with Product Objectives and Key Results
* Develop deep expertise in at least one functional area, driving strategic advancements through innovation and transformation
* Actively participate in team-building initiatives, including contributing to hiring processes

Skills and attributes for success:

* Communicate clearly and effectively, with precise articulation and logical progression of ideas
* Apply structured frameworks and logical thinking to address complex problems, asking the right questions for deeper understanding
* Demonstrate a diverse range of ideas and prioritize effectively, focusing on the end outcomes
* Leverage a data-driven mindset to derive insights from metrics and make well-informed product decisions
* Show strong user empathy, using structured problem-solving to address pain points through hypothesis-building and solution development
* Benchmark competitors and validate findings through experimentation, maintaining high standards for product roadmap inclusion
* Confidently tackle ambiguous problems with minimal supervision, taking decisive action across the organization
* Foster a collaborative, respectful work environment, open to feedback, while mentoring junior PMs to success and effectively influencing without formal authority

Preferred education and experience:

* Bachelors/Masters degree or equivalent preferred. Overall 4-6 years of experience in building scalable consumer products

If you are looking for an opportunity to deliver meaningful innovations to enable our target customers to manage their IT or non-IT services better and thus improve their business success and work experience, and if you are looking for an opportunity to help lead Ivanti's ESM business to financial success and to participate in it, then join our team!

* Drive innovation by exploring new use cases and applications for virtual assistants and chatbots.

**What Will You Bring**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field. MBA or advanced degree is a plus.
* Experience: Minimum of 5 years of product management experience, with at least 3 years focused on AI, virtual assistants, or chatbots.
* Skills: Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to lead and inspire cross-functional teams.
* Technical Knowledge: Familiarity with AI technologies, natural language processing (NLP), machine learning, and chatbot frameworks.
* Customer Orientation: Deep understanding of customer needs and a passion for creating user-centric products.
* Project Management: Proven track record of managing complex projects and delivering products on time and within budget.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Authentication - India
jobs.description:
### Job Summary

About the Role: Identity is the new security perimeter, and JumpCloud's Access Authentication team owns it.

With remote work and the domainless enterprise here to stay, every login is now a security decision. Our products decide who gets access to what across devices, SSO apps, servers, RADIUS and LDAP. They power MFA, passwordless, and Zero Trust conditional access built on identity, location, risk, and certificate-based device trust.

As a Senior PM, you'll define how millions of users prove who they are. You'll balance two customers: IT admins who need control, and users who just want to get to work. And you'll shape the strategy for our platform in a market being redefined right now. If you want to prove security and simplicity aren't a tradeoff, join us.

JumpCloud is looking for a Senior Product Manager to help drive the authentication roadmap and significantly influence the future of frictionless authentication at JumpCloud. You will own one or more product capabilities and be responsible for strategy, meeting KPIs and objectives.

If you love authentication and are passionate about Kerberos, Zero Trust principles, and conditional access; let's have a conversation.

### Responsibilities

* Setting strategy and roadmap. Stay close to customers, competitors, and the market, and turn what you learn into clear priorities.
* Championing the customer. Understand what IT admins and end users need, not just what they ask for, and make sure it shapes what we build.
* Making access simple. Partner with UX, architecture, and engineering to turn complex authentication flows into experiences that feel effortless.
* Driving outcomes across teams. Align engineering, design, security, and go-to-market around shared goals, and deliver against them.

### Requirements

* 5+ years of product management experience owning strategy and execution for SaaS, enterprise, or security products.
* Deep domain knowledge in identity and authentication, including several of the following: certificate-based authentication, Kerberos, MFA, FIDO and passwordless, Zero Trust, and continuous authentication.
* A talent for untangling complexity. You can take a messy, interconnected authentication landscape, make it simple, and get a cross-functional team moving in one direction.
* Fluency with AI tools in your day-to-day product work, from customer research and specs to analysis and prototyping.

### Bonus Points for

* A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience. An MBA is a plus.

### Location / Language

**Location:** JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role.

**Language:** JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

### Notes

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
About Vista Equity Partners

Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology-enabled businesses. With over $100 billion in assets under management and a portfolio of more than 90 software companies worldwide, Vista supports growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long-term partnership.

Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is helping its portfolio companies apply generative AI responsibly across products, operations, and decision-making. Vista also supports learning and development through portfolio-wide programs, leadership workshops, and AI initiatives.

About Amtech

Amtech provides enterprise software for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems support order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics, helping customers improve efficiency and operational performance.

With Vistas investment and strategic guidance, Amtech combines the agility of a growing technology organization with the stability and career opportunities of a global software ecosystem.

Our Employee Value Proposition

At Amtech, you can:

* **Make an impact:** Help shape manufacturing and supply chain operations through mission-critical enterprise software.
* **Keep growing:** Access learning, leadership development, and opportunities across Vista’s global network.
* **Work collaboratively:** Join a transparent, people-first culture grounded in accountability and integrity.
* **Contribute to innovation:** Help modernize business processes and explore technologies such as AI-driven automation.

Role Overview

We are hiring Product Owners at the **Product Owner II and Senior Product Owner levels** to support product execution across Amtech’s labeling and corrugated ERP platforms, with a focus on automated scheduling applications.

Depending on experience and scope, the role may focus on owning the scheduling product backlog or performing product-management execution for the labeling product line while coordinating and supporting the product-owner community across both product lines.

In either focus, you will work with product management, engineering, QA, UX, architecture, and customer-facing teams to turn roadmap initiatives and manufacturing needs into clear development work and useful product outcomes.

The Senior Product Owner focus includes coordinating agile planning and ceremonies, supporting product owners, and maintaining quality standards for product development lifecycle (PDLC) artifacts. This is a coordination and enablement role and does not carry direct people-management responsibility. Market-facing direction, priorities, and customer strategy are set in partnership with in-market product leadership.

You will work closely with the **Principal Enterprise AI Architect and AI engineering teams** to translate product vision and customer requirements into clear, prioritised and achievable product capabilities.

jobs.title: Sr AI Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**    

As a Senior AI Product Manager, you will be the day-to-day strategic partner for forward deployed engineering (FDE) pods working on a set of high-impact engagements. This is an individual contributor role for someone who can take a complex business problem, structure it, size the value, prototype hands-on, and turn it into something a forward deployed engineer can build against.

You won t manage engineers - you will be in the room with them, the business sponsor, and the data, translating between all three and keeping each engagement focused on the most valuable outcome.

Forward deployed teams are most powerful when paired with sharp opportunity selection. In this role, you will make sure the engineers we deploy are working on the right things by:

* Sizing value, structuring problems, building concept prototypes, and writing the business cases that fund engagements.
* Acting as the day-to-day strategic counterpart to FDE pods in active deployments.
* Bringing opportunity signals from business sponsors back into the portfolio.

  
   
  **Responsibilities**    

**Opportunity identification and value sizing**

* Surface and size AI opportunities across your assigned engagements and adjacent business units, producing one-page opportunity briefs that are easy to compare and prioritise.
* Build credible value cases with finance-grade reasoning behind cycle time saved, decisions accelerated, revenue uplift, or cost avoided.
* Develop hands-on domain knowledge of your engagement areas - workflows, data, decisions, and the people who own them.

**Strategic prioritisation and portfolio shaping**

* Recommend what to start, continue, and stop across your engagements based on evidence, not enthusiasm.
* Sequence work for impact, helping engineering leads decide what is in scope this sprint, what comes next, and what is out.

**Engineering partnership and enablement**

* Be the day-to-day strategic partner to FDE pods, converting business ambiguity into crisp problem statements, success metrics, and decision frameworks engineers can act on.
* Run engagement structure end-to-end - scope, success criteria, exit conditions, and scaling pathways - drafted, agreed, and revisited.
* Spot reusable patterns that should become platform capabilities instead of point solutions.

**Stakeholder alignment and communication**

* Work confidently with Director-level business and scientific stakeholders, running working sessions that move things forward and produce decisions, not just notes.
* Maintain sponsor confidence with concise updates, honest risk calls, and clear asks.

**Measurement, learning, and iteration**

* Track value realisation on each engagement against the business case written up front.
* Capture lessons rigorously and feed them back into how the team scopes the next engagement.

  
   
  **Required Skills**    

* 15+ years of professional experience with bachelor s or master s degree or equivalent qualification.
* Candidates with the combination of pharma/life sciences, AI/ML products, product management, or strategy roles in technology-led organisations are preferred.
* A track record of taking complex, ambiguous business problems and turning them into structured, sized opportunities with defensible business cases.
* Strong working knowledge of at least one area of the pharma value chain (such as RD, supply chain, or commercial), including how decisions actually get made on the ground.
* Technical fluency in modern AI/ML - enough to design realistic engagements with engineers and avoid hype-driven choices.
* Strong individual contributor instincts - you produce quality artefacts, not status updates.

  
   
  **Preferred Skills**    

* Experience in Global Supply Chain (GSC), particularly Quality and Manufacturing Science Technology (MSAT).
* Working knowledge of large language models (LLMs), agentic systems, the ML lifecycle, and evaluation patterns, with the ability to assess data readiness (availability, quality, access constraints, and labelling) before engineering starts.
* Understanding of how GxP, regulatory, and data-governance requirements shape AI deployments in pharma - and how to factor them into scoping without over-constraining engineering.
* Experience producing value cases with clear assumptions and sensitivity ranges, and maintaining an opportunity portfolio with clear rationale for what is in flight, queued, or de-prioritised.
* Product intuition: a clear understanding of the difference between an MVP, a product, and a platform, and the ability to spot patterns that should become shared capabilities.
* An AI-native way of working - codifying product management and user research best practices into reusable skills, plugins, and markdown files, and using the command line to automate everyday tasks.
* Ability to lead through influence and write crisp, outcome-focused communications that connect progress to the value case.
* Experience running honest retrospectives that distinguish execution failures from selection failures.

  
   
  **Skills**    

* Agentic Platforms
* Global Supply Chain
* Global Supply Chain Strategy
* Pharmaceutical Supply Chain
* User Needs Analysis

jobs.description:
Were looking for product managers who are builders first - people who talk to customers constantly, ship real product to real users, and get into the details of how AI systems behave in production. This is not a role tied to one specific product line. Based on your strengths and interests, you could work across consumer AI products, enterprise platforms, developer tools, speech and voice systems, or edge deployments.

You have 3-7 years of product building experience, have shipped products at meaningful scale at strong B2C or B2B companies in India, and have real, hands-on familiarity with how AI products work under the hood.

**What Youll Do**

- Own a product area end-to-end - talk to users, write specs, define success metrics, ship, and measure outcomes

- Get into the details of how AI systems behave in production: prompt design, model selection, latency budgets, failure modes, and eval pipelines

- Write code, prompts, and copy when thats the fastest path to learning or validating an idea

- Set up funnels, write queries, and instrument events to diagnose whats working and whats broken

- Work directly with engineering, design, and leadership - no layers, no hand-offs

- Ship product every week, not plans

**What Were Looking For**

- 3-7 years of product management experience; you have shipped real products at meaningful scale at strong B2C or B2B companies in India

- Currently a product manager - this role is not for people transitioning from consulting, project management, or program management

- Hands-on familiarity with AI: youve built agents, understand how context windows work, and have thought through trade-offs like cost vs. latency vs. accuracy - experience with evals, tool calling, or agentic workflows is a strong plus

- Strong data skills: comfortable writing SQL, setting up funnels from scratch in PostHog, Mixpanel, or similar tools, and defining meaningful success metrics (not vanity numbers)

- Strong product thinking: you start with the customers problem, talk to users regularly, can structure vague problem spaces, and ship v1 without over-engineering

- Systems thinker: you see the handshakes between components, the failure modes, and the dependencies when you look at a product

- High ownership, high agency: you dont wait for permission, you solve problems, and youve stayed up to fix something because you couldnt let it stay broken

- Clear communicator: you can explain complex technical concepts simply - to engineers, leadership, and users alike

**Bonus Points**

- Youve built at least one working AI agent end-to-end - not a demo, something that actually does a job

- Youve used tools like Claude Code, built skills, or set up agentic workflows, and have opinions on when to use agents vs. simpler approaches

- You have side projects, open-source contributions, or products shipped outside of work

- You can point to 2-3 things in your life - product or otherwise - where you went deep and had real impact

**Why Sarvam**

Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population-scale impact.

- Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar

- High ownership and high impact, from day one

- Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems

- You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates

If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Senior Product Manager**

Product Team | Pune, India | In Campus

  
 **The Role**

We are seeking a high-ownership Product Manager to own the complete software surface of our robotics platform - spanning the core robot software stack, fleet management across the sorting systems, AMRs, customer integration pipelines, and the operator-facing UI applications used on the warehouse floor every day. You will be the single owner of the software experience, from intelligence running on each robot to the dashboard a warehouse manager opens every morning.

**The opportunity**

Own the product direction and business outcomes of assigned product lines, from customer discovery and new product development through launch, adoption and improvement of systems already operating at customer sites. Turn market needs and field evidence into a clear strategy, measurable product requirements and a prioritised roadmap.

You will work across robots, induction and discharge systems, embedded controls, batteries and fleet software. Bring the technical judgment to challenge engineering assumptions, the commercial discipline to choose valuable opportunities, and the ownership to verify that customers realise the promised value. Expect to spend time in warehouses, engineering labs and the factory.

**How the role works with other teams**

You own customer problems, product strategy, priorities, product requirements and acceptance criteria. The Technical Program Manager owns the integrated delivery plan and dependencies.

Engineering leaders own architecture, technical decisions and validation; Engineering Managers own people and capacity. Operations and Service own manufacturing, deployment and support execution. You drive scope and priority decisions, challenge commitments and escalate gaps.

Release decisions follow assigned authority, with the required technical, safety, quality and operational approvals.

**Key responsibilities**

Customer insight and product definition

**Customer discovery and market choices**

1. Observe warehouse workflows and speak directly with operators, supervisors, maintenance teams, buyers and integration partners. Combine site visits, customer interviews, usage data and win/loss analysis to identify unmet needs and validate demand.
2. Define target segments, priority use cases, competitive positioning and the conditions in which the product is a strong fit. Evaluate alternatives, including existing manual processes and other automation, and recommend opportunities to pursue, defer or stop.

**Strategy and product economics**

1. Own the product vision and multi-year roadmap, balancing new capabilities, reliability improvements, customer commitments and platform reuse. Prioritise investments using customer value, market potential, evidence, cost, risk and engineering capacity.
2. Build business cases covering addressable demand, customer payback, pricing and packaging, product cost, deployment effort and lifetime service costs. Set cost and margin objectives with Finance, Engineering and Operations; track commercial results with Sales and refine the investment case as evidence changes.

**Requirements and customer experience**

1. Own business and product requirements (BRDs and PRDs), use cases, operating assumptions and measurable acceptance criteria. Work with Systems and domain Engineering to derive traceable system and subsystem requirements and assess changes.
2. Define sustained throughput, accuracy, availability, parcel and payload ranges, footprint, scalability and operator productivity targets under representative workloads. Specify installation, recovery, diagnostics and serviceability needs so performance claims reflect real operating conditions.
3. Define operator and supervisor workflows, exception handling, reporting and warehouse software integration needs. Work with design and engineering teams to make systems practical to learn, operate, recover and maintain.

**Technical judgment and commitments**

1. Challenge estimates, dependencies, capacity assumptions and validation evidence with the TPM and engineering leaders. Make explicit scope and priority decisions when performance, cost, reliability or timing changes, and drive timely resolution of decisions affecting customer commitments.
2. Assess technical alternatives for their customer value and lifecycle implications. Ensure intended use, safety and compliance requirements inform product decisions from the start, with engineering and functional safety owners retaining technical approval.

**Key responsibilities**

New products, commercial launch and the installed base

**New Product development and pilots**

1. Define customer hypotheses, target outcomes and evidence for concept, prototype, pilot and production gates. Use representative workload sand, where appropriate, simulation with Engineering to test assumptions, assess capacity and validate sizing claims before scaling.
2. Agree pilot baselines, supported configurations, acceptance criteria and rollout conditions with customers, Solutioning, Engineering and Delivery. Own the product acceptance assessment and launch recommendation; use results to decide whether to scale, iterate or stop.

**Launch and repeatable growth**

1. Lead product launch planning with Sales, Marketing, Solutioning, Operations and Service. Equip teams with clear positioning, validated capabilities, sizing limits,pricing guidance, demonstrations, documentation and training requirements; measure adoption and realised value after deployment.
2. Define standard capabilities and configurable options.Evaluate customer-specific requests against strategic value, repeatability, engineering effort and support cost. Keep proposals and commitments within validated productlimits, with exceptions explicitly assessed and approved.

**Deployed products and lifecycle decisions**

1. Own the improvement backlog. Define product metrics and instrumentation requirements with Engineering, establish reliable baselines, and prioritise work using telemetry, customer feedback and recurring field issues. Verify with Engineering and Service that releases improve customer outcomes.
2. Own product policies and requirements for supported variants, compatibility, upgrades, migration, component obsolescence and end of life. Align lifecycle decisions with Engineering, Supply Chain and Service, including the cost and operational impact on installed systems.

**What you will deliver**

An evidence-backed product strategy and business case; a prioritised roadmap and backlog; clear product requirements and acceptance criteria; launch and lifecycle plans; and a product scorecard linking customer outcomes to commercial performance.

**First 90 days**

Review customer workflows, installed systems and economics. Agree product metrics, reliable baselines and priority gaps. Prioritise the roadmap and backlog. Define the next pilot or release scope, supported configurations, acceptance evidence and decision owners.

**Experience and capabilities**

The background and results we are looking for

1. Typically 10-15 years of relevant experience, including 5+ years owning hardware and software products. Product decisions, technical judgment and results matter more than tenure alone.
2. Evidence of taking a complex product from discovery through production and customer deployment, with measurable outcomes after launch.
3. Engineering grounding across mechanical systems, electronics, embedded software, controls, power and software architecture, sufficient to challenge assumptions and assess system trade-offs.
4. Experience with structured NPD, pilot builds, change control and software releases. Understand how design risk reviews, DFMEA and validation evidence inform product decisions.
5. Strong commercial and analytical skills: assess customer ROI, product economics and pricing, analyse operational data, and defend investment and priority decisions.
6. A record of influencing multidisciplinary team

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.

Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow - all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.

PTC is seeking a **Principal Product Manager** to join our Visualization Product Management team and lead the products and technologies that transform complex engineering data into visualization-ready content across PTC s product portfolio.

You will have primary product responsibility for **Visualization Content Services (VCS), Windchill Visualization Services (WVS), and Product View Adapters**, working at the intersection of **CAD interoperability, enterprise PLM, visualization, and content processing**.

This is a hands-on product leadership role for a technically oriented PM who enjoys solving complex engineering problems, working closely with engineers and architects, and engaging directly with customers and partners worldwide.

**What You ll Do**

* Own the product direction, priorities, roadmap, requirements, releases, and adoption of **VCS, WVS, and Product View Adapters**.
* Drive the evolution of **VCS into a broader content-processing platform** supporting reusable publishing, transformation, and processing services across PTC products.
* Lead product direction for **Windchill publishing**, including publishing workflows, representations, reliability, scalability, serviceability, security, storage, and performance.
* Define **CAD interoperability and Product View Adapter strategy** across native CAD formats, neutral formats, adapters, third-party conversion technologies, and emerging interoperability requirements.
* Work directly with global **customers and partners** to translate publishing, CAD conversion, deployment, and operational challenges into scalable product capabilities.
* Partner with engineering and architecture on complex technical decisions involving conversion technologies, distributed processing, cloud services, deployment architecture, performance, licensing, and build-versus-buy choices.
* Balance near-term customer and release priorities with longer-term investments in architecture, scalability, interoperability, and platform evolution.
* Mentor other Product Managers and provide technical and product leadership across the Visualization PM team.

**What You Bring**

* Strong Product Management experience with technically complex enterprise software, engineering applications, platforms, or infrastructure.
* **Deep working knowledge of Windchill publishing is required**, including WVS, publishing workflows, representations, workers/adapters, and downstream visualization.
* **Demonstrated CAD interoperability expertise is required**, including CAD translation, native and neutral formats, adapters, and conversion technologies.
* Strong understanding of **CAD, PLM, and engineering workflows**.
* Ability to work deeply with engineering and architecture teams while connecting technical decisions to customer and business value.
* Experience engaging directly with customers and turning complex technical problems into scalable product capabilities.
* Strong cross-functional leadership, communication, and influencing skills in a globally distributed organization.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* 8+years of experience as a **software engineer, architect, solution architect, technical consultant, or similar technical role** involving CAD, PLM, visualization, or engineering software.
* Broader knowledge of Windchill and enterprise PLM processes.
* Experience with **cloud/SaaS architectures, distributed processing, or content-processing platforms**.
* Experience with interoperability SDKs, third-party conversion technologies, neutral formats, or **USD/OpenUSD**.

  

**How You ll Lead**

This is a senior **individual-contributor role** without direct people-management responsibility. You will lead through product expertise, technical credibility, collaboration, and influence across Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, customers, and partners.

The position is **based in India with global responsibilities**. International travel is required based on customer, partner, and business needs.

**Your mission: Own the product leadership and future direction of PTC s visualization publishing, content-processing, and interoperability platform across VCS, WVS, and Product View Adapters.**

We respect the privacy rights of individuals and are committed to handling Personal Information responsibly and in accordance with all applicable privacy and data protection laws. Review our Privacy Policy here ."

**About Phenom**

Our purpose is to help a billion people find the right work! Phenom is an AI-powered talent experience platform redefining the HR technology landscape. We have grown into a global organization with offices in six countries and over 1,500 employees. As an HR tech unicorn, innovation and creativity are embedded in our DNA. Join us in making every talent moment phenomenal!

**Job Summary**

As a **Product Manager IX (Integration Experience)** at Phenom, you will drive the strategy, development, and launch of integration-focused products that enable seamless connectivity across enterprise platforms and deliver exceptional candidate and customer experiences.

You will work closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, and other cross-functional teams to define product vision, translate customer needs into scalable solutions, and build developer-friendly integration experiences. The ideal candidate will bring strong product management expertise, hands-on understanding of integration platforms, workflows, APIs, No-Code/Low-Code platforms, Applied AI, and metadata management concepts.

* **Product Strategy & Vision:** Define and execute the product roadmap, establish product vision, prioritize initiatives, and translate business objectives into measurable outcomes.

* **Stakeholder Communication:** Communicate product vision, strategy, and roadmap through effective storytelling and collaborate with global teams in a fast-paced environment.

**What You've Done**

* 4–7 years of SaaS product management experience, with at least four years of relevant product management experience.
* Proven experience building, launching, and managing products from ideation to market adoption, preferably in enterprise SaaS, HR technology, or recruitment technology.
* Strong understanding of **integration platforms (iPaaS), enterprise integrations, APIs, web services, and data synchronization** across enterprise applications.
* Experience building or managing integration frameworks and developer-focused or API-centric products.
* Understanding of **workflows, workflow automation, orchestration, and business process configuration**.
* Experience working with or building **No-Code/Low-Code platforms**, preferably with hands-on exposure to integration and workflow capabilities.
* Understanding of **Applied AI concepts and their potential applications** in product experiences, automation, and intelligent integrations.
* Knowledge of **metadata management**, including schemas, data models, mapping, transformation, and data consistency across connected systems.
* Experience integrating enterprise HR systems, such as ATS, HRIS, CRM, and other talent acquisition or workforce platforms.
* Strong understanding of candidate experience and its impact on recruitment, talent acquisition, and employer branding.
* Proficiency in product development tools such as JIRA and experience with Agile, Scrum, or Kanban methodologies.

* Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and collaborate effectively with customers, engineering teams, and international stakeholders.

Our commitment to diversity runs deep! Diversity is essential to building phenomenal teams, products, and customer experiences. jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
Data Governance and Data Hygiene Product Owner

One role Contract-to-hire India

Role summary

You will own the data hygiene program day to day. You will turn a backlog of more than 40 known data problems into defined, prioritized, and verified cleanup work. Over time, you will build that into a lasting data governance practice. You work directly with business leaders and operations teams, so clear communication and a real understanding of how the business runs matter as much as technical skill.

What you will do

* Own and prioritize the data hygiene backlog, sequenced against the 2027 roadmap releases.
* Meet with business owners and operations leads to understand their processes, why the data breaks, and what clean data has to look like for them.
* Write clear business definitions and a business glossary for each data domain, in plain language business users can sign off on.
* Define critical fields, data quality rules, and how quality is measured for each domain.
* Plan bulk cleanups: what to fix, how (mass update, matching algorithm, or reload), how to validate it, and who signs off.
* Lead the two Data Quality Analysts: assign work, review their output, and remove blockers.
* Keep a gap log of each data issue found, who owns the fix, and when it closed.
* Work with the data platform and Salesforce teams on field and model changes, and with the data team on automated quality checks.
* Report progress to U.S. leadership in short, clear updates: what was cleaned, what changed in the numbers, and what is next.
* Over time, set up change control for new fields and definitions with business owners.

What we are looking for Critical (must have)

* **Communication.** You explain data problems and trade-offs clearly to nontechnical business leaders, in writing and live. You run a meeting, push back politely, and follow up.
* **Business understanding.** You learn how an operations business works (how work moves from sale to field to invoice) and connect each data problem to its business impact.
* **Technical skill.** You write and read SQL well enough to profile data, check a cleanup, and challenge an analysts work. Snowflake experience is preferred.

Also required

* 5+ years in data governance, data quality, master data management, or a data product owner or business analyst role.
* Experience owning a backlog and prioritizing with business stakeholders.
* Experience writing data definitions, glossaries, or data quality rules.
* **Comfortable working with U.S. teams until at least 12:00 p.m. Pacific.**

Nice to have

* Field service, facilities, utilities, telecom, or energy industry experience.
* Salesforce data model experience (Service Cloud or Field Service).
* Experience with data catalog or governance tools.
* Power BI or another BI tool.
* Agile and Azure DevOps.

What success looks like in the first 90 days

* Glossaries and quality baselines in place for the asset and technician domains.
* The first bulk cleanups delivered and signed off by their business owners.
* A working weekly rhythm with business owners and the analysts, with a backlog leadership can see.

Required Skills

Business Process Modeling Presentation and Communication skills Power BI Snowflake Stakeholder Communication ADO SQL Agile Methodologies

jobs.description:
**Overview:**

We are looking for a detail-oriented Finance professional with strong reconciliation skills and hands-on experience in managing high-volume financial data and complex Excel-based reconciliations.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Accounts Receivable & Sales Reconciliation**

* Customer ledger and balance reconciliation.
* Sales Register vs Books reconciliation.
* Customer outstanding tracking, balance confirmations and payment follow-ups.
* Reconciliation of sales returns, credit notes and debit notes.
* Payment gateway and e-commerce marketplace settlement reconciliation.

  

**2. Accounts Payable & Purchase Reconciliation**

* Vendor ledger and statement reconciliation.
* Purchase Register vs Books reconciliation.
* GR/IR reconciliation and vendor outstanding tracking.
* Reconciliation of purchase invoices, debit notes and credit notes.

  

**3. GST Reconciliation**

* GSTR-2B vs Purchase Register reconciliation.
* GSTR-2A/2B vs Books reconciliation.
* Identification of missing invoices, GSTIN mismatches and ITC differences.
* Vendor-wise ITC reconciliation and follow-ups for pending or incorrect GST filings.
* Sales Register vs GSTR-1 and Books reconciliation.
* Identification and resolution of GST-related discrepancies.

  

**4. Inventory Reconciliation**

* Physical stock vs ERP/system stock reconciliation.
* Warehouse-wise and SKU-wise inventory reconciliation.
* Purchase inward, sales outward and stock movement reconciliation.
* Identification of stock shortages, excess stock, negative inventory and valuation differences.
* Coordination with warehouse and operations teams for variance resolution.

  

**5. MIS Reporting & Month-End Closure**

* Preparation of periodic MIS reports, reconciliation statements and ageing reports.
* Support monthly book closure and ensure timely reconciliation of all major accounts.
* Review outstanding balances, open items and provision-related entries.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely closure of month-end activities.

  

**Preferred Candidate Profile:**

* Strong knowledge of Accounts Receivable, customer reconciliation and collection follow-ups.
* Advanced Excel skills (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, etc.).
* Hands-on experience handling large volumes of data and complex Excel-based reconciliations.
* Working knowledge of ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite or similar.
* Preference for candidates from D2C, E-commerce, FMCG, Retail or Manufacturing backgrounds.

BDO RISE stands for round-the-clock international services for excellence and is dedicated to providing exceptional client service in the global economy to BDO USA

Our professionals leverage consistent best practices to delivery outstanding service and solutions.

BDO RISE serves BDO USA, which utilizes the services of BDO RISE in delivering its final work product to BDO USAs clients across its Assurance, Tax, Advisory and BDO Digital practices.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a detail-oriented, CA Intermediate-qualified professional to join our Finance team. The successful candidate will own core Record-to-Report (RTR) accounting, intercompany reconciliations, and cash flow forecasting, supporting accurate financial reporting and effective liquidity management. The role requires strong analytical skills, advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft 365 tools, and increasing comfort with AI-enabled finance tools.

**Job Duties**

**1. Record-to-Report (RTR) & General Ledger**

* Manage monthly close general ledger accounting, journal entries, accruals, and month-end/year-end book closures.
* Prepare and review balance sheet reconciliations, identifying and resolving discrepancies in a timely manner.

**2. Cash Forecasting & Liquidity Management**

* Prepare, monitor, and update short-term and medium-term cash flow forecasts (weekly/monthly).
* Track daily cash positions, bank balances, and working capital movements to ensure adequate liquidity.
* Analyze variances between projected and actual cash flows and report key drivers to management.

jobs.title: Executive - Revenue Operations and FP&A
jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities

1. Revenue Operations & Customer Billing :

• Manage end-to-end customer billing, ensuring invoices are raised accurately and within agreed timelines.

• Coordinate with Account Managers and Operations to validate FTE headcount, transaction volumes, rate cards, and other billing inputs.

• Ensure timely submission of invoices through customer billing portals and email.

• Track invoice acceptance, rejections, disputes, and corrections to ensure successful processing.

• Maintain customer-wise billing trackers and identify unbilled revenue, billing discrepancies, and potential revenue leakages.

• Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to resolve billing issues and ensure timely closure.

  

2. Accounts Receivable & Collections Management

• Maintain customer-wise AR ageing, outstanding balances, and collection trackers.

• Follow up with customers and Account Managers to ensure timely collections.

• Track overdue receivables, collection commitments, and payment disputes, escalating delays where necessary.

• Reconcile customer receipts against invoices, including partial payments, deductions, and missing remittance information.

• Ensure regular reconciliation of customer accounts with accounting records.

• Support working capital reporting and cash collection forecasting.

  

3. Center Cost Management & Accounts Payable

• Validate delivery center invoices against customer billing, approved sharing ratios, agreed rates, and supporting operational data.

• Maintain customer-wise and center-wise cost trackers and ensure timely reconciliation.

• Monitor center payables, due dates, ageing, and payment schedules to facilitate timely payments.

• Track center sharing ratios and ensure changes are appropriately documented and implemented.

• Coordinate with Delivery Centers and internal stakeholders to resolve invoice discrepancies.

• Ensure accurate accounting of center costs, accruals, and pending invoices.

• Identify discrepancies affecting customer-wise gross margins.

  

4. Contract, Rate Card & Commercial Tracking

• Maintain a centralized repository of customer MSAs, SOWs, purchase orders, rate cards, and commercial amendments.

• Track contract validity, renewals, billing terms, payment terms, and other relevant commercial conditions.

• Maintain accurate pricing records for FTE-based, transaction-based, and other billing models.

• Track annual rate increases, COLA revisions, contractual escalations, and changes in commercial arrangements.

• Ensure updated pricing and center sharing ratios are accurately reflected in billing and cost calculations.

• Identify deviations between contractual terms and actual billing and coordinate corrective actions.

  

5. Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)

Budgeting & Forecasting

• Support annual budgeting and periodic forecasting exercises by coordinating with Account Managers and Operations teams.

• Maintain customer-wise revenue, headcount, pricing, and center cost assumptions used in budgeting and forecasting.

• Prepare and update monthly revenue forecasts based on existing run rates, new business, ramp-ups, ramp-downs, and contractual changes. • Track actual performance against budgets and forecasts and identify material deviations.

• Support preparation of customer-wise and consolidated revenue and gross margin projections.

Financial Analysis & MIS

• Prepare monthly Budget vs Actual vs Forecast analysis for revenue, center costs, and gross margins.

• Analyze month-on-month revenue movements and identify key customer-wise drivers.

• Monitor customer-wise profitability, take rates, revenue per employee (RPE), and other operating metrics.

• Analyze changes in revenue resulting from headcount movement, pricing revisions, transaction volumes, and customer mix.

• Support preparation of monthly MIS reports, dashboards, and management presentations.

• Provide clear explanations of financial variances, operational movements, and emerging risks.

Business Finance Support

• Assist in evaluating the financial impact of contract renewals, pricing revisions, and changes in center sharing arrangements.

• Support basic scenario analysis relating to revenue growth, headcount, pricing, and margins.

• Coordinate with business teams to validate forecast assumptions and track changes.

• Identify trends, exceptions, and opportunities for revenue improvement or cost optimization.

  

6. Trackers, Dashboards & Data Management

• Take ownership of revenue, AR, center cost, AP, budgeting, forecasting, and operational trackers.

• Ensure financial trackers and dashboards are accurate, regularly updated, and reconciled with accounting records.

• Develop and maintain customer-wise dashboards covering revenue, costs, margins, collections, and other business metrics.

• Ensure consistency between operational data, billing records, accounting systems, and MIS reporting.

• Improve reporting efficiency through automation and standardization. • Maintain proper documentation and version control of key financial data and reports.

  

7. Statutory Compliance, Audit & Finance Support

• Support GST compliance, including outward supply reconciliations, GST returns, credit/debit notes, and related documentation.

• Assist in TDS reconciliations, statutory filings, and compliance relating to customer receipts and center/vendor payments.

• Prepare schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documentation for statutory audits, internal audits, and other financial reviews.

• Support resolution of audit observations relating to revenue, AR, AP, and center costs.

• Ensure proper documentation, audit trails, and adherence to internal financial controls.

• Assist in monthly financial closure and other related finance activities.

  

8. Process Improvement & Automation

• Understand and document end-to-end processes covering customer billing, collections, center costs, payments, budgeting, and reporting.

• Identify process owners, establish clear responsibilities, and coordinate with stakeholders to ensure timely completion.

• Identify manual activities, repetitive tasks, control gaps, and reporting inefficiencies.

• Drive process improvements through standardized workflows, stronger reconciliations, and automation.

• Explore opportunities to use Excel, Power Query, Power BI, AI tools, and other available technologies to automate finance processes.

• Develop automated checks, exception reports, and dashboards to reduce manual intervention.

• Continuously work towards improving accuracy, reducing turnaround times, and increasing overall process efficiency.

The work is fast-paced and seasonal in nature, corresponding with Oracles quarterly and annual fiscal cycles.

  

Night shift mandatory

  

A **Contracts Administrator** is responsible for overseeing the entire lifecycle of an organization's contracts acting as a fiduciary ensuring legal compliance, mitigating risks, and maximizing financial and operational performance. This role requires a blend of knowledge on contracts language, business acumen, and strong project management skills. Legal knowledge although not mandatory is beneficial.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Contract Drafting, Review, and Negotiation:** Prepare, review, and modify a wide range of agreements (e.g., vendor, client, sales, and non-disclosure) to ensure clarity, accuracy, and alignment with company policies and legal requirements.
* **Contract Lifecycle Management:** Manage the entire contract process from initial request and authoring through execution, performance monitoring, renewal, or termination.
* **Compliance and Risk Management:** Ensure all parties adhere to contract terms and conditions, monitor adherence to federal, state, and local laws, and identify and mitigate potential legal, financial, and operational risks. Strict adherence internal contract management policies and procedures
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:** Serve as the primary liaison between internal teams (legal, AR, reporting, collections, process owners, business practice and approvers) and Sales to ensure mutual understanding and agreement on contract terms.
* **Q management:** Ensure all contractual records and correspondence are attached in the Q system for efficiency and easy retrieval and allowing for continuity
* **Dispute Resolution:** Address and resolve any contract-related issues, conflicts, or breaches in a timely and professional manner to avoid litigation and maintain positive relationships.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Proactively identify and analyze areas for process optimization, operational efficiency, and service quality enhancements. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement best practices and innovative solutions. Track the effectiveness of improvement initiatives through data-driven metrics. Additionally, possessing practical knowledge of crafting and leveraging AI prompts to support automation, workflow enhancement, and informed decision-making
