jobs.title: Accountant
jobs.description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible **Accountant** with a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience to manage day-to-day accounting operations, financial documentation, reconciliations, billing, and compliance-related activities at our resort.

  

The candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, processing invoices, monitoring receivables and payables, reconciling bank transactions, supporting and preparing periodic financial reports.

  

The ideal candidate should have good knowledge of accounting principles, bank reconciliation, and accounting software, along with strong analytical skills, accuracy, and the ability to coordinate with different departments.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Day-to-Day Accounting Operations**

* Maintain accurate books of accounts and financial records.
* Record daily financial transactions, including receipts, payments, purchases, sales, and expenses.
* Prepare and maintain journal entries, payment vouchers, receipt vouchers, and contra entries.
* Ensure all transactions are recorded under the correct ledger and cost centre.
* Maintain proper documentation and filing of financial records.
* Monitor daily cash transactions and ensure accurate cash book maintenance.

  

**2. Accounts Payable & Receivable**

* Process vendor invoices, bills, and payment requests.
* Verify invoices against purchase orders, delivery notes, and approvals.
* Maintain vendor ledgers and track outstanding payments.
* Monitor guest and corporate receivables, including outstanding booking payments.
* Follow up with relevant departments and customers for pending payments.
* Prepare accounts payable and receivable ageing reports.
* Ensure timely processing of approved vendor payments.

  

**3. Bank & Cash Reconciliation**

* Perform regular bank reconciliations.
* Verify bank statements against accounting records.
* Identify and resolve discrepancies in bank transactions.
* Maintain cash book and petty cash records.
* Monitor cash collections and daily cash deposits.
* Ensure proper supporting documents are available for all financial transactions.

  

**4. Revenue & Billing Management**

* Verify daily revenue reports generated by Front Office, F&B, and other operating departments.
* Check room revenue, restaurant sales, event revenue, and other operational income.
* Reconcile billing records with actual collections through cash, UPI, cards, and bank transfers.
* Verify discounts, complimentary services, refunds, and cancellations against approvals.
* Monitor advance payments and guest booking balances.
* Ensure proper invoicing and documentation for corporate and individual customers.

  

**5. Purchase & Inventory Accounting**

* Verify purchase invoices and supporting documents.
* Coordinate with Procurement and Stores for purchase and goods-received documentation.
* Check vendor bills against approved purchase orders and goods received.
* Maintain records of purchases, stock-related expenses, and vendor payments.
* Assist in periodic stock valuation and inventory reconciliation.
* Identify discrepancies in purchase records and report them to the concerned manager.

  

**6. Financial Reporting & MIS**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly financial reports.
* Maintain expense statements and department-wise cost records.
* Prepare outstanding payment and collection reports.
* Assist in monthly closing activities and ledger scrutiny.
* Track operational expenses and highlight unusual variations.
* Support preparation of profit and loss statements and other management reports.
* Provide accurate financial information to management as required.

  

**7. Departmental Coordination**

* Coordinate with Front Office, F&B, Housekeeping, Procurement, Stores, HR, and Administration teams.
* Collect and verify financial documents from respective departments.
* Follow up on pending bills, approvals, collections, and supporting documents.
* Ensure timely submission of financial information.
* Escalate accounting discrepancies and irregularities to the reporting manager.

  

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in **B.Com, Accounting, Finance, or a related field**.
* Minimum **2 years of experience** in accounting or finance operations.
* Experience in hotel, resort, hospitality, retail, or service-sector accounting will be an advantage.
* Good knowledge of accounting principles and financial documentation.
* Working knowledge of GST, TDS, bank reconciliation, and accounts payable/receivable.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and accounting software such as Tally Prime.
* Knowledge of payroll accounting and statutory compliance will be preferred.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.

jobs.title: Head of Finance & Accounts
jobs.description:
**Job Description: Head of Finance & Accounts**

**Company:** Hatti Food & Beverages Pvt. Ltd. (Hatti Kaapi)  
**Designation:** Head, Finance & Accounts  
**Department:** Finance & Accounts  
**Job Location:** Bengaluru  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Reporting To:** Managing Director / CEO

  

**Job Summary**

Hatti Food & Beverages Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a highly qualified, experienced, and strategic Finance Head to lead the company's Finance & Accounts function.

  

The ideal candidate should have substantial experience in the FMCG, Food & Beverage, Retail, or Manufacturing industry, with a strong understanding of financial management, business planning, accounting, taxation, statutory compliance, and commercial operations.

  

The candidate will be responsible for developing financial strategies, driving profitability, strengthening financial controls, managing working capital, ensuring regulatory compliance, and providing strategic financial insights to support business growth.

  

The role requires a hands-on finance leader with the ability to manage multi-location operations, improve financial processes, and work closely with senior management on business decisions.

  

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

  

**1. Financial Planning & Strategic Management**

* Develop and implement financial strategies aligned with the company's business objectives and growth plans.
* Lead annual budgeting, financial forecasting, and long-term financial planning.
* Monitor financial performance and provide periodic reports and recommendations to Management.
* Analyse revenue, expenditure, profitability and business performance across outlets and business units.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to support strategic business decisions.
* Evaluate new business opportunities, expansion plans, capital investments and financial feasibility.

  

**2. Financial Reporting & MIS**

* Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and management reports.
* Ensure timely preparation and presentation of Profit & Loss statements, Balance Sheets and Cash Flow statements.
* Develop and implement financial MIS, dashboards and performance tracking systems.
* Monitor outlet-wise, region-wise and business-unit-wise financial performance.
* Analyse budget versus actual performance and highlight deviations with corrective action plans.
* Ensure accuracy, transparency and timely closure of financial records.

  

**3. FMCG / Food & Beverage Commercial Finance**

* Manage financial operations in a multi-location retail, FMCG and food service environment.
* Monitor product costing, food costs, gross margins, contribution margins and operating expenses.
* Implement effective inventory valuation and stock reconciliation processes.
* Monitor raw material procurement costs, wastage, stock movement and inventory holding.
* Work closely with Procurement, Operations and Supply Chain teams to improve cost efficiency.
* Establish effective controls over outlet-level cash collections, expenses, billing and settlements.
* Monitor outlet profitability and identify opportunities for margin improvement.

  

**4. Working Capital & Treasury Management**

* Manage cash flow, fund allocation, liquidity and working capital requirements.
* Monitor accounts receivable, accounts payable, and outstanding balances.
* Ensure timely vendor payments and effective credit management.
* Develop cash flow forecasts and optimise the utilisation of financial resources.
* Maintain banking relationships and coordinate with financial institutions for funding requirements.
* Monitor fund utilisation and ensure adequate liquidity for business operations.

  

**5. Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable GST, Income Tax, TDS, TCS, and other statutory requirements.
* Oversee timely filing of statutory returns, payments and reconciliations.
* Coordinate with external auditors, tax consultants, and statutory authorities.
* Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and regulatory requirements.
* Establish strong internal financial controls and ensure proper documentation.
* Monitor changes in taxation laws and regulatory requirements affecting the business.

  

**6. Internal Controls & Risk Management**

* Establish and strengthen internal financial control systems and accounting procedures.
* Develop financial policies, approval matrices, and expense control mechanisms.
* Monitor financial risks, operational leakages and potential irregularities.
* Conduct periodic financial reviews and internal audits across outlets and departments.
* Ensure proper reconciliation of bank accounts, vendor accounts, customer accounts, and inventory.
* Implement corrective measures to minimise financial losses and improve operational efficiency.

  

**7. Accounts & Finance Team Leadership**

* Lead, guide and develop the Finance & Accounts team.
* Define responsibilities, establish performance expectations and monitor team deliverables.
* Ensure timely processing of vendor payments, employee reimbursements, payroll accounting, and financial transactions.
* Build efficient accounting processes and improve departmental productivity.
* Coordinate with HR, Operations, Procurement, Sales and other departments for financial requirements.

  

**8. Audit & Business Coordination**

* Manage statutory, internal, and tax audits.
* Coordinate with auditors, consultants, bankers and other external stakeholders.
* Ensure audit schedules, supporting documents and reconciliations are completed on time.
* Present financial performance, business risks and recommendations to senior management.
* Support management in business expansion, investment evaluation and financial decision-making.

  

**Educational Qualifications**

* Chartered Accountant / CMA / MBA in Finance from a reputed institution with strong relevant experience.
* Strong knowledge of accounting standards, taxation, and financial management.

  

**Experience Requirements**

* 5 - 10 years of overall experience in Finance & Accounts.
* At least 3 years in a senior finance leadership or managerial position.
* Strong and preferably mandatory experience in FMCG, Food & Beverage, Retail, Manufacturing, or a multi-location business.
* Experience in managing large-scale financial operations, budgeting, costing, taxation, audits, and financial reporting.
* Experience in ERP implementation, accounting automation, and process improvement will be an added advantage.

  

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strategic financial planning and business partnering.
* Advanced financial analysis and interpretation.
* Strong knowledge of GST, Income Tax, TDS, and statutory compliance.
* Budgeting, forecasting and financial modelling.
* Working capital and cash flow management.
* Inventory valuation, product costing and margin analysis.
* Internal financial controls and risk management.
* ERP / Accounting software knowledge.
* Advanced MS Excel and financial MIS reporting.
* Strong leadership, negotiation, and decision-making skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

  

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Improvement in overall business profitability and operating margins.
* Accuracy and timely closure of monthly financial statements.
* Effective working capital and cash flow management.
* Timely statutory compliance and audit completion.
* Reduction in operational costs and financial leakages.
* Improvement in inventory control and reconciliation.
* Timely and accurate financial MIS and management reporting.
* Strengthening of internal financial controls and processes.

  

**Interested candidates with strong FMCG / Food & Beverage finance experience and a proven track record in leading finance functions are encouraged to apply.**

**Qualification:** B.Com / M.Com

  

**Role Purpose**

Ensure that all material inward, consumption and outward transactions at the plant are correctly accounted for, reconciled and reported in the books.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Inward accounting:** Book vendor invoices against PO and GRN (3-way match); clear GR/IR differences; accrue for material received but not yet invoiced; ensure correct GST input credit.

* **Outward accounting:** Reconcile dispatches with sales invoices and stock reduction; account for job-work, subcontracting and returnable material; account for scrap sales.
* **Inventory reconciliation:** Reconcile stores records with the books (GL vs stock ledger); account for physical verification differences; support month-end inventory valuation.
* **Month-end closing:** Pass plant-level accruals, provisions and adjustment entries; prepare inventory and GL reconciliations for the Manager.
* **Reporting & audit:** Prepare monthly consumption, material cost and scrap reports; provide schedules and data to auditors.

  

**Key Skills**

* Sound knowledge of inventory and cost accounting
* Working knowledge of GST (ITC, e-Way Bill, job-work) and TDS
* ERP experience (SAP FI/MM preferred) and good Excel skills
* Strong reconciliation skills and attention to detail

jobs.title: AVP / GM - Accounts & Finance
jobs.description:
**Nature of Role:** Strategic and Operational Leadership

**1. ROLE OBJECTIVE**

We are looking for a highly experienced, commercially oriented and hands-on Chief Financial Officer (CFO) with strong expertise in Trade Finance, Banking, Treasury, Working Capital Management and International Trade Financing.

The company is engaged in domestic and international trading of commodities and products such as Coal, Speciality Chemicals and other allied products.

The CFO will be responsible for managing the organization's complete financial operations, with particular emphasis on arranging and optimizing banking facilities, structuring trade finance transactions, managing Letters of Credit, Bank Guarantees, Buyers' Credit, Suppliers' Credit and other fund-based and non-fund-based facilities.

The incumbent will play a pivotal role in developing strong banking relationships, enhancing existing credit limits, arranging additional funding facilities, reducing financing costs and ensuring adequate liquidity to support business expansion.

The CFO will work closely with the CEO, Group CFO and business leadership team, acting as a strategic business partner while ensuring strong financial discipline, effective risk management and robust financial controls.

**2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. TRADE FINANCE & BANKING RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY**

This is the most critical requirement of the position.

* Independently manage relationships with banks, financial institutions and other financing partners.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with senior banking officials and credit teams.
* Arrange, negotiate and enhance existing fund-based and non-fund-based banking facilities.
* Manage multiple banking arrangements and consortium banking relationships, wherever applicable.
* Structure appropriate banking facilities to support domestic and international commodity trading.
* Negotiate competitive interest rates, LC commissions, BG charges, processing fees, collateral requirements and other banking terms.
* Identify new banking partners and alternative financing sources to support business growth.
* Ensure optimal utilization of sanctioned banking limits.
* Lead annual bank limit renewals, credit reviews, documentation and enhancement proposals.
* Prepare and present financial projections, business plans, CMA data, stock statements and other information required by banks.

**B. LETTER OF CREDIT (LC) MANAGEMENT**

* Extensive hands-on experience in opening, negotiating and managing Import LCs, Inland LCs and Export LCs, as applicable.
* Strong understanding of Sight LCs, Usance LCs, Deferred Payment LCs and Back-to-Back LCs.
* Manage LC amendments, extensions, negotiations, retirement and devolvement.
* Negotiate LC tenor, payment terms, commission and banking charges.
* Ensure proper monitoring of LC utilization and outstanding exposure.
* Optimize LC limits to support high-volume trading transactions.
* Ensure coordination with suppliers, customers, banks and logistics teams for timely execution of LC transactions.

**C. BUYERS' CREDIT & SUPPLIERS' CREDIT**

* Strong practical experience in arranging and managing Buyers' Credit for international imports.
* Evaluate and structure cost-effective Buyers' Credit arrangements.
* Negotiate financing tenure, interest rates, currency, margins and other commercial terms.
* Evaluate the cost-benefit of Buyers' Credit against alternative financing arrangements.
* Manage Suppliers' Credit and other permitted trade financing structures.
* Coordinate with domestic and international banks for financing arrangements.
* Ensure timely repayments, documentation and regulatory compliance.
* Monitor overall trade finance costs and their impact on transaction profitability.

**D. BANK GUARANTEES & NON-FUND-BASED FACILITIES**

* Arrange and manage various types of Bank Guarantees, including Performance Guarantees, Financial Guarantees, Advance Payment Guarantees and other contractual guarantees.
* Negotiate BG commission, margin requirements, collateral and validity periods.
* Monitor outstanding BG exposure, expiry dates, renewals and timely release.
* Optimize utilization of non-fund-based banking limits.
* Ensure appropriate documentation and compliance with contractual and banking requirements.

**E. WORKING CAPITAL & TREASURY MANAGEMENT**

* Take complete ownership of the organization's working capital and liquidity management.
* Develop effective cash flow forecasting and fund planning mechanisms.
* Optimize receivables, payables, inventory and cash conversion cycles.
* Monitor customer credit periods, supplier payment terms and inventory holding costs.
* Ensure adequate liquidity for procurement, imports, logistics and other trading operations.
* Optimize utilization of Cash Credit, Overdraft, WCDL and other working capital facilities.
* Minimize interest costs, bank charges and other financing expenses.
* Establish daily, weekly and monthly cash flow monitoring systems.
* Monitor fund requirements across domestic and international operations.

**F. CUSTOMER CREDIT & COUNTERPARTY RISK MANAGEMENT**

* Establish and monitor customer-wise credit limits and exposure.
* Evaluate financial strength and creditworthiness of customers and suppliers.
* Develop credit approval policies and payment terms in consultation with business leadership.
* Monitor overdue receivables and ensure timely collections.
* Establish controls over unsecured advances and counterparty exposures.
* Monitor country-wise, customer-wise and supplier-wise risk exposures.
* Ensure appropriate financial safeguards for large-value trading transactions.

**G. FOREIGN EXCHANGE & INTERNATIONAL TRADE FINANCE**

* Manage foreign currency exposure arising from imports, exports and international transactions.
* Develop and implement appropriate foreign exchange risk management policies.
* Monitor foreign currency receivables, payables and commitments.
* Evaluate hedging strategies and permitted foreign exchange instruments.
* Understand RBI, FEMA and applicable international trade finance regulations.
* Coordinate with banks for foreign exchange transactions and cross-border payments.
* Monitor the impact of exchange rate fluctuations on trading margins.

**H. COMMERCIAL FINANCE & BUSINESS PROFITABILITY**

* Work closely with trading, procurement and sales teams to evaluate transaction profitability.
* Establish transaction-wise costing and profitability analysis.
* Monitor product-wise, customer-wise and geography-wise margins.
* Analyse landed costs, freight, insurance, customs duties, port charges, financing costs and other expenses.
* Evaluate the financial viability of large trading transactions.
* Monitor commodity price movements and their impact on business margins.
* Support management in pricing decisions, business expansion and new market opportunities.

**I. FINANCE, ACCOUNTS, TAXATION & COMPLIANCE**

* Oversee the complete accounting and financial reporting function.
* Ensure timely preparation of monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements.
* Oversee GST, Income Tax, TDS, customs-related tax matters and other statutory compliance.
* Ensure compliance with Companies Act, FEMA, RBI and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Manage statutory audits, internal audits, tax audits and bank audits.
* Ensure appropriate financial controls and accounting policies.
* Monitor GST input tax credit, reconciliations, refunds and export-related tax matters, as applicable.
* Ensure timely closure of books and reporting to management.

**J. FINANCIAL PLANNING, MIS & MANAGEMENT REPORTING**

* Lead budgeting, forecasting and financial planning.
* Prepare comprehensive monthly MIS for the Managing Director and leadership team.
* Monitor profitability, working capital, cash flow and borrowing costs.
* Develop dashboards covering bank limits, LC exposure, BG exposure, Buyers' Credit, receivables and payables.
* Provide financial insights and recommendatio

We are looking for a qualified, detail-oriented and responsible \*Accountant\* to manage the day-to-day accounting and financial operations of the school.

  

The candidate will be responsible for student fee accounting, vendor payments, bank reconciliation, statutory compliance, payroll coordination, financial reporting and maintaining accurate financial records.

  

**2. Key Roles and Responsibilities**

  

**Student Fee Management**

- Maintain student-wise fee records, including tuition fees, admission fees, transport fees and other applicable charges.

- Record daily fee collections through cash, UPI, bank transfers, cheques and online payment gateways.

- Generate fee receipts and maintain accurate collection records.

- Monitor outstanding fees and prepare student-wise fee due reports.

- Coordinate with the admissions and administration teams for fee reconciliation.

- Prepare daily, weekly and monthly fee collection reports.

- Reconcile fee collection software with accounting records and bank statements.

- Maintain records of fee concessions, scholarships, refunds and adjustments.

  

**Daily Accounting and Bookkeeping**

- Record all financial transactions in Tally Prime or other accounting software.

- Maintain cash books, bank books, ledgers and journal vouchers.

- Verify bills, invoices, receipts and supporting documents.

- Maintain proper accounting records for income and expenditure.

- Perform monthly bank reconciliations.

- Monitor petty cash and day-to-day school expenses.

- Ensure correct classification of expenses and accounting entries.

  

**Vendor and Payment Management**

- Verify vendor invoices against purchase orders and delivery records.

- Maintain vendor-wise outstanding statements.

- Process payments after obtaining necessary approvals.

- Reconcile vendor accounts periodically.

- Maintain records of advances paid to suppliers and contractors.

- Track payments relating to infrastructure, maintenance, books, stationery and other school purchases.

  

**GST, TDS and Statutory Compliance**

- Assist in GST compliance, including applicable GST returns and reconciliations.

- Calculate and deduct TDS on applicable payments.

- Prepare data for quarterly TDS returns.

- Assist with Professional Tax, PF and ESI compliance, wherever applicable.

- Maintain statutory challans, returns and supporting records.

- Coordinate with Chartered Accountants and statutory consultants.

- Ensure timely submission of compliance-related information.

  

**Payroll and Employee Accounts**

- Assist in monthly salary processing.

**Company:** CustomFurnish  
**Location:** Hyderabad  
**Experience:** 35 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced **Accounts Executive** to independently manage the day-to-day accounting, payments, taxation and statutory compliance activities of our company.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience managing the complete accounts function of a small or medium-sized business and should be able to work independently with minimal supervision.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Day-to-Day Accounting**

* Maintain books of accounts, including journal entries, ledgers, expenses and financial transactions.
* Handle accounts receivable and accounts payable.
* Maintain customer and vendor accounts, reconcile balances and follow up on outstanding payments.
* Perform bank reconciliations and monitor daily bank transactions.
* Manage petty cash and employee expense reimbursements.

**2. Payments & Banking**

* Process vendor payments, employee reimbursements and other company expenses.
* Prepare payment schedules and ensure timely payments.
* Track customer collections and outstanding receivables.
* Maintain proper documentation and approvals for all payments.

**3. Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Prepare and file GST returns, including GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B, and reconcile GST input tax credit.
* Calculate, deduct, deposit and file TDS returns.
* Manage Provident Fund (PF), ESI (where applicable), Professional Tax and other statutory payments and filings.
* Maintain records relating to gratuity and other employee statutory benefits.
* Ensure timely payment of applicable taxes and statutory dues.

**4. Payroll & Employee-Related Accounting**

* Process monthly payroll, including salary calculations, deductions and reimbursements.
* Maintain employee salary and statutory deduction records.
* Handle full-and-final settlements and leave encashment calculations.
* Coordinate statutory contributions and employee-related payments.

**5. Financial Reporting & Audit**

* Prepare monthly profit and loss statements, expense reports and basic MIS reports.
* Monitor cash flow, outstanding receivables and upcoming payment obligations.
* Assist with monthly and annual closing of accounts.
* Coordinate with the company's Chartered Accountant for audits, income tax filings and annual financial statements.
* Maintain accurate accounting records and supporting documentation.

**6. Inventory & Purchase Accounting**

* Record purchase invoices, supplier payments and purchase returns.
* Reconcile supplier statements and outstanding balances.
* Coordinate with procurement and production teams for invoice verification.
* Assist in tracking inventory purchases, material costs and stock reconciliation.

Qualifications & Skills

* B.Com / M.Com or equivalent qualification in Accounting or Finance.
* **3–5 years of hands-on accounting experience**, preferably in a small or medium-sized company.
* Proficiency in **Tally Prime** and Microsoft Excel.
* Good working knowledge of GST, TDS, PF, ESI and other applicable Indian statutory compliances.
* Experience independently handling accounts payable, receivable, payroll and bank reconciliations.
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage deadlines and work independently.

Preferred Candidate

We are looking for a **hands-on accounts professional, not just a data-entry operator**, who can take ownership of the company's routine accounting operations, ensure timely statutory compliance and provide accurate financial information to management.

jobs.title: Audit Executive
jobs.description:
**Role Summary**

The Quality & Audit Executive is the person who does the audit work on the ground. Each cycle, the Executive draws random samples of critical transactions for the functions and campuses assigned to them, checks each sample against the documented standard, collects evidence, rates the result, and writes up the findings. The Executive then follows up with function teams until fixes are made and checks that they have worked. The work depends on being accurate, fair, and consistent: two auditors looking at the same transaction should reach the same conclusion. The Executive also helps the Head improve the standards, checklists, and dashboards so that the audit gets faster and sharper each cycle.

  

**How the Audit Works**

The audit steps the Executive will follow (illustrative; the Head will finalise the methodology):

  

* **Receive the plan** get the audit calendar, scope, sample size, and checklist for each assigned function and campus
* **Draw the sample** pull random samples of critical transactions from source systems according to the sampling plan, without input from the function being audited
* **Check against the standard** — review each sampled transaction against the documented standard and checklist — for example, whether steps were done, on time, with the right records
* **Record the evidence** — keep working papers, screenshots, records, and notes so that every conclusion can be verified later
* **Rate and report** — score each sample, classify findings by severity, and draft the audit report inputs for the Head
* **Follow up** — track agreed corrective actions with function teams, verify closure, and re-check where needed

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Audit fieldwork** — carry out audits of critical transactions for assigned functions and campuses as per the audit calendar, through desk review of records and systems and, where needed, campus visits
* **Sampling** — draw random and risk-based samples from source systems and record how the sample was selected, so it can be repeated and defended
* **Checklists and standards** — apply the audit checklists consistently; suggest changes to checklists and standards where a standard is unclear, out of date, or not working in practice
* **Evidence and working papers** — keep complete, organised evidence and working papers for every audit; keep data confidential
* **Findings and reports** — write clear, factual findings with evidence, severity, and likely root cause; contribute to the regular audit reports and scorecards shared with all functions
* **Data analysis** — use spreadsheets and data tools to analyse samples, find patterns across campuses, and prepare dashboards and trend views
* **Discussion with function teams** — walk function teams through findings, confirm facts before reports are issued, and agree corrective actions and due dates
* **Corrective action follow-up** — track closure of agreed actions, verify the fix with evidence, and escalate delays or repeat issues to the Head
* **Escalation** — raise serious findings at once with the Head — for example, misconduct, fee leakage, student-safety issues, or data integrity concerns
* **Process learning** — learn the processes of the assigned functions in depth, including curricular and co-curricular assessments such as GRIT, BRAVE, and MINT, and pick up new functions as they are added, and flag process gaps and improvement ideas to the Head
* **Calibration and improvement** — take part in calibration sessions with other executives so that scoring stays consistent across auditors and campuses

sistency of scoring; findings disputed and overturned; completeness of evidence and working papers

  

**Who We're Looking For**

* 3–6 years of experience in internal audit, process assurance, risk advisory, or operations quality
* Knows how to plan an audit, draw a random sample, test it against a standard, document evidence, and write up findings
* Has audited transactions or operations at volume — in a risk advisory or internal audit team, a shared-services or BPO quality team, a bank or NBFC operations audit, or a similar setting
* Comfortable with data: strong spreadsheet skills; ability to pull and analyse samples from systems; exposure to BI or audit-analytics tools is a plus
* Attention to detail and objectivity; able to give accurate findings without being swayed
* Clear written and spoken communication — can explain a finding to a function team politely and firmly
* Learns new processes quickly and is curious about how operations really work
* Willing to travel across campuses

  

**Good to Have**

* Experience in ed-tech, education, or student-facing operations
* Exposure to Lean / Six Sigma or ISO quality management
* Experience with ticketing, CRM, or program-tracking systems
* Experience writing or improving checklists and standard operating processes

**Job Summary:**

The Cash Application Clerk is responsible for accurately and promptly recording, applying, and reconciling customer payments within the organizations accounting systems. This role supports effective accounts receivable management by ensuring payments are applied to the correct customer accounts, investigating unapplied cash, resolving payment discrepancies, and maintaining accurate financial records.  
Working closely with Accounts Receivable, Billing, Customer Service, Sales, and customers, the Cash Application Clerk helps maintain accurate account balances, support cash flow management, and ensure timely and reliable financial reporting.  
Key Responsibilities

+ **Cash Application:** Process and apply customer payments received through electronic funds transfers (EFTs), wire transfers, cheques, lockbox transactions, credit cards, and other payment methods.
+ **Payment Reconciliation:** Match incoming payments to customer invoices and remittance advice, ensuring accurate and timely posting.
+ **Unapplied Cash Management:** Identify, investigate, and resolve unapplied and unidentified cash to minimize outstanding balances.
+ **Discrepancy Resolution:** Research payment differences, short payments, overpayments, duplicate payments, and missing remittance information.
+ **Customer Account Maintenance:** Review customer accounts, maintain accurate payment records, and ensure transactions are posted to the appropriate accounts.
+ **Internal Coordination:** Collaborate with Accounts Receivable, Billing, Customer Service, Sales, and other departments to resolve payment-related issues.
+ **Customer Communication:** Contact customers when necessary to obtain remittance details, clarify payment discrepancies, and resolve account allocation issues.
+ **Reporting and Documentation:** Maintain organized records of cash receipts, reconciliations, adjustments, and outstanding payment issues.
+ **Month-End Support:** Assist with month-end closing activities, cash reconciliations, accounts receivable reporting, and other accounting tasks as required.
+ **Process Compliance:** Follow established accounting procedures, internal controls, and company policies to ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial transactions.
+ **Continuous Improvement:** Identify opportunities to improve cash application accuracy, processing efficiency, and reconciliation procedures.

  

+ **Required Skills:**
+ **A two-year Accounting Graduate or equivalent education is required.**
+ Two years of experience in accounting, cash application, accounts receivable, or banking is preferred.
+ Experience in the trucking, transportation, or logistics industry is considered an asset.
+ Knowledge of accounting principles, accounts receivable processes, and cash application procedures is required.
+ Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications is required.
+ Experience using accounting software, ERP systems, or transportation management systems (TMS) is an asset.
+ Required Skills and Competencies
+ Strong attention to detail and a high degree of numerical accuracy.
+ Good analytical, problem-solving, and reconciliation skills.
+ Ability to investigate discrepancies and resolve payment issues effectively.
+ Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to meet deadlines.
+ Effective written and verbal communication skills.
+ Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.
+ Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced accounting environment.
+ Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and accurate financial records.
+ Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)  
  Performance may be evaluated based on:
+ Accuracy and timeliness of cash application.
+ Volume of payments processed within established deadlines.
+ Reduction in unapplied and unidentified cash balances.
+ Timeliness of payment discrepancy resolution.
+ Accuracy of customer account reconciliations.
+ Compliance with month-end closing deadlines and internal control procedures.
+ Working Relationships  
  The Cash Application Clerk works closely with the Accounts Receivable team, Billing, Customer Service, Sales, customers, and other internal stakeholders to ensure accurate payment processing and effective resolution of account-related issues.  
  Overall Objective  
  To ensure customer payments are accurately recorded, applied, and reconciled in a timely manner, supporting effective accounts receivable management, reliable financial reporting, healthy cash flow, and positive customer relationships.

jobs.title: Analyst - Proxy Voting
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**  

The Proxy Voting team, part of Invesco's Investment Stewardship team, is responsible for supporting the end-to-end proxy voting process within Invesco.

Invesco is seeking a Proxy Voting Analyst to join the Proxy Voting team in Hyderabad.

The Proxy Voting Analyst will support the end-to-end proxy voting process, including account setup, vote execution and reconciliation, reporting, and operational controls. Working closely with portfolio managers, custodian banks, technology teams, legal and compliance, and third-party service providers, the analyst will help ensure the accurate and timely execution of proxy voting activities across client accounts.

Due to its broad stakeholder engagement and involvement in critical governance and regulatory workflows, this role provides a unique opportunity to develop a deep understanding of proxy voting, investment stewardship, regulatory reporting, and operational excellence within a global asset management environment.

  
  
**Responsibilities**  

* Support the Proxy Voting team in the end-to-end execution of proxy voting activities, including ballot monitoring, vote instruction preparation, voting execution, and post-vote oversight, while driving enhancements to the efficiency, scalability, and control environment through process improvement, automation, and systemization.
* Ensure accounts are accurately established, maintained, and closed across the firm, custodian banks and proxy agents, conducting regular audits, reconciliations, and exception management to ensure data integrity and operational effectiveness.
* Develop and maintain expertise in proxy voting platforms and workflows, supporting the accurate processing of ballots, monitoring voting deadlines, and escalating issues in a timely manner.
* Assist in the development, documentation, and ongoing enhancement of standard operating procedures, controls, and governance frameworks supporting proxy voting operations.
* Support annual SEC regulatory reporting, including Form N-PX, as well as regional regulatory, client, and management reporting requirements.
* Partner closely with internal business teams, Technology, custodians, proxy service providers, and other external stakeholders to ensure the effective operation of proxy voting processes and the timely resolution of operational issues.
* Monitor data quality through reconciliations, exception handling, and maintenance of accurate records and audit trails across all proxy voting activities.
* Help ensure proxy voting activities are conducted in accordance with client mandates, internal policies, and applicable regulatory requirements, escalating discrepancies and risks as appropriate.
* Research and analyze corporate governance and proxy voting trends, policies, and emerging issues, providing insights to support ad-hoc Investment Stewardship projects, reporting, and stakeholder requests.
* Prepare and deliver proxy voting data, analytics, and reporting for internal stakeholders, clients, RFPs, due diligence requests, and broader Investment Stewardship initiatives.
* Collect, analyze, and present ad hoc company and voting data, insights, and statistical information to support strategic projects, client engagement, and decision-making.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing operational efficiency, reporting capabilities, controls, and overall service delivery.
* Utilize analytical tools (SQL, Excel, Python, and visualization tools) to enhance reporting capabilities, process efficiency, and automation opportunities.

  
  
**Experience Qualifications**  

* Master's degree in finance, or related field
* 1-3 years of experience in Capital Markets domain, preferably in Asset Management Industry
* Passing any level of CFA would be added advantage
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines
* Proficiency in data analysis tools, such as SQL, Excel, Python, and data visualization software, is an added advantage.
* Experience and/or Understanding proxy voting and corporate governance is a plus.

  
  
**Skills Competencies**  

* Eager to learn and develop expertise in a specialized operational function.
* Methodical and process-driven, with a strong focus on accuracy and risk awareness.
* Good communicator, comfortable working with internal teams and external counterparties.
* Proactive and self-motivated to learn, with a collaborative team- oriented approach.
* Ability to prioritize effectively during busier periods.

The SAP FICO Solutioning Consultant will support SAP S/4HANA opportunities by translating customer finance priorities into credible, differentiated, and commercially viable solutions. * Address India localization requirements including GST, TDS/withholding tax, e-invoicing, e-way bill, statutory reporting, and SAP Document and Reporting Compliance.
* Develop finance solution narratives, value propositions, process maps, demo storyboards, solution architecture inputs, scope assumptions, exclusions, risks, and differentiators.

* Coordinate with industry, technical, integration, data, analytics, security, delivery, and commercial teams to produce a coherent end-to-end solution.
* Support customer presentations, clarification sessions, solution defense, competitive positioning, due diligence, and deal-closure activities.

  
  

**Preferred candidate profile**

* 1014 years of relevant SAP FICO experience, with strong exposure to SAP S/4HANA Finance.
* **Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) or Cost Accountant/CMA. This is a mandatory requirement.**
* Prior experience in SAP solutioning, proposal development, customer advisory, or a customer-facing lead consulting role is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of finance transformation, accounting, controlling, statutory compliance, internal controls, financial close, and management reporting.

jobs.description:
**What Youll Be Part Of**

The role is responsible for supporting Travel & Entertainment (T&E) transaction processing, auditing employee expense reports, and performing accounting activities in SAP. The position will ensure timely and accurate payment processing for HARMAN entities globally. The resource will work closely with Finance leaders and business stakeholders to ensure accurate accounting, reporting, and period-end closing activities, aligned with HARMANs current and future business requirements. Additionally, the position will support the Finance Manager in managing day-to-day people and process operations across Corporate Travel Accounting, Accounts Payable, and Disbursements functions.

  

**How Youll Make An Impact**

* Review and complete daily Corporate Travel & Entertainment (T&E) and P-Card activities, including expense report auditing, accounting, and payment processing.
* Perform T&E/P-Card reconciliations and ensure accurate accounting and General Ledger (GL) postings.
* Validate receipts, business purpose, cost centers, GL accounts, tax information, and supporting documentation, while maintaining process trackers.
* Ensure timely and accurate SAP postings, including monthly accruals/provisions where applicable.
* Coordinate with cardholders and business stakeholders to resolve exceptions, obtain missing documentation, and ensure timely closure of open items.
* Support month-end closing activities, including accruals, reclassifications, and account reconciliations, while ensuring compliance with timelines and operational KPIs.
* Collaborate with global Finance teams and HARMAN business units to address audit requests, resolve ad hoc issues, and ensure smooth and accurate execution of T&E, P-Card, and related accounting processes.

  

**What Makes You A Strong Fit**

* 3–5 years of accounting experience, preferably across core accounting and shared services environments.
* Hands-on experience in SAP journal entry processing; exposure to SAP S/4HANA is an added advantage.
* Strong understanding of General Accounting principles, processes, and practices.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to effectively collaborate with stakeholders and team members.
* Strong attention to detail, along with the ability to manage multiple priorities and resolve issues effectively.
* We see AI as an important part of how work gets done. While tools may vary, a baseline familiarity with using AI to support efficiency, problem-solving, and quality is expected.

  

**Bonus Points if You Have**

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. A Master’s degree or higher accounting qualification will be an added advantage.
* Strong functional understanding of key Finance areas, including Accounts Payable, Travel & Expense, Disbursements, General Accounting, and Financial Reporting.
* Sound knowledge of accounting principles, with a good understanding of US GAAP and IFRS.
* Certification or specialized training in Expense Audit, Accounts Payable, or Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes is preferred.
* Proficiency in MS Office, with strong hands-on experience in Microsoft Excel.

  

**Things To Know**

* This role is based in Bangalore, India, and follows a hybrid work model with regular in-office collaboration with Corporate Finance, Controlling, Tax, and FP&A teams.
* The position supports global product launch timelines and may require occasional early morning or evening meetings with teams across Europe and the US.
* Occasional domestic and international travel may be required for customer visits, manufacturing locations, and product launch meetings.

Professional working proficiency in English is required for effective day-to-day communication with employees and stakeholders across the US and Europe.

**Role & responsibilities**

Role & Responsibilities Business Development Manager

We are looking for a result-oriented Business Development Manager with 35 years of experience in B2B sales, preferably in the digital marketing, advertising, or IT services industry.

The candidate will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, acquiring clients, building strong business relationships, and driving revenue growth for DIGITALOPS.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. Identify, generate, and develop new business opportunities through outbound calls, LinkedIn, email campaigns, networking, referrals, and other channels.
2. Acquire new clients for DIGITALOPS across services including SEO, Google Ads, PPC, Social Media Marketing, Website Development, and Digital Marketing.
3. Identify potential businesses, decision-makers, and key stakeholders across SMEs, startups, and enterprise segments.
4. Understand client requirements, business objectives, and marketing challenges to recommend suitable digital marketing solutions.
5. Conduct sales presentations, client meetings, and service demonstrations.
6. Prepare business proposals, quotations, presentations, and commercial agreements.
7. Manage the complete sales cycle, from prospecting and lead qualification to negotiation and deal closure.
8. Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline and consistently achieve monthly and quarterly revenue targets.
9. Follow up with prospective clients, negotiate pricing, and convert qualified leads into long-term business relationships.
10. Maintain accurate sales records, lead status, follow-ups, and pipeline updates in the CRM.
11. Coordinate with internal SEO, PPC, creative, and operations teams to ensure smooth client onboarding.
12. Track market trends, competitor activities, and industry opportunities to identify new revenue streams.

**Key Performance Expectations:**

* Consistent new client acquisition.
* Achievement of monthly and quarterly sales targets.
* Strong lead-to-client conversion rate.
* Growth in recurring business revenue.
* Development of long-term B2B client relationships.

  

**Preferred candidate profile**

  

Preferred Candidate Profile

* 3–5 years of experience in Business Development, B2B Sales, Client Acquisition, or Enterprise Sales.
* Prior experience in a Digital Marketing Agency, IT Services, Advertising, or Media industry is highly preferred.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing services, including SEO, Google Ads, PPC, Social Media Marketing, Website Development, and Performance Marketing.
* Proven track record of generating leads, acquiring new clients, managing sales pipelines, and closing B2B deals.
* Experience handling clients across startups, SMEs, and enterprise businesses.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, persuasion, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to independently identify prospects through cold calling, LinkedIn, email outreach, networking, and referrals.
* Experience preparing proposals, conducting client presentations, negotiating commercials, and closing business.
* Familiarity with CRM tools, sales reporting, and pipeline management.
* Self-motivated, target-driven, and capable of working independently to achieve revenue goals.

**Added Advantage:**

* Experience selling digital marketing services to international clients, particularly in the US, UK, Australia, Canada, and Middle East markets.
* Existing B2B network and experience in acquiring high-value clients.
* Understanding of recurring revenue models and monthly retainer-based services.

**Company Website:** https://festivaevents.co.in  
**About Festiva Exhibition & Events Pvt. Ltd.**  
Festiva Exhibition & Events delivers large-scale events and exhibitions where the stakes are high and the margin for error is zero. Recognized by DPIIT and backed by a leadership and technical team with over 100 years of collective industry experience, our firm handles the full arc of turnkey executions from concept and custom spatial fabrication to AV engineering, protocol coordination, hospitality, and on-ground delivery across India, with operations spanning **Delhi,** **Gurgaon,** **Noida, Mumbai, Hyderabad, and Lucknow**.  
Having delivered 250+ events and 70+ large-scale exhibitions (including 100+ events in the last three years), our portfolio spans G20 India 2023 across 30+ locations, BRICS Summit India 2026 summits, 250 Years of US Independence, GS1 General Assembly 2025, Telangana Rising Global Summit, Khelo India, Legends League Cricket, and World Para Athletics 2026. We serve marquee government, institutional, and corporate clients including the Ministry of External Affairs, DPIIT, MeitY, Ministry of Tourism, Government of Telangana, U.S. Embassy in India, Government of Maharashtra, Godrej Properties, Thomas Cook, Mercer, Marsh, Cloudflare, and CEAT.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **New Client Acquisition:** Identify, prospect, and onboard fresh enterprise corporate accounts, diplomatic missions, industry associations, and institutional bodies across **Hyderabad**, for conferences, trade exhibitions, product launches, brand activations, and mega-events.
* **Existing Client Expansion:** Work closely with existing clients to generate repeat mandates, upsell additional event and exhibition scope, and drive sustained account revenue.
* **Pipeline, RFPs & Deal Closure:** Build and manage a strong sales pipeline, lead corporate RFP and tender submissions within deadlines, negotiate commercials while protecting margins, and close deals through to Purchase Order (PO) sign-off.

**Client Servicing**

* **End-to-End Client Servicing:** Act as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts across **Hyderabad** from initial brief intake through commercial closure, ensuring responsive communication and long-term client retention.
* **Brief Decoding & Pitch Alignment:** Translate client objectives into clear creative, 3D spatial, and technical briefs; collaborate with design and estimation teams on pitch decks, BOQs, and cost sheets.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* **Experience:** Minimum **5+ years** of proven experience in Business Development and Client Servicing within an event management, exhibition, MICE, or experiential marketing agency (or closely related field). Candidates with relevant industry experience will be preferred.
* **Track Record:** Demonstrated ability to acquire and onboard new clients, grow existing accounts, and manage end-to-end client relationships across corporate events, exhibitions, or institutional mandates.
* **Regional Network:** Strong existing decision-maker network across corporate, agency, and/or institutional ecosystems in **Hyderabad**.
* **Core Skills:** Persuasive pitch presentation, brief decoding, BOQ/cost-sheet oversight, commercial negotiation, and structured handover to operations teams.
* **Mobility:** Willingness to travel as required for client meetings, pitches, and key engagements.

**Location:** Hyderabad, Telangana (On-site / Hybrid)

  

**Job Type:** Full-Time

  

**Notice Period:** **Immediate Joiners to 7 Days Max**

  

**Target Audience:** **Open to current QA Team Leads OR Senior Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) ready to step into leadership**

  

**Department:** Quality Assurance / Operations

  

**Role Overview**

  

We are looking for a **Quality Assurance Team Lead** to maintain, evaluate, and elevate our performance standards. **This position is ideal for experienced Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) with exceptional communication skills looking to take the next step into leadership**, as well as current QA Leads seeking a fast-paced environment.

In this role, you will act as a benchmark for quality and communication. You will leverage **strong MS Excel skills** to evaluate metrics, uncover trends, facilitate calibration sessions, and deliver high-impact developmental coaching to team members.

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**  

Location: Hyderabad/Bangalore.

Experience: 5 10 years.

Designation: As per OMA.

Employment Type: Full Time

  
  
**Role Overview**  

The Demand and Resource Fulfilment partner will manage the end to end demand, recruitment coordination, candidate selection and onboarding process. The role will work closely with the Client PMO team, Hiring Manager team, RMG, Talent Acquisition, competency leads, CGI SPOCs, ERM focal points and client stakeholders to fulfil critical, niche and high volume requirements within agreed timelines.

The role will be responsible for validating demand, creating Service Orders, coordinating sourcing activities, screening candidates, managing interviews, supporting offer closure and tracking candidates through onboarding and assignment start.

  
  
**Responsibilities**  

* Demand Management and Requirement Gathering
  + Work closely with the Client PMO team to fulfil assigned resource requirements.
  + Gather and understand requirements from PMO SPOCs and client stakeholders.
  + Review demands received through the demand management system and emails from the Hiring Manager team.
  + Assess job descriptions to ensure that mandatory skills, primary skills, experience requirements, role expectations and other essential details are clearly defined.
  + Clarify incomplete or unclear requirements with the client.
  + Attend calibration calls with the client, Talent Acquisition team or external panels to gain a clear understanding of the role requirements.
  + Prioritise and initiate action on critical and time sensitive demands.
  + Arrange requirement clarification calls for critical demands where required.
* Service Order Creation and Demand Externalisation
  + Create Service Orders for roles with complete and actionable job descriptions.
  + Match new demands with existing Sales Orders based on skill alignment.
  + Coordinate with the RMG team to ensure that roles are externalised within 24 hours.
  + Share externalised demands and corresponding Service Order numbers with the Talent Acquisition team.
  + Provide recruiters with complete requirement details, including skills, experience, location, notice period and role expectations.
* Internal Resource Review
  + Review the internal resource pool to identify suitable candidates.
  + Screen internal profiles against the demand requirements.
  + Coordinate with competency leads to validate profiles before client submission.
  + Identify and communicate any profile improvements required before submission.
  + Screen both internal and external profiles before sharing them with the client.
* Sourcing and Candidate Assessment
  + Own the end to end sourcing strategy for critical, niche and high volume requirements.
  + Source suitable candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, employee referrals, job portals and other relevant channels.
  + Conduct detailed candidate discussions to assess: Technical suitability Relevant experience and skills Career aspirations Compensation expectations Notice period Location and work model preferences Joining availability Competing offers and other employment considerations.
  + Maintain accurate candidate records and ensure that profiles meet the required quality standards before submission.
* Interview Management
  + Manage the complete interview lifecycle, including scheduling, coordination, follow ups and feedback collection.
  + Arrange L1 interviews with the relevant interview panels.
  + Coordinate interview slots between recruiters, panels and the designated CGI SPOC.
  + Coordinate client interviews for candidates who successfully complete the L1 stage.
  + Work with the Client Hiring Manager focal point to schedule interviews across all required skillsets.
  + Arrange managerial round interviews after the candidate is shortlisted by the client.
  + Track interview outcomes and ensure that feedback is collected and recorded promptly.
* Client Submission and Selection
  + Move shortlisted candidates forward to the client for the relevant role.
  + Ensure candidate profiles are uploaded to the correct Job IDs.
  + Share submitted profiles with the ERM focal point and other relevant stakeholders.
  + Coordinate with the client SPOC throughout the selection process.
  + Maintain accurate records of candidate status, interview outcomes and selection decisions.
* Offer Management
  + Manage the offer lifecycle from candidate selection through offer acceptance.
  + Validate candidate compensation, expected CTC, notice period, joining date and competing offers.
  + Conduct compensation discussions and negotiations with candidates.
  + Partner with internal stakeholders to secure the necessary approvals.
  + Coordinate with the Talent Acquisition team for offer release.
  + Track offer acceptance, joining commitments and potential risks.
* Candidate Engagement and Joining Management
  + Take complete ownership of candidates from offer acceptance until joining.
  + Maintain regular communication with candidates throughout the notice period.
  + Build and maintain strong candidate relationships.
  + Proactively address candidate concerns and remove barriers to joining.
  + Track joining risks, counteroffers, notice period issues and changes in candidate availability.
  + Provide regular updates to the relevant stakeholders until the candidate joins.
* Work Order, Onboarding and JML Coordination
  + Coordinate with the CGI SPOC to collect and share onboarding details after final candidate selection.
  + Initiate and track the work order process.
  + Monitor work order activation in SAP Fieldglass, which generally takes 8-10 days.
  + Track the Joiner, Mover and Leaver process initiated by the client.
  + Follow up regularly with the CGI SPOC and other stakeholders until completion.
  + Coordinate SOW based onboarding, including: Approval from the PA Owner Alignment with CGI Addition of the candidate to the relevant PA
  + Track client laptop provisioning and system access setup, which generally takes 4-5 working days.
  + Confirm that all required onboarding activities are completed before the assignment start date.
* Assignment Start Readiness
  + Confirm that the candidate is ready to commence the assignment once:
  + The work order is approved and active in SAP Fieldglass.
  + Required client assets have been provisioned and received.
  + Required system access has been completed.
  + JML activities have been completed.
  + The candidate's start date has been confirmed with the client and internal stakeholders.
* Reporting and Stakeholder Coordination
  + Coordinate with the Client PMO team, Hiring Manager team, RMG, Talent Acquisition, competency leads, CGI SPOCs, ERM focal points, interview panels and client stakeholders.
  + Maintain accurate demand, recruitment, resource management and people management trackers.
  + Provide regular updates on: Demand status Service Orders Externalisation progress Candidate pipeline Interview status Offers and acceptance Work orders Onboarding and JML progress Joining risks
  + Ensure all recruitment and onboarding information is updated accurately and on time.

  
  
**Key Skills and Experience**  

* Experience in demand management, resource fulfilment, recruitment coordination or talent acquisition operations.
* Experience managing critical, niche and high volume requirements.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience coordinating with PMO, Hiring Manager, RMG, TA and delivery teams.
* Knowledge of candidate sourcing through LinkedIn, Naukri, referrals and job portals.
* Experience managing interviews, candidate feedback, offers and joining processes.
* Understanding of Service Orders, Sales Orders, work orders and SOW based onboarding.
* Experience using SAP Fieldglass or similar workforce management platforms.
* Strong understanding of candidate engagement and notice period management.

jobs.title: Senior Application Transition Manager
jobs.description:
This is a high-impact leadership role for a Transition Managerwho is ready to shape the future of application transitions — combining deep delivery expertise with AI-powered innovation to redefine how complex global IT services are handed over, stabilized, and scaled.

We are looking for a seasoned **Application Transition Manager** to lead end-to-end planning, solutioning, and execution of complex, multi-service managed services, application development, and support/maintenance transitions. This role sits at the intersection of delivery leadership, AI-powered modernization, and enterprise-scale program governance.

The ideal candidate brings deep hands-on experience in transitioning large application development/support portfolios — including custom-built, packaged, and cloud-native applications — and is fluent in harnessing AI tools, automation, and intelligent accelerators to compress timelines, reduce risk, and elevate transition quality.

You will operate as the single accountable owner across pre-sales solutioning and live execution, partnering closely with the client, delivery towers, and incumbent vendors to deliver a seamless transition to steady-state operations.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Independently design and own transition solutions for complex outsourcing pursuits across multi-vendor, multi-geo, multi-stack, multi-service (Apps, Infra, Security, Automation, Cloud) environments
* Define transition strategy, milestone frameworks, resource models, and success KPIs for RFP/RFI/SOW responses and contract negotiations
* Defend the proposed transition solutions and execution approaches to senior Client stakeholders / C-suite audiences (Orals)
* Design AI-powered transition solutions using GenAI-based knowledge extraction, automated documentation generation, and intelligent codebase discovery to accelerate solutioning timelines
* Leverage AI estimating models and effort prediction tools to build data-driven transition business cases and risk-adjusted transition plans during pre-sales
* Lead transitions of 100+ applications spanning custom development, microservices, APIs, data platforms, ERP/CRM systems, and cloud-native workloads
* Manage all transition phases: Knowledge Acquisition Shadow Reverse Shadow Parallel Run Stabilization (Hypercare) BAU Handover
* Oversee structured code and architecture discovery activities — codebase walkthroughs, dependency mapping, tech-debt assessment, and environment cataloging
* Ensure delivery of all transition artifacts: SOPs, Runbooks, Application Passports, Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), RACI matrices, and operational documentation
* Manage Knowledge Acquisition sessions across development teams (onshore/offshore), ensuring structured capture of tribal knowledge, design rationale, and undocumented dependencies
* Deploy AI-based code analysis tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, CodeScene, SonarQube AI) to accelerate codebase understanding, surface tech debt, and auto-generate inline documentation during Knowledge Acquisition
* Use GenAI-powered documentation tools to auto-draft SOPs, Runbooks, and Application Passports from discovery sessions, reducing documentation effort by up to 40%
* Apply AI-driven dependency mapping tools to visualize application interdependencies, integration touchpoints, and data flows across complex portfolios
* Establish and chair Transition Governance Forums — weekly/bi-weekly SteerCos, RAID reviews, milestone checkpoint meetings, and executive reporting cadences
* Maintain a real-time Transition Dashboard tracking milestones, knowledge transfer completion, risk status, team readiness scores, and go-live criteria
* Drive RAID log management (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) and proactively resolve blockers impacting transition timelines
* Manage 50+ active stakeholders — client executives, product owners, architects, vendor leads, and delivery managers — across multiple geographies
* Use AI-powered project analytics tools and NLP-based status reporting to auto-generate executive dashboards and transition health summaries
* Define and execute Go-Live Readiness Criteria encompassing access provisioning, monitoring setup, SLA framework validation, on-call rota, and escalation paths
* Lead structured Hypercare operations post-go-live: stabilization sprints, defect triage, performance baselining, and SLA attainment tracking
* Ensure tooling readiness: ITSM (ServiceNow), observability stack (Dynatrace, Splunk, Datadog), CMDB accuracy, and alerting configuration
* Integrate AIOps capabilities (anomaly detection, predictive alerting) during Hypercare to proactively surface risks before they escalate to incidents
* Use ML-based SLA prediction models to benchmark incoming team performance trajectories and forecast BAU stabilization timelines

**Requirements**

* 12–18 years of IT industry experience with significant tenure leading enterprise Application Transition programs
* Minimum 8 years of hands-on experience transitioning Application Development portfolios within Managed Services or IT Outsourcing environments
* Proven track record managing transitions of 200+ FTEs and 100+ applications across multi-geo delivery models
* Hands-on exposure to AI tools and automation platforms used across the transition lifecycle (code analysis, documentation generation, test automation, AIOps)
* Experience managing transitions in Agile, SAFe, Waterfall, and Hybrid delivery models; able to adapt governance to match client maturity
* Demonstrated ability to manage 50+ active stakeholders, including CXOs, Product Owners, Architects, and Vendor Leads
* Strong pre-sales experience: RFP/RFI responses, SOW development, contract reviews, and client oral presentations
* Exposure to multi-domain transitions covering Application Development, Application Support, Data & Analytics, and Integration platforms

**Nice to have**

* Skills in DevOps and CI/CD Migration/Management
* Proficiency in AIOps and Observability
* Background in GenAI Tooling for Development, Prompt Engineering, and AI-driven Code Analysis Tools
* Experience in Cloud Transition (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Certifications such as Anthropic Claude Certified Architect, PMP/PRINCE2 Practitioner, ITIL Foundation/Managing Professional, SAFe Agilist (SA) or SAFe Program Consultant (SPC), AWS/Azure/GCP Cloud Practitioner or Associate, or GitHub Copilot / relevant AI/ML practitioner certifications

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Engineer
jobs.description:
**ABOUT ELEVANCE HEALTH**

Elevance Health is a leading health company in America dedicated to improving lives and communities and making healthcare simpler. It is the largest managed health care company in the Blue Cross Blue Shield (BCBS) Association serving more than 112 million lives across 14 states.

A regular in **Fortune** 500 list, **Elevance Health** ranked **20** in 2022. Gail Boudreaux, President and CEO of Elevance Health has been a consistent name in the Fortune list of most powerful women and currently holds 4th rank on this list.

**ABOUT CARELON**

Carelon Global Solutions (CGS) is a healthcare solutions company that is simplifying complex operational processes to improve the health of the healthcare system.

Previously known as Legato Health Technologies, Carelon Global Solutions (hereinafter, CGS) underwent a name change and joined the Carelon family of brands in January 2023, as a fully owned subsidiary of Elevance Health *(Previously Anthem Inc.).* CGS brings together a global team of like-minded innovators who manage and optimize operational processes for health plans as well as providers.

Our brightest minds housed across our global headquarters in Indianapolis as well as Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Gurugram in India, Manila in the Philippines, Limerick in Ireland and San Juan in Puerto Rico bring with them innovative capabilities and an unmatched depth of experience. This global team uniquely positions CGS to enable scalable, next-generation platforms and specialized digital tools that make healthcare operations more practical, effective and efficient.

**OUR MISSION & VALUES**

**Our Mission:** Improving Lives and Communities. Simplifying Healthcare. Expecting More.  
 **Our Values:** Leadership | Community | Integrity | Agility | Diversity

**JOB POSITION**

**JOB RESPONSIBILITY**

* Develop and maintain microservice architecture and API management solutions using REST and gRPC for seamless deployment of AI solutions.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including data scientists and product managers, to acquire, process, and manage data for AI/ML model integration and optimization.
* Design and implement robust, scalable, and enterprise-grade data pipelines to support state-of-the-art AI/ML models.
* Debug, optimize, and enhance machine learning models, ensuring quality assurance and performance improvements.
* Familiarity with tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, and Pulumi for efficient infrastructure management.
* Create and manage CI/CD pipelines using Git-based platforms (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins) to ensure streamlined development workflows.
* Operate container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes, with advanced configurations and service mesh implementations, for scalable ML workload deployments.
* Design and build scalable LLM inference architectures, employing GPU memory optimization techniques and model quantization for efficient deployment.
* Engage in advanced prompt engineering and fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs), focusing on semantic retrieval and chatbot development.
* Document model architectures, hyperparameter optimization experiments, and validation results using version control and experiment tracking tools like MLflow or DVC.
* Research and implement cutting-edge LLM optimization techniques, such as quantization and knowledge distillation, ensuring efficient model performance and reduced computational costs.
* Collaborate closely with stakeholders to develop innovative and effective natural language processing solutions, specializing in text classification, sentiment analysis, and topic modeling.
* Design and execute rigorous A/B tests for machine learning models, analyzing results to drive strategic improvements and decisions.
* Stay up-to-date with industry trends and advancements in AI technologies, integrating new methodologies and frameworks to continually enhance the AI engineering function.
* Contribute to creating specialized AI solutions in healthcare, leveraging domain-specific knowledge for task adaptation and deployment.

**QUALIFICATION**

**Minimum education: Bachelors degree in any Engineering Stream**  
 **Specialized training, certifications, and/or other special requirements: Nice to have**  
 **Preferred education: Computer Science/Engineering.**

**EXPERIENCE**

**Minimum relevant experience - 6+ years in AI Engineering**   
 **Preferred total experience – 8 years**

**SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES**

**Technical Skills:**

* Advanced proficiency in Python with expertise in data science libraries (NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn) and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow)
* Extensive experience with LLM frameworks (Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain) and prompt engineering techniques
* Experience with big data processing using Spark for large-scale data analytics
* Version control and experiment tracking using Git and MLflow
* **Software Engineering & Development:** Advanced proficiency in Python, familiarity with Go or Rust, expertise in microservices, test-driven development, and concurrency processing.
* **DevOps & Infrastructure:** Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation), CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins), and container orchestration (Kubernetes) with Helm and service mesh implementations.
* **LLM Infrastructure & Deployment:** Proficiency in LLM serving platforms such as vLLM and FastAPI, model quantization techniques, and vector database management.
* **MLOps & Deployment: Utilization** of containerization strategies for ML workloads, experience with model serving tools like TorchServe or TF Serving, and automated model retraining.
* **Cloud & Infrastructure:** Strong grasp of advanced cloud services (AWS, GCP, Azure) and network security for ML systems.
* **LLM Project Experience:** Expertise in developing chatbots, recommendation systems, translation services, and optimizing LLMs for performance and security.
* **General Skills:** Python, SQL, knowledge of machine learning frameworks (Hugging Face, TensorFlow, PyTorch), and experience with cloud platforms like AWS or GCP.
* Experience in creating LLD for the provided architecture.
* Experience working in **microservices** based architecture.

**Domain Expertise:**

* Strong mathematical foundation in statistics, probability, linear algebra, and optimization
* Deep understanding of ML and LLM development lifecycle, including fine-tuning and evaluation
* Expertise in feature engineering, embedding optimization, and dimensionality reduction
* Advanced knowledge of A/B testing, experimental design, and statistical hypothesis testing
* Experience with RAG systems, vector databases, and semantic search implementation
* Proficiency in LLM optimization techniques including quantization and knowledge distillation
* Understanding of MLOps practices for model deployment and monitoring
