jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Data & AI Engineer

**Job Title:** Data & AI Engineer  
**Reports To:** IT Director  
**Location:** India Remote  
**Employment Type:** Permanent, Full-Time  
**Salary:** Up to 20 LPA

Role Purpose

The Data & AI Engineer will be responsible for the end-to-end development, deployment and management of automated AI workflows and tools. The role involves identifying business opportunities, designing suitable AI solutions, building them using Microsoft Foundry and the wider Microsoft technology stack, deploying them into production, and ensuring they operate reliably and securely.

The role will also involve developing and supporting the Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse in collaboration with the Lead Data Engineer.

Key Responsibilities

1. Ownership of AI Workflows and Tools

* Take end-to-end ownership of AI workflows, agents and tools in production, covering requirements gathering, design, development, release, support and retirement.
* Maintain a register of AI solutions covering purpose, ownership, data used, models, costs, risk ratings and support arrangements.
* Monitor model consumption and Azure expenditure, optimising model selection, prompts and architecture to manage operational costs.
* Manage model and platform changes, including version upgrades, deprecations and regression testing, ensuring system reliability.

2. Solution Design

* Work with business process owners to evaluate AI use cases based on business value, feasibility and risk, and translate approved use cases into solution designs.
* Select appropriate approaches, including deterministic automation, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), single-agent and multi-agent orchestration.
* Design human-in-the-loop checkpoints, exception handling and fallback mechanisms for workflows involving orders, customers, suppliers and financial data.
* Define integration approaches with core business systems and the Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse.
* Ensure solutions comply with IT governance and approval processes.

3. Development

* Build and deploy AI agents and workflows using Microsoft Foundry, including Foundry Agent Service, Foundry Models and hosted agents, using Microsoft Agent Framework (Python or .NET).
* Develop and orchestrate end-to-end business process automations.
* Build and integrate tools using Model Context Protocol (MCP) and REST APIs.
* Develop document and data extraction solutions for sales orders, supplier documents and other business documents using Azure AI Document Intelligence and LLM-based extraction.
* Follow software engineering best practices, including Git source control, CI/CD using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, and Infrastructure as Code.

4. Support and Operations

* Provide second- and third-level technical support for AI workflows and tools, resolving incidents within agreed service levels.
* Implement monitoring and observability through tracing, logging, alerting and evaluation dashboards to track quality, latency, accuracy and costs.
* Conduct continuous evaluation using defined test sets, monitor accuracy over time and address model performance drift.
* Prepare technical documentation, operational runbooks and handover materials to enable effective first-level support by the Applications Support team.

5. Data Platform – Microsoft Fabric

* Develop and support the Microsoft Fabric Medallion Lakehouse architecture (Bronze, Silver and Gold layers) in collaboration with the Lead Data Engineer.
* Work on data pipelines, notebooks using PySpark and SQL, Dataflows and semantic models.
* Build and maintain curated data products that support AI workflows, ensuring data quality and lineage.
* Follow established CI/CD processes, deployment pipelines and workspace standards.
* Support Power BI semantic models and reporting requirements related to AI use cases.

6. Security, Governance and Responsible AI

* Implement least-privilege access using Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities and Azure Key Vault.
* Follow data governance standards covering data ownership, classification, access controls and Microsoft Purview.
* Configure AI guardrails and content safety measures to prevent prompt injection, data leakage and excessive agent permissions.
* Maintain audit trails covering AI agent activities, data usage and actions performed on behalf of users.

7. Adoption and Enablement

* Work directly with business users across the UK, USA and India to understand business processes and drive adoption of developed solutions.
* Stay updated with evolving AI technologies and Microsoft platforms and identify practical opportunities for continuous improvement.

Skills and Experience

Essential Requirements

* Minimum 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering or Automation.
* At least 1–2 years of hands-on experience building and running LLM-based solutions in production.
* Practical experience with Microsoft Foundry (formerly Azure AI Foundry) or Azure OpenAI, including AI agents, prompt engineering, retrieval and evaluation.
* Strong programming skills in Python. Working knowledge of C# / .NET will be an advantage.
* Experience integrating business systems using REST APIs, OData APIs and event-driven automation tools such as Logic Apps, Azure Functions or Power Automate.
* Strong knowledge of SQL and data modelling.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, Databricks or Azure Synapse.
* Experience with Git, CI/CD and structured software engineering practices.
* Understanding of AI security risks and their mitigation.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts and trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

Desirable Skills

* Experience with Microsoft Agent Framework.
* Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and tool development.
* Copilot Studio and Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility.
* Azure AI Document Intelligence or similar document extraction technologies.
* Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central data model and APIs.
* Experience in manufacturing, distribution or supply chain domains, including Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay and Inventory Management.
* Relevant certifications:

+ Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102 or successor).
+ Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer (DP-700).

**Interested candidates with hands-on experience in Generative AI, Azure OpenAI, AI Agents and Microsoft Fabric are encouraged to apply.**

* **Front-End Analytics:** Implement advanced Set Analysis, calculated dimensions, and custom expressions to power dynamic KPI tracking.

* **BI & Data Modeling:** Solid understanding of BI fundamentals, ETL workflows, data warehousing, and dimensional modeling (Star/Snowflake schemas).
* **Qlik Core Skills:** Working knowledge of Qlik Set Analysis, QVD architecture, and incremental loading strategies.
* **Communication:** Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills to translate business requirements into clean technical solutions.

  

**Good-to-Have Skills**
